reviews.author: Blake
reviews.title: The Team That Keeps Us Coming Back
reviews.text:
A huge thank you to Aria R., Jayden, and Austin at The Canal Club, and Ryan and Hayden at the front desk. They absolutely made this trip. Their attention to detail, incredible recommendations, genuine hospitality, and amazing personalities transformed our stay from excellent into an unforgettable experience.

The Scott Resort & Spa is a beautiful property, but what truly makes it exceptional is the people. From the moment we arrived, every interaction was warm, thoughtful, and effortless. The team consistently went above and beyond, anticipating our needs and making us feel genuinely welcomed and appreciated throughout our stay.

Every time we visit, we’re reminded why we keep coming back. The combination of an incredible atmosphere, outstanding service, and a staff that truly cares creates an experience that is difficult to match.

Thank you again to Aria R., Jayden, Austin, Ryan, and Hayden for making this stay so memorable. You are a tremendous credit to The Scott Resort & Spa, and we can’t wait to return.

reviews.author: Kristine L
reviews.title: High end resort!
reviews.text: Great resort! I loved the location. Close enough to Old Scottsdale where all the unique shops, restaurant and history is. Resort was high end feel, accommodating and clean. It was easy to get to all activities from here. They have a great pool area but unfortunately we were there the only cool days that were in April. I would  love to go back.

reviews.author: David R
reviews.title: Scammed out of $1,000
reviews.text: Where do I start! We got scammed out of $1,000 on this trip to the Scott. We had a 3 day reservation and after only 1 night we had a death in the family that resulted in us leaving 2 days early. I spoke to the manager at the front desk and he was compassionate and said our money would be refunded for the 2 unused nights. After we were home for several weeks I noticed that the refund did not appear on our charge card statement. After a lengthy investigation I discovered that the refund went to Priceline.com and that even though the website we used to make the reservations clearly looked like the Scott Hotel and the operator presented herself as a representative of that hotel it clearly was not. This is where I blame The Scott Hotel! They clearly are in bed with these scam booking agencies that act like hotels. I filed a claim to get my refund from Guest Reservations who used Priceline to make the reservation. That website pops up first on google and you cannot tell the difference. Priceline wanted a simple letter from The Scott and that turned out to be a problem. I called the hotel many times asking to speak to  manager about this but did not get a return call. The Scott was absolutely no help at all. I see on there website that they are not endorsed by the BBB nor do they list any names and or email to contact anyone, they simply do not want to help! I'm out a thousand bucks. Thanks Scott Hotel!

reviews.author: Cathy H
reviews.title: Relaxing long weekend - would definitely recommend!
reviews.text: Staff was great with excellent service, from the pool to the spa to the restaurant. Food was very good.

reviews.author: Norma M
reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: Nice place but too expensive and forget about getting a glass of wine $24 for a glass filled 1/2 way.  Food also was not that good.

reviews.author: Marisa W
reviews.title: Needs one of the pools designated to adults. Sewage smelling room
reviews.text: This resort could be 5 stars. Avid traveler here...The decor, music and vibe is nice, however where it misses the mark is there should be a designated pool for families with kids and one for adults trying to relax. As I sit here poolside now, its hard to relax when parents let there kids use the pool like there own personal pool throwing footballs as people are trying to just relax and read books or wade in pool to also the annoying sound of Marco polo. There are two pools. Make one adults only. Many guests we encountered felt the same. Children should be able to play in the pool, but be respectful of guests trying to relax and not be hit with footballs. A simple fix would be a family friendly pool and an adults only. Another lack was our poolside room got worse each day of sewage smell that hit you when you opened the door. We complained and maintenance came and just sprayed and said it was due to older plumbing.  We paid a premium here and should not have to sleep in a room that smells like sewer and musky smell! Such a disappointment because this place has the opportunity to be perfection with some changes. We did like the complementary shuttle. Would love to come back, if these changes were made.

reviews.author: Em T
reviews.title: Not what we were expecting for price point
reviews.text:
Not what we were expecting for the price point. This hotel had cool vibe but was lacking in quality of food and overall experience.  The pool was nice and we liked our balcony view.  But the hotel room smelled of musty dog urine and there was a French fry on the carpet. The staff was nice, except for one of the front desk receptionist.  Food was okay, not exciting tasting. We appreciated the free shuttle service. 
Overall we wouldn't stay here again.

reviews.author: Monique W
reviews.title: Stay at The Scott
reviews.text: The Reaort grounds are beautiful and the pools are nice. Our furst room was dark overlooking some gravel and I complained as I had asked for poolside or pool view. The next day I was moved and the difference in light was night and day. From depressing to beautiful. The balcony overlooked the pool area and was much brighter. Room cleaning service was amazing but the food service on the restaurant was hit and miss. One morning I got up 5 times to ask for more coffee, jam, the toast thy forgot and so on. The manager saw me getting up and didn't offer me anything or say sorry . I went to the front desk and complained and the hotel manager said he would take care of the breakfast but at checkout today the breakfast was still on there. They did of course comp it but glad I checked. Overall a nice hotel but expect service by the pool or in the restaurant to be hit and miss.

reviews.author: Jk68
reviews.title: Best deep tissue massage!
reviews.text: My husband and I went to the spa for massages. He got a Swedish massage which he liked a lot but I got a few tissue massage by Briana and omg it was the BEST deep tissue massage I’ve ever gotten. I like a lot of pressure and she 100% delivered. I feel so relaxed now!

reviews.author: Susan
reviews.title: Lovely Hotel with Character and Ambiance.
reviews.text:
Lovely hotel. The first thing you notice is the 1956 BelAir in the front courtyard and the unique  character continues to flow reflected in every detail throughout. Greeted with a lobby that smelled beautiful with their signature spa scent and fresh cold beverage station..
Staff were wonderful, especially the gentlemen at the front who coordinated the complementary transportation. Pool cleaners, gardeners, housekeepers all greeted us with smiles and a hello.
Rooms are clean, comfortable with all amenities.
Pool and hot tub were perfect temperatures and lounge chairs comfortable. We ordered a drink at the lobby bar and enjoyed the ambiance.
A wonderful experience. It loses a star for the high prices. Our 2 drinks, wine and martini, were $50 US which is rather steep. Mornings coffees were $8 US each. We dined off the resort to explore local eateries. Also found having to use keycard several times to get to our room was a bit of an inconvenience. (At pool entry, at hall entry, at room entry)

reviews.author: Caroline M
reviews.title: Excellent Getaway
reviews.text:
This hotel and staff are truly top-notch. From the moment you arrive, the team delivers a true white-glove experience and makes you feel exceptionally well cared for.

I stayed for four days while attending a conference, and unlike most conference hotels where food can be hit or miss, the dining here was outstanding. Every meal was fresh, thoughtfully prepared, and absolutely delicious, with great variety and quality throughout the stay.

I was so impressed that I’m already planning to return with my family for a long weekend getaway. Highly recommend.

OH and they have a shuttle that will take you around up to a 3 mile radius. See what I mean?  Yeah you should go!

reviews.author: Shannon S
reviews.title: Fabulous Spa at The Scott
reviews.text: I had an absolutely wonderful massage experience at The Scott with Angela. From the moment I arrived, everything felt calm, welcoming, and thoughtfully done. Angela is incredibly skilled. She listened carefully to what I needed and tailored the massage perfectly. Her touch was both relaxing and effective, and I left feeling completely refreshed, loose, and re-centered. You can tell she truly cares about her clients and her craft. This was hands-down one of the best massages I’ve had, and I can’t wait to come back. Highly recommend Angela at The Scott!

reviews.author: jennamack
reviews.text:
There were some really good parts but mostly it wasn’t worth the price.

Location is good—walkable to lots of shopping, restaurants, etc. Ubers and Waymo readily available. But the hotel has a shuttle that will drive you anywhere in a 3 mile radius. We found this out on last day.

When we checked in we were not made aware of shuttle or any other amenities. We found gym on our own and it was nice. Food at restaurants was good. 

Do not under any circumstances accept an even numbered room in the Agua Dulce building if you’d like to sleep past 5:30am. The staff are dragging carts in front of that building constantly from 5:30-7:30am. We stayed 3 nights, and were consistently woken up by this. 

The door men were really nice as was the pool bartender. Pools are allegedly heated but the water was freezing.

reviews.author: Stephanie W
reviews.title: Very nice, but not worth the price paid.
reviews.text: Very nice, but i wouldn't say worth the price.  The lobby is gorgeous! the pool area - gorgeous, although the pool is FREEZING and don't expect to get a lot of sun as the palm trees make it pretty shaded in most areas which is either good or bad.  (We are from WI so wanted all the sun we could get).  The room - which was just a standard room, was pretty...standard.  Cuban decor was neat and lovely but all in all, it was a rather small, ordinary room.  Small bathroom, low ceilings, mini bar that i didn't dare take anything from.  Not worth the $650/night.  For that amount, i would expect near luxury.  We were only there for 1 night so we didn't take part in a lot of amenities. Great location though.   I will say - we got there early and they let us check in almost 4 hours early which was very much appreciated!

reviews.author: ramitay
reviews.title: Disappointing facilities and staff for an expensive night's stay
reviews.text: Upon checking in, I asked for a quiet, well-placed room.  We were put in a street-facing room in the pets building, so street noise and dogs barking early am.   Upon inquiring about moving was told it was a $60 up-charge to change rooms: I had booked a patio room and nowhere does it say that patios are street facing - the resort is just off the highway exit.  We had dead plants in our back patio area, the lighting from the back patio shone brightly and directly into our room.  The furniture was scratched, the phone keypad was mangled.  Then to the pool area - upon arrival there were no open seats or if there were, they were covered in used towels (we arrived on a Friday afternoon).  There are no tables upon which to place your drink and there were plastic drink cups strewn around on the ground.  So, not well maintained, check in staff not listening or accommodating.  Had high hopes and at every turn dashed.  Not an inexpensive resort - should have stayed at the Biltmore but was trying to branch out.

reviews.author: Lori G
reviews.title: Woot woot!!! Girls trip!!!
reviews.text: The decor and grounds are stunning. Pool is cooler than I expected. They have bicycles to use for free. The free shuttle is PRICELESS!!!! There was an event and they closed the pool early 1 day-but no one warned us—and then they closed the pool an hour earlier than posted-

reviews.author: meg
reviews.title: 60th Birthday celebration.
reviews.text:
Booked a weekend for my husband’s 60th birthday.  Spent extensive time with the hotel to make sure that there would be champagne on ice waiting for him in the room.  I called ahead of time to double check, and was told that there was nothing set to be delivered to the room.  

After another 10 minutes on the phone with them, they corrected themselves and assured me that it would be there waiting.  

As we arrived, I saw a room service person rush into and drop off a WARM bottle of champagne on the credenza and then leave as we were standing outside of the room.  I had to grab a bucket, and go find an ice machine, and chill it myself.  Not the great surprise that I had planned for my husband.

Also, the shower was disgusting, and pooled water.  

We will not be going back.

reviews.author: sjn1587
reviews.title: Great spot
reviews.text:
During our recent stay, we had the pleasure of interacting with Jon, who worked both at the front drop-off area and as the shuttle driver. From the moment we arrived, Jon was friendly, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable about the local area. He gave us great recommendations for places to eat and must-see attractions around Scottsdale.

Beyond just providing helpful tips, Jon was a delight to chat with, making our ride to and from various spots in the city enjoyable and informative. He even helped us with our luggage, going above and beyond to ensure we felt welcomed and comfortable.

If you're staying here, I highly recommend requesting Jon. His dedication to making sure guests have a fantastic experience truly sets him apart. Thanks, Jon, for making our trip even more memorable!

reviews.author: cindi c
reviews.title: Don't do it!
reviews.text: The Estancia wing of this resort has a horrible host of loud bangs, bams, knocks, etc. that goes on all night long. It is 3:30am and  the noises haven't stopped once. This is our 3rd night and  each night brought the same experience👎.

reviews.author: wavelength2014
reviews.title: Old and Trendy?
reviews.text: Cute hotel! It's very old and outdated but has a trendy vibe. The drinks are expensive. We thought about ordering coffee in the morning with room service. We were shocked and horrified to learn there's a 25% service charge PLUS $5:00 delivery charge! The rooms are just okay, outdated but clean. We were facing the parking lot. The best rooms overlook the pool area. It's a vibe you either like or don't! For the price, you can definitely get nicer with more affordable prices. The staff are amazing

reviews.author: Deionlopez2
reviews.title: darling, but spendy
reviews.text: AMAZING VIBE!! Cutest hotel and bar! Great location, pricy drinks! My husband got a beer and I had coctail and bill was 48$!! Hotel has the cutest bikes to rent, the cutest pools and decor. Definatley coming back!!

reviews.author: Vince B
reviews.title: Great Place for a Reunion
reviews.text: I stayed with my wife for my high school reunion. The facility is well maintained and accommodated our 200 plus attendees with plenty of indoor and outdoor spaces for gathering. The food was excellent. The staff is very professional and courteous. We enjoyed our stay. It was nice to see they were doing painting and maintenance on some rooms keeping the facility in good condition.

reviews.author: Riley B
reviews.title: Canal Club
reviews.text: The canal club was so cute and the service was amazing! Our server, Elaine, made us feel right at home. She was attentive, kind, and did an amazing job! Will definitely be coming again!

reviews.author: Goober818
reviews.title: It's a pretty nice place
reviews.text: Beautifully re-done mid-century hotel with several different wings, multiple large pools (including with a sandy beach entry), restaurant, bar and beautiful lobby. Very friendly staff, nice rooms, comfortable beds. Clientele was kind iffy - if you're looking to party with friends - this is your place, if you're looking to relax with your significant other, it might not be a great fit. A lot of thongs (and I don't mean shoes) and intoxicated people at the pool. That's not the hotel's fault but if that's not your scene, might want to look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Heather
reviews.title: Nice resort with great bar and food
reviews.text: Nice resort, old Havana, Cuba vibe. Room was spacious with a generous seating area and comfortable bed. All rooms seem to have a patio or balcony, some overlooking the pool. We asked for a quiet room, away from the pool, but were very disappointed that the noisy tree trimmers with their loud equipment started before 7:00 am right outside our window!  Nice bar in the large lobby with a great bartender, Zac. All of the tapas food that we ordered was delicious (ceviche, tostones and jerk chicken skewers). Two small but nice pools with a poolside bar. One pool even had a small sandy beach area. Plenty of shady spots to sit by the pool. Except for the tree trimmers, it was a nice stay.

reviews.author: Maria A
reviews.title: Excellent service from Aria!
reviews.text: Aria was the best bar tender ever! She nade us feel like home. Cheyenne the chef was so kind tgat she even came out to greet us thanks to aria! Best guest experience thanks to them!

reviews.author: kwpNJ
reviews.title: Mixed Experience
reviews.text: The hotel has a beautiful lobby and the staff were very nice but it is lacking in other areas.  The pool had leaves and twigs every day of our stay.  They were trimming the trees but didn't clean the pool afterwards,  A manager came by and apologized but it still didn't get clean, The food we had at the Canal Club was good but the menu is limited.  The rooms have espresso machines but if you want a regular cup of coffee it will cost you $6 at the restaurant.

reviews.author: Susie M
reviews.title: Trendy Spot Close to Downtown
reviews.text:
We were in town for a wedding in Phoenix and decided to stay at this boutique hotel within walking distance of downtown. It's important to note that room location makes a big difference. We were given a drab first floor room facing the main road, so it was impossible to sit outside without hearing the rush of traffic. Our room was small but comfy enough for a 3 day stay. The lobby is really pretty and bar area decent for a hotel. I was working remotely and the Wi-Fi and desk area in the room was adequate enough for what I needed. We used the gym several times and the area was clean with relatively new equipment and a Peloton. 

Of note, this hotel seems to cater to bachelorette parties (because of the spa and pool area) and corporate retreats. During our stay, there was a very large company on site as well as a bachelorette party. Both of these groups occupied most of the bar/lounge area in the evening and the pool area during the day. Not a negative but just a comment for those seeking a more peaceful stay ~ you might encounter large groups at this property.

reviews.author: Jaiden R
reviews.title: 10/10 will be back
reviews.text: Came here on my bachelorette and had an incredible time. The resort is so cute and everyone on the property is so nice. The pool is beautiful. Ryley was our server and was amazing. Make sure to get an espresso martini from The Canal Club! Will be back! 💕

reviews.author: Shannon
reviews.title: Gem in the middle of a city
reviews.text:
This was our first trip to AZ and The Scott was the perfect place to stay. I would rate it a 4 1/2, but unable to do that here, so I rounded up because, despite some issues, we would stay here again. 
Pros-
Location: Close to Old Town and restaurants/shops. We used Lyft, but the resort does have a shuttle service, we opted not to use it. You could probably walk into town or use the resorts bikes, we just weren't feeling that this trip. 
Ambiance: We enjoyed the vibe of this resort. The decor and details are exceptional. 
Pools: We spent  a lot of time at the pools. Both pools were well-maintained and pool towels provided. The pool side bar was open and we had server, Alexa, many times. She was great! 
Room: Excellent room! Very spacious, clean and the decor was fabulous. Big double doors leading to a balcony overlooking the pool was a big plus. AC worked. Bed was so comfortable with great linens. Lots of mirrors and closet space. Nespresso machine, ceramic mugs and glass water cups were a plus. 
Drinks: We had several drinks at The Canal Club and poolside, all great.
Grounds: The grounds are beautiful. We enjoyed walking around at night. There are several hidden little areas to sit and enjoy. There are hammocks as well. 
Other: The option for early check in was priceless. Arriving from another state  in the morning and being able to check in at noon was one of the things that sold us on this resort. The grounds crew, housekeepers and valet gentlemen were so friendly. Always offering a smile and a hello. 

Cons-
Staff: The ladies at check in were not super friendly. They were pleasant enough, but were not warm and welcoming. Every server we had at The Canal Club inside the resort was rude. Very curt and more interested in conversing with other young staff than serving their paying customers. We felt ignored on more than one occasion by wait staff and servers. 
Food: We were disappointed with most food we ordered, with the exception of the Cubano sandwich, which was good. 
Late Check Out: Since we had a late flight out of AZ, we opted to pay for late check out which gives you an extra 2 hours. When laying by the pool I received a text that housekeeping had entered our room and found our belongings still there and check out was 11:00. My husband went to the front desk and told them we had late check out, to which they replied we did not. I had the receipts of this and then upon looking into it, she realized that indeed we had paid for late check out. Unfortunately,  our key card was locked and we could not access our room to shower and pack. We wasted a good hour of our late check out trying to get this issue resolved and therefore our checkout was stressful. Not a good way to end an otherwise relaxing trip. We were offered to stay an additional hour and be charged $100 for it, which we opted not to do as we had already paid for early check in and late check out. No apology was given and the ladies were not friendly. 
My advice, if you pay for late check out, call the front desk and confirm this before 11:00 to be assured your keycard will not be locked. 

As mentioned above, this resort is great, with the exception of some staff and the check out snafu and we would stay here again if visiting AZ.

reviews.author: Cheryl R
reviews.title: Local Luxury
reviews.text: We dropped by The Canal Club for breakfast and had the best time. From the initial entry at The Scott, we encountered a thoughtful curated environment with impeccable design, courteous staff, and delicious food. Our server, Veronica, was wonderfully patient as we mulled over the menu; being first time visitors, it was hard to choose where to start! I didn’t get the names of the other staffers who assisted in bringing out our food; I wish I had. They all deserve compliments for their professionalism. Their Cubano sandwich and chicken torta are tasty but are even better with a side of black pepper candied bacon. I look forward to our next visit.

reviews.author: Zachary O
reviews.title: Drinks were amazing
reviews.text: My wife and I did a Staycation at the Scott, and it was amazing. We sat at the Canal Club and Aria who took care of us was amazing!!! She made a special drink for my wife and I and it was honestly the best drink I have ever had. We cannot wait to make a trip back.

reviews.author: Char R
reviews.title: Would recommend
reviews.text: We recently did a staycation at the Scott. The ambiance is amazing. We hung out at the Canal Club for hours and had the best time. Aria was our bartender. She was so sweet and made the best drinks! I gave her a few items that I liked in a cocktail and she whipped up the most incredible drink. We ended up getting 4 of them. Definitely would recommend. Thank you for your hospitality, Aria!

reviews.author: miguel r
reviews.title: Rude and lying staff
reviews.text: The security guard with the pubic hair on his face was a complete jerk. He was making up, lies to get us to move for some photos. We were not blocking anything as a matter of fact, we even opened the door for many of the people coming in and out. I asked him if he was doing out of spite and he said that, yes, he was.

reviews.author: Randy H
reviews.title: Mid-Century Vacation Vibes!
reviews.text:
The Scott is an unexpected gem in the heart of Scottsdale. The atmosphere takes you back to 1950’s Cuba in the best way: decor, music, food & drinks. 
The staff were so friendly and welcoming. We had one or two small issues with our room, & the front desk addressed them promptly. 
The hotel has a 1956 Bel Air to shuttle guests around Scottsdale. We got to be the first guests to ride in it after a lengthy maintenance and restoration of the vehicle. Rocko, our driver, was so friendly and knowledgeable. 
Both of us are very particular about the way that our martinis are made. Mike, at the bar, not only crafted our order to perfection, but he also remembered our names and how to make our drinks every time we came down to the Canal Club each evening. 
This was our first visit to Scottsdale, and the hotel made an exceptional impression. We will definitely be returning.

reviews.author: Katie M
reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: I was planning a trip for March and accidentally booked a room for the same day as I was booking. February 19,2025. I immediately realized my mistake and called the hotel 2 minutes later to say I needed to cancel that reservation and make reservations for 3 weeks away. After calling 4 different times to speak to a supervisor, my request was denied. I understand the 24 hour cancellation policy but thought that since I rebooked and it was an obvious mistake that they could have refunded me the $550.00. Even a partial refund. Super disappointing as that is a lot of money to be out for a simple mistake

reviews.author: JDawn
reviews.title: Unable to balance conference attendees and guests both
reviews.text:
This is a conference center more than a resort and spa. On both days, half of the common areas were reserved or dominated by conference participants. There were no tables or reservations available for meals. Housekeeping entered our room at 8:30am after a light tap that we thought was coming from the room nextdoor. I called the front desk and they told me I was wrong because housekeeping didn’t start until later. I definitely spoke to the person when she came into our room!  Every time we mentioned issues to the staff we were just told sorry, with one exception, Ashley. She was so kind and supportive. We could not use the hot tub because that part of the pool was booked for the conference so we left for our dinner, as we had to do unless we wanted to eat at the overcrowded bar and lobby, and came back to a cold hot tub. Ashley was helpful and spoke with engineering to get it working again. After an hour it was better but not quite there so we gave up. 
Our spa appointments went well and the staff was kind.
The resort is absolutely gorgeous and right from the start, we began plans to come back. Sadly, this is not the resort experience we had hoped to find and we were treated like more of an inconvenience than guests.

reviews.author: Marissa B
reviews.title: Gorgeous place, delicious food!
reviews.text: We have never stayed at this hotel, however we LOVE the restaurant and visit often. Kiara treated us so well, very kind and attentive. The environment is cozy and welcoming, smells wonderful, and is a place I enjoy just sitting a while after eating.

reviews.author: Denise D
reviews.title: Relaxing stay
reviews.text: I celebrated my birthday with my daughters in Scottsdale at The Scott.  We loved the lobby and pool area. Our room was nice with a courtyard view.  The bathroom area is small but not a deal breaker.  We loved the location because we walked to all of our restaurants.

reviews.author: Geekaye
reviews.title: A good family option with beautiful facilities
reviews.text:
We had a lovely stay as a family travelling with two kids under 3. Pool area was fabulous - pools nicely heated and the kids loved swimming even in January! 
Rooms and resort tastefully decorated. Restaurant lovely. Staff very friendly. Entire resort just a beautiful, well located and relaxing place. Check in easy, early check in was provided and very appreciated.
A couple of things that are not complaints but just for others to be aware of:
- while the room was not dirty, we did not find our room to be that “pristine clean” that you’d expect for a resort of this price range. We had small pockets of dust, minor scum build up in the bathrooms, some visible marks on walls. Fine for us, but some travellers would be bothered by this and it took away from the overall vibe of the place.
- free pack and plays provided but it did not have a soft mattress at all and we had to significantly pad it with extra sheets and blankets (which housekeeping kindly provided). Again, we also didn’t find it to be clean and there were food crumbs in it. 
All in all, we’d stay again but only at the right price.

reviews.author: Bree
reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text:
My husband and I went for my bday and had such an amazing time. Everyone was so accommodating and nice. Our AC was not working properly and Tom the handyman came to our rescue. He was so sweet and got it fixed so fast! 
We will definitely be coming back! Thank you Tom and staff for making everything perfect!

reviews.author: Nick G
reviews.title: Not a memorable stay
reviews.text:
Unfortunate stay. We did a staycation for our wedding anniversary and my wife who is expecting our first child. Zero extra accommodations were added for our special stay, the pool was closed for the 2nd day of our stay for a private event including a DJ playing club music (which we were not made aware of), slow service and unenthusiastic staff. 

All in all, we were looking for a relaxing stay to wind down and The Scott totally missed the mark. Bummer to see for a hotel that used to be such a gem. 

At this price point, I would expect better service and amenities but we were extremely let down. I would hope that the experience can be improved, but I don’t think we will be back to find out.

reviews.author: MomWally
reviews.title: Girls Weekend at the Scott
reviews.text:
The Scott is beautifully designed with a chic, tropical vibe that makes for the perfect getaway. It was an ideal spot for a relaxing girls’ weekend!

A highlight of our stay was the amazing spa experience. I had the best facial and the spa itself was beautiful. The resort was also an easy walk to Old Town Scottsdale and nearby shopping. We walked into town and adventurously took a Waygo home - a very futuristic driverless car experience!

While the food was delicious, the service at the restaurant and Cabana Club could use some improvement. We found ourselves waiting quite a long time for our orders. The Club may have been short staffed as we had to put in our own drink orders at the bar as servers didn’t come around, and glasses were left unattended around the fire pit area, which detracted a bit from the ambiance.

All in all, though, the inspiring design, relaxing atmosphere, and incredible spa made it a wonderful stay.

reviews.author: Nahal Y
reviews.title: A cozy home away from home
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at this hotel while in town to give a keynote at a conference, and I hadn’t even looked it up beforehand due to a whirlwind of back-to-back travel. My flight to Phoenix was delayed, so I arrived at the hotel at 1 a.m., completely drained. But the moment I stepped out of the cab, everything changed. The entrance alone was captivating, and the lobby, with its stunning artwork, instantly revived my spirit. I knew right then that I would be extending my stay—and I did, that very night.

The service here is truly something special—genuine, thoughtful, and attentive. Every detail of the hotel feels intentional and welcoming, from the perfectly placed hammocks to the soothing sound of waterfalls that create the most relaxing ambiance. The hotel is filled with cozy little hideaways, perfect for unwinding, and the décor feels like a warm, stylish home away from home.

The most remarkable touch? The artwork throughout the hotel is created by the owner, Rose. It adds such a personal, intimate layer to the experience, knowing that the same person running this exceptional business is also shaping its look and feel. I ended up extending my stay by three days, completely captivated by this magical place. The only downside? You might not want to leave the hotel to explore Phoenix! I can’t recommend this gem enough.

reviews.author: K W
reviews.title: Not worth the price
reviews.text: Hotel (more like a motel) is way overpriced for the facilities, service and experience. This is an expensive hotel, so one expects a somewhat higher quality service. It appears to be run poorly. Staff are nice and 'friendly' but the service is still very lacking. Stayed 3 days and had no internet (laptop or phone) in the room the entire time even though they assured the were fixing it all three days. Workout facilities were small, overcrowded and not clean. One of two treadmills broken. One of two elliptical machines broken. Everything feels a little bit run down. And they charge for EVERYTHING even though you've already paid a hefty price for the room.

reviews.author: mayagodiva
reviews.title: Terrific hotel and stay
reviews.text: Such a great stay!! The staff were all lovely, especially Christian M who came and fixed the tap in my room, and the ladies in housekeeping. Warm, friendly people and beautiful grounds! The pool was to die for Rand the food was fresh and tasty. I will definitely come back ❤️

reviews.author: NurseGodoy
reviews.title: The hotel is outdated, but they make up for it in service.
reviews.text:
The hotel is Havana themed and very quaint. The space is quiet and peaceful. The bathrooms are small but they make up for it with extra counter space in the form of carts. Rooms are clean and beds are comfortable. The room was spacey with lots of places to sit and counter space to work. 

WiFi is free and fast enough - no issues. Chromecast was available on the tv (which was large!) - I was only able to get Netflix to work. But that was fine. 

Service was impeccable. The hotel manager was hovering and micromanaging, making it slightly uncomfortable for everyone present. I’m not sure if that’s why the service was so good but it seemed like everyone was happy to work there so I think it was unnecessary. 

Food was ok. I had a pizza which was unique in the flat flour crust - I liked that but the flavor profile was a little odd. The manchego overpowered the pizza. I also had chilaquiles and those were ok as well. The meat seasoning was a little overpowering. 

Coffee in the room was better than coffee in the restaurant so that’s a new one. 

I would stay again, but probably wouldn’t eat here.

reviews.author: Amanjunkie
reviews.title: Solid property that checks all the boxes
reviews.text: A beautifully spacious entryway greets you when you first enter the hotel and there are some really nice common areas at the property.  The rooms are very comfortable, spacious, and feel a bit dated, but otherwise, have all the elements of a solid resort experience.  The gym is dated with old equipment and the pool is standard.  I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Pathfinder797479
reviews.title: Great time with old friends
reviews.text: Ate dinner here with a group of friends in May of 2022 and enjoyed several small plates and pizza. Excellent food and service at their restaurant! Take your palate on a culinary journey then treat yourself to a cocktail in their awesome cocktail lounge before or after!

reviews.author: Jena P
reviews.title: My favorite hotel
reviews.text: The food and drinks at Canal Club are wonderful, I’ve never had something I didn’t love. It’s also gorgeous inside, definitely the best decorated hotel in town! It’s perfect for date night, a casual night out with a few friends or a big party!

reviews.author: Michelle T
reviews.title: Best Food in Scottsdale
reviews.text: The Scott is by far my FAVORITE place to stay in Scottsdale. The food is the best part. The restaurant is delicious and they host really cool pairing dinners too. The bar is fun and the drinks are great. I love to stay for a staycation or girl's night.

reviews.author: bano k
reviews.title: I’m shocked at all the great reviews!!
reviews.text: Where do I begin . The Scott resort has a beautiful entrance and lobby. Once you pass that and head to your room, it’s all over! The resort has several buildings; all which have 2 floors. If your room is on the second floor, get ready. There is no elevators so you’ll have to lug your suitcases up and down the stairs. When I checked in, the front desk employee didn’t even offer to have someone assist us. I swear the resort has less than 10 employees besides the cleaning staff  if that.  The rooms are old and the dust is incredible. My sheets were stained when they were supposed to be changed the following day.  Oh and the pool was full of leafs. They clean the pool once a day and that’s it. So best you go first thing before it’s full of leafs. Oh and my flight wasn’t until 11 pm and I asked for late check out, they said no and it would I costs $30 for ever additional hour; mind it , it’s slow season and the hotel was not full. Stay somewhere else!!!

reviews.author: Michew03
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, the enhancements aren’t worth it
reviews.text: Came to the Scott to stay for the weekend for a girls trip because I love the atmosphere, but we’re pretty disappointed with the overall experience. We added on a few of the “enhancements” for a bottle of champagne & a fiesta package of chips, guac, and margaritas and it was far more chaotic and disorganized than it was worth to add things on. We had the chips and guac and margs delivered to the room at some point between 8pm-11pm when we weren’t in the room on the first night, with nobody asking what time would be best to drop it off, and we didn’t receive the “bottle of bubbles” when we arrived. We were initially told that because of how the fiesta package had been delivered that we would be comped for it and get additional margaritas delivered in return, as well as be comped for the champagne that we got and would be receiving an additional bottle of champagne as well for the disconnect. When we followed up about that later, we were told a different story and that we wouldn’t be getting anything additional. Asked for the fiesta package to just be removed from the rooms since it was disorganized and more of a hassle than it was worth. And we were again told that at least the bottle of champagne that we had paid for would be delivered; which also never happened. We were given refunds for the fiesta package, the bottle we never received, and an additional $100 in place for everything, but it was still overall a huge headache and put a damper on what we were hoping would be a relaxing girls weekend with some extra fun with the enhancements. The Scott is a beautiful resort but the enhancements are totally not worth the additional cost since there isn’t enough coordination to actually get and enjoy what you’re paying for.

reviews.author: mariannecollins35
reviews.title: Shocking show
reviews.text: Tonny scott comedean? I dont think so,  not a bit funny, racist scumbag, told not to film him incase he's targeted if he's that brave why is he hiding, there's better and funnier in benidorm plus the drinks are a ripoff howe they get-away with that i dont know

reviews.author: MenifeeHelen
reviews.title: 3 night stay at the Scott Resort, Scottsdale  AZ.
reviews.text:
This is a very relaxing resort.   The staff are very efficient - especially the Food & Beverage manager Hannah Peppler.   The staff really moved around the pool making sure we were all served efficiently.    Food and beverage at pool perfect.   Dining room also a great experience.   The lobby is extremely spacious and you get a private feeling.    There are 2 pools and one jacuzzi.    They have live entertainment on weekends.  The patio rooms have a private area to sit and the rooms are comfortable and roomy.    The shower has plenty of hot water.
I recommend the Cuban sandwich.      The pool rooms are a better choice.

reviews.author: Kathy L
reviews.title: Not a place I would stay again
reviews.text: The lobby was nice but the rooms and their furnishings were very run down. The hallway had a distinct chemical order about it that was overwhelming. The pool was so cloudy and full of leaves that I would never consider swimming in it.  Granted there were winds that day,  but I've never seen a "resort" pool so unmaintained.  It's not someplace I would not stay again.

reviews.author: Elizabeth L
reviews.title: Stayed at the resort for a wedding. The outdoor venue was beautiful and the food and service were excellent.
reviews.text: Amazing resort with all the creature comforts you’d expect plus an extremely professional and attentive staff. Rooms were well appointed and quiet and the restaurant and pool bar were fantastic!  Highly recommend this resort for a peaceful retreat or as much to do as you want. Upgrade to the Courtyard view. It’s worth it!

reviews.author: Conny Wylie
reviews.title: Pretty Playful Resort.
reviews.text:
The Scott Resort is a chic Havana-inspired boutique resort, beautifully landscaped, that brings together the colors and comforts of Cuba. The 1956 Chevrolet Bel Air parked outside the entrance was reminiscent of younger days dragging my 1955 Chevy Two Door Hardtop. The Scott crams an exceptional number features into it's beautifully landscaped grounds, including 2 sprawling gorgeous pools (one with a sandy bottom & a beach), a fitness center, an inviting day spa (La Vidorra). A real perk is the Cuban-American restaurant, the 'Canal Club' where I enjoyed the taste of Havana from a Cubano sandwich & a Mate Mojito while the lobby bar serves top notch cocktails. Accommodations are spacious with cool Miami-like furniture and private patio as exemplified by my Lagoon View Guestroom.
So, if you are looking for a Cuban-inspired resort................then try the ...........................
..........Scott Resort & Spa.......................pretty playful resort.

reviews.author: Sandra W
reviews.title: Pretty hotel with convenient location and parking
reviews.text:
We stayed 4 nights at The Scott for a family trip in March ’24.   We were a group of 8 staying in multiple rooms.   The hotel put all our rooms close together which was nice. 

The furniture in our room was dated.  Clearly older with tabletops a bit beat up.   The beds were super comfortable.  No complaints with the shower/bathroom area.    The room was well-lit  (I hate hotel rooms without sufficient lighting!)    The balcony was roomy and useful.   The Nespresso machine in the room worked well.   Its a good thing since fetching coffee from the restaurant/bar/lobby area was over $5/cup.  There IS a mini-fridge.   It was chock full of mini-bar stuff.   Mostly beverages for sale.    We cleared it out enough to put some occasional leftovers and a 6-pack of beer in it. 

The pool area/grounds are nice.   When we stayed (spring break time), there were not enough pool area loungers.  People were reserving them all day by piling stuff on them.  By mid-morning all were ‘claimed’ for the bulk of the day.   Each time I was at the pool I ended up without a chair or lounger even tho most of them did not have people on them.    It was slightly annoying given the ‘cabanas’ that were rentable and empty each time we were in the pool area.    The hotel did a great job of keeping fresh towels available in the pool area,  and staff roved around in case anyone wanted to order food or drinks.   

We only ate at the hotel one time.  It was fine.   Some of the food was tasty. Some was only ‘ok’.  There are so many area places to eat that we checked out new places for all our remaining meals.

All the hotel staff were pleasant.   The location is nice - easily walkable to the canal or restaurants.   The free and easy parking were nice.   The building we stayed in had no elevator (I’m not sure if other parts of the hotel did have elevators).  We carried our bags up stairs to get to the room and had to walk stairs to come and go.   I never visited the spa / exercise area so I cannot comment on that.  
 
I did not choose this hotel or pay for it so I can’t really speak to value for price compared with neighboring hotels.

reviews.author: Jenny L
reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.text: Hands down the most gorgeous and comfy stay ever! My husband and I went for our anniversary trip and had so much fun! The Canal Club had an amazing atmosphere and food was delish! We had exceptional service that started at check-in and continued until we checked out! This place also had so many beautiful picture spots!

reviews.author: Aaron L
reviews.title: Highly Recommend
reviews.text: Love The Scott! We come here every year for spring training baseball and it is a great experience every time. Going to a game and then coming back and relaxing by the pool is hard to beat. Wish we were in town more often but will be back again next year.

reviews.author: Chris G
reviews.title: Boutique Gem
reviews.text: Had a great stay at the Scott. Of all the big resorts you read about in Arizona, the Scott is up there with the best. Staff and food were great. Also, close to some many of Scottsdale's main attractions. Will be back the next time I am in town. Thanks for the wonderful stay.

reviews.author: Liz L
reviews.title: Incredible place to stay!
reviews.text: The property is beautiful and well kept! The pool area is gorgeous and the water temp was great! The staff was very friendly and helpful! We ate several times on the property and it was delicious! Our room was very spacious and relaxing! We will definitely be staying again!

reviews.author: Renee
reviews.title: Fantastic Girls Weekend!
reviews.text: We had the BEST girls weekend at the Scott! The entire staff was attentive and kind from the moment we arrived. The food and drinks were delicious and well presented! We got facials and massages at the Spa which was exactly what this worn out mama needed. The hotel itself is super cute with unique decor. The location was perfect to us; close to the mall and Old Town and not too far if you wanted to get some hiking in! We cannot wait to go back!

reviews.author: Matt P
reviews.title: Health hazard
reviews.text: Sad google wont allow me to leave 0 stars.  This place was absolutely disgusting, and the 17 year old idiot behind the check in desk couldn’t write her own name down if you spelled it for her.  Black mold and broken tiles in the shower, bugs on the floor.  After asking the manager to come see the room and tell me she can’t leave the front desk she calls me a liar and assures me its water stains.  I go to the front desk to get my money back and leave this health hazard of a crack house and ask for the general managers info so I can leave my opinions, the security guard goes to my room confirms the mold is unacceptable and then proceeds to refuse any Info I requested so the police were called on me for asking for a receipt of my refund and a managers name or card.  These cowards wouldn’t even own up to their mistake, they called the police after I voiced my concern unhappy because vs making it right.  I will be filing a formal complaint with the BBB, leaving multiple reviews everywhere, posting all pictures and story on social media, news outlets have already reached back out to me to get the story and pictures of the health hazard.  As well as the health department for Arizona.  This place should be shut down.  Hospitality business? More like liberal crybabies who charge 700/night for a 45/night motel experience. Would sleep in a cleaner bus stop bench with a homeless meth head before I stayed here for free.

reviews.author: Alison B
reviews.title: Fun boutique hotel!
reviews.text: The vibe of this hotel is super chic, perfect for a weekend couple's get-away or a girl's retreat. The pool is quiet and we didn't have any problems finding chairs. The rooms were very clean, well appointed and beds were comfortable. Loved the patio that each room has - great for a morning cup of coffee. Service for food was slow, but friendly.

reviews.author: Melanie P
reviews.title: MOTEL
reviews.text:
OOF! I so wanted to love this place. It is quite picturesque, however much is lost in the details.
 Upon arrival I called and let them know I would be arriving soon and NOT to place the bottle of champagne that I prepaid for in addition to $200 food and beverage credit and late check out, I was VERY specific that the person I was traveling with was not drinking and I did not want that when we showed up. Night two we arrived to the room with the bottle of champagne over ice, the SAME bottle I specifically said not to put in the room. Speaking of, they also should have told me there's tons of alcoholic beverages in the mini fridges when I mentioned the person I was traveling with was not drinking. Very tone deaf!
The front desk staff were often not sitting at the desk and you'd have to ring the bell and wait, not very high end.
The rooms are motel rooms. 
There were drinks and room service left all over the property for HOURS. It got really annoying to see the same room service trays all day from the early morning and drinks people left near the fires that were clearly empty, just sat there.
If you want to get a coffee there's two bartenders making coffees, drinks, while also taking to go orders, so be prepared to wait a LONG time for your latte.
Our dinner took so long to cook that even our server told us "this is absolutely ridiculous, I'll comp you a dessert" but we declined. 
Our room didn't get cleaned until 4pm some days. 
The final straw was when I saw a charge on my credit card for $233 when I had a pre paid $200 food and beverage credit. I called and they said "Oh the credit didn't apply." So, had I not checked my statement paying for the room credit would have been a waste of money and I would have been double charged. 

The pros:
The coffee from the bar was good, although very slow. I did enjoy the complimentary bikes you can rent. I loved the lobby and all of the fireplaces throughout. The staff was very nice.

reviews.author: Pauline T
reviews.title: Not so luxury and no so private
reviews.text: From the minute we checked in until leaving, nothing was going right.  When we arrived at 4:20 to check-in, we were told the rooms weren't ready despite check-in at 4 PM.  The front desk gal spoke to a manager and somehow we got a room.  Then the TV didn't work.  Then the Internet didn't recognize my name and room number - not valid!  Then later, after coming back from a cold rainy evening out, we couldn't get the heater to work - 11:30 at night we had the (dis)pleasure of maintenance in our room fixing the heater.  While the hotel granted us an additional hour checkout the following morning, housekeeping took it upon herself to enter the room despite the privacy tag ON the door!!!!  That topped everything and when I tried to speak to her, her English was not good and she followed me back to the room and tried to enter!!!  I shut the door and called the front desk.  The room was somewhat charming, the patio was nice, but the service was unbelievably bad.

reviews.author: Channel P
reviews.title: Get Whisked Away
reviews.text: For my birthday, I chose The Canal Club at The Scott Resort after sampling their delicious ceviche at Devour. The calming aesthetic whisked me away, and my experience at the restaurant was fantastic. The staff provided exceptional service, making minor modifications to accommodate us. The menu offers a variety of delicious cuisine without being overwhelming, along with well-crafted cocktails! Celebrate your special occasion or catch a vibe at The Canal Club. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Steven S
reviews.title: The Worst Travel Experience Of My Life
reviews.text:
The Scott Resort was awful.   

I lead a 60+ person event at the Resort, and found my vehicle stripped of wheels and tires in the resort parking lot. In the middle of Scottsdale. At a resort.   

I personally planned and booked the event with my administration team, spending over $50K at the hotel, and received the absolute worst/bare minimum support from them. I just can't believe it. I can't believe I even have to write this.   

I was informed by the front desk and was told this is the first time it has happened in over 6 years; however, The Scottsdale Police Department informed me this was the fourth time they have been to the resort in the last year where vehicle theft/damage occurred. The parking lots have minimal lighting, poor security footage, and minimal support. There were no signs on that side of the parking lot, no information when checking in that this was a risk - especially since this has happened multiple times. It took over 10 hours to get my truck out of the parking lot and all I received was a phone call that day and an "I understand" from the team. The gates into the property were also missing locks, and we found one of the doors to the hallways propped open.

I was offered free meals and a certificate to return for my "inconvenience" - which was completely tone deaf due to the lack of safety, security, and overall wellbeing for a family traveling for business. I didn't even stay there the last night and checked out the next day because...why would I stay there or want to return if all the wheels on my vehicle were stolen. I mean...this was wild.  For spending that amount of money at a resort and to receive a gift certificate...is something. I don't know whether to return it or frame it.   

There's a solid chance you'll see 60 more reviews like this from my team and multiple corporate recommendations to no longer travel/stay here until safety, security, and other items are addressed holistically.   

This was absolutely the worst, most bizarre experience I have ever had.  You'll see a picture of my truck in another review - I don't even want to share it again.

reviews.author: Backtobmw
reviews.title: Great week but need more security
reviews.text: Had a great week here, staff were friendly and the outdoor area was lovely. There is construction going on in the pool area during the week but you could tell they were trying to keep the noise down. Tried the hotel bikes- they needed some love and so we brought them back after an hour. There is a great e-bike rental store- magnum a block away and we rented from there- great store. Noticed a nice new truck got stripped in the parking lot when we were there- wheels and tires were stolen- also some glass in parking lot where another cars window was broken so maybe some better security? Didn’t feel unsafe when we were here though.

reviews.author: LeDiscerningTraveler
reviews.title: Hyped up old motel, low value
reviews.text:
We booked that hotel for a conference and paid a premium for a pool view: at check-in we declined the first room offered which was on ground floor, behind a 8ft fence that blocks the entire view and light with loud workers during the day (undisclosed on website of course); the second option offered was not great but acceptable although I asked front desk to keep an eye for better room with wide windows , even for an additional fee...they never got back to me in 3 days despite many rooms visibly left empty in the desired building.
Then again, staff is hardly available or visible, nor really helpful when solicited, cleaning staff leaves trays of old food in hallway for hours after starting their service, amenities are skimpy (worn out towels, exorbitant mini bar, no toiletries...)
On top of it all, I accidently left behind a piece of jewelry in the back of the safe ( dark lighting ): when I realized the next day, I immediately called front desk and gave a full description to Lucy who took notes and said they would promptly get back to me for action... however,  nobody ever followed up with a call or timely check by security or cleaning staff that could have turned item up...By the time they sent an admin. form to fill in 3 days later, it was of course too late for a chance to retrieve  the $ 1 000 piece that was probably bagged by next guest or cleaning crew. I requested the manager to call me back on that, he never did.
All that shows that this old motel is marketing lipstick on a pig, with average staff and amenities that were once fluffed up to justify a premium that is not deserved. No ambiance, average food and cocktail bar, mostly run by very green / untrained staff without clear and present management leadership nor culture of hospitality Overall level of amenities is poor: run down furniture , no attention to details, no toiletries, skimpy towel service, exorbitant mini bar, old bedding etc...everything feels  designed to squeeze maximum money from guest, on top of already overpriced nightly rates for what this resort actually delivers in value... Skip for better value The Adeline or W nearby that some of our friends and colleagues enjoyed  !!!

reviews.author: jill g
reviews.title: Hidden Gem found
reviews.text: I have stayed at The Scott Resort before and loved it, but never ate at The Canal Club. I finally stopped in for lunch with a couple of friends and was so glad we did. From the time we arrived, we were greeted with hellos and smiles and immediately shown to our table. Our waitress was very personable and knowledgeable on the menu. We started off with the shrimp ceviche and holy moly that was the best ceviche I’ve ever had! I ordered the seasonal squash salad per her recommendation and wow oh wow my mouth was doing a happy dance. The butternut squash was diced perfectly along with all the other accompaniments throughout the salad. I ended our meal with the Spanish latte and all I’m going to say is “hug in a mug”! I highly recommend the Canal Club and I’ll be coming back to try the brunch and grab another Spanish latte!

reviews.author: Lindsay C
reviews.title: A Scottsdale Staple
reviews.text: My second time at Canal Club and it somehow surpassed the first. The scenery is absolutely gorgeous with the decor and plants. The lighting and atmosphere has an amazing vibe for a night out. Our waitress Shayla was quick and kind. The food was excellent. We ordered the chips and queso and it had a perfect flavor and consistency. Ordered the red snapper as an entree and it was so crispy and the rice was cooked just right. Couldn’t recommend this place enough. Have such fond memories here and cannot wait to go back again soon.

reviews.author: D C
reviews.title: Excellent food and ambiance at Canal Club
reviews.text: I visited the Canal Club Restaurant with some friends. I got the Salmon it was delicious. The cut was generous and the sauce was savory. The meal also came with a side that had excellent roasted potatoes.The service was attentive and welcoming. The decorations of the restaurant created a very romantic and warm ambiance. I will be returning and would recommend it to anyone looking for a premium dining experience.

reviews.author: Madison G
reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience at this hotel! We went in for dinner at the restaurant together and were warmly greeted by the all of the staff that were present. The service was top notch and the food was even better! We ordered the filet, the salmon, and the snapper and were all impressed with our meals. I have absolutely zero complaints! The service and food was amazing but the atmosphere and vibe of the whole hotel truly made the experience. I will certainly be returning!

reviews.author: CX
reviews.title: 滿舒服的家庭渡假飯店
reviews.text: 滿舒服的家庭渡假飯店，房間也大，可惜飯店沒有包含早餐，要另外加點。也沒有提供飲用水，房間所有的點心及食物都要付錢。

reviews.author: tk4star
reviews.title: Great Vibe
reviews.text: We loved so much about this resort.  Both the rooms and grounds are welll kept.  The pool areas were great for both kids and adults looking for some quiet pool time.  Beware, the mini-fridge is packed with purchasable items.  There is no room for anything you may bring.  Some of the staff were cold and unattentive, while others were amazing.  The 3 mile shuttle is great for evening meals.  The location is convenient for walking to shopping and dining.

reviews.author: fiddle723
reviews.title: Thanksgiving Week
reviews.text: Overall unhappy with value. I've already submitted a more detailed description on a previous page of this review.  Not clear why you are asking me to repeat myself.  But, again, restaurant was overpriced, wait staff was inattentive, there were a lack of amenities (such as free coffee and tea), noisy common areas, construction noise throughout our stay, failure to provide a complete invoice.

reviews.author: kberry012021
reviews.title: Love the resort but has gone downhill
reviews.text: We have been coming to this resort every Thanksgiving for the last five years. Sadly this will most likely be out last time. They are in the middle of some renovations and they did not give any heads up or notice. Not even when we checked in. The bar staff is extremely rude and impatient. We do love the location and the rooms though. Everyone but the bar staff is friendly and the common areas and rooms are clean.

reviews.author: corcart
reviews.title: Look elsewhere
reviews.text: The price to value is not great. The main areas were lovely but the Parlor Suite we paid for smelled like sewage whenever you ran the water (typical of an older hotel). The hotel was severely understaffed and our room wasn't ready until 6pm on our arrival date (2 hours after check-in). Would not recommend.

reviews.author: ninochkajeanpierre
reviews.title: Charming but needs a revamp
reviews.text: The hotel is clean and the staff is overall very accommodating and professional.  The style is dated and the overall aesthetic would be great with a new coat of paint and updates to light fixtures. it would also be great if there was an additional way to get heavy luggage to the second floor without having to carry it yourself or wait for the very busy staff.

reviews.author: leonardfarrington
reviews.title: Conference
reviews.text: Great room. Enjoyed my stay. Didn't get a chance to use any of the amenities. I was in my room all day, but the room was very nice. Has a fully stocked minibar and nice room. It is a little on the older fashioned side. I had a special rate for the conference. Don't know if I'd spend 500 a night if I were paying for myself.

reviews.author: emilyfincher11
reviews.title: Cutest hotel ever!
reviews.text:
We had an amazing girls trip here! The lobby and lobby bar are amazing! The outdoor patio was also so fun! Cutest hotel we have ever been too! Picture perfect! Location was super convenient and close to everything! Plus they have a shuttle (actually a fancy Grand Wagoneer) and they will take you anywhere you want to go! Everyone who works there was so friends and helpful!! 
 The spa definitely left something to be desired, it's incredibly expensive for what you get and you aren't able to book anything with friends! Everyone must go one at a time! 
I 100% recommend staying at this hotel, just skip the spa part! The hotel was PERFECT!

reviews.author: DiaG4007
reviews.title: Director Meeting
reviews.text: If you are looking at having a business meeting and do not want a huge resort to wander through, this is your place! Great location! The resort is beautiful and the food is absolutely delicious! This is a smaller but it will meet all your needs.

reviews.author: Liamasta
reviews.title: The Scott Resort & Spa
reviews.text: I attended a conference at this resort. The location was excellent - close to restaurants, shopping and historic area. The resort was beautiful, and staff were very friendly. Food at restaurants was excellent (loved the French toast) and meals served in the banquet hall were okay.

reviews.author: lisacostin
reviews.title: Great vibe
reviews.text: This hotel is an entire vibe. From the moment you walk in, you are transported in time.  The staff is very responsive and the fire pits are amazing. There are lots of quiet spaces and I totally felt secure on the property.

reviews.author: Traveler
reviews.title: Top notch!
reviews.text: Definitely my favorite stay in the Scottsdale area that I’ve had! The staff was attentive and understanding to my needs. Check-in was seamless and the room was neat! Love the Havana theme! The food is also delicious!

reviews.author: Rosemary M
reviews.title: Canal Club Saturday Brunch
reviews.text: The Canal Club Saturday Brunch was delicious.  My friends ordered the Peruvian Hash and I had the Seasonal Squash.. pomegranate vinaigrette was so good!!  I would recommend this venue with the open air feel…it was a delightful brunch!  Just a table full of locals enjoying a beautiful fall morning in Arizona!

reviews.author: liz l
reviews.title: Absoletly gorgeous property
reviews.text:
The Scott Resort and Spa is georgeous. The front lobby is beautiful and inviting. The front desk staff is incredible,  very friendly and attentive to your needs. The food at the reasturant has great presentation and is delicious.  Outdoor gathering area is perfect for intimate or group settings.  Very large pool  area. Pool is beautiful and heated. Also has a nice bar in the pool area. I would recommend this property for a wonderful getaway..
Liz L.

reviews.author: Scott L
reviews.title: Beautiful resort and Spa in Scottsdale AZ
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort. Lobby is beautiful, many areas to meet and greet friends and family. Front desk staff are very friendly and welcoming. Food is delicious - plentiful helpings, and beautiful presentation. Staff are very friendly and helpful all around. Great outdoor areas, nice pool and spa. I would highly recommend.
Scott L

reviews.author: ct k
reviews.title: Can’t wait to go back to The Scott!
reviews.text: Comfortable room, great staff! Really enjoyed the room, the service and friendliness of the staff. Check in and Check out was easy and hassle free. I look forward to my next stay in the next few weeks, I have recommended friends who enjoyed it too!

reviews.author: Sarah C
reviews.title: Beautiful room and great food
reviews.text: Loved the room! The staff was kind, the room service was great and the meal was delicious! Best stay! We have talked about going back. I can’t wait! There is a spa and beautiful pool. The amenities are beyond great!

reviews.author: anna p
reviews.title: Best relaxation spot!
reviews.text: The food and drinks are amazing here! Staff is all very kind and helpful. The bathrooms are very clean and it is a very good “hangout” atmosphere. Would absolutely recommend to everyone thinking about going! Even if you are not staying, the restaurant and bar are worth checking out.

reviews.author: davidr9
reviews.title: To be avoided.
reviews.text: Absolute s***show. Our large group flew in from multiple cities to find none of our rooms would be ready for at least two hours. 2 clerks at the front desk are overwhelmed and nasty. Lobby is hot on 100F Arizona day. Nobody is answering the phone. Avoid at all costs. There are too many nice hotels nearby to suffer through this.

reviews.author: Stephen P
reviews.title: Lovely Phoenix Hotel with a Sense of Place
reviews.text:
The Scott is lovely.  Relaxed elegance, interior spaces uniquely designed with lots of wicker, rattan, palm motifs, appropriate for the desert.  Also old photos of kids swimming in Phoenix canals, etc in the rooms are very cool.  Staff is incredible.  Food and cocktails excellent.
And just all around fun in general.

reviews.author: Jordan G
reviews.title: Amazing Customer Service
reviews.text: Excellent customer service the best front desk staff you could ask for extremely nice upgrades will definitely come back here again. Rooms have been upgraded very clean everyone has been extremely friendly new updates look great definitely a hidden gem in

reviews.author: Ellie K.
reviews.title: Relaxing staycation
reviews.text:
I came here just for a short staycation with my pup, Mr. Binky. Honestly, I felt like a bunch of things of things went wrong initially, but everything worked out. I couldn't get my Chromecast to work even though I did everything right. Reception was really helpful (I loved that I could just text them!) to get some guys out to figure out the Chromecast for me and they eventually got it to connect. Also, the first night I tried to order room service. No one answered. I was prompted to leave a message, so I did, but no one called me back or delivered my order. That might have been a blessing though 😅

Overall, I enjoyed my stay. I most appreciated La Vidorra Spa 🤤 My aesthetician, Stacy, was very kind and I hope to receive spa treatments from her again 😌

reviews.author: Christi M
reviews.title: Pretty underwhelming
reviews.text: First off, I paid more for a “poolside room” (see photo). The room was behind a gate encircling the pool and there was no direct access. The staff were not helpful - no pool towels - and just an OK room. For ~$800 per night, it was so NOT WORTH YOUR MONEY.

reviews.author: Eugene Shyshpanov
reviews.title: Anniversary
reviews.text:
Pictures online are deceiving. Nothing as it looks. Only nice part is the front lobby. 
The rooms are super old,  carpet is old paint is chipping. The hallways to room are creepy and super low ceilings……………………………………………………………………….don’t go.

reviews.author: Kelsey S
reviews.title: Loved all the details!
reviews.text: Had the best time here on a girls trip! Everyone was so kind, the rooms were clean and everything was beautiful! We all had great experiences at the spa, and can’t wait to come back! Loved all the details!

reviews.author: FirstClassTkt
reviews.title: Modern property for the right client
reviews.text:
As other recent reviews stated, The Scott is an enclave for the young and hip. The hotel sells day passes that attract young locals. The lobby, bar, seating areas and pools cast a Caribbean party vibe that is the backdrop for bridal events and meet ups. The grounds are beautiful. Definitely not a family destination. 
We were there for a business conference which was supported well by catering and service staff.
Being part of a room block we did not have high expectations for a great room and, indeed, we had a first floor room with parking lot (no) view. Would not be happy if we were paying rack rate as many rooms overlook the pool and court yards. Decor was modern rustic and quite large with under-sized # of outlets for electronics. WiFi worked well. Room was dark and AC was tepid which made for uncomfortable sleep. Mattresses had “topographic” surfaces and need to be replaced. Biggest issue was that even w/6 bed pillows, not one was comfortable as they were all overstuffed. One nice feature was sturdy, upholstered benches at the foot of each bed. 
Room was clean enough and there was daily housekeeping, which seems to be a forgotten amenity in hotels post Covid.
Restaurant menu is limited when facing multiple days but interesting at first glance. Bar does a nice job with cocktails but has a very underpowered offering of beers on tap.

reviews.author: Dee2759
reviews.title: Nope
reviews.text: Just checked in and wish I could leave. I feel like I’m staying in someone’s basement. There are fingernail cuttings on the floor and the shower looks gross. This particular room only has one set of French doors where others have more expansive windows so it’s dark. The furnishings are beat up so look college dorm rather than cool. Very unhappy but was told there is a convention (great) and no other rooms are available. Dishes still sitting outside our door from previous guest and a pair of underwear on the path by the pool. Ugh. Expensive for subpar accommodations, very disappointed.

reviews.author: KET
reviews.title: Great for a younger crowd
reviews.text:
This resort is best for a younger crowd- that’s who they cater to. Bachelorette parties everywhere!!! Hard to get a reservation in the only restaurant even though it’s usually empty, except for the large tables of bachelorette parties. We were told several times that they were completely full even though half the tables were empty. Hotel lobby has a DJ  on weekends, while cool it was so loud and made it hard to have a conversation. We were assigned a room on the street side, which was extremely loud by traffic and all the hotel delivery trucks starting first thing in the morning. The pool was very nice although extremely busy. It seems they sell day passes so there were people everywhere. I must say the pool staff was excellent. 
Hotel is visually pretty, great for everyone taking selfies everywhere. It’s just not for us.

reviews.author: Sarah G
reviews.title: Loved The Scott
reviews.text: I almost never write reviews but my in my experience The Scott deserves to be applauded! We were guests there from 4/12-4/16, part of a large group there on business. The hotel was very busy the entire time. First the entire staff was amazing - helpful, pleasant and going above and beyond to make us feel welcome. The food was amazing! I ate breakfast at the restaurant on three different mornings and loved every one of the meals. We also attended two events in the evenings and I can't say enough about the food, service and the beautiful presentation. I loved the atmosphere around the pools and in the lobby area  and our room - whoever did the interior design did a fabulous job! Our only issue was that the air conditioning in our room never seemed to be able to get quite cool enough. I know that while we were there the hotel experienced some issues with the pool bar and some of the other guest rooms. But overall, our entire stay was wonderful and I will highly recommend this resort to friends who are visiting Scottsdale.

reviews.author: NRBJR
reviews.title: AVOID THIS PLACE!
reviews.text:
Went to a meeting at this hotel so I had no choice but to stay here.   It's an old, tired hotel from the 60's that has had a half baked attempt at remodeling. On the second day we were there, the sewers backed up in all of the first floor rooms of building A.   Some rooms were totally flooded.  Fortunately (that's a joke) the sewage was contained to my shower.  I called the front desk but no one showed up.  After completing my shower in the sink, I went to the front desk and was promised a "cleanup."   The hotel was full and there were no other rooms available.    The next morning I called the front desk at 6:30am and requested a one hour extension to checkout because our group meeting was not over until noon.   The lady at the desk said "of course you can have an extension for a $60 fee."  I won't repeat my response.
Upon checkout I asked what accommodation was going to be made for the fact that I was unable to use my room for half a day due to sewage.  I was happily offered a $40 refund of the annoying Resort Fee.   After much discussion and "consulting with my manager" I received a 50% refund of my daily rate for one day.   I had a plane to catch and had no more time to deal with this place.   
Our group will not be returning to this place.

reviews.author: OCCouple2004
reviews.title: Fantastic resort close to it all!
reviews.text: Love this resort. Perfect for a girls weekend or a date weekend- not so much a ‘kid-resort’! The atmosphere is laid back and trendy, the rooms are comfortable and updated, and enjoyed every meal we ate here!! The location is perfect just a few blocks from the old town. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: marnsmty
reviews.title: Horrible for Wedding Parties
reviews.text: We reserved the Scott for a wedding celebration. They think they are upscale but were consistently unprofessional. The billing was a mess and we did not meet our room minimum because our guests were so disappointed.  I would strongly discourage anyone from doing business with the Scott.

reviews.author: Grace W
reviews.title: Thank you for an awesome stay!
reviews.text: The Scott is a unique and beautiful resort in a fantastic area. The pool and pool area were clean, spacious, well staffed and beautifully designed. Our room was clean, comfortable and upscale. Special thank you to Theresa, Front Office Manager for making our stay extra special by accommodating our requests. We will definitely stay here on our next trip to Scottsdale and will recommend to friends and family.

reviews.author: Lisa L
reviews.title: Great, low-key husband and wife trip
reviews.text:
My husband and I had a wonderful 5-day trip to The Scott.  Our room had the things I gather all their rooms have:  comfy robes for use on property; large containers of beautiful smelling, complimentary shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and lotion; and Nespresso pods for a morning (or evening) espresso.  I’m under the impression the refrig did not have sensors—we were told they determine what you used upon checkout—so we were able to move things around and keep things cold there.   

It was unseasonably cool during most of our stay.  Though some people passed by  headed for the pools, we decided a wet swimsuit with cool weather wasn’t in the cards for us.  However, both pools looked beautiful.  I loved that one had a walk in sandy area.  

The property has lots of nice features—hammocks, fire pits, bikes, corn hole, table or card games, etc.  We were there for a quiet trip and to see a few Spring Training games.  I gather there were some adult activities elsewhere on property, but we never heard the music.  We enjoyed the peace and quiet on our patio every morning and at the end of each day.  

I noticed many of the rooms appear to have only an exterior view, though the website doesn’t speak to that—implying every room has a beautiful view.  As best I could tell, some rooms will only overlook a parking lot.  I’d verify what view you’ll have before you commit to your reservation.

We had breakfast each day in the restaurant.  The yogurt, granola, and fresh fruit was heavenly and a large serving size.  We only ate dinner there once, because we like to try area restaurants when we travel.  The Roaring Fork is a short walk across the street!  

I noticed many of the reviews refer to things being dirty or run down.  Our room and the nearby areas were nice and clean.  The lobby area (which is large for a small hotel like this with many different seating areas) was always spotless when we walked through or when we sat down to have a drink or to relax.   I liked the retro decorations (mid-Century, I think?) in our room and the lobby.

Each member of the staff we dealt with (mainly front desk, bar, restaurant, house keeping) were polite and friendly.  My only problem was the feather pillows—they make me sneeze like crazy so no matter where I stay, I always ask for foam—I called housekeeping, then the front desk, and received foam pillows promptly.
