We’ve stayed at a number of high end hotels in Scottsdale and while we’ve enjoyed our other stays, my husband and I decided this is our new go-to place.

reviews.author: Ballee3
reviews.title: Not good choice for families!
reviews.text: My advice if you are considering staying here either be part of a bachelorette party, a wedding, a business group or enjoy taking pictures of yourself for social media.  If you are a family choose another resort.  This is NOT your typical resort for families.  The two pools which are OK are not designed for kids to play or families to hang out, my opinion this should almost be an adults only resort.  There is nothing for kids to do here.  The only restaurant they had was always occupied and surrounded by people all dressed up and part of a convention or gathering.  Walking through the lobby we felt like we were walking through business meetings.  Not a lot to this resort (not sure it should be considered a resort).  We were glad our parking for our room was in the back so we could enter our room without going through lobby.  The rooms are like staying in a motor lodge.  For the price they charge you don’t really get anything because there is not much to it.  The room was good sized and clean but make sure you bring all amenities, they have stuff in the room for showering but at a cost.  No travel size shampoos/lotions like every other hotel, instead you can buy their big bottles in the room for $20 a bottle.  The fridge is stuffed with items you can purchase at a steep cost.  We had to buy a cooler for our stuff cuz the fridge is filled with theirs and we didn’t want to pull it out for fear of being charged.  For what they charge a night I would not choose here.  No gift shop or anywhere to buy water, snacks, etc., just the stuff they stock in your room and charge a lot for it!  I just wanted to give a heads up to families with kids (any ages) because there are way better places for this price to stay.  Again, should be an adults only resort.

reviews.author: Ymani F
reviews.title: The worst hotel experience ever ! THERESA is the worst manager and should not be running this hotel.
reviews.text: I stayed at The Scott March 21-24th. This hotel was an absolute disgrace for the price. The bed was extremely itchy I woke up with bites on my leg and all they told me is they will have maintenance check the room. The shower was extremely dirty with broken metal not screwed in the wall I will upload photos. I spoke to Theresa the manager she should definitely not be running this hotel she was extremely rude and when you spoke to her she just squints her eyes at you like you are slow. Next time I take a trip to Arizona I will definitely be taking my money elsewhere. Beautiful state definitely visit just not at THE SCOTT. Oh and as you can see this is the filthy hallway you have to walk through to get to your room

reviews.author: Joshua D
reviews.title: AWFUL- run.
reviews.text: NoT a 4 star hotel! It was so rundown, our room was filthy- paint coming off walls, black marks in bathroom, tikes coming up in shower / just to make a few! The gym had drinks sitting there for 2 days! Half the rooms have a view of the parking lot! Service was terrible, attitude awful- this was supposed to be a special trip and they managed to kill that vibe. When told they did not care - it was AWFUL. RUN 2-3 star at best.

reviews.author: E8306UBadam
reviews.title: Warning !
reviews.text:
After a rough stay last year we decided to give The Scott a second chance, one because it is close to our daughter, second assuming Covid made it difficult to find good people a year ago. 
Well it was as bad as a year ago, they haven't improved a thing if anything the place looks a year older. 
The worst thing is the service, it is so bad that the restaurant asked us to go off property because they are "running an hour behind" we received this suggestion several times as they are trying to redirect business away from the kitchen. It is actually panful trying to get breakfast there. 
The place seems run by kids who haven't been trained whatsoever. 
Shame because the property Looks so good online and from the surface. 
We won't be giving it a third chance.

reviews.author: Atl4316
reviews.title: Total disappointment
reviews.text: I checked on Thursday mid day and the woman checking me in asked if I would like first or second floor. I responded that I would just like something quiet. The woman gave me room #223. Horrible and u know she knew this when she’s checking me in! I was awaken by the housekeepers at 6:45am cause their staging area was right outside my room along with with the trash dumpster pick up. I ask to be changed and Trey who was wonderful got me a new room. After changing rooms I realized I left my shampoo, conditioner, razor, body soap in the room. They sent security looking for it- gone! So I had to go and by new. Then that night I realized I let my PJ’s in the room. Well nobody can fine those either! So disappointed in this hotel. The rooms are ok… not what I was expecting. This will definitely be my last time at the Scott and u might want to look somewhere else too!

reviews.author: awts30
reviews.title: Nice hotel, great location but restaurant lacking
reviews.text:
Nice stay.
My husband and I loved the Scottsdale location- close to shopping, restaurants and quaint Old Town; and the hotel had a free shuttle to these places; the driving staff- John and Saidou were two of the nicest staff - very polite, accommodating and knowledgeable. 
The hotel lobby and grounds were beautiful and very well manicured but:
The room decor was dated; and despite the rave reviews, the restaurant food was not good - the waffle, chicken sandwich and salad croutons had weird flavor/spice combinations, croutons were made out a hash and not crunchy. Overall very odd spices and flavor combos- luckily there were many other restaurants within shuttle distance from the hotel. 
We’d return only because of the location, staff and beautiful grounds

reviews.author: Renee A
reviews.title: naked man in my newly cleaned and assigned room
reviews.text: If your security is not important to you then sure by all means this is the place for you.  I arrived to the Scott after a long 6 hour flight. Upon entry everything seemed to be nice. However the check in process was cringe and the young lady at the front desk clearly had no idea of what she was doing. After the acting manager Carloyn Anne came to help her thats when everything went down hill. I asked about amenities it became an issue, i asked about the hotel layout that also became an issue., I asked about room upgrades that was an issue. Finally I asked for my key and just went to my room. Along the way the hotel was over crowed with a convention. To get to my room I had to walk with my luggage's through the pool area where kids were splashing and everything is getting wet. For a "spa" styled hotel the rooms are in the layout of an INN.. Upon arriving to the building of my room housekeeping has dirty blankets all over the hallways. I go into my assigned room and to my surprise I find a NAKED MAN! Absolutely mortified I walk back to the front desk and kindly inform the staff of the mistake THEY made. I also noted that this situation they put myself and the other guest is dangerous and a safety hazard.  The Carolyn Anne completely disregarded anything I said and rebulbed with "well our system shows the room is empty" So you'll have to wait until 4 when the next room is open. Doesn't apologies for a mistake they made doesn't offer to comp a meal or even a drink while I wait 6 hours. Doesn't offer any upgrades that are available. Just looks at me as if i were the problem.  As someone who has been in customer service for 10plus years I was so disappointed in the lack of care. Not once did she seem empathetic or apologetic, nor was there any time she tried to rectify the situation and make me feel comfortable with actually staying. I collected my belongings and left the hotel. Would never suggest you stay.

reviews.author: Outdoors
reviews.title: Relaxing few days at the Scott.
reviews.text: Great location, ambience, service and enjoyable food and drinks. Rooms comfortable  and a relaxing few days with everything you need onsite. Staff very friendly and welcoming all round. Walking distance to old town restaurants and have shuttle on demand if needed.

reviews.author: Olga M
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text:
Had the opportunity to stay at this location to celebrate my daughter birthday.  This was an incredible experience from the room, wonderful service, restaurant was unbelievable and the  pool area unbelievable.
We had a 5 star experience in every area.

reviews.author: Anne D
reviews.title: Dinner and Drinks
reviews.text:
I stopped in for dinner and a drink because I heard the food was good.  The atmosphere was great however the bartenders did not offer a good experience.  I sat down and after 5 min I asked the bartender (who was just standing there the entire time) if I could order a glass of wine. I had a question about a wine and he had no idea how to answer it.

My dinner was delicious.  My water glass was empty for over 5 min and the bartender did not refill it.  He stood behind the bar on his phone.  I had to get his attention and ask for more water.

I am giving a big Thumbs Up for the food and a big Thumbs down on the service.  I don't think I will be back given the bad service I received.

reviews.author: Carolyn O
reviews.title: Loved This Resort!
reviews.text: Highly recommended! I loved the spaciousness and quality of light throughout the resort. The lobby was so inviting with several areas to sit to read or talk. The rooms I stayed in were clean and comfy with luxurious amenities here and there. The very best part of my stay at The Scott was the gracious and friendly staff. Very professional and attentive from the front desk people (amazing), the housekeeping crew and the van drivers. Amazing care for their guests! Thank you for the great care you gave me during my stay with you!

reviews.author: Renee O
reviews.title: Minnesota Couple LOVED the Scott❤️
reviews.text: The perfect long weekend to relax by the pool, shop and enjoy the resort. Rooms were comfy, lobby is unbelievably gorgeous and great to relax and people watch, read a book or visit and enjoy the ambiance.  The outdoor areas- pool/lagoon, gardens could compete with any luxury Caribbean resort.   The Spa was so great I went Twice!  Absolutely will return. Rachel @ the morning bar was our favorite staff.  Friendly and made amazing lattes to start our days.  Saydo is the man to see at the shuttle for ideas of what to do-where to go! We loved both of them!

reviews.author: lynnef505
reviews.title: Loud music, packed pool, poor service.
reviews.text: This hotel clearly caters to weddings, bachelorette parties, girls weekends.  If you’re in that group you may love this spot. Hotel rooms are pleasant, but mini fridge and shelves filled with booze and snacks to buy. No other space. Couldn’t get reservations in dining room because “kitchen was backed up” from a large wedding. Yes, you could eat in the lobby at low cocktail tables. Steak on your lap? Whole place is overwhelming—loud (DJ in lobby) and pools jammed with partiers. NO down time here, which is what we needed.

reviews.author: The Z’s
reviews.title: Girls staycation!
reviews.text: The Scott Resort and Spa has exceeded above and beyond our expectations! They were nothing but super helpful and kind to us through out our whole stay. My friends and I had the most relaxing stay and the amenities and services that they offer made our staycation well worth it. The food, massages, private cabana, and the beautiful hotel were unforgettable, I will definitely come back!

reviews.author: Melissa U
reviews.title: This place has a real VIBE
reviews.text: I LOVE The Scott. The gorgeous tropical design aesthetic; the zillions of cubbies, tables, and nooks where you can work, sip, read, or talk; the restaurant with the best Cobb salad I've ever had; THE POOLS (so many areas)... and the people-watching, most of all. This is for sure a place to see and be seen, but for someone who prefers to remain a quiet observer, The Scott is heaven.

reviews.author: Thomas J
reviews.title: Return visit and we will keep coming back!
reviews.text:
The property, staff and cleanliness never disappoints us! We stay at The Scott whenever we are in Scottsdale. The service and the accommodations are exceptional.

This boutique resort and spa is a nugget in Scottsdale, AZ. It is located close to Old Town that has many bars and restaurants to choose from. The shuttle service provided by the bell staff is very convenient and appreciated.

Thank you for a great stay!

reviews.author: Shannon B
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text:
My husband and I were so excited to stay at this hyped up resort. Sadly, it did not live up to the hype in our opinion. The staff at the resort were all very friendly which was great. Our room was very clean and that is a crucial factor when we travel. 

The bed in our room was one of the most uncomfortable beds we’ve ever slept on. It felt extremely worn out and not supportive. Every morning we both woke up in pain. Not a great way to start the day on vacation. The pool area was nice and the first two afternoons we were there it was clean. On our last afternoon we were grossed out by the trash that was literally all over the pool deck from people eating and drinking. Their were used towels in almost every chair making it hard to decipher which spots were open. All of the cabanas were not in use or clean which was sad because we had requested one that morning and told there weren’t any available. I don’t know if they were short staffed that day but the one waitress that was working would not pick up anything. For being advertised as a luxury resort, I would expect better from them. We will be returning to Scottsdale but not staying at this overpriced resort.

reviews.author: Caristi1
reviews.title: Instagram worthy hotel!!!
reviews.text: Service was exceptional and the hotel is instagram worthy. Rooms are nice and clean, and the  Pool was amazing. Shenoa was our server at the pool bar for a few days and she absolutely killed it. The Scott is a first choice. Anywhere else comes second.

reviews.author: Selma524
reviews.title: Lack of Pool Umbrellas
reviews.text: We chose the Scott again because of the location and lovely pool with lots of umbrellas for shade. All of the pool umbrellas were removed for the second day in a row to be used for a private event. This leaves paying resort guest with no shade at the pool. Basically making the pool in useable for those who can’t sit in sun. Management said umbrellas would be back but that did not happen. Poor planning on every level. With so many resort choices in Scottsdale, I will surely choose another place next time we visit.

reviews.author: Darryl
reviews.title: Amazing Lobby and Courtyards
reviews.text: The hotel has an amazing lobby and pool area. There is also plenty of comfortable stylish seating in the courtyard for enjoying a nice day or night outside. The hotel staff was very accommodating and the hotel even offered shuttle services around town. We stayed in a king patio room, which was very spacious in the bedroom. The only cons are the rooms are not as updated as the hotel website shows. The bathrooms were sacrificed to accommodate such a large bedroom area. The ceilings are maybe 6ft tall. Overall, I would recommend the Scott if you're looking to socialize with friends or enjoy being outside at the pool areas. The bar inside the hotel was great and there was live music in the lobby. The had plenty of seating and fun games spread around the lobby. Would absolutely book again.

reviews.author: EEE123
reviews.title: No
reviews.text: If you have other options, go with them. Stayed here for a girls trip and it was really disappointing. We had a great first day, but the second day we had a wedding party at the pool who took our chairs and moved our stuff. When we complained to the manager - Travis - he said they were paying guests and there was nothing he could do. We were also paying guests. Not an issue that couldn’t have been easily fixed, but they chose not to. If you have the choice to stay other places- please do!

reviews.author: Busym0m03
reviews.title: A pleasant and serene stay
reviews.text:
The resort has a smaller intimate feel due to the lovely outdoor space, plenty of shaded seating nooks and gathering spaces. You can gather as a group or find a secluded spot to unwind and be by yourself. There are lots of fountains and water features throughout the property as well. So calming and serene.

The staff is customer focused and was happy to help make your stay and experience memorable. 

We were there for a conference and had several meals on site. The food was delicious - flavorful, fresh and well-prepared, a wonderful change from merely acceptable typical conference fare. The staff worked hard to please the group and they succeeded. 
 
Others in Our group rode the resort bikes in the nearby Canal Walk paths and enjoyed that. Lots of good restaurants nearby, hotel will shuttle you within a three mile radius. Uncle Sal’s Italian was small, family owned and delicious!

I booked a spa appointment and had a most pleasant experience. I had a body scrub (get rid of that dry winter skin!) with a foot reflexology add on. My masseuse was excellent, targeting areas that I didn’t even know needed attention. I had been plagued with some plantar fasciitis issues and the masseuse worked on that and reduced my pain level markedly. 😊 Tim really had a healing touch. I so appreciate his help!

The resort was a pleasant surprise!  We would stay here again. Thank you Scott Resort for a great stay.

reviews.author: asanden
reviews.title: Great Weekend at the Scott
reviews.text: Went to Scottsdale for a girls weekend away and the Scott was a perfect home base for us! The hotel is well laid out with an expansive lobby and lounge with drinks and food. The pool was great (crowded on Saturday) but wasn't a crazy scene which was appreciated. The rooms were great and wonderfully decorated. Everything was super clean and all staff attentive. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Fred N
reviews.title: Paradise in Scottsdale
reviews.text: A paradise!  We were greeted by very friendly resort staff.  We arrived late and the lobby area was very welcoming.  The grounds are immaculately cared for and the room made for a great get-away.  The pools were a great place to relax as well as our shaded patio.  I wish we could have stayed longer.  Travel safe…

reviews.author: Dave W
reviews.title: THE Best Boutique Hotel in Scottsdale
reviews.text: I have had the privilege of staying at The Scott on many occasions. Each and every time I stay here, i am blown away by the attention to detail on every level! This boutique hotel has all of the best amenities one would want at any hotel. The staff always go above and beyond at every opportunity - this includes the pool servers. There is never a time where I have felt that I have had to wait an extended period of time to get a drink or order food. The restaurant and bar are exceptional the food is amazing. (DO NOT miss out by not ordering the breakfast hash browns (potatoes) - INCREDIBLE). The rooms are clean and the beds are extremely comfortable. The ambiance of the entire place is off the charts with firepits, places to sit and hang out all around the property. I have also utilized the spa services, and I had one of the best massages I have ever had. Cannot recommend this place enough. Every time I go, whether it is for work or for fun, I am always treated amazingly. Keep up the great work, and I can't wait to be back again soon.

reviews.author: Eunora F.
reviews.title: Fun Girls' Getaway
reviews.text: This resort was beautiful and had everything we needed for a fun getaway. We took advantage of the bikes offered to ride into town for breakfast, the food and drinks were good, and lounging by the pool was the perfect way to spend the afternoons. The pool area is much smaller than other resorts so I am thankful we were there during the weekday. I would imagine the area to be too crowded on weekends. Also the chairs were placed too closely together- again, not an issue for us but could be too close with more people. Overall a nice experience.

reviews.author: Marissa H
reviews.title: Nice lobby if you want to sleep there
reviews.text: This place is horrific. I would consider this a motel with a lavish welcome area. The rooms are dark and dingy. The hallways made us feel as if we were in a scary movie. The pool area can’t accommodate the amount of people at the hotel. I would stay else where. We planned to stay for 7 days and we left after 4 days of being there.

reviews.author: Reno24
reviews.title: Sadly disappointed
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying.. I never write reviews, but this experience was so poor, I wanted to share my experience and warn others that what you see on the website is not what you get. 

While the lobby and pool area were beautiful, the rest of the hotel was a let down. Our room was on the ground floor and practically IN  the pool, to the point that we couldn't even leave our shades open. So I paid a ridiculous about of money to stay in a room where I had to keep the blinds closed the entire time. 

The bed sheets in our room were dirty when we opened our bed the first night (yuck) and when we requested a blanket it took over 2 hours to arrive. 

There were constantly half eaten food trays left in the hallway. 

We had paid for the "festiva package" upon arrival, and not only did we not received it, the staff appeared aggravated when I requested that it be removed from my bill. 

The first night of our stay, the hotel was hosting a wedding. When I asked to place a dinner order to take back to my room,  I was told that they weren't serving food bc the kitchen was only cooking for the wedding that night. I was then told to call Uber Eats. So, I paid a Saturday night room fee and was unable to use the amenities at the resort, bc they were hosting a wedding. 
To say I was disappointed is an understatement. 

The only people that made our stay enjoyable were Jason, Zach, Rocco and the rest of the gentleman that worked our front and ran the shuttle. They were welcoming, informative and friendly.

reviews.author: Sharon91320
reviews.title: Nice resort, Completely Understaffed, Poor Follow Through on Issues.
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice and the grounds are beautiful however this place is suffering from greedy management who have filled every room but have not staffed properly to manage all the customer base. I gave this to a friend as a gift and when she checked in at 4 PM the room was not ready and was told it would not be ready until 5 pm -  that was after waiting 20 minutes for valet parking who never showed up to take her car.  She had to haul her luggage from the back parking lot all the way to the lobby. The front desk gave her a drink coupon which she took to the bar and every single bar spot was loaded with dirty dishes and barware and only one bartender trying to manage the entire place. The next day at the pool, she waited for a waiter to take her drink order but nobody ever showed up. She went to the bar and was told that all orders had to be placed at the bar and she had to keep checking back to find out if it was ready. That took 45 minutes for one drink and an appetizer. The next day she had a massage and that went well. Throughout her whole stay, she went out for dinner each night in the valet parking was nowhere to be found and people are lined up angry waiting for their cars. I called the manager Tyler to talk about some kind of compensation as I had also ordered an amenity for the room which was never delivered. He was very nice and offered me a discount which I never received and have called the accounting department no less than 8 times to try to get this resolved - with no call back - and my credit card is still being charged for the full amount of the stay. I am now disputing the charge with my credit card company and have wasted so much time on this ridiculous situation that I was compelled to write this review. I have traveled all over the world and held meetings all over this country and I have never been so disappointed in a $700 a night resort. This place better get its act together or they will go out of business.

reviews.author: oski90
reviews.title: Worst hotel experience ever
reviews.text: I don’t write reviews but had to do so here.   This place is beyond horrible.  Wannabe hipsters staying in a glorified run down appartnment complex with completely incompetent staff.  Loud and beyond unsophisticated. Honestly, do not stay here.  It’s awful on every level

reviews.author: Meryl A
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel, Great Location, Excellent Massage, Horrible Management
reviews.text:
We checked into the hotel late on a Wednesday night and were so excited to see how beautiful the lobby was. Our room was well equipped and clean and we looked forward to our 5 night stay. Thursday morning breakfast in the Canal Club was good - not great, but still happy. 
Then the restaurant, bar and pool bar were suddenly closed for most of the weekend. There was no communication from anyone at the hotel about what was happening, but they seemed to open briefly and close again. So, for most of the weekend, all of the food and beverage were shut down.
Also, by Friday afternoon, when our room wasn't cleaned, we called down to ask if Housekeeping would be cleaning at all. We were told they are cleaning every other day. But our room hadn't been cleaned for 2 days. So they told us they would send someone the next day to clean. When we saw Housekeeping in the hall on Saturday, they said we weren't on their schedule. Just seemed like a lot of miscommunication.
On the bright side, had a spectacular massage at the spa.
When we checked out, the front desk told us that they would remove the resort fees from our bill because everything was closed. And they also offered to remove our food charges. But when they charged our credit card, we were still charged for all of it. I called their billing department, left a message, and they never responded.
It's really a shame that this amazing property is so poorly managed. We have a son who lives in Scottsdale and we really would have loved to have a great place to go back to.

reviews.author: E8306UBadam
reviews.title: Nice setting but ridiculous lack of service
reviews.text:
A Beautiful property but service is so bad, there were a few odd employees who were generally very nice but like in other reviews, typically we were made to feel like we were annoying the staff, at the bar, and trying to get a table at the restaurant whether for breakfast lunch or dinner, each time was a hassle, if we could find anyone to help at all. Its a shame really that this brand doesn't have the employee training of a Relais Chateaux or LHW chain or Four Seasons it could have been a great experience. I never write reviews but felt compelled to let everyone know what they are walking into. 
AC from Toronto Canada

reviews.author: Andrea K
reviews.title: Ambiance on point, service, meh
reviews.text:
Walking into this hotel is like a dream.  Decor is stunning and the smell... ahhhh!  If they didn't get the ambiance so darn flawless, I would have rated the hotel a lot lower.  The room was a good size, felt clean and of course adorably decorated. 
For the price point, however, I had higher hopes.  1. We paid for a "Kind Pool View".  There was literally only a view of the back of a cabana.  When I inquired about it, they did not seem to understand the problem with the room - repeating, it is a pool king, what is the problem.  Anyway, it might help if you ask for a room on the upper floor since the lower floors provide no "view".  2.  We got to the pool around 3 the first day and there were NO towels.  We had to ask several times for towels and 30 minutes later someone brought some hotel room towels to us and a line up of other guests waiting for towels.  3. We got to the pool around 9 am on a Saturday and there were already so many chairs "saved" with towels, we grabbed two chairs quickly and spend the day in the mostly shady side of the pool.  It would be helpful for the hotel to put in place a clear "no holding" policy as there are very few sunny spots and people that actually want to enjoy the pool in the morning are left with no options, while others sit at brunch and come back hours later for their chairs. 4. In general the staff seemed unconcerned about our presence.  Pool service on Saturday was great, otherwise, desk, bar, restaurant and housekeeping staff seemed disinterested in their roles and us as guests. No bad interactions, just nothing memorable or special.  For the price I will stick with other resorts that pay more attention to customer service details over interior design.

reviews.author: Luke L
reviews.title: Spa Service
reviews.text: Wow!  I just had the most incredible massage I’ve ever experienced.  Michelle W made my massage so memorable and comfortable that I would seriously plan my next Scottsdale trip here specifically to get another massage from her.  It felt like she pulled any tension and negative energy out of my fingers, toes, and the top of my head.  I highly recommend asking for Michelle W!

reviews.author: auggie_tech1
reviews.title: Nice corporate meeting location
reviews.text: They did a great job hosting my company for a smaller corporate event. Meeting space was nice and had the tech necessary. Food was good too. Was even able to have space for our group outside for dinner one night. Rooms weren't cleaned daily, but can blame that on COVID still. Otherwise would recommend and wish we had more time there.

reviews.author: kalee h
reviews.title: Boutique Hotel Paradise
reviews.text: Wonderful spot for a bachelorette trip! The design of the hotel, staff and amenities were perfect for our group of 15. The location is ideal, close to great restaurants, shopping and bars. I will be back!

reviews.author: Vera
reviews.title: Wow this is amazing
reviews.text:
Ok, first I just want to get this out of the way. I love the pools. One of them has a beautiful sandy beach INSIDE it! Now the food. Yes, the steak might be 40 dollars but that’s not the only thing you have to order. I personally love the burger that I had. And the desserts! I would pay every single penny I own for one of those. They taste (and I do NOT use this word lightly) perfect.
The rooms are lovely. I love the general flow, you know,the big windows, the natural light flooding in. The beds are comfy and the pillows are soft and lovely.

reviews.author: chrismC5035RQ
reviews.title: Great place, location, staff, and food and beverage.
reviews.text: This is a true resort!  I will not go in too many details, but you will be pleased staying here.  The staff is incredible!  Room, location, food is top notch!  I definitely did not want to leave. I will return soon for sure.

reviews.author: GrlsTrip
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Poor Customer Service
reviews.text: The Scott is a gorgeous resort, unfortunately the customer service is lacking.  The bell staff was more than helpful, but other than that, the service was slow and we felt like we were annoying the bar staff. No pool service and we didn't have one person ask how our stay was going... not even during checkout. The Spa is amazing.

reviews.author: scnuki
reviews.title: Cool vibe, great food and fabulous service
reviews.text: Very quaint, eclectic, fun vibe hotel. The food is outstanding, my hubby had the steak salad 2X! and I cannot speak enough about the staff and service, they went above and beyond. Rooms are very large and comfortable - I would stay here again and again. If you are looking for a place that is not an overcrowded standard resort this is it!

reviews.author: laufersj
reviews.title: Nice hotel!
reviews.text:
Overall, we enjoyed our stay at The Scott! Pros: Beautiful grounds, comfortable beds, nice staff. Cons: Lobby not picked up consistently (dirty in morning from previous night), limited coffee in room (only give you 2 Nespresso pods every other day), room not cleaned daily. 

Overall, would stay again and would recommend to others - but, for an upscale resort I would expect them to address some of the cons on this list!

reviews.author: kparke370012
reviews.title: Overpriced and outdated rooms
reviews.text: Old AC/Heater vents in room squeezed and squelched all need even after turning them off. Beds were wonky with deep impressions on one side from to many people sleeping on them. The property and amenities were great. But the rooms were not on par with the lobby and grounds which all looked clean and newly updated.

reviews.author: lambros2022
reviews.title: Lambros
reviews.text: The room was average at best, but its a  great location. The service at the restaurant was below average, we waited for over 20 minutes and finally went to the bar for breakfast. Its overpriced for the overall experience

reviews.author: lcurtis918
reviews.title: Birthday trip w/a baby
reviews.text: Relaxing place to stay. We loved the fire pits in the evening. Pool and vibe were great. The rooms were a little small and dated. The spa was overpriced in my opinion. Overall a unique hotel with chill vibes! I would go back but skip the massage at the spa and just do a facial.

reviews.author: Jacqueline S
reviews.title: Best resort in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
The Scott exceeded our expectation!! This was a girls trip and it was ideal location for walking to restaurants and just a mile away from The District. 

The FOOD was phenomenal here. The pool/hot tub were fabulous. Absolutely will be returning.

Say hello to Stefan at the front desk. He’s the best!

reviews.author: Tyson M
reviews.title: We Had a Better Visit Last Time
reviews.text:
We really liked The Scott the last time we came. This time, the AC didn't work and wasn't fixed when we asked about it. 

The Canal Club is a great place for good drinks and a nice place to hang out. 

Not many spa options because they were booked. When I called, I got the impression that there was only one person working. 

It's probably because of COVID, but still not good.

reviews.author: skigirltiff
reviews.title: Misleading room description
reviews.text: I was surprised to see the courtyard view is of a white wall with pool supplies, or of the road. Either get a standard room or you’ll have to upgrade to pool (probably their intent). The pool was nice, I loved the sandy beach. The grounds are beautiful.

reviews.author: Melissa S
reviews.title: Lipstick on a Pig
reviews.text:
This iconic Scottsdale Boutique hotel has outlived it prime!  Let me start by saying what a lovely welcoming front entrance with the classic car and bicycles.  The Lobby was beautiful with its Havana vibe.  The front desk staff was welcoming, and check in was prompt.  
We went to room 116, and were please with the size, layout and decor, but it was quite weathered.  The shower had poor drainage and there was a loud and constant whirring noise (not associated w the A/C), keeping us awake all night…even  noise canceling AirPods with music could not block the noise.  They move our room at 5 am.  Room 550, consistently decorated.  We had not tried the A/C until bedtime (our bad), now we had a different, and even louder noise.  Exhausted from the day we turned it off for the night but the room got stuffy. Back to reception…maintenance fixed the A/C, no more noise, but not blowing cold air any longer.  There was a room service tray on the floor in the hall for 24+ hours.
Taking advantage of the live music and energy of The Canal club after returning from dinner we found the service to be horribly understaffed.  Couldn’t order a second round and unbussed tables all around the lobby, we had to search someone out to pay.
SO DISAPPOINTING…. Don’t waste your money.

reviews.author: Kheib26
reviews.title: Instagram vs. reality - photos make it seem way nicer
reviews.text:
I felt like the photos made the rooms seem much nicer and cleaner, but when we arrived and walked into our building B it already smelled very musty and walking into our room the decor is beautiful but it really just looked like cheap paint was painted over during their renovation- it was chipping everywhere, and the paint layers looked very thick like they didn’t really bother, just painted over. The hardware on the closet doors were loose and the vent above the door was extremely dusty - really disgusting actually. The canal club couches we sat on for breakfast were also very dusty and the floor was so dirty with dust and food as well. Dust builds up fast but it clearly doesn’t get dusted/vacuumed enough. We enjoyed our stay but I was just shocked at the quality of the rooms especially, compared to the photos online.
I was confused that there was no hand soap - they had put a face bar cleaner but otherwise nothing. Housekeeping only comes every 2 days and we only stayed for 2 nights so our room never got cleaned. 
We only went in the hot tub but the white plastic railing to hold on to was very very lose and flimsy so probably a good idea to tighten those. Overall it was a cute hotel, nice to take photos there but I think it was more like a Instagram vs. reality which was a bit disappointing. I felt like the photos made the rooms seem much nicer and cleaner, but when we arrived and walked into our building B it already smelled very musty and walking into our room the decor is beautiful but it really just looked like cheap paint was painted over- it was chipping everywhere and the vent above the door was extremely dusty - really disgusting actually. The canal club couches we sat on for breakfast were also very dusty and the floor was so dirty with dust and food as well. Dust builds up fast but it clearly doesn’t get dusted/vacuumed enough. We enjoyed our stay but I was just shocked at the quality of the rooms especially, compared to the photos online. 
We only went in the hot tub but the white railing to hold on to was very very lose and flimsy so probably a good idea to tighten those. Overall it was a cute hotel, nice to take photos there but I think it was more like a Instagram vs. reality which was a bit disappointing. I think it was way overpriced for what we got.
The location is great, only like 20 min from the airport, right by the fashion mall and a 3 min drive to old town Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Chanel W
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text:
Rooms are lovely, Staff was excellent, especially Stefon at the front desk. The African American gentleman that helps at the entrance was just that a gentleman. The bar staff was really good. Great lattes in the morning. The pool area is well kept and beautiful. 
The spa..... OMG! as  a SPA DIVA. I give it a 10+ I will definitely come back.

reviews.author: 60christine1089
reviews.title: Excellent property! Beautifully upgraded and the staff is amazing!
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised how well this property was remodeled. The decor and the overall hotel vibe was great! This coupled with an amazing staff I will for sure stay there again! My only wish for this property is a more expansive spa. I loved my massage but would have loved to have a more spa experience. A property this beautiful definitely needs an upgraded spa! Otherwise overall great experience!

reviews.author: FunForFrank
reviews.title: Birthday getaway
reviews.text: The Scott was an excellent choice for our adult getaway to celebrate our friend's 40th.  The staff was friendly, the grounds were clean and well manicured and room was very comfortable.  The espresso martini was my favorite, but thoroughly enjoyed cocktails by the firepit in the patio.

reviews.author: Rebecca Z
reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.text: Everything about The Scott is lovely from the well-appointed and interesting accommodations to the outdoor landscapes to the zen-ful common areas! This is a go-to spot for daughters and I when we are in the area. Service and staff are impeccable. Common areas and rooms are very clean and comfortable. Great boutique hotel experience!

reviews.author: jmariehartley
reviews.title: If you want to get COVID and come to a resort with NO basic cleaning, book away!
reviews.text: I travel to Scottsdale frequently and previously had fabulous drinks outside at the Cabana Club. I had made a mental note this hotel looked fabulous so we were excited to stay for the holidays this year. Unfortunately when we checked in, we quickly noticed that basic service was completely missing. At the pool, dirty towels and cups sat for an entire day prior to being bused. The same thing occurred around the grounds and at the Cabana Club which limited where we could sit and was in general not at all the ambiance we’d hope for. Individuals in neighboring rooms ordered room service and those plates sat in the hallways for DAYS until I called MULTIPLE times asking them to be picked up as the hallway was starting to stink. Half way into our stay our heater went out and we were told there was nothing to do but one night’s resort fee would be refunded. It was actually cold over the New Years and we were freezing! There was no manager while we were there and our request for a manager to please call us when we checked out has gone completely ignored the last 10 days. Two days after checking out, I tested positive for COVID. I realize it’s a pandemic but we had gone very few places outside of the hotel and I was wearing a K95 elsewhere. I believe I caught COVID at the Scotts Resort which is not a surprise since there was very clearly no effort to maintain a clean and tidy property. This place is past its’ prime. The grounds are beautiful but the service is completely non existent. Book elsewhere for sure.

reviews.author: Selina L
reviews.title: Great Atmosphere
reviews.text: The Cuban theme was nicely done, lobby, bar, pool and patios. Recommend it for all ages and families. Location was great and bike friendly. We rode the hotel bikes on paths around the town to the riverfront to a pub for a beer,

reviews.author: faustin0garza
reviews.title: Beautiful Property & Excellent Service
reviews.text: Comfortable and spacious lobby and gathering areas.  Two large pools and beautiful gardens.  Several private outside areas.  Room was spacious and comfortable with outside sitting patio. Staff was friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: bluegizmo4
reviews.title: Great resort for couples!
reviews.text:
Did a quick couples retreat and my wife and I were both very impressed! Exceptional attentive service and top quality accommodations. Room was ready even before check in and was spotless. The pool was fantastic and dining greatly exceeded our expectations!

We will be returning, thank you so much for just what we needed to recharge!!

reviews.author: rshipley2022
reviews.title: The prices you pay and not have housekeeping daily, not for me
reviews.text:
No room service until second day, for the prices you pay for staying at the hotel we spect room service EVERYDAY and that was not the case. Not coming back here again for that reason.

We called to reception to make this point and they told us they just going to send clean towels, they use the COVID excuse to not clean, but it should be the oposite, clean daily to kill bacteria.

reviews.author: swimwixon15
reviews.title: Learn to clean and remove dishes
reviews.text: No service, no salt…. High prices… No thank you. I won’t be back. Covid ruined this place. They really hung their hat on the “staffing shortages,” excuse so they can cut costs. Also, the kitchen is garbage now.

reviews.author: AAgarwal12
reviews.title: Resort review
reviews.text: The resort was average . You need to improve your rooms and provide more value for the money charged . Provide some extra benefits to your guests , include breakfast packages , some extra perks in the Canal bar, do some special events.

reviews.author: ChelseaRenee123
reviews.title: Not well maintained and bed bugs
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I stayed here for two nights.  At first glance the hotel was lovely.  Well decorated, great landscaping, fun design and well thought out.  The actual guest room was a bit dirty (hair in the sink, stains on walls and furniture) and also seemed quite run-down.. Paint chipping off all over, door handles to the closet broken, overall not well maintained.  We checked out yesterday and went to another hotel- my boyfriends ankles/legs were covered in bed-bug bites.  We were in room 211. I didn’t have any because I slept in socks and pjs that were pants and long sleeves. I have tried to contact the hotel, but to no avail I was unable to reach a manager to discuss, so I’m leaving this review here in hopes they address the problem.

reviews.author: bibi-eduardo
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL PLACE TO STAY!
reviews.text:
This hotel in Scottsdale was a wonderful surprise! A beautiful place in a small town really close to Phoenix and other places. We enjoyed our time there and would like to return someday soon.
Beautifully designed!

reviews.author: rlargo645631
reviews.title: Relaxing and hip
reviews.text: Have stayed here twice and have seen the bar and lobby filled with model worthy singles in a Sunday afternoon, met and talked with other couples while enjoying a drink sitting around the fire pit, met families, fellow dog owners… it’s a very intimate and inclusive property that is walking distance to Old Town. Very short drive to some super restaurants. Pools are clean and surrounded by lush foliage. Staff is excellent!

reviews.author: tdonal751532
reviews.title: Air Did Not Work - 2 Rooms
reviews.text: The air conditioner did not work in the room.  The maintenance team came in and checked and said that the chillers were working and everything was good but they were not sure why it was not cooling down in the room. They added a note  to my booking and when I went to the front desk the next morning to ask for a room change, it was simply shared that we would only take off your resort fee. Mind you, the room was unbearable and they acknowledge that. They moved me to another room on the first floor which they called a pool view as well, which there was absolutely no view of the pool as it was blocked by flourishing trees. This made it absolutely a view that was not a pool view and no form or fashion. Again. Was told there was nothing that could be done because I booked through a third party so only thing was credited was the resort fee.

reviews.author: Mike O
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: We had a great stay and loved the historic property. Everything was clean and the property was well maintained. Great location, close to shopping and dining options in downtown Scottsdale. Drinks at the bar were pretty pricey...

reviews.author: 368drew
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text: Lovely hotel with a great atmosphere and decor. Beautiful pools and great location in Scottsdale. My wife and I had a great time and enjoyed the room and amenities. It was a little too chilly to use the pool, but we utilized the outdoor jacuzzi one night and it was magical.

reviews.author: jacob
reviews.title: AWESOME RESORT
reviews.text: Great little hidden gem! Came in to have a few drinks with friends and it was beautiful. We then came back and decided to stay the night a month later and the service was excellent. When we arrived we were brought up to our room by the bellman Chase, who told us about a bunch of different restaurants in the area. He even called us a golf cart to take us to dinner. The  pool area is a cool little spot. Food was fantastic! The room is a cool Cuban vibe with a layed back tone. I would HIGHLY recommend.

reviews.author: jlwalls996
reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text:
I was fortunate enough to win a stay with The Scott’s parent company, Classic Resorts. I chose The Scott for a girls weekend to Phoenix to see the ballet. We had a wonderful time there.
Room was clean and nicely furnished, staff were fantastic and accommodating.

reviews.author: FellowTraveler781631
reviews.title: Super fun vibe and really nice accommodations in an awesome location.
reviews.text: We loved the vibe of this hotel. Super cool! Definitely feels like you are on a vacation someplace special. The decor and attention to detail were very impressive. Very convenient location to many fun places in old town.

reviews.author: mia902
reviews.title: Not the best value for money
reviews.text: Hallway smelled awful. Room was too small for the price. Staff were nonetheless nice and friendly and lobby was nice.  Hotel rooms and hallways should be renovated. Valet was not always available. Umbrellas should be provided.

reviews.author: ksmith462
reviews.title: Not recommended
reviews.text: The room was so overpriced due to the condition of the property. You can't put lipstick on a pig! Would definitely not recommend! Our firm came in for a corporate function and will not plan to stay here again.

reviews.author: ExperiencedTraveler88888889
reviews.title: Passable if you are a 23 year old bridesmaid - NOT fun for the well-traveled &/or business traveler!!!
reviews.text:
Stay away if you are not a 23 year old bridesmaid in search of your next selfie to post on social media. This place is literally overrun with them. They should really hand out selfie sticks upon checkin. 

I am a professional adult - very experienced domestic and international business traveler and found this place to be miserable. Big groups of loud mindless chatter that you really cannot escape from in the common areas. 

The wifi did not work. To hear yourself think you will be forced to stay in your room and will have to use your cell phone hotspot to get online. This is not a "four diamond resort" if you are an adult who has traveled at all. 

I also very much disagree with the terming this a resort. It has a nicely designed pool with a lukewarm spa which is invariably at capacity with various dewy-eyed bridesmaids. Not large grounds to explore (most of which are reserved for the various bridal parties at all times) and just one restaurant with the exact same daily menu. Not many vegetarian options... Decent feather pillows in the room was the only upside.

reviews.author: wombatnat
reviews.title: weekend stay
reviews.text: Overall a great stay. Morning yoga was excellent, the food was good, and the atmosphere pleasant.  Saturday night was busy and loud with hotel Christmas party guests, but otherwise the atmosphere was relaxed.

reviews.author: 942mcrowe
reviews.title: Outstanding Guest Service
reviews.text: I was ill and one of the housekeepers heard me coughing (alot) in my room.  She notified the front desk, Mehgan contacted me to see if she could send tea and did I needed anything.  Wow!  The Scott is such a happy, positive place, and their team is genuinely caring  Can't wait to return when I am feeling better!

reviews.author: abbeybergquist
reviews.title: Cute hotel, great location!
reviews.text: Hotel is in a great location! It has plenty of parking and the interior decor of the hotel and rooms are very cute and stylish. Hotel staff was very friendly and helpful. The nespresso in each room was a much appreciated touch. As a solo traveler I felt very safe on this trip and would suggest this hotel to other solo travelers. The pool area was nice with plenty of lounging options. I did have a difficult time finding a spot in the sun however as most of the pool area was shaded.

reviews.author: Tom E
reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: You can get a pretty good instagram picture at the hotel. It seems set up specifically for that purpose. Don’t expect great service or a luxury stay but it doesn’t seem like that is the point here anyway.

reviews.author: Busiest358w
reviews.title: Not for business travelers!
reviews.text:
If you happen to be anything other than a giddy untraveled 23 year old bride with implants, or part of her 20 person instagram team, this is not the place for you. I am a very experienced business traveler who was simply looking for somewhere luxurious and peaceful. All I found were teams of chatty bridesmaids. It’s almost hilariously overrun in that way. it is not at all peaceful except in the rooms. But I am not trying to pay $457 / night plus a $100 resort fee to be confined to a bedroom just hear myself think. 

If you are not in your early 20’s and will not be blown away by a nice but super basic swimming pool, this is not the place. If you’re a man looking to watch women trip over themselves to impress each other while you crack up, it could be fun. 

The wifi doesn’t work...got a hotspot? 

But they do have a DJ in the lobby... Just need to add a spinning strobe light and maybe hand out selfie sticks upon check in. 

I wish I had gone to something like the Garden Inn or a Residence Inn or maybe even an old run down Sheraton
Instead. Ha. Torture. 

One upside was the pillow. Pretty decent pillows. 

Caveat emptor...

reviews.author: kstins0n
reviews.title: Business trip
reviews.text: Great location.  I stay here often when traveling for business in Scottsdale.  Close to Old Town Scottsdale.   Rooms are comfortable and quiet. Nice set up for work with fast internet.  Spa and Fitness center on site which is a huge plus!

reviews.author: karinharris13
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, great proximity
reviews.text: The Scott has a very cool, hip lobby, lots of couches and chairs to hang out. The wraparound bar is very simple and beautiful with plenty of outdoor seating and games. The restaurant had a laid back yet elegant vibe. The property is lovely with lush landscaping, more games, two pools, with plenty of shade, fire pits and tables galore. The rooms are nice with a huge balcony, so nice with a garden view. The beds could have softer less creaky mattresses, and more electrical plugs throughout. The decor is cute, "casablanca- esque", but the bathrooms are small. The walk-in closet is nice, but a bigger bathroon would be better, I really liked this resort, but it is expensive and I found it is better to purchase closer to the date you are staying as cheaper rates open up or you are looking at $400/night.

reviews.author: Pinot R
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text:
My husband and I spent the Thanksgiving weekend at the Scott Resort and Spa and enjoyed our stay very much. We found the hotel amenities such as the pools, lobby, location, etc. perfect. The resort is walking distance to many restaurants and a mall. You can choose to go for a morning or afternoon bike ride using the bikes provided by the resort at no additional charge. There was plenty of seating at the pool areas. The one difficulty was finding locations in the sun. I’m sure the shaded areas come in handy at the height of the summer. 

We found the decor of the rooms and the hotel to be nice. 

We  enjoyed sitting by the fire pits listening to the outdoor entertainment. 

Service was offered at the pool and the staff were very efficient and attentive. We found the restaurant staff to be less efficient, as we had to wait quite awhile to be waited on after being seated. The food was good but for what we paid we would have hoped for better service. 

We most definitely would consider staying at the Scott in the future.

reviews.author: rachthompson20
reviews.title: 10/10 The place to stay!
reviews.text: The Scott is where you want to stay on your next trip to Scottsdale! Not only is the property exceptional, and reminds you of a desert oasis paradise, but the staff is truly the cherry on top of the cake! Everyone from the front desk staff, to the bell men, to security and the medic, went above and beyond to help us with all our needs and make us feel welcomed and comfortable. I don't have a single complaint about this place, everything was perfect.

reviews.author: kberry012021
reviews.title: Used to be our favorite
reviews.text: This used to be our favorite resort, this last trip left a little to be desired. Air conditioning went out, only cleaning around the pool area every 4-5 hours and the main bar closed at 10PM. With the cost of this resort I would hope that they can soon figure out the short staffing issues (even though all the staff was friendly) and get the resort back to what it used to be.

reviews.author: Adrian5664
reviews.title: A can’t miss resort
reviews.text: Took my wife there for her 40th birthday and could not have had a better time!  The staff was absolutely amazing!! Definitely recommend having a treatment at the Spa!!! We did a couples massage and it was amazing!!

reviews.author: Steve R
reviews.title: Decent Stay, Not as High as we expected
reviews.text:
Pool was clean and had a 'fun' atmosphere. Same with jacuzzi. 
Food very good, but not excellent. Somewhat pricey. 
Staff very helpful, the property definitely has an old-line 'resort feel.'
Would stay again, but kind of pricey for the amenities. 
Bed comfortable, but was not given a King, and instead had two Queens. 
Bar scene at times was hopping.

reviews.author: stayC m
reviews.title: Management Fail
reviews.text: Your facilities were grossly understaffed (or at least the staff on hand could not handle the volume). For such a pricy, supposed "4 star resort", I was extremely disappointed. And honestly - I felt sorry for the staff. They seemed completely unsupported. I can give some specific examples. On a busy Saturday, the Kitchen Manager apparently stopped all food orders at the Canal Club bar so nobody could order any food from the bar. Drinks were also pretty backed up, but again they seemed understaffed and the bartender was doing the best she could and friendly. The restaurant hostess, on the other hand, was rude and unprofessional. We approached her for seating and she was on her phone and we had to get her attention. We were told it was a 30min wait, even though there were tons of open tables. A couple after us was told 10min and when I questioned her she said, "I thought there were 4 of you", which there were clearly only 2 of us standing there. No waitress EVER came to our table and after 20min we went and hunted one down. They were also very overwhelmed and explained there were no sections assigned and they didn't know we'd been seated (again- hostess fail, but still they should have checked on us). Once we finally got our food, it was very good but I wouldn't say worth all the hassle and wait time. The only real positive thing I have to say is check out was very easy and there was a very friendly, helpful man that worked on getting us a car; very professional and constantly updating. He gets a gold star, but the resort management gets a giant thumbs down.

reviews.author: Kelly S
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with amazing food
reviews.text: The Scott is the perfect place to relax for a few days. The property is beautiful and the rooms are spacious and really nicely designed. The restaurant on the property is fantastic but it also close enough to Old Town that you can easily walk to any of the numerous restaurants there. The pool is fabulous and the entire property is so well designed with many places to sit, eat, drink and relax. Also the spa is absolutely wonderful! Get the "experience", you won't regret it.

reviews.author: wayofthewarriorm2021
reviews.title: My 1st Stay
reviews.text: The staff was incredibly friendly, fast and easy to reach.  The resort is beautiful, the bar was great and the food we loved.  Everything was easy to get access to and the gym even though smaller than I'd like, had all the equipment I needed for a good workout.

reviews.author: sweetsunshine55
reviews.title: An elegant oasis in the heart of Scottsdale
reviews.text:
The vibe of the resort kind of felt like Palm Springs meets Havana.
Upscale and chic, yet relaxed.
This was a great central location to explore Scottsdale and Phoenix.
Excellent service.
Great guest room including a balcony. Quiet as a tomb.
Quick drive or bike ride to Old Town. (Complementary bikes at the resort.)
Within walking distance to restaurants and nightlife. 
Note, 2-story hotel, but no elevators. 
Would absolutely return.

reviews.author: dmazon26
reviews.title: Bad service
reviews.text: Short on staff and hospitality. 1 option for food out of a whole menu. No staff to carry bags to a second story building with no elevators. Air conditioning in the rooms seems outdated. Had to wait 15 minutes at the valet parking, not because it was busy. The guy in charge was somewhere else.

reviews.author: Brown_Samantha
reviews.title: Nice boutique hotel close to Scottsdale Old Town and many other attractions
reviews.text:
The location is quite ideal.  Short distance to Old Town, and near all the sights we wanted to see:  Desert Botanical Garden, Taliesin West, Hole in the Rock.  Even the In-N-Out Burger we love.  Our room was located on the second floor, with no one above us.  It overlooked the lagoon and green area; quite lovely.  We loved the room – so much space.  The only negative thing is the bathroom is quite small; a one-person space.  That’s probably the case for older properties.  Other than that, very good.  We ate at the Canal Club once, for breakfast, it was great and quick.

We found the front desk staff to be very helpful and friendly.  They answered texts promptly.  The whole property had a relaxing atmosphere.  We loved the look and feel of the resort.  While the resort can be accessed from the streets, they do have secured main doors that you can only open with your room key.

They held 2 weddings on the weekend.  One had a fantastic DJ that played danceable music until about 10 pm.  Wish we could have crashed it; would have danced the night away.  The second wedding was towards the patio, with a live band.  Less variety.  If you want absolute serenity, this may be something you keep in mind.  It did not bother us, since we usually go to bed about 10 pm anyway.  If you were out on the town drinking and partying, that would be a non-issue as you would return during the wee hours when the whole resort is very quiet.

We our booking agent told us the resort fee was extra and $25.  They charged us $42 per night + tax at check out.  Probably would have still chose to stay here, but $42 is steep.

reviews.author: lilyalexbuck
reviews.title: Nice but overpriced.
reviews.text: The grounds are beautiful and offer a lot of outdoor places to relax.  The rooms are nicely done, but you can tell it’s just a facelift and underneath is still an old hotel. Beds were comfy, AC not loud. Food was good and not overpriced.  Just be prepared to wait for service.  Not as luxurious as you’d think given the price tag (I can stay at the Ritz elsewhere for the same price!), but the hotel market during high season in AZ is going to cheat you one way or another.

reviews.author: 54paulak
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
This is a lovely resort especially the pools. The pools were never over crowded and I really liked the options for sun or shade.
The food was excellent. I ate several restaurant meals and all were great. The hotel staff was always very helpful.

reviews.author: Jevaye S
reviews.title: Mediocre Drinks and Unclean Bar/Service
reviews.text:
Resort was nice. Not a fan of the Bar/Service. Drinks were mediocre. Sat at the bar one evening and watch MULTIPLE dirty glasses be sent out. Also EVERY server/bartender was trying the drinks and adding garnishes. Mind you, they were not washing hands. And I'm sorry but during this time, 4 people grabbing olives out of the same jar to put in my drink?? I'll pass...

But the property itself was nice.

reviews.author: Bruce102021
reviews.title: Business stay
reviews.text: The staff and resort accommodated every need for the conference held at the resort. The activities were engaging for everyone from Corn hole to sitting around the fire places outside at night talking with other guests

reviews.author: Q415HOjeff
reviews.title: great design
reviews.text:
loved staying at this hotel. we were staying nearby and decided to move as we loved the feel of the place. Food was good with nice vegetarian options. 
Like pool with sandy bottom. Loved restaurant "cabanas" for our dinner.

reviews.author: dshea2021
reviews.title: We sure had "Sun" Fun!
reviews.text: In town for a Board Meeting and it could not have gone any better.  Location, location, location.  Service, service and service.  Luxury, luxury and luxury.  Oh, and sun, sun and more sun.  The Scott was a perfect choice for our group.

reviews.author: Charles D
reviews.title: Resort in the Heart of Scottsdale
reviews.text: The Scott Resort is beautiful and very well done!  It has an open air reception running all the way back to the bar and pool area.  Very relaxing and comfortable feeling to it.  Two pools to choose from.  The restaurants have good food.  The meeting rooms we used were well done and taken care of nicely.  The staff was always helpful and available.  The room was large but a little "tired".  They need to remodel the rooms.  The location is very handy to Old Town Scottsdale and other bars and restaurants and close to golf courses.  Great location.

reviews.author: hallerin5
reviews.title: Scottsdale Wedding
reviews.text: We stayed here as the mid-price room block option for a wedding and we had a great trip. I'm not sure if the room block was discounted from the normal price, but I probably would have been a little disappointed if we had chosen this hotel on our own and it was more per night than what we paid. The location is great, walking distance to restaurants and shopping. The lobby was beautiful, the food and drinks at the hotel bar/restaurant were great. The pool that doesn't have the sand is pretty nice, but food takes a while (like an hour). The fitness center is tiny - walked in and walked out at 9am because there were 5 people in there and there was no room. The room was decent and is what I would have been a little disappointed with if I had chosen this hotel on my own.

reviews.author: 934kjensen
reviews.title: Don't Waste Your Money
reviews.text: We were very disappointed with this resort. The rooms are old and dingy and not at all the caliber one would expect for the price. The room smelt mildewy and dusty. It felt like the room hand't been updated since the 70s except the furniture. I would not recommend this resort.

reviews.author: bethelstar
reviews.title: Love Love Love
reviews.text: I’ve been to the Scott a few times, one of our families favorite place to stay when we visit. Great location, we love there breakfast. Our kids love there pool. Overall cleanliness has been great. We love how close in proximity every thing is.

reviews.author: LongIslandGuy
reviews.title: So BAD on so many levels, I honestly do not know where to begin
reviews.text: I honestly don't know where to begin. Everything from the dirty sheets, noisy nighttime workers, barely functioning WiFi, terrible drinks, terrible room service, nonchalant attitude of certain staff, and an overall inconsistency that is indescribable. This is a 4 star hotel? I've packed up early - get me out of here! An utter ruining of my vacation.

reviews.author: Trek56096926103
reviews.title: Not bad
reviews.text: The hotel looked beautiful, just wish the tv comcast would work, wifi was really slow. But we watched on the select channels that were available on cable tv. Not sure if I would stay again or not. Pretty pricy for a one night stay.

reviews.author: T9643TAemilyb
reviews.title: Beautiful Property
reviews.text:
Very beautiful property - every detail has been taken care of, from the smell of the gorgeous lobby to the rooms.  Pool is nice, everything was very clean and pretty - it's got a very laid-back, quiet vibe. 
 Location is perfect in the heart of Old Scottsdale - you can walk to most anything.  There are not a ton of food options (one restaurant) but there are some of the best restaurants nearby anyway.  Overall, awesome resort!

reviews.author: lg4292021
reviews.title: Loved just about everything about this hotel!
reviews.text:
I almost cried when it was time to leave.  Absolutely gorgeous facilities, grounds and decor.  My husband and I spent a few days here for our anniversary and it was everything we hoped it would be. 
 Take me back!!!

reviews.author: Nancee80
reviews.title: Mid October Stay
reviews.text: This hotel has such a cool vibe and it smells amazing! There are so many places to sit and hang out - from the lobby areas, to the pool area and areas all around the building. The hotel has very friendly staff and is very clean. The food menu was a little too limited to want to stay for dinner and drinks were a bit pricey but good. We picked a patio view for our room and that was a bit of an oversell. The patio view was of the parking lot. That was not clear at all in the booking. The pool area was very nice and not over crowded for the time that we were there. One drawback is that you aren't within walking distance to much. You CAN walk but it takes bit to get to places (like restaurants or shopping). Overall, I would stay again but I would pick a pool view and would definitely go to dinner somewhere outside of the hotel. Snack and lunch options were good.

reviews.author: ashleyzoomak12
reviews.title: Perfect weekend get away
reviews.text: Came to Arizona for the first time and stayed here. Didn't use the spa but hoping to come back and try the spa. Everything else was great! Drinks were delicious poolside. The beds were so comfortable, and i loved using the balcony for coffee in the morning

reviews.author: Kat J
reviews.title: Not coming back…
reviews.text: This was my second (and last) time at The Scott. While the rooms were comfortable and clean and the property is beautifully designed, we had numerous room access and communication issues during our stay. We contacted the front desk no less than 5 times with door key issues with our room - only to find out that the locks are battery operated and staff only replace them when the locks die every 3 months or so. Our last morning we stopped by reception to see if we could check out a little late to spend some extra time by the pool - we were told it was no problem and waved on. Then, while checking out, we were surprised to find our bill was $800 over the original quoted price - we tried calling it out to the front desk staff who said “that’s the price of your invoice”. I decided to call accounting to resolve later - it turned out there was an billing system error overnight and the hotel had added additional nights stay to guests’ invoices - plus fees - and our invoice was affected. Accounting fixed the error when I called, but it was sketchy that The Scott didn’t proactively reach out to guests on the issue!? The Scott had also charged us an additional $50 to check out late - a fee that was not disclosed when we asked if it was possible, and I was lectured on their invoicing policies when I told them we wouldn’t have stayed late knowing it was an extra fee. I know this hotel is huge with “influencers” and wedding parties (they were EVERYWHERE), but it’s definitely not worth the $500/night we paid after all the add-ons, especially with the additional headaches.

reviews.author: Justin B
reviews.title: The Best Customer Service.
reviews.text:
We visited last week the first week of October. The weather was unbelievable…..the customer service was better. Greatness is a quality that isn’t easily attained. It takes work, and desire to be the best. The staff showed that this weekend. Thank y’all for taking care of us. 

Thanks,
-J Brady

reviews.author: tjames755208
reviews.title: Great place for an adult vacation
reviews.text:
We took a quick girls trip to the area and luck guided us to The Scott. The location is perfect, the staff is wonderful, the ambience will leave you wanting to extend your stay. 

We will definitely return for more fun!

reviews.author: sfreem817184
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: Aesthetically pleasing throughout. Lobby, rooms, grounds are all welcoming as is the staff. Great mix of relaxing and energetic vibes depending on time of day. My Fiance and I enjoyed every moment of our stay.

reviews.author: mbrewer2021
reviews.title: Scott Review
reviews.text: The Scott exceeded all expectations and was absolutely incredible! The staff, food, attention to detail and overall aesthetic of the resort were second to none. We will absolutely be back and highly recommend it to all of our friends and family.

reviews.author: KH
reviews.title: CHECK ON POOL CLOSURE fFOR PRIVATE EVENTS
reviews.text: I was  booking a last minute trip and per reviews about the pools being closed for private events decided to call.  Room was available and no mention of closure when I asked she looked up and closed for private event the whole time. I’m all for private events but that should be known to the rest of your guests when booking.  She was very pleasant on the phone but I’m pretty sure she would have booked my room and never told me.  Glad I Called.  Thanks for whoever put out that initial review on!

reviews.author: tracyjoy2021
reviews.title: Nice boutique hotel
reviews.text: The Scott has done a nice job reviving an older Scottsdale property, and breathing new life into it. Their vibe is very hip, and definitely draws in a young & elite crowd. Comfortable public spaces, great bar staff, and well-appointed rooms. Parking is also very easy on the property, and it's close enough to everything you need including Old Town Scottsdale.

reviews.author: henrymaestas12
reviews.title: Henry
reviews.text: The room was not what we expected from the online photos , the room had definitely not been cleaned or serviced in sometime , there were what appeared to be blood stains possible red wine? on the back of the bathroom door. The concierge did have it cleaned but it left a bad feeling in our stomachs. So we ended what was a 4 day stay and went else were. for the price of the room is was definitely not up to par

reviews.author: smcc2021
reviews.title: Lots of service and wait staff....
reviews.text: however good luck trying to get one to see that you would like some assistance.  Upon providing assistance I was going to ask for a drink to be served but the wait staff person had turned around and walked away so fast that I never had the chance.

reviews.author: Kailene R
reviews.title: The Best Atmosphere & Comfort
reviews.text: We stayed at The Scott for our friends wedding. We originally decided to stay here out of convenience because the reception would be here. After walking into the lobby, I already wanted to find an excuse to return. The lobby and bar area felt like such a cool atmosphere and I was worried we’d be too busy to enjoy it! The room itself made us feel so cozy and comfortable. It’s the type of room you are excited to come back to at the end of the night - not to mention it was stocked with everything you could possibly need.

reviews.author: sandymcconnell60
reviews.title: Not up to par
reviews.text: Hotel was a disappointment. The light next to the bed didn’t work the iron was broken there was no safe in my room. The halls are dark and gloomy. The only good part was the gentleman at the desk and the bellman.  Overall not up to Scottsdale standards.

reviews.author: Resort305561
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Stephan, the front desk manager needs more training in customer service. A mistake was made in our reservations. My husband & I were out enjoying our last day of vacation. Stephan called…said we were to ck out that morning. I told him no. He argued with me. We arrived back to the resort with our confirmation. Ruined our day, to be told we could stay, but would need to change rooms. He said they “sold our room”. Then, Stephan changed his mind & said we could stay in our room. Like he was doing us a favor. I went back later & asked him to comp that night due to our inconvenience. Stephan was nonchalant when he said “What inconvenience?” There is more…but the bottom line is…I have never been treated as disrespectful as Stephan treated me that day.  We wont be back-ever!

reviews.author: Tcbjka613
reviews.title: Nice place....wouldn't stay again
reviews.text: We stayed 6 nights. First off, the place is overall nice. There are 3 buildings. The lobby and restaurant/bar is in one and the rooms are in the other 2 . That was fine but it kind of kills the resort feel and makes it feel like an expensive motel. The rooms are big with plenty of closet space and they were very quiet. Our 2nd night there we went to the lobby bar and asked to order some food. It was 9:00 and the restaurant was supposed to be open until 11. We were told that they closed so we ordered from doordash. We found it annoying but brushed it off. The next day for lunch we ordered from the pool bar and got a cup of fruit and a sandwich. It took an hour and fifteen minutes to get out food. Again, annoying but we brushed it off. Our last full day there we had planned to stay at the pool all day. The place has 2 pools. One that is nice with a bar and is 6 feet deep and one that sucks with fake sand that is like 3 feet deep(I would assume for kids). When we got to the pool around 9:30 that morning there was a sign at the nice big pool that it was reserved for some insurance company. So, we were forced to scrunch over to kid pool and our relaxing day was pretty much out the window. The pool bar was out of draft beer, Pina Colada mix and pretty much anything else because of the event that they had planned, but that we were not informed of. The whole day just turned out to be a mess and we felt like second class citizens in a resort that we booked and paid for 6 months in advance. We went to the front desk wanting to be reimburst for that night and they waived the $40 resort fee for that day. Uhhh........thanks. Whatever. We've stayed at a ton of places like this and we tried to make the best of it but it really underwhelmed in the customer service department.

reviews.author: Debra S
reviews.title: Above and Beyond
reviews.text: The entire staff went out of their way to make us feel special, and greeted our requests so warmly, and so professionally. I will absolutely be staying at the resort again!  And the BEST bedding and pillows I've experienced in a long time! Felt so indulgent!

reviews.author: raziarichter
reviews.title: Scottsdale
reviews.text: Cute hotel with a great vibe nice patio with game boards. Slow service at the pool.  Noisy room with early morning carts and traffic. Main pool was reserved for guests attending a conference so it gave us limited pool access.

reviews.author: KristinMonesmith
reviews.title: Great for relaxation
reviews.text: I came for a much needed break after working 60 hours per week for the last 18 months in the ER.  This was perfect.  Super close to Camelback and Pieswesta.  Hike in the morning, pool in the afternoon.  Menu is incredible, the staff super friendly.  I’ll be back.

reviews.author: Lswenn
reviews.title: Beautiful, Cozy Stay
reviews.text: This is a beautiful property. The staff was professional, friendly and attentive. The food and drinks were great. The pool area was nice, plenty of seating and shade available and the pool temperature was perfect.

reviews.author: 3txi6c2310
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: Fabulous stay at The Scott.  The location is ideal!  Staff was wonderful!  It was just plain GREAT! The front desk staff was incredibly helpful and nice.  Everything from beginning to end was just as we had hoped it would be!
