reviews.author: K9759NJjohn
reviews.title: Focus on Service
reviews.text: Service was again horrible and I am shocked that after 6 months this was never corrected.  Also, why does the bar close at 10:00, when there are plenty of people trying to hang out and spend money?  Thinking with everything going on, the hotel may want to try and get more customers somewhere so they can hire staff to accommodate people that would like to eat and drink there.

reviews.author: Linda M
reviews.title: Disappointed with this visit to The Scott
reviews.text: Hotel quality has declined since last visit. The Scott appears to cater to bachelorette parties and conferences. Pool and common areas were not kept clean. All but 2 bikes were broken so never available.

reviews.author: mmendez2021
reviews.title: Too many guests for you to handle
reviews.text:
Nearly impossible to get room service, as they had more guests than they had staffing. Finally did get breakfast, but no silverware. Tried to call room service, but only got voice mail. Front desk said they would send some over, still waiting...
Room wasn't ready, and not vacuumed when cleaned, which is only every other day. Fire alarm goes off for no reason in the middle of the night. 
Just to name a few of my fun moments!

reviews.author: trippinmd
reviews.title: Great property, decent rooms, but dirty floors
reviews.text:
I would have given this hotel a solid 4 stars. Its onsite restaurant and bar are great. Check them out, even if you're not staying there! Delicious food and superb craft cocktails. The pools are also super nice. As for our room, it was spacious with SUPER comfy beds. And it was quiet! Had a wedding reception going on near our room. With the doors and windows closed, we didn't hear a thing. No complaints there. 

But then there were the filthy floors in our room... yuck! 

We had to wear flip flops around the room to avoid our feet and socks from turning brown. Reported it to the front desk and they came and serviced the room, but it did nothing to solve the issue. What they REALLY need to do is some serious carpet shampooing in their rooms and a much, much deeper clean than whatever they're doing. In this day and age, cleanliness is something hotels need to take extra steps to make sure they get right. If this hotel addresses and corrects this issue, we would totally come back. Otherwise, not a chance.

reviews.author: samB5910DJ
reviews.title: Great Scott!
reviews.text: The whole hotel felt and smelled like a spa, everyone was extremely kind and helpful. Didn't sleep the best but that's my fault as I my drink of choice was the espresso martini's. Definitely recommend

reviews.author: kirstyrwilliams
reviews.title: Great Hotel for a girls trip
reviews.text:
My two friends and I stayed at the hotel for a last minute 4 night stay. We drove in from California, we got the ‘neighboring state’ reduced rate which was a nice touch. We were greeted by a lovely man upon arrival who helped us get checked in and with our luggage. The hotel lobby and the Canal Club bar area are really well decorated and inviting. 

Our room (552) was a courtyard facing 1st floor room, easy to access, it was a decent size with two queen beds (super comfy) and lots of natural light. The pool (s) provided plenty of sun loungers. My only negative points were that there were not enough servers and we were told we couldn’t order lunch on the Monday when we arrived as the kitchen was too overwhelmed?!! We ended up waiting an hour and then managed to order. But the staff are friendly and the cocktails were great. We ate in the Canal Club restaurant on the first night, the food came quickly and was delicious. It’s a fantastic location to get to town for dinners. Definitely visit Maple & Ash and Francine for dinner - both better than most restaurants I’ve eaten at in LA!!

The hotel gym was pretty basic, but has enough equipment for a workout, just ensure you bring a towel from the room. We didn’t use the Spa facilities.

Overall I would highly recommend this hotel, there was a good crowd (lots of bachelorette groups and couples) the facilities are mostly clean and inviting and the service was great (definitely better than in LA!)

reviews.author: ninaU9422OU
reviews.title: Retuning for a Non Work Event
reviews.text: Loved the location, the hotel and I can't wait to come back for personal reasons! The customer services was top notch and the ambiance of the resort was so inviting! Overall I loved my time there. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: BJH1966
reviews.title: Old and outdated.
reviews.text: My room had multiple moths, a dead bug, refrigerator didn’t work, and dirty towel.  The air conditioner wasn’t super cold which is tough with a 100+ degree weather. It needs updating and cleaning. I wouldn’t recommend.

reviews.author: brittanie673
reviews.title: BEATIFUL PROPERTY
reviews.text: Loved everything about our stay at The Scott - the food was delicious, atmosphere was relaxing and fun, rooms were beautifully appointed.  Overall fantastic resort.  Hope to come back when the weather is better!

reviews.author: Erika S
reviews.title: Swanky and fun atmosphere
reviews.text:
Overall the atmosphere and style of this resort is what I loved most. 
Very clean room and grounds. Perfect distance to shopping, restaurants etc. 
We enjoyed a couples massage at the spa and that was lovely. 
Bed was way to hard for my liking.

reviews.author: Ashley V
reviews.title: Perfect location for staying in Old Town Scottsdale and enjoying the downtown.
reviews.text: The Scott is a stylish, well kept property with lots going on. Tons of fun with lots to do on the property, a vibrant bar and fun pool. The property is clean and service at check in and check out was great. Limited service available in the restaurant, making things slow, but likely due to COVID restrictions. Would recommend and will stay again!

reviews.author: kergiella
reviews.title: So far it’s a little disappointing…
reviews.text: I am hoping to be able to amend this review before the end of our trip for my birthday, but we have been here for just a few hours and so far not impressed.  We were rushed at check-in and told that our room wasn’t ready yet—understandable as they were busy and we were 15 minutes early…we knew we’d have to wait.  Unfortunately the room still wasn’t ready for almost 40 minutes past check in time.  My husband then had to re-wait in a 10 minute queue to get the keys.  While we waited we got a mock tail—buck beach I think—-it was fantastic!  We sat in the atrium area which was really very dirty—lots of dust, dirt, and tons of food crumbs and sticky stains over seating areas.   The pool area and lagoon are pretty…there is a weird musty smell, but again kind of understandable as it’s always hot and there are water features and foliage to retain moisture and get musty.  When we got up to our floor and walked into the hallway it was completely covered in dirty room services trays—the door to our room was literally surrounded on both sides with trays.  The room is pretty and spacious, if not overall unkempt—dusty, the sink area had either soap scum or dried toothpaste over it and all the grouting was grimy, the tiling in the shower floor is gross with buildup around the drain.  It’s not the worst cleaning job I’ve seen, but I definitely expect way more overall for this price point.  Lackluster service (canal bar server was lovely though) and upkeep so far.  :/. I think they really overbook themselves and ride on the coattails of the conferences they host.  Hoping things turn around a bit!

reviews.author: l1ya2wqwls
reviews.title: Nice rooms, awful service
reviews.text: Unfortunately really cannot recommend due to the terrible service. Although nice rooms and nice pool area, the service was unfriendly when they were around - which was on a very rare occasion. Short staffed to say the least

reviews.author: Mike P
reviews.title: Nice property, old-smelling rooms
reviews.text:
We stayed here for our anniversary on the recommendation of a friend. The property is well maintained and close to a ton of great restaurants.  The rooms were clean. Our only complaint was a rather pungent smell coming from the air conditioning. We asked a staff member about it and they informed us that it was because the building was old. Not a great answer. 

Outside of that, a nice property with helpful staff.

reviews.author: 1ngcb9q2yy
reviews.title: Beautiful property but food and food service are a problem
reviews.text:
Air conditioning cannot be individually controlled in guest rooms.  Pool area not kept up,  as the day progresses. Long waits for food ! or kitchen gets overwhelmed and cancels request   Leaking AC 0
Pipe above entrance to one corridor of rooms.  No warning sign or any attempt to direct the dripping water away from pedestrians head when using doorway

reviews.author: nl1us7yhdj
reviews.title: very disappointed
reviews.text: I was there in the past and is the only reason why we came back, but won't again.  pool and garden areas where not kept up.  Rooms were dark and not updated for years.  Even the food was disappointing.  Nothing came to the value of $700 for 2 nights.

reviews.author: jjbird1214
reviews.title: Couples vacay
reviews.text: We really enjoyed staying here and would totally do it again. We were even able to bring two of our friends to come hang at the pool with us that live in the area. The canal club was OK for food but definitely mediocre to all of the great restaurants within 1 to 2 minutes of walking distance from the place. If you plan on eating at the kennel club and want to do that for the experience definitely do it for breakfast and brunch that food was delicious

reviews.author: lgregory555
reviews.title: Terrible experience!
reviews.text:
Our 1 year anniversary would have been better spent elsewhere. Anywhere else!

Terrible service from the moment we got out of our Uber. Food, staff, pool… everything was not as advertised.

Nowhere to sit because of dirty tables. Mixed up our orders multiple times.

Canal Club literally treated me a staff and not as a guest. 

Lost our luggage in check out.

reviews.author: eileenandmaci
reviews.title: Can’t go wrong
reviews.text: Resort landscaping and decor is immaculate and almost magical at night. Close to every Scottsdale attraction and the staff is very accommodating. The room was amazing and the nespresso machine was incredible

reviews.author: Stephanie F
reviews.title: Unmet Expectations
reviews.text: We were really looking forward to our weekend away without our 6 kids in tow. When we arrived we found out there was a group of 600 woman there ready to party. The hotel is too small to host large groups and not have it largely impact other guests. My recommendation is to definitely call ahead to see what large group might be there. The decor is great, but the room was slightly disappointing. The hallway carpet was dirty and our air vent was noisy to the point of interrupting sleep. The hotel has potential to be great. It did not meet the expectations I had set by what I saw online.

reviews.author: mridgway
reviews.title: Unique hotel
reviews.text: We always enjoy our relaxing stays at The Scott. Rooms are very nice and I love the outdoor patio! Pools are nice and relaxing! Love the outdoor patio seating and variety of seating areas around property! Unique boutique style hotel! We’ll be back!

reviews.author: lisetteweavil
reviews.title: Amazing place to stay!!
reviews.text: I highly recommend this spot. I came for a work retreat and will definitely be back!  The restaurant had delicious food morning and evening. The bartenders were fun to be around and made fantastic drinks.  All staff was friendly and easy to talk to.  Location is perfect too!  Walking distance to a lot or a quick lyft ride on the super hot days.  Love that the hotel had bikes to borrow too!!!

reviews.author: Lacey T
reviews.title: Luxury...at a distance
reviews.text: Make sure no large events are planned during your weekend getaway or you may be stuck observing all the beautiful amenities from afar. In our case, the pool was closed during our stay and we were not informed until we were checking in after a 2 hour drive to get there.

reviews.author: osatic1vif
reviews.title: Dirty and under staffed
reviews.text: Went here for business. A cute renovated place..not a RESORT by any means. Lobby was dirty, food and drinks took forever to get because they were understaffed. Room was mediocre. Not what I expected. The room was poorly stocked.

reviews.author: Danae8202
reviews.title: Beautiful Property
reviews.text: It was a beautiful property. The staff were friendly and we had a lot of fun pool side. The room was beautiful. It would have been nice to know there wasn't a fridge or microwave available in the room. There was a tiny beverage fridge but if you wanted the space you needed to empty it.

reviews.author: YaiYai
reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text:
As a returning guest, we were shocked at decline.  We understand the staffing shortages created by COVID, but I sort of think The Scott has a permanent staffing issue due to poor management.  
They no longer offer a shuttle to Old Town, so that was disappointing.  You’re sort of on your own.  
The menu is very limited.  They were out of chicken, of all things.  
They booked the whole resort out to a large contingent of drunk women for a convention so the pool was not the least bit relaxing.  Would have loved to know that ahead of time. 
One of the cabanas was broken..we watched the repair guy wander around the whole week looking at it, and he chose the day all the drunk females arrived to fix it…didn’t secure the perimeter and the roof of the cabana came tumbling down with a loud crash, nearly injuring a group of women.
The pool bar was not staffed three of the four days we were there. 
Housekeeping is every three days…we were there four…
The staff were all very nice, I will say that.  
The lobby is beautiful.  
The rooms are overpriced for what few amenities they still have and could use updating…things like sluggish shower drains.  
Sadly, there are just too many other places to stay.  We loved The Scott but it just misses the mark now.

reviews.author: Lovelyduck987
reviews.title: Poor Experience
reviews.text: Hallways weren’t great, pool area wasn’t clean at all, and had to cancel other amenities due to staffing shortages. Overall was not impressed with this boutique hotel. Especially while still in a pandemic

reviews.author: joelagrubbs
reviews.title: Somewhat a let down
reviews.text: Overall the hotel was great. However it seemed short staffed, lights on the pool went out at night, staffed seemed overwhelmed and i knowledgeable on things. Messes were left from people. A large group came in one day, took over the pool area which had no service and left a mess everywhere. We had to go to the other pool which was dirty.

reviews.author: jbice2021
reviews.title: The Scott is great!
reviews.text: I always love staying here.  Clean, great location, great feel and vibe.  I love the unique smell when you walk in, the clean/classic look.  And the beds are comfortable, with a nice boutique feel.  I wish there was a rewards program because I stay here a lot for work.

reviews.author: Robin M
reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: The location of The Scott is perfect if you plan on spending any time in downtown Scottsdale.  You can easily walk or check out one of the bicycles they have on site for guests to use!  The resort itself is gorgeous.  Our room was super comfy and stylish.  The ONLY bummer is that there are some rooms that are "dark" because of their location and we happened to be in one.  We were only in town for one night so, not a big deal.  Otherwise, our stay was absolutely lovely!

reviews.author: Jennifer S
reviews.title: A very disappointing experience
reviews.text: Our expectations were a bit high for this hotel given the rating, advertised amenities and cost.  Room was not clean, given excuses of short staffing.  Bedding was reused from previous guests.  Dirt, filth and hair from previous guests in bathroom.  Chemicals in hot tub so strong caused burning of the eyes and watering of the eyes.

reviews.author: Mostafa
reviews.title: Overflowing Shower
reviews.text: Overall the hotel is very nice. We had an issue with our shower that was never taken care of. The shower would not drain, it would overflow and was disgusting. I reported it twice. We were never offered to relocate our room. We did receive money back from the amenity fees, but it really wasn't enough for how bad it was. This is a "resort" style hotel, but I have stayed at 2-3 start hotels that have better rooms.

reviews.author: Megan M
reviews.title: Lobby is nice- rooms are not
reviews.text: The rooms smelled like cigarettes and cat pee. The pool is enclosed by a safety fence, no elevators and poor service at bars. Minimum room rate was $300, save your money and go stay at the Phoenician or the four seasons

reviews.author: Allison R
reviews.title: Luxe Relaxation
reviews.text: The resort transports you to a far away place and it's lovely. I stayed here for a "No Mo Chemo" celebration. I loved LaVidora spa experience package and throughly enjoyed my cabana rental. I would love to return with my Mom and/or husband to share this with them.  Thank you for a wonderful retreat.

reviews.author: Kathy K
reviews.title: Great Staycation
reviews.text: We enjoyed our staycation at The Scott at a great summer special price. The staff was very friendly and helpful. While there we also enjoyed a wonderful couples massage at the Spa. Great location in Scottsdale!

reviews.author: jstarkie1578
reviews.title: Ladies Weekend
reviews.text:
I stayed recently at the Scott Hotel for a "staycation" with some girlfriends. Everyone was friendly &  super helpful.  The rooms were clean.  The area of the resort we stayed was quiet and peaceful.

Highly recommend the Scott Hotel!

reviews.author: Briana O
reviews.title: Stay here!
reviews.text: We loved every moment of our staycation here. The pool, the adorable room, and the cabana club were everything we needed and more. We have a couple staycations every year and so far this has been our favorite resort so far!

reviews.author: Janelle F
reviews.title: The Scott
reviews.text: We liked thee overall vibe of the hotel. Location was great. We didn’t eat there so can’t comment on the food, had wished there was live music Saturday night live they had on Friday. The main bummer was the room outdoor drain crashing noise and not being able to enjoy our patio especially since we had paid to upgrade for that specific reason.

reviews.author: Eric R
reviews.title: Great mix of relaxing and party environments.
reviews.text: We went for a local "staycation" wanting to relax by the pool all day. The pool area is wonderful with a good mix of sun & shade throughout the day. Great balance of fun/people watching without being out of control or a Scottsdale frat party environment. There were few children on the property as well, although there were some families especially at the "beach" pool. The grounds are beautiful and you could always find a secluded spot to relax. Guest rooms are quiet, even with activity outside. Sunday brunch at restaurant was delicious and not overpriced. Fitness center was well-equipped and lightly used. Try the "Rum Diary" cocktail but beware if you drink more than one.

reviews.author: Anna C
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text: We love this hotel and have returned to it 3 times now. Already planning my next trip. Staff is wonderful, food is great, drinks are awesome and the pool, well that’s the best part of it all. If you prefer a quieter experience come during the week, the weekends tend to have lots of bachelorette parties! Nothing crazy but it’s def busy.

reviews.author: Chetna G
reviews.title: Misleading info on website about rooms, poor customer service
reviews.text: Room was different than what's posted on website and booked. After talking to reception, they took no action and just told me to pay more for a different room. Well, how about you fix the pictures on your website! On the weekend, the chef doesn't show up. I can't imagine a resort depending on only one chef for the entire resort, and so it meant that there was no breakfast till 9am on saturday, and on sunday, they just cancel the brunch menu and end breakfast at 11. Which I find out at 11 when I go to the cafe. The servers were not interested in accommodating any requests either despite all of this mess happening on their end. Will not book again.

reviews.author: bmorga281118
reviews.title: Pool Bartender and Severs need an attitude adjustment
reviews.text: Very disappointed in the staff at the pool bar. All the girls were very rude and not helpful. They never came around once to ask if we needed anything. When we approached them at the pool bar they all seemed very annoyed when we asked for drinks and food. Never came back around again to check on us. Would definitely not want to return to the pool.

reviews.author: Malika R
reviews.title: Best Staycation Ever
reviews.text: Just a great overall experience. My family came into town and the Scott Resort and Spa was the best. The beds are amazing and allowed me to get great nights sleep! Jason was great along with the rest of the staff!

reviews.author: Kris L
reviews.title: Only Looks Good on Social Media
reviews.text:
Hello! I was very disappointed on my stay at The Scott Resort. When we first got to our room we noticed there were dirty q-tips on the bathroom and hair all over the telephone. While we were then moved to a new room, we were appalled with the cleanliness and how something like that could have been missed by the cleaning staff. Our second room we were moved to was extremely hot and we had to buy a portable fan to deal with the lack of air conditioning in our room. 

We also bought a cabana at the pool and was very disappointed in the pool. The pool was not clean and had leaves and other items floating in the pool. Because of this we never got in the pool. Additionally, the presentation of the food and drinks we received at the cabana was lackluster. The food came in plastic containers and the drinks didn’t come with ice in the bucket or for use even though it was extremely hot. 

While the lobby, lounge, and the Canal Club were very nice and decorated well, we were very disappointed in our overall stay at the hotel.

reviews.author: Amy P
reviews.title: How is this place a 4 star?
reviews.text: I never do reviews but I think the truth needs to be told. We are local and came over for a night before school started for our daughter.  My daughter had found it online. The pictures looked great but they didn't represent our experience.  The beach is like ten feet of sand. We stayed in building D.  The hall smelled like heavy deodorizer - covering up smoke.  My bed had three  orange stains on the coverlet. We ordered room service - they were out of everything.  Pizza, hummus, hamburger and pork sandwich was the choices. My daughter's pizza came in a  bowl with all the cheese ran into the middle - like they were out of plates.  The internet on the TV wasn't working. Had to rent a  paid movie to find the TV's volume wouldn't turn up over the air conditioning that was so loud in the room.  After we both sneezed about 20 times we decided to head home.  Two hours was enough.  Super disappointing.

reviews.author: Jessica B
reviews.title: A hotel for Beetle Juice
reviews.text:
I think the amount of alcohol in the room and in the lobby helps guests and the hotel not notice bugs in the bed and cockroaches in the room. 
The room was very muggy, the a/c didn’t help at all when we left the room in hopes it would cool down when we   checked in at 6pm. And returned at 10pm. The front desk was nice enough to look concerned , gave me a number to call about the issue, left a voicemail and never received a call back.
We had a nice night dreaming about cockroaches feeling like they were crawling around. I’ve always wanted to stay here and was so disappointed.

reviews.author: roxshiflet
reviews.title: Don’t get re-routed to their booking agency!
reviews.text: This place is beautiful, and I’d recommend it, but the reservation booking agency they use was unreliable, and the communication between them and the hotel is non-existent, or spotty at best. Check-in was an hour-long debacle, and took multiple subsequent trips to the front desk (not a short walk) before everything was sorted.  Again, nice-looking place though.

reviews.author: emilyamoran1
reviews.title: Review of the Scott Report & Spa
reviews.text: Our trip to Scottsdale was wonderful. Having never been to AZ we were excited to be there and see everything to offer. We liked the Scott Resort and Spa. The location was great to getting into town! The building, properties and rooms were all very nicely kept and aesthetically pleasing. The main building on the property was beautiful, spacious and had all the amenities in one area. The Canal Club was also a great spot to grab a bite or a drink. The servers and bartenders were very accommodating and helpful. The only complaint we had was the turn down service. We stayed for several nights and never had the room cleaned up, even after a request. We didn't make a fuss because we were just happy to be on vacation but it would have been nice to have fresh towels after the third shower! Maybe next time we be more vocal. Other than that our stay was lovely, and I'm sure we'll be back.

reviews.author: Scott W
reviews.title: Good price; but not a good value
reviews.text: We were hoping for more…. Place looked great online.  But the decor is a bit funky; food service was limited (menu); and the service was sub par.  Apparently a guest needs to “request” cleaning services…. But it is not communicated at the front desk.

reviews.author: fbrans726958
reviews.title: Fantastic for the price
reviews.text: Location was great. Facilities were great. Loved the food. The decor is Instagram worthy. This is a great resort for the price and not too stuffy. Many great restaurants in the area as well. We loved hanging out in the lobby and pool area.

reviews.author: Kelsba84
reviews.title: Upkeep
reviews.text: Groundskeeping wasn’t up to par . Staff not the friendliest, and guest services slow to rooms to provide room service . Nice resort not as moderate and pics display on website . Had a nice trip but could’ve been better .

reviews.author: Jack H
reviews.title: Great Island Cuban feel
reviews.text: Cozy - great sitting areas in courtyard/pool area. Central to Scottsdale close to entertainment. Pool needs music and for the pool bar to stay open past 4:30pm on Fri/Sat. Overall staff VERY nice and attentive - Front desk, Canal and Pool Bar and Bellman.

reviews.author: bgribb11
reviews.title: Noisy Room
reviews.text: Eve and the ladies at the pool were amazing and very prompt. The rooms are amazing but the noise level was horrible. Heard every little thing. Definitely a fun hotel with a great pool anf bar but need to fix the noise levels.

reviews.author: Curious58484135769
reviews.title: Would not recommend
reviews.text: Sheets smelled, and had blood stains. Door would not shut or lock and was open upon arrival (this got fixed after  along). Lack of communication amongst staff. We were told reservations were not needed for guests for the restaurant, but that was wrong and they did not have room for our party of 6. Upon booking we asked for our rooms to be together, upon arrival we were told they could not accommodate.

reviews.author: 517lavonnem
reviews.title: Spacious Room and a comfy bed
reviews.text: The a/c was fabulous in our room! The beds were very comfy and there was room to move around at the foot of the beds. Bathroom a little awkward with the toilet so close to the door, but roomy once inside. Adult beverages are quite pricey poolside. The lobby is clean and nicely designed. Pay attention when booking, as a "patio" room doesn't mean first floor with a courtyard patio- we ended up with a balcony and a parking lot view.

reviews.author: taylor680
reviews.title: Worst experience ever do not stay here
reviews.text: Do not stay here. It’s a glorified motel with a nice lobby. Our bed linen & towels had holes in the linen. The hotel had a storm the day before and it took days for anyone to start cleaning the property. There were trees blocking pathways that no one cleaned up before we left. The rooms had an old smell to them. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone, stay anywhere else.

reviews.author: 1998KPowell
reviews.title: Disappointing- Condescending staff.
reviews.text: They did not have our room ready by check in, only cleaned the room once out of our 4 day stay, the staff was rude, stand offish and condescending, when I went to pay for the stay at the desk the receptionist took my credit card from my hand and inserted the card into the machine for me in the midst of informing me for the first time that they hold $100 per next on the card for the stay. It would have been nice to know I would have had hundreds of dollars tied up for the time of trip, and the ability to think about if that was the best decision for the trip financially before actually paying (in which the receptionist took my card from me before I could reply).

reviews.author: clemensve08
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.text: BEAUTIFUL! Customer service was great and hotel was beautiful. Shoutout to Scott at the canal club bar, he was AMAZING!! He remembered my name and order each time. Best iced vanilla lattes. Wonderful resort. I will be back!

reviews.author: jgoss2021
reviews.title: Resort with Style
reviews.text: I was pleased with my short stay here. Overall it was a memorable experience. I think there are small areas were the resort could improve, but overall a great time. The resort really has a fun atomosphere and wonderful spa.

reviews.author: keepinthefaith2021
reviews.title: Love this place
reviews.text: Love how beautifully decorated this place was. Service was top Notch and the food…don’t even get me stared. It was Ana big. The Cabal bar and restaurant serves amazing drinks and the food 🥘 was so yummy.

reviews.author: cnd24h8ar1
reviews.title: Bad staff bad experience
reviews.text: Too little characters to explain just find a different hotel no pool bad staff bad beds bad bad service bad front desk serve bad room cleaning service bad restaurant bad everything over all just find a different place to stay

reviews.author: vooysb
reviews.title: The Scott
reviews.text: Great stay. A few bumps in the road with getting our room cleaned daily, but all in all a decent experience. The bar and space is beautiful! The morning breakfast was also fantastic! The one day we got out to the pool was great as well.

reviews.author: Lgsagiv
reviews.title: מלון יפייפיה
reviews.text: המלון  מדהים ביופיו אבל חוסר הפניות והגמישות לא תואמת את המחיר. ניתן להזמין אך ורק חבילה של חצי פנסיו. לא ניתן להמיר את ארוחת הערב לארוחה בבר או כל זכוי אחר … המחיר הוא מחיר מופקע ואנחנו בקשנו וניסינו לשנות את האפשרות של ארוחת הערב שאותה לא נממש . אבל למרות על הפניות לא נענו…

reviews.author: williamjO2825BB
reviews.title: A nice place to visit and I wouldn't mind living there
reviews.text:
Great property with a welcoming and spacious lobby that encourages gathering and conversation and that gets people out of their rooms and interacting with each other.  The chess boards were a nice touch.  The pool area has natural elements that create a relaxing atmosphere and the grounds, with their meandering paths, native plants, and nooks and crannies for quiet moments as well as spacious areas for larger groups, were well-maintained and intriguing.
Overall, the food for our conference was the best of any hotel I have ever stayed.  The restaurant menu was limited but more than sufficient.  
The staff is friendly and the rooms are spacious and nicely appointed.  All in all, it was a very pleasant stay.

reviews.author: Betsy W
reviews.title: Accessibility people with disabilities
reviews.text: Wheelchair user. Door gates pool too high. No access  because upstairs rooms not accessible, no elevator.  Front and all doors no access. Very disappointing. Was required to stay result of conference. If you are solo on trip a quad, or para, senior citizen with walker, any disabilities book different, accessible hotel.

reviews.author: RL4545
reviews.title: Does not meet expectations
reviews.text: Reservations were made based on positive recommendations, but my actual experience was lacking. All doors were difficult to open and close including the guest entry door which presents a safety concern when the door does not latch without a hard push. Once inside various surfaces had accumulations of dust and there was still decorations left from the previous guest. The lobby on the other hand was breath taking and the pool was perfect for relaxing in the sun/water. The shallow sandy beach area was perfect the kids though the hotel is primarily an adult destination. Perfect for social media pictures from afar, but leaves you disappointed when you look closely.

reviews.author: Angelaaaa318
reviews.title: Birthday weekend at the Scott
reviews.text: The Scott is a very cute boho style resort! My friends and I came here for my birthday and booked the parlor suite. It was supposed to have three beds; a king in one room and two queens in the other. When we walked in there was only two beds. This led to a lot of frustration as there was six of us. When I complained to the front desk they told us that when I made the reservation they were supposed to special request that set up and it was missed. They then informed me they were sold out and could bring us two roll away beds. At first they just wanted to take $100 off the reservation which I felt was not much for a huge mistake. They took off my reserved pool cabana and gave us a free round of drinks. The weekend was very uncomfortable as two of us had to squeeze into roll away beds.

reviews.author: Emilie P
reviews.title: The Scott Resort and Spa
reviews.text: This hotel exceeded all of my expectations.  It was beautiful and clean. The staff was wonderful.  I was sent a text when we checked in and I could use that number to communicate with the staff throughout my stay.  They even called transportation for me and had it waiting.  Super easy.  The pool was awesome and there was waitstaff constantly checking on us and bringing us food and drinks.  The room was beautiful, clean and the bed was one of the most comfortable beds I had ever slept in. My favortie part was the fact that this resort is not super expensive. It is incrediblely affordable!!! Stay here if you are coming to Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Victoria
reviews.title: Old World Charm
reviews.text: I love the look of the older hotels here in Scottsdale.  They have so much more appeal to me than the newer more stark ones coming up.  The rooms are large and very comfortable. The pool area is mature with large trees and palms.  Pool bar could use some spiffing up but the server was very nice.

reviews.author: yndato
reviews.title: Super Relaxing
reviews.text: Stayed at the Scott on recommendations from 2 different friends for a girls trip.  I would definitely go again! -Close to fantastic restaurants! The staff was very friendly, and we appreciated the self parking close to our room.

reviews.author: darbiewieczorek
reviews.title: The Scott
reviews.text: I love this hotel. Rooms and main area are always clean , smells good, great location, and great rooms. It’s never to busy is close proximity to many good food spots and shopping. I will continue to come back to The Scott

reviews.author: lmccon913528
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text: Gorgeous property.  Rooms were beautifully decorated.  Very clean. Great location. Attentive staff.  Restaurant was surprisingly good. The pools were our favorite part- except the staff didn’t know how to use the lift chair and it took an hour for them to figure it out (training is imperative).

reviews.author: Jsecrest2021
reviews.title: So cozy!
reviews.text: So cozy and the staff was so friendly. My daughter and I floated in the pool every day for hours and sipped on fancy drinks from the poolside bar. Great location. Walking distance to the mall/Fashion Square.

reviews.author: lgraha985752
reviews.title: Stay was just ok
reviews.text: The lobby and pool were nice. The room was nice but extremely hot. The AC would not cool down. Also had a reservation issue. The crowd was rowdy. There was someone that threw up outside our room, that was not cleaned for several hours

reviews.author: 51f531f1mv
reviews.title: Fantastic as always
reviews.text: Really like this resort.  Right on Scottsdale Rd, easy to get to everywhere.  Nice layout of property, rooms suround the pool, lagoon, and grassy area.  Atmosphere is good.  Ask for rooms that face the pool or lagoon, upstairs is my preference.  Nice rooms with balconies.  You can ask for a small fridge to be brought to your room.  Beds are really comfortable.  Blackout curtains work great.  Free parking.  Food and drinks are a little pricey.  Postinos Wine Bar is two buildings over and is fantastic.

reviews.author: Larry L
reviews.title: High price to pay for AC not to work
reviews.text:
All things considered, The Scott is a lovely resort.  However, and hopefully it did not happen to anyone else, our AC in the room was not cooling at a comfortable level.  We were given a few free drinks to make up for it, but that simply will not cool you off in the desert heat. Was supposed to be given back our resort fees as well and that did not happen either.  

IF this had not happened, this would be a top resort.  Could just be my experience, but if other reviews are saying the same thing about the air conditioning not working, pay attention!! I hate to give bad reviews of properties, but the promising to take care of  the situation and not keeping your word is a big deal when you have this price attached to your bill.

reviews.author: tinaF4839VV
reviews.title: Stayation
reviews.text: We loved the pool. We ordered drinks and lunch. It was fresh and delicious. Fresh pool towels, and lots of seating. There s tons restaurants and a big mall for shopping.  It took in a movie at the nearby theater.

reviews.author: kmQ3726MS
reviews.title: Best Resort EVER!
reviews.text: Breathtaking resort and was everything I was looking for in a relaxing getaway! Very pleased and will be back again shortly! The staff was so kind, the spa was very relaxing, and overall it was just an amazing stay

reviews.author: 969rtqx7ts
reviews.title: Fabulous Resort
reviews.text: We were looking to relax before a busy National Competition and this resort was just what we needed. We loved the pools and the garden view patio.  It was a relaxing and enjoyable experience and we hope to return in the future!

reviews.author: fernplush
reviews.title: No Cuban
reviews.text:
Advertised Cuban restaurant, was not. Food mediocre. Charged resort fee, nickeled and dimed only had pool & spa.
Very small property. Substantially renewed still parking lot and paths were old and cracked.

reviews.author: 2wxac86qve
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel- great vibe and perfect location!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay this week and would highly recommend this hotel. It is amazing and has a cool vibe and unique decor. It was very quiet and quaint, and the staff was great!  The pools were perfect and we loved that we could walk to the mall to shop or see a movie. We even walked down to Old Town but you may want to get a lift there. We loved all of the nearby restaurants and shopping, and we spent a lot of time near the pool. Best sisters trip ever!

reviews.author: uf0lyc9216
reviews.title: A Diamond in the Desert
reviews.text: The ambiance when you walk in feels like you are on an island somewhere.  And the staff, all of them, from the doorman, to the bartenders, to the cleaning crew are all so attentive.  They can’t do enough for you.  The food was AMAZING!  The bartenders all so sweet, but also anticipated what you were going to order.  I hosted 8 people for a birthday celebration for the weekend.  Once they knew what everyone drank & ate, they were “Johnny on the spot” when we wanted something else.  I normally stay at the Westin when in Scottsdale, but this is my new favorite hotel….oh!  And the spa experience was one of the best I’ve ever experienced.  Treated my Mom, Sister, Daughter & myself to treatments & EVERYONE came out so relaxed & so happy with their treatments that it made me happy that this was the trip I chose to celebrate my Moms 80th birthday.

reviews.author: StaceyJ_12
reviews.title: Good property great location
reviews.text: Nice property with a great location. The pools were good though crowded. Food was okay. Baristas were really good. Rooms are average. Lobby is very nice. No daily cleaning service still which I would have liked to have had. You can request something but seemed like a bother to do that. Lots of nice areas to sit outside.

reviews.author: Karly C
reviews.title: Excellent Ambiance
reviews.text: We absolutely loved The Scott!  We stayed for 3 nights for my sister's bachelorette, and everything was wonderful.  The ambiance of the resort cannot be beat, the pool was fantastic, and the spa exceeded our expectations.  We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: ddub
reviews.title: Lack of attention to details.
reviews.text: We were greeted by a large roach and large moth.  The doors to the patio leaked during a rain storm.  Dirty room service dishes were left in the hallway across from our room for most of our stay.  The murphy bed didn’t have pillows.

reviews.author: Kesia A
reviews.title: A Perfect Picturesque Oasis
reviews.text: I absolutely loved my stay. My boyfriend and I truly enjoyed ourselves. From the warm staff greeting upon our arrival to excellent meals to the perfect instagramable pictures. I would definitely be returning... the hotel location was perfect. This hotel was exactly what we were looking for... relaxing but fun. A place where I could wear my cute outfits and take cool pics. The only suggestion would be to get to the pool early; seats go really quickly.

reviews.author: reilly3689
reviews.title: Very cute and fun atmosphere
reviews.text: Even cuter than the photos! Beds were so comfortable and rooms were great. The only negatives about our experience is they don’t charge you until arrival so if someone else paid for your stay, you get a nice surprise. Then the restaurant wouldn’t seat us for breakfast at 10:30 when it states it’s from 7-11- didn’t even offer to let us order drinks or lunch. Just made us wait until 11:00 to be seated.

reviews.author: dbaldrid
reviews.title: Great Scott
reviews.text: The Scott Resort was amazing and had the friendliest staff and beautiful Grounds! We will absolutely be back to visit in the future with our kids and more friends. The Canal Club was a great hangout and had really good bartenders.

reviews.author: cabo23
reviews.title: Our stay at the Scott
reviews.text:
The resort was nice, but it definitely felt a bit dated. 

PROS: 
Location was great - centrally located 
Room was large & spacious 
Employees were very nice and attentive - especially the valet & bartenders 
On-site bar (Canal Club) was great 
Lobby was very trendy and pretty (during the day)

CONS: 
The pool was dirty & had a lot of leaves & debris. The "zero entry beach" felt kind of dirty.
The room & lobby (at night) felt very dark. 
The bathroom/shower area was dark & shower didn't drain well. 
The hotel didn't feel super secure. While it is in a good area & the actual hallways required a room key, the gates of the property entrances were unlocked. 
The property didn't feel super maintained. You can tell that they invested a lot at first, but haven't totally kept up with renovations/upkeep. 

Given that we paid nearly $300/night, it wasn't the greatest value. We would probably return again if the rates were lower. Overall a decent stay but not the best.

reviews.author: NYCTravelPal
reviews.title: Hip hotel, but could provide better cleaning service
reviews.text: Nice hotel with “hip” feel but a bit neglected in common spaces, especially by the pool.  The rooms are nice and we had one with a lagoon view which was lovely.  The pools were crowded (it was very, very hot) and there were plenty of towels, but no one seemingly cleaning by the pool which was covered with leaves and dirt and plenty of used towels all over.  Staff were friendly, but allegedly due to Covid there was no cleaning  in the room and limited “concierge “ service — you have to text questions to an anonymous person. This was strange since common areas were super crowded and there was limited social distancing.   Other hotels are now resuming daily housekeeping so not sure why the Scott didn’t provide it.

reviews.author: jc9fu9wfu2
reviews.title: Family Getaway
reviews.text: Need to monitor and enforce some noise curfews.   Very late parties and yelling going on from midnight to 2:30 AM.  We were awakened both Friday and Saturday nights buy rowdy noises and partying indoors and outdoors.

reviews.author: y6o9te7qrj
reviews.title: Fair
reviews.text: Not worth the high resort fees for pool. The service was blah. Pool area not maintained for the fee. Pool servers are not trained very well at all, we took $150 in cash for tips, we only spent $15 for the bellman who was helpful and nice. We usually come back with zero cash.

reviews.author: heidisellers4
reviews.title: Great Getaway
reviews.text: I was looking for a resort and spa for a weekend mother daughter trip.  This quaint little gem popped up.  We were taken with the place as soon as we set foot on the grounds.  The atmosphere is fun and serene.  We spent alot of time at the pool, enjoyed good food and drinks, and had a very relaxing spa experience.  This will be our spot for future weekend getaways!

reviews.author: justinplyler
reviews.title: Nice resort
reviews.text: Nice resort everything is pricey and there are resort fees. Also can’t sit in the day chairs at the pool with out reservations. So not sure what resort fees pay for but it’s nice it’s close to everything in Scottsdale

reviews.author: ehedghog1
reviews.title: Great for couples, not so great for families with small children
reviews.text: Great for couples, not so great for families with small children.  Rooms are equipped with a bottle of wine at table height, more liquor at a high shelf, and a wet bar with more alcohol.  Would liked to have a refrigerator and microwave.  Beds were very comfortable and balcony was nice.  My AC worked great but other guests complained of hot rooms.  The pools are great but watch for ants by the bridge.  No elevator, only 2 stories but for the price, an elevator would be appreciated.

reviews.author: Erica Cooper
reviews.title: Mostly Wonderful
reviews.text: Hotel was beautiful, clean and quiet.  We enjoyed much of the amenities.  Restaurant/bar offerings were above expectation.  Service was good but not great, only one staff person went out of their way to make us feel overly welcome.  Guest atmosphere was very different, depending on time of day or day of arrival. (a young drunken crowd was unexpected at this relaxing resort)

reviews.author: Andrea Z
reviews.title: Girlfriend BDay getaway
reviews.text: My friends and I recently stayed at The Scott for a B-Day celebration.  For anyone looking to stay here, and curious to know if you should, don't look any further!  Beautiful grounds (feels as if you are in an island) attentive service (authentic, genuine and cared for) comfortable rooms and PERFECT location to Old Town Scottsdale.  Scottsdale perfectly hidden GEM!

reviews.author: jrw981
reviews.title: Not a four star resort. Stay away
reviews.text: Nice lobby decor, that’s about it. Pool is overcrowded and disgusting. Lack of regular cleaning in both common areas and guest rooms. Had makeup on pillows and towels. Had to clean our own room and make our own bed. Not the relaxing spa resort vacation we were hoping for.

reviews.author: yirh6qad2t
reviews.title: Rooms are dumpy, terrible
reviews.text: Don’t let the common areas fool you. The rooms are old, dumpy, and terrible. First room was full of bugs and mosquitoes. Second room stunk horribly of cats and cat diarrhea. The rooms are nothing but paint over old junk. The room finishes and furnishings are also vey cheap. No elevators. No real restaurant. No real pool bar. Super low quality all around. Way overpriced all around. Only positive was the staff’s willingness to discount everything, but still overpriced for what you get.

reviews.author: liljenny04
reviews.title: Mini paradise
reviews.text: Old world charm property. Simple love all the decor and aesthetics of this property. Definitely will revisit. The shower was not up to par that’s why I gave it a 4 star. It had soap buildup and rust on shower head. I notified the property.

reviews.author: kelsiegrossen
reviews.title: Couples Getaway
reviews.text: I booked a stay here for 5 days with my husband for his birthday and had a great time! Love that it was mostly couples our age (late 20's / 30's). The pool area was very nice & fun. Loved that there were so many  things to do (spa, hotel restaurant, corn hole, and free bike rentals). Our room was nice and our balcony overlooked the main pool so we could see prime lounging spots. The hallways however smelt like I was walking through a dead presidents home from the 1800's. The smell hits you ever time you enter, but left once we entered our room (luckily). I would change that, and if my room smelled like that, I would have been very upset and ask to move.

reviews.author: TCmgs
reviews.title: Overall a great find in a great location!
reviews.text:
Well-situated just north and within walking distance of Old Town, this lovely little boutique find is a break from the Phoenix chain hotel experience. It has a gorgeous lobby and beautifully appointed rooms, and the architecture of a two-story 60s motel with a distinctly 2020s design vibe. Think rich paint colors with soft neutral fabrics, caning, wicker, and brushed gold or brass. Very Instagram-worthy. Pool is beautiful and was used frequently by happy guests, including families with children and night-time gatherings. 

Didn’t eat at the restaurant so can’t comment there. Was able to purchase delicious Pressery juices and coffee at the bar in the am along with some simple breakfast items. You could also 
Choose a sit-down breakfast in the restaurant. Beds were VERY comfortable, more comfy than some other very high end hotels I’ve stayed in!!

The main areas, landscaping, pool, and pool decking seemed clean and well-cared for. I did notice that night-time poolside gatherings were still being cleaned up in the am while guests were sitting and lounging—unusual in my experience at nicer hotels like this one, but perhaps a matter of COVID-related understaffing? Also, my poolside room (which I requested) got a little loud on the weekend with late night pool parties. Just something to be aware of when choosing your room situation.

Staff was very nice though I had little interaction with anyone, to be honest. I was visiting family and spent most of my daytime and meals elsewhere, as it turned out. 

I stayed 5 nights. Upon arriving I was told my room would only be serviced on day 3, so that was disappointing (tho not a deal-breaker). However, this isn’t a cheap hotel experience so I found myself feeling a bit annoyed with that after two days. I asked for more towels so I didn’t have to keep reusing the towels that never quite dried and they complied without issue. Still seemed like a bummer for the price.

All in all, I would definitely recommend a stay here. It’s possible the room service issue is temporary (I didn’t ask), the staff was very nice, the hotel gorgeous, and the location is fantastic if you are interested in staying and experience the vibe in Scottsdale/Old Town. I would stay here again!

reviews.author: Doll33
reviews.title: Overcrowded pool
reviews.text: They let anyone come to the pool by being a cheap day pass. The pool, which is small to begin with, is overcrowded with locals, who bring their own food and glass beer bottles to the pool.  This hotel is not worth the price. Do yourself a favor, book a cheap hotel and then just come here with a day pass.

reviews.author: Maripat K
reviews.title: lovely lobby and nice staff but I won't be back
reviews.text:
Pool area not cleaned up after guests and no servers to be found.  We had to get our own drinks and food from inside.
Rooms were not being restocked (bar and coffee area) or cleaned. I understand COVID but life is getting back to normal and for the high price of the room you should get full service unless you don't want it.

reviews.author: MarinaT6011
reviews.title: Not worth the price
reviews.text:
Our room was infested w/ mosquitoes, nothing was done to resolve issue. It also did not include hand soap, or a fan in the bathroom.
The pool was very dirty in some parts, (dirt, leaves, etc.).  
Overall experience was not as high as our expectations and definitely not worth the price.

reviews.author: 8eq1qkbk3n
reviews.title: Loved It
reviews.text: Beautiful property! Great location! It's right next to a nice mall and pretty close to the old part of Scottsdale. It took about 20 minutes to drive in from the airport. Check-in process was quick and easy. They offer free parking with a few spots that have some shade.

reviews.author: Preston A
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: This was a great hotel, with fun vibes, good food/drink, and a great location. The spa does not have a wide variety of amenities, but the staff was highly talented. The pool area allows for a fun environment as well as relaxation if you prefer that.

reviews.author: ngadom118167
reviews.title: Hold on to your belongings
reviews.text: The room wasn’t available until after 4:30. They charge a resort fee but the pool is so over packed that their wasn’t a chair available. My friends and I had to sit on the side of the pool on cement. Also my friends designer bag was missing after we left our things upfront.

reviews.author: Johanna G
reviews.title: Gorgeous property! Will visit again.
reviews.text: We loved our short trip to Scottsdale! We were particularly impressed with the decor style (Cuban/Havana - so fun/trendy!), well kept grounds, friendly staff and delicious food! Can’t wait to visit again (we found the location as we’d stayed at sister hotels La Playa in Carmel California and the Inn at Laguna Beach in California as well). Only issues were occasional long delays with food at the pool (the servers mentioned they were short staffed) and slow Wi-Fi. Not huge issues - we had a great time!

reviews.author: Natalie Fearon
reviews.title: Mediocrity at best
reviews.text:
Hailey, the waitress by the pool was amazing. She served our drinks and snacks fast and with a smile. 

The Scott’s claim to fame is its lobby. After that it’s all down hill. Crowded pools, limited amenities, renovated motel vibes, tiny bathroom, no housekeeping unless you the guest follow up.

reviews.author: Joel M
reviews.title: Excellent resort. Close to restaurants and shopping.
reviews.text: We had a great time at the Scott. I would recommend it to anyone. Specifically, it is great for couples wanting to get away for a couple days or a weekend. It felt like we were in a resort in Hawaii or Cancun, if we didn't know there wasn't a beach nearby.

reviews.author: BobbyBrew
reviews.title: Great Boutique Hotel
reviews.text: This hotel offered all amenities but the pool is very crowded and condensed. The staff is friendly and the rooms were great with balconies. The drinks are a little overpriced but very good. The location is perfect on the main strip of all restaurants and nightlife.

reviews.author: Amber E
reviews.title: Great staycation!
reviews.text: As much as we love The Strawberry Inn, we're travel junkies at heart and LOVE visiting other boutique hotels and learning all we can. That’s why we jumped at the opportunity to have a little stay-cation at The Scott Resort & Spa. The Scott is unique in that while it is part of a group of hotels (Classic Group and Hotels), each hotel has a completely unique design, and is managed directly by Classic Group to give each guest a beautiful botique experience! We loved our stay- highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kyle B
reviews.title: A Desert Oasis
reviews.text: Wonderful stay at this beautiful Scottsdale property.  The Havana theme has been perfectly executed with no detail left unturned. Amazing pool facilities and amenities. Well appointed rooms that invoke a sense of calm luxury. Amazing staff. Will highly recommend to our friends visiting the area.

reviews.author: Rhynop
reviews.title: Good for millennials, bad for families
reviews.text:
The Scott has a beautiful facade, but just below is a dirty hotel for locals and hipsters. Do better "The Scott", I know you can. There is the potential but the staff could care less. 
It was my fault for bringing kids, but if your "resort" is kids friendly you could at least have a kids menu that is available. You could give priority at your pool to guests paying the crazy fees instead of selling day passes to locals. You could deep clean your rooms and make sure your doors operate properly. You could check for broken wine glasses in your guest-rooms. You could make the internet free (imagine that) or at least usable. You could do so much more, and you didn't. 
I hope you get better, because you have the potential to be a really great hotel. Overprice and underdeliver is the sure-fire way to lose your reputation.

reviews.author: kwilli381042
reviews.title: Wish it was different
reviews.text: Our room smelled like a sewage backup & couldn’t enjoy the amenities due to people outside of the hotel enjoying them. Wristbands were not enforced and the 30 minute chair checks were also not done. Made it almost impossible to enjoy pool and spa time. Which is why we booked the hotel in the first place.

reviews.author: Chips_Queso
reviews.title: Amazing, will be back!
reviews.text:
We had an amazing trip. The resort grounds are gorgeous and well-kept. Service is excellent: bar, restaurant, front desk, in-room dining, poolside. Spa is top-notch! Rooms are large and comfortable, and quiet! 

Two pools, amazing experience. They offer morning yoga, which I took advantage of several days. 
Food and drinks are not overpriced for a resort, and more importantly, they are actually delicious! Sometimes resort food can be mediocre, The Scott is fabulous. 

We had to leave a day early due to a family emergency, and even though I had pre-paid, they refunded our final night. I didn’t ask for that, she just did it - I was shocked and super pleased. 

Needless to say, we will be back again and again.

reviews.author: Joni H
reviews.title: Beautiful premises and great location!
reviews.text: I've been to The Scott several times, and it's always a great experience!  You can't beat the location, the staff are always friendly and helpful, and the restaurant/bar is wonderful.  Definitely one of the best resorts in Arizona!

reviews.author: Elizabethtaryn
reviews.title: Dreamy hotel
reviews.text: Girls getaway to celebrate a birthday at the beautiful Scott Hotel. Amazing location, design and styling on point. Absolutely gorgeous hotel. No detail left unnoticed. Will definitely be back again to stay!

reviews.author: Traveler27405989495
reviews.title: Adult getaway
reviews.text: This was the perfect boutique resort for our adult getaway. Pool was great after golf and hikes. The food was excellent, drinks were good and the coffee at the bar was the perfect start each morning. All the nooks and crannies of the courtyard/pool areas were fun to explore and relax in.

reviews.author: mrsmhensley
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, close to downtown Scottsdale. Staff were very friendly and helpful. Grounds were well maintained. The pool does get very busy on the weekends, but the noise was manageable. Overall wonderful stay.

reviews.author: Passport38713750968
reviews.title: Great Scott!
reviews.text: The Scott was a great place to stay. My wife and I stayed for a long weekend to celebrate our first wedding anniversary. Very close to Old Town Scottsdale and Fashion Square. We would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: kaliejones99
reviews.title: The perfect Scottsdale aesthetic
reviews.text: The Scott definitely gives such old Havana/Sonoran vibes! So so cute and comfy!! I took pics of little detail all around the hotel to use for future home inspired! The bed was like a cloud and the bench in the room was as comfy as it was cute. You have to get french fries at the Canal Club and the location was great for Scottsdale. Super close to old town so it helped with uber prices. The Scott also has the cutest mint green bikes to get in a fun sweat. Our bike ride turned out to be one of my boyfriend and I’s favorite things all trip!

reviews.author: stephannrusso
reviews.title: Beautiful but lots of room for improvement
reviews.text: There are only two visible trash receptacles around the entire resort that we could find. It was a very busy weekend and each morning we woke up to trash everywhere. So gross. Room keys hardly worked and they were very short staffed but the staff was amazing and the resort is so cute. Overall it was a good stay but definitely room for improvement

reviews.author: e1y41e8ca4
reviews.title: Always perfect!!
reviews.text: You will not be disappointed. The property, staff, location, food, staff, drink and amenities are all wonderful. The lobby area is amazing. The food was so good and the drinks were great as well. Only slight drawback is AC in rooms could be cooler.

reviews.author: rachleh
reviews.title: Great stay! Would definitely return!
reviews.text:
We loved The Scott! We did a girls trip May 7-10 and it was excellent. I am surprised at the negative recent reviews. Perhaps it was spring break related. Though they told us upon check in that they were at "full capacity", we never once felt cramped on the grounds. We were always able to find a seat in the gorgeous lobby (nearly always almost empty and very serene!) or at the pool no matter what time of day. We enjoyed hanging out in all different areas around the property, all unique and fun. So many photo ops! The staff was very helpful and friendly. There was always water available to fill cups or bottles at front desk or pool. Canal Club had great food, especially brunch. We had a check-in snafu, but the manager was gracious and made up for the inconvenience. We had wonderful massages and facials at La Vidorra spa and loved being able to reserve the beach cruiser bikes to ride to Old Town. Daily 9am yoga was great, Shirley was awesome!!  The rooms are a bit older, but very well appointed and comfortable. The bed was amazing and we slept like rocks!
My only two (minor) drawbacks would be that the outdoor furniture cushions, pillows etc could use a cleaning and the perimeter around the pool is very slick, we saw several people almost fall during the three days we were there. Overall, great and I look forward to next time we get to visit this resort. Perfect for couples, friends or families.

reviews.author: Roam609958
reviews.title: Scott hotel does not have daily housekeeping like most hotels.
reviews.text: No daily tidy of rooms, making of beds, restock or change out of towels unless through request. If this is important to you, don’t  stay. I was hoping to relax...completely...the resort rooms/hallways have a dated, worn feel. The beds were comfortable. Pool is extremely crowded unless you want to try for a chair by 9am. The cocktails & breakfast were good but pricey. Pricey for being marketed as a upscale resort until one notices little things. We checked in on Thursday. Housekeeping didn’t arrive until monday morning, with little change in appearance/cleanliness. We checked out Tuesday.

reviews.author: asiagonzalez19
reviews.title: Beautiful Property but not worth the price
reviews.text: Wonderfully decorated. Great ambiance. But my garden view room was a parking lot view. My hallway smelled like garbage left overnight in heat. No-one ever came to clean my room and room service tray was left for an entire day. A lot of things seemed neglected and for the price I would expect more. But beautiful property great for pictures.

reviews.author: carolynpetersen81
reviews.title: Wonderful place!
reviews.text:
Came here for a quick getaway with my daughter. We had the best time! Considering this is during a pandemic we experienced amazing service. If we needed anything we texted the front desk. The room and pool were clean and well 
Maintained. Highly recommend The Scott!

reviews.author: toriakaras
reviews.title: Clean Rooms, Beautiful Property
reviews.text:
The Scott is like a little desert oasis in the middle of Scottsdale. I love taking my clients and staff members here when they come to town. 

The beds and pillows are the most comfortable I have ever seen in a hotel.

reviews.author: evitahernandez80
reviews.title: May 2021
reviews.text: Our room was very clean and fully stocked.  Lobby is beautifully decorated and staff is very friendly and helpful.  We had a great stay here.  If you are looking to spend the day at the pool, I would suggest getting there early (6-7am) as the seats fill up quick.

reviews.author: Lauren12488
reviews.title: Beyond Gorgeous!
reviews.text: I cannot say enough great things about this place. The hotel is a airy combo of havana and tropical with a modern feel and decor. Staff is super friendly, grounds are beuatiful. Rooms are spacious and well decorated. The beds are sooo comfy! Probably the most comfortable hotel bed I have ever been in. The room patios are super cute and nice to relax on. The hotel itself has a signature scent that is soo clean and fresh. We miss the smell of the hotel now that we are home! We will 100% be going back!

reviews.author: Jen G
reviews.title: Nice property but crowded
reviews.text: The hotel wasn’t as nice as the website made it seem. Never could get chairs by the pool because they were being saved. Ridiculous hold on credit card for incidentals. Staff was friendly though. Lobby was nice.

reviews.author: meghaneileen2021
reviews.title: Very poor housekeeping
reviews.text: We weren't told upon arrival that there would not be any housekeeping during our 3 night stay. Understandable during COVID, but no refresh items were delivered to our room without us having to request them, which was a pain and took away from the experience. Housekeeping just threw refresh items on a pile of our laundry and didn't put them away properly as we hoped. Comforter was stained with prior guest makeup, too. Overall we were disappointed.

reviews.author: tim m
reviews.title: Work and play
reviews.text: It sure what is going on here but service is horrible from front desk to room cleanliness to bar to restaurant. Hard to believe it’s so bad, 2 hr seating for some burgers and took 45 min to get first round of drinks. No one seems to care.

reviews.author: Cole S
reviews.title: Great stay in Parlor Suites
reviews.text:
We just returned from our stay at The Scott and it was wonderful!  We had 2x 1 bedroom Parlor Suites and totally enjoyed everything about our stay.

I don’t understand what all of the negative reviews have been about.  Our room was spotless as we as the overall resort.  

We rented a cabana one day and our server was very attentive and friendly.  

We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: mardicrane2166
reviews.title: A Safe and Restful Vacation Venue
reviews.text: My sisters and I were happy to spend a few days at The Scott.  We wanted a spa vacation with good food and a nice property.   We wanted respect for the ongoing needs to protect ourselves and others from COVID.  The Scott is doing a great job in providing R&R for our family.

reviews.author: Snaha S
reviews.title: It is not quite a resort but an awesome hotel.
reviews.text: I was looking for more of a resort so at first was disappointed with the hotel like feel of our rooms but by the end of our stay was looooving the place! The lobby is awesome and pools and common areas are soooo awesome and well decorated. The location of the resort is IDEAL. So easy to get to the mall or old town or even phoenix.

reviews.author: shevaelliot
reviews.title: Scott Review
reviews.text: Beautiful place, still a bit unorganized. Salty food. The TV in our room was broken. When we checked in, she told us there were no upgrades avail, but after we called about the broken TV, there suddenly were other rooms avail.

reviews.author: tialevesque
reviews.title: Not as great as I thought it would be
reviews.text:
Pool is packed like Mardi Gras with zero places to sit. We lost out on 2 pool days bc of this issue. 
Hallways and buildings are dingy and dirty. 
Slowwww food service. Dirty pool. Never saw one person skimming the debris out of the pool. 
Overpriced. You’re paying for location, not the resort itself. 
Left very disappointed.

reviews.author: FYoung10
reviews.title: Not What You Think It Is...
reviews.text: The grounds are very nice, and it is beautiful. But as a person of color this may not be the place for you, as we experienced several issues and even could not get a meal at the restaurant as paying hotel guest. We were told that if we had wanted to eat at restaurant, we needed to inform them of that when booking. I have never heard of that in my life, but ....We went somewhere else came back and the restaurant was still empty. We received some help from some staff members, all were not like this, but there were a few that you could tell had an issue with us being there. Its sad in 2021 that this is even a thing, but unfortunately if I had not experienced it myself, I wouldn't be stating it. The food that we had on day one from the bar was good (light snacks), and drinks were ok as well. The grounds as stated was very nice, didn't take advantage of pool it was very packed daily, so didn't go there due to COVID. All in all we really didn't want to stay there, it wasn't worth the money, as they charged regular price for the rooms but had limited staff and services due to COVID. The housekeepers out of 4 days only can come to your room once, that was the day before we left. Again, thats fine, if that is how it is due to low staffing and COVID but why is it still the regular price to stay there? I wouldn't recommend the hotel, possibly just go to take pics, but not stay. Its mainly for young, IG influencers not of color.

reviews.author: mamamia714
reviews.title: Too crazy
reviews.text: I do not recommend. Not a relaxing spa-like atmosphere on the weekend. More like a party. Too many kids at the pool. No chairs available.  Understaffed in dining. Room not ready. Requested room not available. Comfortable beds. Small fitness room.

reviews.author: jschulz25
reviews.title: Beautiful and Relaxing
reviews.text: We had a beautiful and relaxing birthday weekend celebrating at the Scott Resort.  The facilities were well appointed and clean, the atmosphere was peaceful, and cheery.  We spent a lot of time enjoying swimming and relaxing by the pool.

reviews.author: tngal2021
reviews.title: Good for solo travel
reviews.text:
Always felt safe even though I was traveling solo.  Enjoyed leisurely meals at the Canal Club restaurant.  Lots of food options nearby and I found Scottsdale to be very walkable.

Enjoyed having a private patio (facing wall, not pool or laguna) where I could enjoy a cup of coffee outside in the morning.

Pool area was very crowded, but I’m not a pool person.  Was always able to find a comfortable place to sit and read in the areas not immediately facing the pool.  Beautiful landscaping and flowers.  I had a facial at the spa - highly recommended.

reviews.author: ASUBrad
reviews.title: Havana Ooh Na-Na
reviews.text: Location, Location, Location. Decor is chic and reminds you of Havana, Cuba. Free beach cruisers to ride into Old Town Scottsdale. Dated pool but the friendly staff make up for it. I hope we can come back again soon!

reviews.author: sreissmueller
reviews.title: family getaway
reviews.text: The Scott is a lovely destination resort if you are looking for some sunshine and a quick weekend getaway with the family. The staff are super friendly and the grounds are kept beautifully for strolling or relaxing in a nearby swing or hammock.

reviews.author: kylatarbet
reviews.title: Pretty, but busy
reviews.text: Aesthetically pretty but terribly understaffed and misrepresented on the website. It was nice, but we won’t be returning for another stay. The pool was crazy busy, lots of trash throughout the property due to understaffing. Again, beautiful property but needed a ‘Marriott touch’ of service and execution.

reviews.author: Jacklyn608
reviews.title: Not as pictured
reviews.text: Don’t let the online photos fool you - The Scott needs some major investments in new outdoor/lounge furniture. All seating cushions incredibly dirty and the wood furniture is very weathered. The pool is alright if you can snag a seat - groups of people claimed every chair in the morning and left them unoccupied for much of the day, hampering the experience for other guests. For this price point, there are nicer resorts in the area.

reviews.author: gkmaggie123
reviews.title: Overall, a nice hotel
reviews.text: Overall, I thought it was a good hotel experience.  Slight delay in check-in (which is surprising given that their check-in time is 4pm), but other than that, a good experience.  Though I am surprised that they still charged the $45 resort fee when there are no cleanings of the rooms or stocking of supplies during the stay due to COVID (unless specifically asked).  But the resort is centrally located.  But for $470+/night (with resort fee/taxes), I guess I would have expected a more luxurious experience.  The actual rooms were nice, but I wouldn't have thought they were $470+night rooms

reviews.author: tsyverson1736
reviews.title: Used to be our favorite but has gone downhill.
reviews.text:
Have stayed many times and has always an excellent experience.  We always were so excited to stay there.  Service has always been top notch from management, food/beverage staff, pool staff and hospitality.  We have sent many of our couples friends and girls trip friends there. However, this and our last past stay, has been not as quality experience.  
There is no question this is a beautiful, unique, exquisite boutique hotel with a gorgeous newly renovated pool and outdoor area, which is why so many people flock here for pictures.  However, in a nutshell, it appears that the pool and lobby bar staff are more interested in catering to those outsiders coming in from the outside (and taking the pool chairs, leaving few open for guests) than in waiting on those resort guests who are actually paying very good money to stay there.  
Front desk/management staff is helpful, but food/beverage/pool staff need some training on taking care of the resort guests that are paying hard earned money rather than those taking advantage and walking in for the sole purpose of pictures for social media.

reviews.author: KJME2021
reviews.title: Gorgeous property, excellent spa, and a mechanical bull…
reviews.text:
This April my mom and I ventured out on our first girls trip in over two years. We did weeks of research and decided The Scott was exactly what we were looking for. Upon arrival the teal vintage car along with all the gorgeous flowers and unique decor made us feel like we made the right choice. We had a beautiful room overlooking the lagoon with a great view of the whole property. As evening rolled around we noticed that they were setting up a DJ stand and professional lighting equipment right outside our room. After we returned from an early dinner there was a full on rave going on 20 feet from our balcony. The music was the loudest I’ve ever heard. At one point the DJ was playing an electric violin to a Bon Jovi song with lit sparklers hanging from his mouth. It was quite entertaining! Thankfully all the noise ended promptly at 10:00. The next day we went and talked to the front desk and complained about the noise and they assured us that they had talked to the event manager and that it should be much quieter the next evening. We noticed them setting up western party decorations as we left for dinner that night. When we returned there was a mechanical bull sitting in the courtyard... The music was a bit quieter that night but the pop guns and bull riding cheering definitely made up for it. The music did stop around 10:00 again but the bull riding continued until later. Thankfully the group left on Sunday and we were able to fully enjoy the hotel. Sunday evening was a dream, we got to sit by the fire pit listening to the trickling sound of the waterfall while enjoying a delicious drink. We also got treatments at the spa and they were absolutely wonderful. The ladies were all so kind and helpful.
We would definitely stay here again but would make sure to ask if there are any events going on the same weekend!

reviews.author: Glyn M
reviews.title: An Overpriced Toilet
reviews.text:
Way over priced.  Rooms are filthy, stains on carpet, smell, etc.  Had to change rooms 3 times.
Extra $200.00 per day for theoretical amenities which is supposed to be returned.  Short staffed.
Room service only every 3 days. Pool crowded with people who are not staying there.

reviews.author: Ashley C
reviews.title: 10/10 highly recommend
reviews.text: My husband and I visited Scottsdale for a babymoon and stayed at the highly recommended Scott resort. Everything about our experience here was amazing. The property is stunning, The staff was friendly and so helpful, and the amenities were a 10/10. We really wanted to just get away and relax and that’s exactly what we did. Highly recommend the Scott for your next trip to Scottsdale!

reviews.author: Tanjello
reviews.title: Nice place to visit but dont stay there.
reviews.text: Paying for a nice lobby and pool area because thats all you will get, the rooms are small with no dresser.  Services where none existent, room never cleaned, food tray of adjacent room sat in hall for 15 hours plus upon check in, AC seems to not cool down room continually  at night . Very disapointed, refunded my resort fee upon check out but I have never had a hotel be this much of a disapointment.

reviews.author: A S
reviews.title: Go elsewhere
reviews.text: Been here only a handful of hours and not too impressed. Extremely dirty pool area. Looks like what you'd see in some trashy spring break hotel location and not a highly rated resort. Used cups, trash, and towels literally everywhere with no one picking them up. Even saw cups floating in the pool. We had to move trash just to be able to sit. Finally saw a single employee picking things up at the end of the evening. No sanitizing done. They had plenty of bellhop on staff when we arrived, none of which greeted us (just stared at us), but very little support staff it seems. Our room is clean enough but was surprised to see no fitted sheet on the bed. I know sometimes places run out of things but, again, not what I'd expect out of a pricey resort. A/C sort of works. At least nothing smells funny. Hoping with our midweek stay things will be better and the pool area won't look so absolutely disgusting?
