Came here years ago under its old ownership and found it to be a much nicer place. So far I'd say take your money elsewhere.

reviews.author: lilyan421
reviews.title: Stay
reviews.text: The hotel room was not clean. Hair in sink and in bathroom. Floor was not clean. The room and hallway both had a bad smell. The staff were not friendly. At the pool the waitress went to everyone except for us even after we told her we wanted a drink. Racist establishment. As a business owner I am appalled by the service. My husband even had to ask if “we looked broke” to them.

reviews.author: Iggy R
reviews.title: Converts
reviews.text: We stayed here for a birthday celebration weekend and have become total converts. From the design of the space, the quality of the dining, and the pools we had a fantastic experience. We usually judge places by asking “Would you come back here?” and with The Scott it was an absolute yes.

reviews.author: E_draughon
reviews.title: Very pretty property, but the cleaning services need to be better.
reviews.text: The resort was very beautiful and the decor/atmosphere. The only flaw is that the guest rooms could have been cleaned better. There were stains on the sheets and room service plates left in the hallway for several days. I would stay here again, but check the sheets and room when you check in. Overpriced for what you get.

reviews.author: higginsteresa00
reviews.title: The Scott Resort & Spa
reviews.text: Our stay was awesome!  The resort is beautiful.  Our room was super nice - loved the robes and patio to relax with a drink - peaceful. The staff is awesome! The location is perfect.  I will definitely make a trip back!!  Highly recommend

reviews.author: Sarah E
reviews.title: Cute resort / awful service
reviews.text: The resort itself is gorgeous - very Boho Beverly Hills Hotel - but the service is simply awful. They also sell day passes to the pool, so good luck finding a seat, even if you get out there there at 8 or 9am. I had really high hopes for this place and was really disappointed. Pretty aesthetic though, and the spa experience was good.

reviews.author: househunter1584
reviews.title: Nice hotel- horrible front desk clerk Jordan
reviews.text:
We had a quick 2 night stay here which we very much enjoyed. The room was nice, the pools and gardens beautiful and the on-site restaurant and bar were fabulous. Try the Cobb salad, best we have ever had!
The problem came when I was trying to check out using the TV in the room. There was a $100 per fee on our folio. We don’t have a pet. I figured it was a simple mistake that could be easily resolved.
I was mistaken.
I called the front desk and spoke to Jordan who also had checked us in. He argued with me for a long time on the phone saying  that I had come back to the front desk after we checked in to register “Penny” a yorkie.
We don’t own a dog.
He insisted that I had signed a form authorizing the pet charge.
He then said he would have to have security review the tape to show me that I had done this 
He argued with me rudely they entire time we were in the phone. Unacceptable to speak to a guest that way.
He then told me I’d have to come down to the desk and show my ID.
Fine, went to the desk and he produced a form that had someone’s else’s signature in it. With a totally different name.
When I pointed that out he then insisted that this person must have been staying in our room! Crazy! He argued again insisting that this woman who signed the the form had to have been in our room.
Finally after standing my ground he finally rudely removed the charge.
We loved our stay but there are 100’s of choices and we won’t be back.

reviews.author: Katie M
reviews.title: Way understaffed
reviews.text:
Although the resort is beautiful, it is starting to show the signs of being very understaffed. We were given the wrong room upon checkout and it took quite some time and two changes in room over two days to get us into the corrected room. We really liked the decor in the rooms, but the bathrooms and the corners of the rooms could have used a good cleaning. The restaurant closed due to lack of employees while we were there.
The hotel does not enforce the "no saving beach chairs with towels" rule, so it is incredibly hard on the weekends to get a spot at the pool unless you are up by 6am. Many times, half the chairs were empty, but "saved" for hours.
Would not recommend.

reviews.author: timandjandi
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: A very nice hotel with, I would recommend staying at the charming location. The Pool was great but you need to get your spot at 6:30am as all the loungers fill up so early. Drinks are ok at the pool side bar. Don’t get the club sandwich as it was dry and almost lacked basic quality

reviews.author: mswebb11
reviews.title: Such a great hidden gem!
reviews.text: Absolutely loved my stay at the Scott Resort! Such a cute place with a great location.  All of the staff were super helpful and the place was nice and clean.  Will be going back soon, and can't wait to visit the other properties as well!

reviews.author: Chatham B
reviews.title: Amazing experience with all the details
reviews.text: Every detail from the grounds, the art on the walls, the food, the record player in the room, the furniture, even the coasters is considered to make this a cool experience. And then the people who work there put this place over the top.

reviews.author: sassy1818
reviews.title: Classy, trendy, resort-like atmosphere, but not perfect
reviews.text: We loved the atmosphere and cuban-influenced decor and food, as well as proximity to old town Scottsdale. Staff was friendly, respectful, and helpful. But I'd stick to a real resort (e.g., in Hawaii, Mexico) if you're looking for a relaxing pool experience, as the pool area here is too small to support the number of guests.

reviews.author: Megan S
reviews.title: Bad service, cute environment
reviews.text: Great for photos, but not for quality service.  Sheets were stained, they did come fix them after multiple requests, but initially declined when we asked for all new sheets and towels. Told us we could have champagne upon arrival and in the room, neither of which occurred without having to request it.  Food is pretty good.  Everyone at this resort seemed to be inconvienced.

reviews.author: Gina Z
reviews.title: Average Experience at a 4 start hotel
reviews.text: Recently stayed at The Scott for a long weekend. The resort was nice, but the pool area was packed and in order to get a chair you had get there right when the pool opened at 6 am. There were many times during our 4 day stay where they ran out of towels by the pool (often taken hours to refill the supply). The pool bar was average and ran out of many basic things for drink such as lemon, limes and pina colada mix. Booked a few services at the Spa onsite and it was a great experience.

reviews.author: i7swcb6fdf
reviews.title: Average experience
reviews.text: Overall the property is pretty and in a good location. The pool was very busy and hard to get a seat.The rooms are a bit out dated, and could use attention.  All outdoor seating was very uncomfortable and old.  The staff was kind and accommodating, however, I will not stay here again.

reviews.author: meredithmacy14
reviews.title: Scott Resort and Spa
reviews.text: You’re better off paying a bit more for a high end resort, the Scott charges a resort fee and lacks all benefits of a resort. Pool was filthy with trash and pool towels. Service was slow if not self serve.

reviews.author: Judy F
reviews.title: Need a new front staff but beautiful
reviews.text:
Loved the location and the hotel
Front staff dreadful
Great breakfast food. lovely waitress Sarah. Great pool lovely lobby
Eat the breakfasting sit by the beautiful pool.
Waited VERY long for our room and there was always a line at the front desk.  
No room cleaning for 3 days

reviews.author: jacobbradford89
reviews.title: Early check in and out is a must
reviews.text:
Came here for my wedding anniversary. We were unable to check in until 8pm, and were then provided ADA room. We usually don’t care about that but there was no bathtub with the room and also the shower leaked really bad into the bathroom. 

The resort is beautiful but you could tell a lot of the staff is new and the ones that may have been there awhile are burnt out. We reserved a pool cabana for the day and when we booked it the person we spoke to on the phone listed all the things that came with the reservation. Appetizers and alcoholic beverages were among the list of things and when we got there we were given a bucket of water and two tiny bottles of champagne. Pretty upsetting for the price paid. 

Again, most of this stuff would never bother me but when you’re trying to do something special for your significant other, these issues become upsetting.

reviews.author: jkosully
reviews.title: A Great Getaway Spot!
reviews.text: From the minute you enter the spacious, airy, beautifully decorated lobby you feel like you are definitely on vacation.  This property is beautiful, with so many tastefully designed/decor places to sit, relax, hang out etc (outdoor fire pits, swinging wicker chairs, hammocks, cool outdoor lounge areas etc).  Rooms were nicely decorated and very clean.  We had a ground level Courtyard room and we loved sipping our Nespresso coffees (in room) our on our little patio in our Adirondack chairs each morning listening to the birds chirping in the warm air.  Poolside chaise lounges fill up quickly in the am, so you need to get out there early!  Places did open up pretty frequently throughout the day though, so that was nice.  Poolside service was quick and friendly.  Overall a fantastic stay for my husband and I to enjoy some sun and time together.  The kids (14 y/o) did join us the last night and were just as impressed with the whole place as we were.  We will be back!

reviews.author: Mallory S
reviews.title: Don’t come for the pool...
reviews.text: The resort is gorgeous, the food at the canal club is great, the bed and pillows are comfortable, and the overall vibe is refreshing! However, management should really mandate a “no chair reservation” policy at the pool. At 7:30am every chair has a towel on it to save them a spot. Every chair is taken and the pool is overcrowded. If you want a chair you better set your alarm on your vacation! Otherwise, everything else was amazing!

reviews.author: Alison B
reviews.title: Beautiful cozy resort in a great location!
reviews.text:
There are some really great things about this resort, and a few things that need a little help.  The personality of the hotel is great and I love the décor.  Open lobby space, great pool area and cozy landscaping that makes you feel like you are nowhere near a busy street.  An oasis really!
-Rooms: We had two rooms on the first floor connected by a parlor.  The set up was great, gave us plenty of room and the rooms were very cozy.  The bathrooms were well-laid out as well.  All three rooms had patios that were used all the time and the kids could wander out to the grassy area that had plenty of chairs and tables.
-Service: The service was hit or miss.  Check-in was great, very friendly.   The service at the pool was amazing.  They were working so hard.    Service in restaurant was so-so.  Sometimes you couldn't even find anyone around.
-Pool: This was a challenge.  Despite there being a sign of "if you are gone for 30 minutes we will refresh your chair for someone else", it didn't really work that way.  People got out there at 6am to put their stuff down, one guy even said 330am.  People wouldn't be there for hours.  If someone's stuff was moved, there was huge animosity, complaining, etc.  Not sure what the solution is, but there needs to be a change so families can get a seat at the pool!
-Food: The food was decent, not great.  We had one dinner there and ended up eating out (or getting take out) the rest of the time. Bar and drinks were awesome.
*Only other problem we saw is that when we got up one morning, there were still drinks leftover from the night before at all the little tables around the resort.  GROSS!
But overall, we really enjoyed our stay and the resort.  Seems like they just need a few more hands, a little more attention to detail.  Because the grounds and the hotel are amazing!

reviews.author: cbahamas
reviews.title: Nice getaway for a young family
reviews.text:
I think the Scott is a perfectly nice hotel. Do not expect luxury accommodations or service, but for the price, it's a nice set up with a cute face lift. A few notes that I think would be helpful for travelers:
1. The rooms are comfortable and nicely sized. We had a suite which was clearly originally 2 adjoining rooms, but one had a king bed and one had a murphy bed with a small modern couch. Both rooms had a bathroom. So essentially, you have 2 bathrooms (with showers, not tubs), a nice sized king bedroom, and a living area with a murphy bed. For us, this set up was great because we were traveling with a toddler who slept in a pack n play in the living room.
2. Sheets and towels are low quality, but clean and fine
3. They are not doing daily house keeping because of COVID (personally, I don't like this policy, especially when masks are now "optional". Seems odd that you don't have to wear a mask inside but can't have your room serviced)
4. Even though we stopped by the hotel at 11am on the day of check in to let them know we had arrived early in the hopes of getting an early check in with our toddler, our room was not ready until well past the 4pm check in time. I did not at all expect to get into our room before 4pm, but I do very much expect to be in our room AT check in time. This was especially irritating because we had been told our room was already vacated at 11am and it would be put on the list for prioritized cleaning. This is a huge pet peeve of mine. However, the staff was extremely reasonable and did offer discounts for our inconvenience which I appreciated.
5. The pool is a great set up. Kid friendly, but if you didn't have kids, it would by no means feel like you were in Disney. I had been worried it wouldn't have a relaxing vibe as the resort is in the city, but it has a great vibe and doesn't feel at all like you are right by a main road in town. 
6. If you want a pool chair (and are traveling during a popular vacation time) get there EARLY. Like 7am.

reviews.author: khvgjvmo23
reviews.title: Needs some love
reviews.text: Lovely location and staff. Rooms rundown. Pool was overcrowded and the 'resort fee' charged per day was very frustrating. They should not charge a resort fee if they cannot provide resort services - and a pool chair should be included in a resort fee.

reviews.author: Mahsa A
reviews.title: worst 5 star resort
reviews.text: were thinking between scotts and omni and what a mistake to choose scotts. mercy pools. no staff to help with the bags, we had to drag the bags to the second floor no elevator (with kids) . awful experience overall. one of the pools had a hard plastic at the bottom to keep the sand in place and the hard plastic was up and I cut my toenail and bled . the hallways are like caves and from 6-7 am you could hear the vacuum outside your room. such terrible service, not sure why its listed as a 5 star hotel.  the only good thing about this hotel is the cute lobby for pictures. lol nothing more.

reviews.author: jchandler2021
reviews.title: Great resort in the middle of Scottsdale
reviews.text: Very nice resort, beautiful property with really cool patios for every guest room. Event space was great, staff very helpful and friendly. Only improvement could be the room AC never seemed to get cold. Wasn’t unbearable but a bit hot when trying to sleep.

reviews.author: nate4clark
reviews.title: Nice Place
reviews.text: The place is beautiful and great prices for rooms. However, drinks and food at the resort are way over priced. The staff at the pool bar were amazing, friendly, and by far the best part of the stay. The worst part of the stay was the day time service at the front desk. The front desk workers were rude and ignorant. Acted like we were taking their time away from them. Stay here for the pool and rooms, but go out to eat in Scottsdale instead.

reviews.author: Sanderspga
reviews.title: A great place.
reviews.text: My family had a great stay at The Scott. My wife and I along with our 12 yo daughter stayed for three days. We loved the pool area. Overall the grounds were very nice and well maintained. The lobby is beautiful. The location was perfect for us. Rooms were really cool. Beds very comfortable. We will definitely return.

reviews.author: margfbrown
reviews.title: Mediocre for what we spent
reviews.text:
Clean you carpets in hallways and redo some of the cushions in public spaces—lobby and pool area. They look dirty and shabby. 
Staff was quite friendly none the less. But service in restaurant in the morning was VERY slow. They did not have enough cooks in the kitchen we were told.

reviews.author: scottyKO
reviews.title: March 2021 Wedding!
reviews.text: Beautiful location for a perfect wedding day!  Our wedding day/weekend could not have gone more smoothly, everyone at The Scott was a pleasure to work with. The food and drinks were fantastic, and our guests had a great time at the resort.  Will definitely recommend to friends and family :)

reviews.author: apolivieri
reviews.title: Nice Property- Rough Service
reviews.text: The property itself was very nice and the location was great. The pool and spa were delightful. The issue was really that they were extremely understaffed. Chips and salsa (white are pre-made) took about an hour to come out. Guests can't eat on property without reservations and honestly when you're a guest spending that kind of money, you should be prioritized without having to be on a tight reservation based schedule. The rooms were fine. We were there to celebrate a birthday and were put in a room looking out at the parking lot so that was a bit disappointing. The champagne that we ordered ahead of our arrival to celebrate took an hour to come from the front desk to the room. Honestly the name of the game the entire time was that you needed to order ahead and be prepared to wait hours for drinks, food, etc. If they figure out the staffing, this will be a great resort but for now, I would say I had a very average stay for the price.

reviews.author: armstl7
reviews.title: Very nice resort but very limited seating around the two pools was frustrating
reviews.text: Charis around pool are claimed early and we could not get one in the afternoon after golfing.  If relaxing by a beautiful pool is part of your plans I would not recommend this resort.  At these prices I think being able to sit by the pool should be part of the experience.  Everything else during our stay was great but this pool chair issue was a major disappointment.

reviews.author: Tsammyseg
reviews.title: Dark dingy room and hallways
reviews.text:
We canceled after seeing room and scrambled to find another hotel. Extremely over crowded pool, Unwelcoming staff, also no windows by the way. No dresser to store your clothes, I’ve personally never seen that in a hotel before. Also an employee mentioned they were slammed and were under staffed because of walk offs. 
Pictures did not translate to reality.

reviews.author: Kyle P
reviews.title: No detail is too small
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at this hotel! From the moment you walk in the lobby, you feel like you have stepped into a 5 star resort. The attention to detail is incredible! The beach/pool is one of the coolest features! And the Canal Club bar is amazing as well!

reviews.author: oxlpis8jva
reviews.title: Great Location and Grounds but Staff was Overrun
reviews.text: The grounds are beautiful and the location great. Make sure to pick your room carefully...if you end up in the wrong one, it's like trying to sleep below an underpass on a highway. Very loud. Unfortunately the staff was often invisible and the onsite services overrun. Think 12 people waiting for a cup of joe in the mornings with one person serving. It's early in the season, so they may have just been overwhelmed by the masses, but The Scoot failed miserably to meet expectations this trip.

reviews.author: Adam S
reviews.title: Couple's 30th Bday Trip
reviews.text: Overall the resort was just what we were expecting from the online reviews. Fun, boutique feel with a laid back vibe. We particularly enjoyed lounging in the lagoon area as it was a bit quieter than the pool. Would stay here again, particularly with a group that is looking for a good time!

reviews.author: chloenc21
reviews.title: Solo Staycation
reviews.text: Had a great time staying here. The morning yoga was awesome and I loved the spa. Though it did seem overall clean, there were a few hairs that I found that definitely weren’t mine. Still would recommend.

reviews.author: stenfamily2021
reviews.title: relaxing getaway
reviews.text: The Scott has the perfect vibe for a relaxing couples getaway. Plenty of nooks and crannies all around the resort to feel private enough yet attentive staff at all times, seeing to all of our needs. Loved our stay!

reviews.author: yanelyh12
reviews.title: Staycation
reviews.text: We stayed here the day after our wedding to have a relaxing day. Let me tell you, it was very relaxing! Atmosphere and food was amazing! Room was beautiful. Resort was easy to find our way around. Staff was very quick when we needed anything.

reviews.author: Randy M
reviews.title: Good Place but Lacking to be Great.
reviews.text: Has some issues with the pool service (Not with the staff that served pool patrons. They were great)  and policies (Particularity with the towel saving policy. You basically had t wake up at 5:00 am on the weekend to get save and procure a towels at the pool.  They would also allow you to save a chair all day and never return once you saved chairs with a towel.) in the pool area. Also, needed a little shop for some personal amenities. You had to go offsite to get anything personal.

reviews.author: 9oitcx4wru
reviews.title: The Scott
reviews.text: Short staffed.  Not enjoyable. No concierge, no airport shuttle, food service terrible. Shower flooded into outer room. Would not go back.  Hotel needs an update.  Wanted our first trip since Pandemic to be special, it’s was just the opposite!

reviews.author: cw3hprv2bt
reviews.title: March stay
reviews.text: Covid regulations not adhered to with overcrowding in bar area and outdoor pools. Hotel had a lovely atmosphere but unable to enjoy because of crowds. Paid resort fee and unable to get a seat at pool, ride bikes or make a spa appointment.  Unsure what it was we paid for. Great location.

reviews.author: KGWIIW
reviews.title: Overpriced and Understaffed
reviews.text: This hotel was way overpriced for what is provided. No bellman, no concierge and short staff overall = unclean lobby and public areas, long waits for food and beverage and rooms that are not refreshed daily. The pool is overcrowded and does not have enough chairs for the number of guests. Chairs that are available are saved by 8am, despite signs saying saving chairs is not allowed. There is a daily resort fee that includes parking even if you do not have a car to park, but DOES NOT include any complimentary bottles of water in your room. You can purchase water for $8 per bottle. I cannot recommend this hotel at all and would not ever return.

reviews.author: Gloria D
reviews.title: VALUE FOR MONEY
reviews.text: This resort gives you everything they promise on their website. The rooms are beautiful. Nice bathrooms and super friendly hotel staff. I had a relaxing stay with my partner and was pleased with everything in the resort. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Tourist717137
reviews.title: Loved our stay!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay. There was an immediate feeling of relaxation and care. The hotel decor is sophisticated. The staff were wonderful and helpful, as well as responsive. I highly recommend and plan to return!

reviews.author: kk4kat
reviews.title: Adorable but absolutely No service staff!
reviews.text: We spent our weekend waiting in lines for food or beverage. Made me sad as I was planning to spend time visiting my friend I hadn't seen for years and instead we were our own service staff.  Hotel is adorable but not worth waiting in lines for anything to eat or drink.

reviews.author: dnbigham
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Beautiful rooms... service was great...the pool was enjoyable and the staff at the pool was friendly.  Never had to wait for food or drinks.  The food was so good and room service was fast.   We will definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: whalenw24@yahoo.com
reviews.title: Poor Service across  the board
reviews.text: From the lack of knowledge of front desk staff, to 20 mins to get coffee and 20 mins to get a glass of water, and one night we asked for plastic silverware, called twice they said it was coming, they never showed up, we gave up. Rooms were so hot and the thermostats are not completely adjustable. Just not what you’d expect of a “resort”.

reviews.author: Mountains90
reviews.title: Beautiful resort...great location!
reviews.text: My husband and three teenage children spent three nights here.  Beautiful pool and gardens.  Great location to restaurants and Old Town.  This is a smaller boutique resort. The pool is crowded and lots of shade.  The bar and restaurant service is slow and  understaffed but once you get the food it is delicious and well prepared.  I felt this resort was better suited for couples and young people.  It looked like lots of girls weekends going on. We love to try new resorts in Scottsdale and this hotel is great for location, but would prefer a larger resort with more dining options, daily cleaning service and just more pool space.

reviews.author: deniseU2958GB
reviews.title: Collective Genius Convention Hotel Stay
reviews.text: The room was very dusty and overall just not clean and it contained an odor to it.  I was also put on the ground floor and there was a lot of foot traffic outside my room which was loud and kept me up at night.

reviews.author: K9759NJjohn
reviews.title: Peaceful and Slow
reviews.text: The grounds at the facility are amazing and allowed for some peacefulness to relax.  The unfortunate part is that the hotel was severely under-staffed and made for abnormally long waits for food and drinks.

reviews.author: echris965684
reviews.title: Don't stay here
reviews.text: As posted prior, horribly rude at check in, no response for leak in ceiling in room, no service at bar and no service at restaurant for breakfast. Other guests verbally expressing their similar experience and disdain for the value. Felt sorry for some of the great and happy employees as they all seemed to feel the same lack of everything.

reviews.author: DMack316
reviews.title: The Vacation We Needed
reviews.text: We took this vacation to get to some warmer weather and celebrate a birthday. It was just my husband and I. This hotel is beautiful! It is in a convenient spot on Scottsdale Road. We did drive everywhere but it would have been a 15-20 min walk to get to some of the restaurants in town! Parking is great at the hotel, we got a spot right outside our room. I love that the rooms have balconies. We spent a lot of time out there. The pools were very nice, lots of shade, and the servers were attentive to the guests! We had a corner room on the front of the hotel and you can hear the traffic on Scottsdale Road. We played fan noises from our phones to create some white noise to drown out the car sounds. Overall, a great experience and we would stay again.

reviews.author: GarrettDelgado
reviews.title: Love The Scott
reviews.text: Any time I visit the Phoenix area, I am staying at the Scott.  From the idyllic pool to close proximity to great adventures and nightlife, this hotel is beautiful and convenient.  My favorite aspects are the decor and number of intimate areas to convene with family and friends.

reviews.author: ARbeach
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: Just returned from three nights at the Scott. The pool is lovely but was packed the entire time we were there. Waitstaff came by regularly to check on our drinks. We loved the brunch and the gaucho steak and kale salad is amazing if you need something in the afternoon by the fire pit. Loved the decor. Only negatives were room was never refreshed even when we hung the sign on the door and our doors stuck badly so were noisy.

reviews.author: todd230
reviews.title: Good location - poor services.
reviews.text: One night girls weekend. No scheduling available for spa services, waiting 30 min for bar service, went to restaurant after bar and they were out of our first three dining food options. Spent most of our time and money offsite - spa, dinner, drinks. Wasn’t worth our money.

reviews.author: jbenoit2021
reviews.title: Review of the Scott
reviews.text: Extremely understaffed yielding in poor service. It should not take 20 minutes for anybody to order a drink at the bar.  Equally it should not take 20 minutes to get attention at the restaurant.  The staff is under staffed and they are stressed out.  Many of the staff expressed a sense of dissatifcation with management.

reviews.author: amandaZ8933QA
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, friendly staff, but there were some issues
reviews.text: Overall great stay. The grounds are beautiful and the staff is so helpful and friendly. However it was hard to get service, it's apparent that it's understaffed. We waited constantly for service at the restaurant and lounge. I couldn't get into the workout room because it's by appointment only and there was never any availability. My room was never cleaned during my stay. I had to ask for coffee refills, towels, etc everyday. I was even told one day that my room was scheduled to be cleaned and it wasn't. I will say that the staff was amazing. Even though they were often short-handed everyone had great attitudes and you could tell that they had a good culture and environment. I would stay here again but hopefully they've worked through some of these issues.

reviews.author: Essca15
reviews.title: Management seems like they are In over there head
reviews.text: Don’t expect to eat at the restaurant and the food is underwhelming. Seems poorly maganeged and understaffed. Food was burnt, took over an hour to get and the next day they served half our party then closed the restaurant. Room service wouldn’t change my pillow for a non feather. The pool is amazing though.

reviews.author: Navigator693679
reviews.title: A Bit of Paradise
reviews.text: Loved this resort, especially the grounds. Very friendly and accommodating staff, and great feel. The bed was comfortable, and the Canal Restaurant had great dishes for every meal. I especially loved the breakfast.

reviews.author: E5367QXnathanp
reviews.title: Less than satisfactory at best
reviews.text: The cleanliness of the room was less than desirable. The shower had black mold all over the grout lines on the bottom wall tiles. Other areas of the shower had the grout completely missing and then smothered over with white caulking. The shower drain barely drained thus leaving your feet soaking in soapy shower water. The vanity countertop seams were moldy and stained. The faucet handles an excessive build up of mineral deposits at their base which did not make you feel like you were using a clean sink. The mattress cover underneath the bottom sheet had not been changed and had urine and other stains on it which is incredibly disgusting and unsanitary.  Last the walls and ceilings were dirty with hand/finger prints, excessive dust and who knows what else all over them.

reviews.author: nlb633026
reviews.title: Beautiful aesthetic yet underwhelming experience
reviews.text: Wished the experience matched the aesthetic. They tell you nothing about activities and accommodations at the hotel when checking in. Make sure to reserve every meal and call the spa 1 week in advance. Have to fight for lawn chairs at the pool. It was underwhelming when our expectations were high.

reviews.author: hect852000
reviews.title: Weekend trip
reviews.text: High potential for a great stay with a more personalized view towards guests. The resort is in a beautiful area surrounded by luxury restaurants, shops and communities. At the end of our stay (11:00pm), from desk tried to rectify the issues in the room but was free out second call about our issues.

reviews.author: Carla K
reviews.title: Great couples getaway!
reviews.text: Staff, room, amenities, lobby, pool were all great! The property has beautiful gardens and there is plenty of seating available throughout the resort to lay back and relax. Note that the hotel restaurant gets super busy so making reservations head of time is highly recommended!

reviews.author: tayhetz
reviews.title: Obsessed
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this resort - made the perfect girls getaway trip! The room, location and overall vibe couldn't have been more on point. The beds were extremely comfortable, loved the little unique touches throughout the room and resort and overall decor - highly recommend and can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: katielynch09
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: The Scott is a gorgeous hotel.  The renovation a couple years ago really took the lobby and room decor to the next level.  The pool area is also nice, with very attentive pool service which I appreciate.  The hotel needs to work out some kinks at the restaurant post-COVID, but the staff is very nice.  Overall, really enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: Carida
reviews.title: Bad service & stole apple air pods
reviews.text:
Only because I cannot pick a zero I have to pick a one.!!! 
This is only our second day here my husband  AIR PODS  went missing they were in his bag at the front desk. We left our bags at the  lobby while we went golfing room was not ready . Came back wouldn’t help us bring our bags to our room no elevator just stairs !! . All day by the pool come back to the room not made up no towels.  Call downstairs let them know our room was not clean and they only clean on every third day horrible what happened to having a clean room and fresh towels I guess not here at the Scotts resort and spa!! 😡

reviews.author: 10KD01
reviews.title: Not worth the money, stay somewhere else
reviews.text: Stayed at The Scott for 3 nights. Towels & washcloths are extremely poor quality: stains, dirt spots, thin & scratchy.  Asked for replacements, same poor quality with stains & spots.  Doors in room were chipped, dented and scratched.  Not worth $400/night!

reviews.author: 930sandd2021
reviews.title: Fresh, friendly, and fun
reviews.text: After seeing The Scott online, we thought it would be a great place to spend a few nights while visiting college campuses. Everything you see on the website matches what we experienced. The pool, lobby, and bar areas were always filled with people having a good time. Our room faced the pool which was perfect as we sat on the lanai each morning. If you’re looking for a fun location (not quiet), with a laid-back feel, this is your place.

reviews.author: Travel12093203204
reviews.title: Conference location
reviews.text: Stayed at The Scott Resort for a 2 day conference, called ahead for late arrival. Check / Check out was quick & easy. Pools and outdoor space were constantly being cleaned & kept very nice. The conference was awesome, everything was set up and ready for us when we arrived. The restaurant was able to handle our lunch orders timely and get us all through and back to the ballroom on time both days! The resort is in a great location, close to lots of local restaurants, local artisan shops and night life. I would definitely come back.

reviews.author: JayWhite704
reviews.title: Everything was great....except
reviews.text: The Scott is a great hotel. Fabulous food, staff, and service. What wasn't great was our room (location). It had a cute little balcony that overlooked...Chaparral Road. This is possibly the loudest road noise I've ever experienced in any hotel experience, including many urban environments. People drag race up and down the road at all hours of the day/night. I will never stay here again, unless I can guarantee that I won't have to deal with this. I slept horribly for three nights.

reviews.author: Climber28623601378
reviews.title: Understaffing effects quality of service
reviews.text: They are clearly running with a minimum staff.  Front desk clerk is stuck on the phone, kitchen is very delayed in preparing food, no cocktail waitress in bar.  Not an acceptable level/quality of service for this caliber and cost of resort.

reviews.author: cb8267
reviews.title: Lovely Resort
reviews.text: I cannot WAIT to go back! The outdoor and main spaces were absolute perfection, and the staff was among the best/most professional I've ever experienced. The room was clean and thoughtfully appointed, the ceilings a bit low, but we didn't spend a ton of time in there other than to sleep. The outdoor spaces are where you want to be!

reviews.author: ChaskaMOM
reviews.title: Lovely stay!
reviews.text: Staff, food and grounds are amazing.  Location good if not renting a car and can walk a mile to most restaurants.  Note - they no longer have shuttle service. Pool very busy on weekend.  Would stay again!

reviews.author: bearabo
reviews.title: Just OK
reviews.text: The property is old and in need of a tune up.  The pool was crowded without sufficient seating for all of the people present. The food at the restaurant was fair and that is being generous.  All in all, not a four star experience but they charge four star prices.

reviews.author: KeeKee9131
reviews.title: Disappointing start of stay but ended well.
reviews.text: We endured some aggrevations, to say the least, at this hotel. We were not given the room we booked and were made to pay for $500 worth of spa treatments that we did not receive. They did give us a facial instead of the spa experience we booked. The seats around the pool were dirty, the pool was not cleaned until noon (pool opened much earlier than that). Drinks and peoples food trays were left around firepits and lounging areas for far too long.

reviews.author: Chelsea E
reviews.title: Stellar experience
reviews.text: The Scott Resort and Spa is one of the best boutique resorts I've had the pleasure of staying.  You will not go wrong booking a long weekend.  When leaving the property to explore other drink and bar options we often commented how the experience at The Scott was better.

reviews.author: 9aa5jkyx61
reviews.title: Good place to stay
reviews.text: The hotel was very nice and had a great lounge vibe. The food we had was great and came out quickly. The pool was packed and there was no enough chairs. There was no house keeping unless you texted and that was only to get towels.

reviews.author: EileenJBall
reviews.title: Our Honeymoon at The Scott
reviews.text: I booked the romance package for my husband and I to celebrate his birthday and our honeymoon. We stayed for one night and every moment was a dream. The hotel itself is beautiful and we were in awe of the design. The room was gorgeous and we were impressed by the mini bar, comfortable bed, and outdoor patio that faced the lagoon. A bottle of delicious champagne and chocolate covered strawberries were delivered to the room. We enjoyed them after having dinner at The Canal Club. The Scott will be our new "go to" when we want to get away.

reviews.author: SanDiegoCouple2
reviews.title: Great Location at a Popular Hotel
reviews.text: We stayed at The Scott as it we very close to our friends' Scottsdale condo. The stay was pleasant though too short. Room was comfortable and clean with nice amenities and a view to the east of the property and not a street. Pool scene seemed chill and Canal Club have great cocktails. Staff all pleasant and helpful. Did not try restaurant. Parking was convenient and free.

reviews.author: Patricia F
reviews.title: Sleep well, Play well...
reviews.text: Always a comfortable stay & great time in all ways...never disappointed! The Spa has always been a highlight on our visit. Many of our Corp/fund-raising events has always been very professional & has exceeded our expectations!

reviews.author: ruthyanntaylor
reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text: The ambiance, food, staff, rooms...everything was amazing.  We rebooked to come back next month! Our only complaint was noisy guests next door who were partying too late into the night.  The staff did send someone to the room to ask them to quiet down...but it's hard to control a party.  But we are still coming back...this place is a gem!

reviews.author: f9rnjdxecn
reviews.title: Highly recommend!
reviews.text: From location, to funky design, to friendly staff The Scott is the best hotel in Old Town Scottsdale. I travel to Phoenix at least once a month and always stay at the Scott. The pool is always vibing and the fire pits are awesome to have an evening cocktail or cigar at!

reviews.author: ssumpter2021
reviews.title: Everything and more
reviews.text: Loved this property, the location and the accommodations.  Staff were very friendly and readily available.  Wish the pool had less shade but if I visit in summer the shade is a huge plus.  Great lobby area and entertaining space outside as well.  Loved enjoying drinks and a meal while around the fireplaces they have scattered thru the lobby and outside patio/pool area.  Will definitely stay again when visiting the area.

reviews.author: E M
reviews.title: Birthday celebration for my husband.
reviews.text: Always do a birthday trip for his day. Our daughter and boyfriend joined us. The hotel was in a great location for shopping and dining. The grounds and public areas were great. Had gas fireplaces surrounded by rotten chairs so very comfortable to be outside.

reviews.author: Kristen P
reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text: Hotel is aesthetically pleasing but that’s about it. You have to walk through pool area to get to your room. If you are on second floor expect drag your luggage up a flight of stairs. Wait staff is nonexistent. You practically have to chase someone down to take your order for food and/or drinks. Rooms are small but nice. We had to deal with a barking dog a couple nights plus the beds had this weird plastic pee pads on them. Although it’s located in a good location to Old Town, I would not stay here again. Se ice really lacked for us!

reviews.author: ShellyM_Brookfield
reviews.title: Amazing resort - can't wait to return!
reviews.text: Great resort and amazing staff!  The pool area is gorgeous and loved the relaxing lagoon section of the resort.  Quiet rooms so slept well even though the resort was at 90% capacity.  Short walk to lots of restaurants and shopping.  Will definitely stay there again.

reviews.author: Emilie B
reviews.title: Great Service!
reviews.text: We had a phenomenal experience at canal club. We sat at the bar and were immediately greeted with a smile! (i could tell even through his properly placed mask was hiding what was sure to be a beautiful smile)  Weston and Jessica were extremely inviting and knowledgeable. Overall 10/10!!!!!

reviews.author: khawker1
reviews.title: sleepless in Scottsdale
reviews.text: Overall the property and the room were very nice, but encountered a late night party that kept us up and as well as other guests. The hotel did take action, but disappointed that this caliber of hotel you would end up dealing with this.

reviews.author: Kota
reviews.title: Average hotel with resort prices
reviews.text: My husband and I were not impressed. This isn’t much of a resort. It feels like an old apartment complex that was made into a 3 star hotel. You must walk through the pool area to get to the rooms in the back when walking from the lobby. Our first room had a view of an old apartment complex. We asked to be moved to a room with a pool view. When we moved our new room had a view of the side of the hotel (which was better then the old apartment view I guess). Our new room had holes in the walls and dirt on the bench at the end of the bed. We found bloody tissues and accu-chek sticks in both trash cans. When we brought this to their attention we were moved to another room. The new room was missing the knobs and all the lamps and you had to unplug them to turn them off. The walls are paper thin and you can hear everything your neighbor is saying and doing. This is a motel 8 with boho decorations at resort prices.  Don’t waste your money on this place

reviews.author: tcmarts11
reviews.title: Relaxing couples retreat
reviews.text: Stayed here for two nights before our flight out, to get some sunshine after a chilly fun week in Sedona. Had an amazing time lounging at the pool all day. Bartender and restaurant on site were fantastic. Booked last minute prenatal massage and regular massage for my husband which well worth it. Literally the only downfall were the hotel bathrooms which could use a little more lighting at the vanity. Felt very safe and clean throughout the hotel during these COVID times.

reviews.author: Cindy
reviews.title: Scott Review
reviews.text: Its not as nice as the website seems. Be careful when paying for a pool view because our first room was not a pool view at all. The location is nice but that's about it. They do landscaping too early, at 7 am every morning with a leaf blower....

reviews.author: becky782000
reviews.title: Weekend away with Husband
reviews.text: I highly recommend The Scott Resort & Spa.  The property & accommodations are exactly as pictured and the beds are so comfortable.  Everything during our stay was absolutely perfect & I have no complaints.  The property is beautiful and well maintained.  You will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: parisoohlala1
reviews.title: Beautiful Scott resort
reviews.text: This was an escape with a girlfriend of mine.. the weather was terrible/rainy, but the hotel was so fantastic, we didn’t mind spending most of our time lounging, eating and drinking on the grounds. The spa was great - definitely recommend la Vidorra experience.

reviews.author: Boysmomma
reviews.title: Couple's Weekend
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay. The suite was lovely and provided enough room to lounge and enjoy balcony time.  The pool was heated and jacuzzi was lovely.  The property has so many areas to just kick back outside, intimate and cozy fire pits, hanging chairs, hammocks and little umbrella table and chair sets. Very tropical and peaceful.

reviews.author: Amanda Dye
reviews.title: Five Star Experience
reviews.text: My fiance and I had the best time at The Scott. Every person we encountered was so nice and incredibly helpful. The drinks at the bar are top notch and the food from the restaurant is great! We will be most definitely be returning for another visit.

reviews.author: spowag1
reviews.title: Cool vibe, nice getaway
reviews.text: The bed was not quality, squeaky and loud. Great location. Bikes were great.  Cool vibe.  Maintenance shouldn’t be running leaf blowers before 9 am on a Sunday (it was 7:30 am) No waitress service in bar or pool, but lots of employees standing around.

reviews.author: chasedeisler
reviews.title: Quick weekend trip.
reviews.text: The Scott is perfect for any type of get away.  The facility and decor are clean, charming and luxurious.  The staff were all very helpful and professional.  The location is ideal to get to great restaurants, shopping, hiking and golf!  We will definitely be back again!

reviews.author: kimmi2021
reviews.title: Not enough Ammenities
reviews.text: Loved the hotel. It was clean, quite and very comfortable.  My only complaint is that they didn't have simple item such as pain killers to purchase and the food available was good, but expensive, with no other options onsite.

reviews.author: pgchristina
reviews.title: A gorgeous stay
reviews.text: Extremely wonderful staff and gorgeous property .  We stayed for 4 days and went to the beautiful pool where the surroundings were gorgeous .  The food and drinks were excellent .  The rooms were clean with stunning balcony views .

reviews.author: leorahartman
reviews.title: The Scott is a beautiful place to stay in Scottsdale.
reviews.text:
Sparkly clean, excellent service, comfy beds and beautiful pools for relaxation time. It was relatively close to the airport. The hotel was beautifully appointed with every amenity a busy traveler might need.
And the women's bathroom in the lobby is a delight. I absolutely loved the décor!

reviews.author: michellecgross
reviews.title: Very nice comfortable hotel
reviews.text: I came for treatment at Honor Health this place was recommended by an uber driver, it was close to hotel and airport. very pleasant stay, friendly staff , good food. The only issue I had that the phone in the room was not working and I was trying to order room service. But I just walked to restuarant and placed order and they delivered my food.

reviews.author: 4ey8igd31d
reviews.title: Awesome lobby and grounds
reviews.text: Only thing nice about this place is the lobby and grounds/pool area. Rooms are 2.5 star. Oh and unless you have hours to spare eat somewhere else, the food was very good but service is ridiculously slow.

reviews.author: bsasugirl
reviews.title: 40th Birthday girls get away
reviews.text: Had seen many pictures of the resort on social media. It did not disappoint! The staff was great, the room was super cute! It was located close to the Scottsdale night life as well. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Juan
reviews.title: Great place to visit
reviews.text: We had a good time at the Scott Resort.  Everyone was nice and friendly.  It beats being locked up in Michigan with all their COVID restrictions.   We had to wear a mask, but we were able to try all the local restaurants in Old Town which was great.

reviews.author: realestate-stacey
reviews.title: Truly Stunning Property
reviews.text:
We scheduled a very last minute girls getaway for the week between Christmas and New Years.  The property was simply stunning from the moment we stepped in the door.  Every corner is literally "picture perfect".  The weather cooperated enough that we were able to enjoy one day of poolside lounging.  We had two lunches at Canal Club and food was great!  Cocktails were wonderful.  

Sadly, I suffered a knee injury on the 3rd day of the trip that required a trip to the ER and an early departure.  The GM without hesitation accommodated us and allowed us out of our pre-paid trip, promptly sent staff to assist me with getting to the car and offered an array of assistance to manage the remainder of the day until we left.  I cannot wait to go back!

My only complaint was there was not an elevator, but the charm of the hotel very quickly overrode that fact.  Next time, I would simply request a main floor room.  So don't wait hurry and book your room now!

reviews.author: Danielle R
reviews.title: Excellent Boutique hotel in scottsdale!
reviews.text: Top Notch Service, Clean during Covid, property/ grounds were beautiful and staff was great! Food at the restaurant was good and enjoyed all the outside areas to relax/ have a drink/ eat/ or just read a book.  Would definitely stay again.

reviews.author: jfarrington2019
reviews.title: Resort itself was nice - Room was dirty
reviews.text: Room was dirty when we arrived, there was what looked like Toothpaste? all over the sink and mirror, and our wine bottle in the room was open and half drank along with our wine glasses were dirty. Not something you would expect out of a $300 a night room during prime season.

reviews.author: y2vnuiws9s
reviews.title: Stay Cation
reviews.text: Very short stay. Resort was beautiful. Location great. Bartenders made amazing drinks and were very friendly. Would go back again and try out the other amenities like the pool and spa.can’t wait to go again.

reviews.author: torikribs
reviews.title: Cutest Staycation!
reviews.text: We loved staying here! The staff is so friendly and thoughtful - they even sent us a surprise to our room for our anniversary, and it made our stay! They go above and beyond to make sure you feel special, and it was so nice. The hotel is super unique compared to others and has such a cute look and feel. It stands out from others by far! We loved it and want to come back!

reviews.author: mnr203
reviews.title: Going downhill
reviews.text: We’ve stayed here many times in the last few years but unfortunately it seems like it’s getting run down and isn’t well maintained. Gross carpets, moldy shower, broken locks and soap dispenser, dirty hallways, etc. Location is great and we love the area.

reviews.author: heatherma729
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: We have been flirting with the idea of moving to the Scottsdale/Phoenix area and when our honeymoon to Bali was cancelled (thanks COVID) we decided to make a trip. I found the Scott Resort on Instagram and the grounds and rooms are even more beautiful in person. The staff is so friendly and attentive, we couldn’t have been happier!

reviews.author: 1ysml7opxp
reviews.title: Great experience. Great location.
reviews.text: Wish we could have stayed longer but our one night stay was memorable in a very good way. Food was amazing. Room was super comfortable, clean and well appointed. We had our dog with us and felt very much at home.

reviews.author: mridgway
reviews.title: Excellent hotel in great location
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel! Front desk staff friendly and helpful. Rooms were clean and spacious. Walls a little thin. Awesome courtyard patio. Loved the multiple seating areas on grounds with tables, couches, hammocks, fire pits, etc.  Close to Fashion Center and many restaurants and shopping areas. We will stay here again!

reviews.author: xpvs16rmd9
reviews.title: Do not hesitate to book here
reviews.text: We spent 3 nights here and wished we could have stayed longer. I enjoyed the visual look, the food,  and the Spa Service, everything was really good! We ate several meals on site and they were all super. Also, great in room coffee service! This was exactly the 'boutiquey' experience we were looking for in Scottsdale. We had great hiking and a 30 min walk to downtown for dinner or shopping.

reviews.author: lorna2021
reviews.title: Beautiful landscaping, large and nicely appointed rooms - great overall location with a short walk to olde town
reviews.text: This is a lovely 4 star resort - especially for the price point. It could easily be rated 5 stars. The 50's vibe is very cool. Landscaping is lush and pools are well kept. Staff is friendly and accommodating. Unfortunately Arizona law prohibits customers bringing their own wine into restaurants, so we were disappointed that our really good bottles of Ca wine could not be corked. Conveniently located with easy walk to olde town. Will definitely return to this resort.

reviews.author: bettylake14
reviews.title: Desert Oasis
reviews.text: As an Arizona native, I rarely find much joy in our typical surroundings. The Scott was completely different. I felt like I had traveled back in time to a more glamorous era. The lobby was gorgeous and welcoming, and I spent time there enjoying espresso by the fire with a good book. The outdoor garden, pond, and pool areas were absolutely amazing. Fire pits open for use, many gathering areas you could utilize with friends, hammocks, swings, heated pool, etc. It was magical. The rooms were rather spacious as well. I have stayed at other boutique hotels and half expected to see the bathroom from my bed, but was surprised that it had its own space. Beautifully designed rooms. Comfortable beds. Balconies or patios at each room. It was a lovely stay. I am already making plans to come back for several more stays (a weekend away with my husband, a family staycation, and a girls trip!)

reviews.author: cemagee2021
reviews.title: Dingy rooms
reviews.text: An overemphasis on public areas and a glaring miss on the quality of the rooms themselves and basic hospitality one would receive in, say, a Holiday Inn Express. Your room will feel like an old musty motel that got a few new tremdy fixtures designed to appeal to young Millennials. But you won’t have a refridgerator or an ice machine that works, or get so much as a “how was your stay?” on the way out.

reviews.author: Soozan Mendel
reviews.title: Beautiful resort. Rude staff
reviews.text: The resort is really beautiful. The use of outside space is wonderful. Lots of fun fire pits and quaint areas to gather.  Well located close to town. An easy scooter ride or Uber. They were definitely under staffed. The front desk staff were very rude and I informative. They had 1 bartender that was totally over worked but sweet. There was no pool service. This was a holiday week, one would think they would increase their help.

reviews.author: cutegurl04
reviews.title: Relaxing baby moon at the resort
reviews.text:
My husband and I came to this resort for my birthday and baby moon on the dates of Dec 23-27th. The resort, staff, and room were immaculate. Everyone was very friendly. The grounds and room were well kept, modern, and clean. The resort allowed us to check in super early due to our flight arriving a little before 11 am. So that was very accommodating. We loved relaxing by the pool on Christmas Day and sitting by the fire pit nightly with a drink (and mock tail). I highly recommend this resort. 
Only con is we did not like the food at the restaurant. A bit overpriced and not that tasty or WAY TOO salty. Other than that, we would definitely come again

reviews.author: ajacob495048
reviews.title: Wonderful resort in the beautiful Scottsdale! Conveniently located next door to Old Town.
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at the Scotts, beyond our expectations. The staff was friendly and professional and   the rooms facing the pool are really nice and very well designed for the utmost confortabile stay. Drinks at the Canal were really enjoyable! We will surely come back!

reviews.author: nvpjg6gl86
reviews.title: Thick layer of dust, are they really sanitizing at all????
reviews.text: My wife had a horrible stay, since she is allergic to dust. The room was very dusty. Reached out for a water and the water bottle had a thick layer of dust. My wife and I very very concerned because if they are not able to wipe down for dust, then what kind of sanitizing and health related measures are they taking??? Maybe none at all.. If you are at all concerned about the pandemic that we are all living, I would say look elsewhere.

reviews.author: GCK
reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: What a wonderful place. Nice and relaxing great staff. The pools and hot tub are amazing. One of the pools had a beach with sand in that continues into the pool area. I highly recommend. We will come back and stay for sure.

reviews.author: katiemariealtoma2020
reviews.title: The best staycation!!!
reviews.text: Booked this as a last minute getaway. The property is breathtaking. Rooms are gorgeous and service was exceptional! This hotel has so much charm and every inch of it is beautiful. I will be back for another staycation very soon. Also, very reasonably priced. Book! You will not regret it.

reviews.author: JoyHeido
reviews.title: Family time for Christmas
reviews.text: Very cute and quaint property.  Great for our family to enjoy together time before Christmas.  Enjoyed taking a bike out for a ride to check out the town.  Covid has taken the spontaneity out of destination travel but this property worked hard to make it a pleasant stay.

reviews.author: Bamboo_Regular
reviews.title: Classy Getaway In Scottsdale
reviews.text: While most hotels try and cheap out on everything, THE SCOTT maintains a high standard with a classic look and feel, and old school charm. It is quiet yet close to everything, rooms have a warm luxurious quality to them, and the pool area is very relaxing.

reviews.author: aprilonishenko
reviews.title: My Review
reviews.text: This property is absolutely beautiful! My boyfriend and I had a great time, he was very pleased that we chose to do our staycation here. The only thing we wish we had was an extra fridge in our room to put our leftover food in after dinner.

reviews.author: NikitAaron W
reviews.title: Staycation
reviews.text: Beautiful ambiance, friendly staff. The rooms may not all be worth the price, no issues but could have better amenities. The Canal Club is a cool place to checkout! Located very close to old town Scottsdale

reviews.author: adsiemer
reviews.title: Our new favorite place!
reviews.text: First, the pictures on their website do not do this place justice. It is very beautiful! The staff are some of the kindest people on the planet! Seriously, Chris, Maria, & Mary are a few that deserve an award! We cannot wait to come back again!

reviews.author: Seasonjoy
reviews.title: Fabulous boutique hotel in the perfect hot location
reviews.text: This boutique hotel is in the heart of Scottsdale and a perfect get-away if you're still seeking some interaction. We stayed at The Scott for a spa and shopping weekend just before Christmas. My friend and I loved the room, so cute and comfortable. The spa, fire pits, and bar in the lobby were well staffed. Lots of options for spa services on property as well as near by. But proximity to fabulous restaurants and shopping was probably the best part of this boutique hotel experience. The Scott is a gem in the middle of the city.

reviews.author: 7ya530e3ka
reviews.title: Great service, very stylish hotel
reviews.text: Had a great little getaway during the covid pandemic. Staff was so friendly and helpful. Chris and with the amazing bartenders took great care of us! The hotel is very stylish as well. Pool area and outdoor spaces are beautiful.

reviews.author: 503Tim
reviews.title: "HEAVENa" in Scottsdale
reviews.text: What a treat. The Scott was extremely well thought out and breathed a whole new life in to a long known Scottsdale property. The grounds are breathtaking and relaxed and you really feel transported to another land. Peaceful and serene and lush. The rooms (We had a pool view King) were spacious, extremely well appointed and expertly styled. Everything about this property from the entrance to the the staff screams bespoke and luxury but never feels stuffy or unwelcoming. Canal Cafe had EXCELLENT eats and the staff was incredible and conversational. Very well done and cannot wait to return!

reviews.author: Corey A
reviews.title: Great Birthday Trip
reviews.text:
Upon our arrival we were unhappy with our room location and the front desk was very understanding and found us a new room right away. The rest of the trip was really great after that.

The decor is amazing. The restaurant and bar had great selections. The spa was super relaxing. Overall service was very friendly and helpful. I wish it wasn't too cold for the pool because it looked very nice.

reviews.author: kfeeder
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: The lobby and pool are was beautiful but the rooms need to be updated for the price of one night! The front desk did not make me feel very welcomed! Almonds on the floor of my room was not pleasant! Room was very small and outdated! Loved the location and enjoyed the hot tub!

reviews.author: jciob83
reviews.title: Cutest Boutique Hotel
reviews.text: I loved this cute boutique hotel! Staff were friendly, rooms were clean and overall feel was excellent! The pillows in the room and the prices of the drinks in the bar weren’t my favorite but otherwise great!!!

reviews.author: RandRMM
reviews.title: Paradise in the middle of Scottsdale
reviews.text: A hidden gem. The resort takes you back to the 1950s of Scottsdale when you lounged at the pool, had proper cocktails, danced and got dressed up. The staff was above exceptional and the rooms are large and very well stocked.

reviews.author: Vanessa W
reviews.title: Small resort with fun decor
reviews.text: I've stayed at The Scott twice and I enjoyed it both times. This is a small resort in a very convenient location. I really enjoy the outdoor dining and pool areas. And the rooms are super cute and unique. Having a seating area outside the room is a bonus.

reviews.author: gcowie2
reviews.title: An amazing place
reviews.text: A beautiful hotel with amazing staff and management. The location is perfect has perfect access to many areas the old town region of Scottsdale. Great Hiking, golf and mini outdoor activities. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone visiting .

reviews.author: atkehoe
reviews.title: New owners
reviews.text: Nice place but food was average. Rooms are trendy but lack warmth and comfort. Not sure if COVID was a factor but towels are looking pretty old and could be replaced. Pool towels were readily available which was very nice. Please update hot tub!

reviews.author: pdc2021
reviews.title: Excellent Resort, Service, and Environment
reviews.text: I have stayed at The Scott Resort and Spa multiples times over the past several years dating back to it being The Firesky Resort. In all my stays, the services, staff, facilities, etc. have been tremendous. I strongly recommend The Scott Resort and Spa.

reviews.author: StacyS853
reviews.title: Great Location. Okay Spot.
reviews.text: This hotel is a cute boutique hotel with a great location but....rooms are small with tiny bathrooms. We asked several times for clean towels and trash cleanup with promises but no action. Food is okay. Told we couldn't move our pool chairs into the sun. Expected more.

reviews.author: @ailseymay
reviews.title: Classy and relaxed
reviews.text: The Scott staff ensured we enjoyed every minute of our stay and lived up to the refined and classy atmosphere the property exudes. The service, rooms and presentation of the property were all fantastic, with relaxed and attentive service from the front desk, bar & restaurant staff and the housekeeping and property staff. Highly recommend staying here

reviews.author: federicoantonioc2017
reviews.title: OLD & VERY WELL LOCATED AT SCOTTSDALE
reviews.text:
the hotel is very old, don't get the wrong idea of the lobby, its great, but the rooms are not!
Please see the rates, there is an Embassy around the corner, much better  in price & quality. 
Regards Federico Coronel

reviews.author: lsrogers999
reviews.title: Do not stay at this hotel.
reviews.text: Do not stay at this hotel. Our room was dirty and uncomfortable and in the four days we were there was never cleaned. We tried a few times to get room service but had to walk to the lobby and restaurant to pick it up ourselves. Customer service was hit or miss. The spa was great, but next time we will stay at a different hotel and I will go to the spa without staying at the Scott. Not worth the money.

reviews.author: richardjnorthcott
reviews.title: Great Experience!
reviews.text: Cute, mini-resort in the heart of Old Town Scottsdale. Very boho, and chic! Staff was amazing, responsive, and friendly. 10/10 would come back again. Only thing that started the trip a bit rough, was the cleanliness of the sheets. Housekeeping quickly remedied this and took care of us right away..

reviews.author: MarkCamaya
reviews.title: DEFINITELY WOULD COME BACK!
reviews.text: You know, other than our disturbed sleep and housekeepers walking in on us changing and knocking on our door all morning for no reason (don't know if there was a miscommunication with front desk and housekeepers with the room being ready or not..) we had a blast! We love the area, lots of options as far as breakfast lunch and dinner, although we did love the canal club! Forgot our bartenders name but she was so friendly and so kind to us. We loved and enjoyed the pool. Love that there are time slots for the gym just for COVID safety. They have free bikes on property. They also have $10 golf rides that take you down to Old Town Scottsdale. So much fun. Other than our lack of sleep because of the housekeepers knocking on our door all morning and disturbing our sleep, we had so much fun here. We love the staff, the property is clean and so beautiful. We are definitely coming back!

reviews.author: R2563XHjoc
reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: Quite pricy for an average hotel. Upon my 4pm arrival which is check in time, I still had to wait about 45 minutes for my room. The mini bar had been picked apart and an empty case of bud light was in the closet. Pretty bad first impression.

reviews.author: McKinley P
reviews.title: Really gorgeous property, but questionable value
reviews.text: Overall enjoyed my stay at the Scott - it made for a great, quick girls weekend getaway. Though we had a pretty decent experience, I'd definitely argue that the value isn't quite there. The price isn't quite justified.

reviews.author: devinswick
reviews.title: I'll be back!
reviews.text: I loved my room - decorated to perfection! Lots of old world styling combined with modern furniture and decor. I stayed in a ground floor room with a king-sized bed and doors to a sitting space outside. The coffee in the Canal Club was wonderful - I would recommend the Spanish latte. Only one star off my room because the heater was broken, but I will definitely be going back with friends and family as soon as I can.

reviews.author: D'Etta D
reviews.title: Great for meeting friends
reviews.text: The entire staff were pleasant.  The newly renovated pool area was fantastic.  Pool staff were very attentive even when busy.  The custom décor in the lobby and rooms makes it all very appealing to the eye and relaxing. Our visit was late September during Covid, the hotel took all of the proper measures for safety.

reviews.author: Joe P
reviews.title: Birthday Celebration
reviews.text: The selection of The Scott was made by the person coordinating the birthday celebration for our daughter.  The exterior is impressive but the rooms were tight.  The shower drain looked like it needed a good cleaning and the area is small. We chose a bottom floor because there was no elevator and since we were staying there two days we had a few pieces of luggage I did not want to haul up a flight of stairs.  Staff at the bar were pretty helpful and attentive.  Not sure I would be staying here if in the area again, however it is close to restaurants and a mall.  Food in The Canal was nothing to write home about as well.

reviews.author: Jane
reviews.title: The Scott is the Best!
reviews.text: From the retro cuban decor to the service to the clean rooms and public areas, we loved our stay and will be back!  Staff members were professional and friendly, the pool was immaculate and the hotel even brought the sun out for us.

reviews.author: wilsodw
reviews.title: The Scott Resort and Spa
reviews.text:
Relaxing stay, but The Scott Resort and Spa website is misleading regarding their recent renovations to the resort and spa.  The location is great in that it is just minutes away from shopping and restaurants. 
Good selection for the most part.

reviews.author: allydiamond
reviews.title: We loved the Scott!
reviews.text: This was a great place for so many reasons - especially during this time! Lots of areas outside to sit and relax outdoors away from others, food was great, rooms are large enough to keep doors open and have a lot of space inside. Quick walk to old town, bikes to rent! All in all, highly recommend.

reviews.author: JGA40
reviews.title: Best staycation spot
reviews.text: Best staycation spot in all of Scottsdale. Family and I have been staying at the Scott Resort pre and post COVID. The property is lush and vibrant, just recently the pool has been renovated adding to combination of recently updated perks of the resort. Was warmly welcomed by Tylor at the reception desk with a genuine attitude and professional personality. Housekeepers, pool attendants and bartenders treated us like family. Thank you to all who made this staycation wonderful as always, warm kudos to the fine leadership this property ! #mijo

reviews.author: Ayako L
reviews.title: Cute boutique hotel in Scottsdale
reviews.text: We stayed at the Scott’s resort one night extending our trip from a soccer tournament to meet up with good friends.  Overall our stay was great.  I love the decor and feel of the hotel.  It’s very cute and clean.  The food at the hotel was excellent.  We were pleasantly surprised because it’s hard to get good food at a hotel.  Definitely recommend this hotel if you are into smaller boutique hotels with style.

reviews.author: myrnajohnston
reviews.title: Hiighly recommend the Scott Resort & Spa
reviews.text: We loved the vibe of the Canal, the fire pits are welcoming and the pools and pool bar are fabulous.  The staff gave great service in every area of the Resort.  The Scott is located within walking distance to  fantastic restaurants and Fashion Square is one of the best shopping centers I have experienced.  I would definitely recommend the Scott Resort to anyone wanting a relaxing getaway.

reviews.author: Stacyrae28
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: This hotel is amazing!  The property, decor and staff couldn't be better!  Great place to escape & relax.  Great for a girls trip- allowing 4 to a room & don't mind if u take your own wine & snacks by the pool.  Beds are super comfy.  Scottsdale has SO many fun places to hike & great places to eat  (Morning Squeeze for breakfast- Olive & Ivy for dinner...tacos at Blanco Taco + Tequila are amazing!  Always a fun time at  Pattie's -- a little dive bar.  Be sure to get the cobb salad at the hotel - eat it by the pool under the warm AZ sun :)

reviews.author: 5r1dt2iapf
reviews.title: Looks fun on Instagram but fails to be a premium hotel experience
reviews.text: The weather during my stay was very warm (98/99 degrees) the AC in-room failed to cool down the room. In the evening I opened my patio doors to cool off the room. It was literally cooler outside, than in my room.  It was very uncomfortable. Let’s be real, The Scott is a party hotel not a “resort and spa.”  Large groups of people crowding the pools in the middle of a pandemic is not what I signed up for, nor what is safe. You did nice renovations to the pool and rooms but this is a heavily trafficked hotel (former motel) right off of a busy highway where people who aren’t even staying there wander and take photos with professional photographers. You sell pool passes so not even the hotel guests can get in some relaxing pool time during the day. I ended up using the pool once during my stay, at night to avoid the crowds. By then beer bottles, used towels, plates littered the entire pool area. If you’re going to charge folks as if you were a premium hotel the above matters need to be looked into (like add an evening cleaning shift). I’ve stayed at countless hotels and I was shocked at how poorly kept The Scott was. It may look cool on Instagram but in reality it was a stressful, hot, and unkept stay.

reviews.author: TrailBlazer281110
reviews.title: Amazing Resort, great location.
reviews.text: We had a great stay at The Scott this past weekend. Beautiful property and grounds, very comfortable beds, very cool decor and style. Staff was very friendly and helpful. We also like the location within walking distance to the mall and many resturants. Thank you!

reviews.author: Kate B
reviews.title: Not worth it. Disappointing to say the least.
reviews.text: While aesthetically pleasing, this property is not worth the cost. The hotel lacks security- people are in and out who are not guests, the place is completely open to anyone walking in as we experienced. Faculties are extremely lacking for a “resort”. It’s very small compared to what is advertised. The hotel cares more about guests potentially smoking in non designated areas (which aren’t marked) then people just showing up to use the pool or lurking around. Other guests brought up this topic in conversation multiple timed over the four days we were there. There are so many other better hotels in the area. Overpriced for what it is. Some staff are helpful- others are not. Communication needs to be improved.

reviews.author: Jennifer B
reviews.title: 50th Birthday Trip
reviews.text: My sister and I chose The Scott based on location, atmosphere & decor.  We were not disappointed.  The style is upscale (but not stuffy) and relaxing.  Giving you the open air experience of a island location in the heart of Scottsdale.The staff was friendly and always helpful. And the grounds within the hotel are gorgeous.  I would highly recommend this hotel and will be returning again next year.

reviews.author: Kim B
reviews.title: Amazing pools and cozy seating areas with fire pits throughout the property
reviews.text: We had a great stay at The Scott.  It's a swanky place.  The rooms have been remodeled and are cozy and stylish.  The porch was nice with nice Adirondack chairs, but overlooked the parking lot.  No exhaust fan in the bathroom.  We're never fans of the "resort fee", which is $42/night.  Just put it in the price you advertise.  The pools were amazing with lush landscaping, water features etc.  We could've been very happy spending every day the pools. Sam was a super waitress at the pool.  Very friendly and offered suggestions on local dining etc.  Their bar is hip and a cool place to hang out.  Restaurant food was very good as well.  Ooh, also the mattress was excellent - a BeautyRest Black and the feather pillows were super comfy.  Full size bottles of shampoo, conditioner and lotion that smelled heavenly.  Nespresso machine in the room.  It's the little things...

reviews.author: 79lauren
reviews.title: Gorgeous and Restful Retreat
reviews.text: This is a beautiful, quiet property set back from the road traffic in Scottsdale.  We stayed here while visiting to monitor the polls during the presidential election.  This hotel was a wonderful choice.  The pools(2) are fabulous, big enough to do laps, lots of space for others to enjoy the poolside service and lounge around.  There is a sand beach which is a hit with kids.  Service is friendly and consistent, and the food and drinks are great.  The room was very comfortable and pleasant with good wifi, good enough for my son to attend school during Covid.  This resort is a great choice if you want to get away from it all and enjoy a relaxing stay.  We got a discount rate emailed to us because we signed up for their email list during a stay at a sister property.  My only complaint is the woman at the front desk didn't know what Old Pawn Jewelry was and didn't know how to direct me to a good source.

reviews.author: Janet D
reviews.title: Do not go here if you plan on having fun.
reviews.text:
Was constantly told to quiet down, , they booked us for
Wrong year so we didn’t get rooms we wanted When we arrived, TERRIBLE food... eggs Benedict that came out cold with no sauce. Had to wait for it so food was really cold and HARD! Very unfriendly staff around the pool and don’t order anything for food from pool. It’s extremely cold and or burned.

reviews.author: charishaar
reviews.title: Heaven
reviews.text: Loved every minute of it and felt well taken care of by the staff.  Room was very clean and pool was so relaxing with waterfalls as well as beautiful landscape. We enjoyed the fire pits at night with a few other guests which was nice because it gave us a chance to meet people we probably wouldn’t have met otherwise.

reviews.author: Navigator49248878887
reviews.title: Fantastic Staycation
reviews.text:
