We've stayed in almost every resort hotel in Scottsdale for a monthly staycation as a couple. We both work remotely and with Covid it's been necessary for mental health. She's batshit crazy after a few days. 
We loved the staff, the bar was social but not overwhelming and allowed for a little "canoodling" in the corner, nothing raunchy, weirdos. 
The pool was a perfect temperature day and night. The trees were awesome, patios were fantastic, and the location was the best. 
My favorite place in Scottsdale. I'll be back for my birthday in mid-November.

reviews.author: iorjxsie3y
reviews.title: Amazing stay-cation
reviews.text: The best place that we've stayed at since Corona hit and we try to take a monthly stay cation! Staff is amazing, water and pool was like being on an island and it's awesome to get a golf cart and ride to Old Town!

reviews.author: Julie L
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: Great resort.  The rooms are very comfortable and the grounds are fabulous.  The waterfalls, fountains and pools are the perfect backdrop.  Poolside service was great as well.  It was mostly adults (some little ones, but not many) which also made for a very relaxing weekend.

reviews.author: Sean E
reviews.title: 5 star prices 3 star stay
reviews.text: We were excited to try a new local resort and decided that the Scott looked like it would be fun and trendy. Unfortunately, the rooms felt very dated, the shower dripped badly and the A/C could barely keep the room cool. Additionally, the hot tub was out of service for much of our stay.

reviews.author: crystaldianeperalta
reviews.title: The views indoors are Killer
reviews.text: We originally booked a night stay during the discounted Halloweekend sale to take advantage of a good deal! We live locally and a staycation seemed like a fun idea. We spent most of our time lounging and enjoying cocktails while we enjoyed the views.

reviews.author: bmaidnew
reviews.title: Great trip! Can’t wait to come back
reviews.text: We needed a break from 2020. We did a little research and found the Scott and we’re not disappointed. The pictures on their site are exactly what you will experience. The Scott is in a great location as well. Lots of different restaurants within minutes of their location. I can’t recommend this place enough! If you’re thinking about going, you should definitely do it!

reviews.author: mwaltz71
reviews.title: Astethic is gorgeous
reviews.text: This place is as beautiful as the pictures look and more. The pools are fun and drinks are amazing. Seriously the most comfiest beds we’ve ever slept on. The staff was amazing too. Food was descent but we only ate at the hotel once.

reviews.author: Hannah_morrow1
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL RESORT
reviews.text: My husband and I only stayed one night here and we wish we had longer. The resort grounds, decor, and rooms are so beautiful and you really feel like you are somewhere tropical! Staff was friendly and cocktails were delicious.

reviews.author: Jasmine H
reviews.title: Amazing gem
reviews.text: I can’t wait to return. Exceeded my expectations and Jessica at the bar was a doll! The aesthetics and vibe was unmatched. The elite popcorn and the Cuban sandwich was to die for. I plan yo return soon!

reviews.author: Sarah Roth
reviews.title: Expensive Hotel with Super 8 vibes
reviews.text: If your kind of hotel involves watching people have sex in the pool right outside your balcony window than you came to the right place. The bathroom is the size of a closet, the drinks are incredibly overpriced and the rooms are mediocre. Save your money and go somewhere else.

reviews.author: frannie356
reviews.title: Beautiful Oasis in Old Scottsdale
reviews.text:
We've been to many of the big resorts in Scottsdale, some multiple times.  We'll return to The Scott going forward.   It was so nice to have many restaurants, shops, and walking trails a short walk from the resort.  Visits to most other resorts require car trips for anything beyond what the resort provides.

Staff were uniformly friendly.   Some of the housekeeping services were limited because of COVID, but fresh towels were provided upon request each day.

The grounds were beautiful, with flowers everywhere.  During our limited time indoors, the TV was equipped with  Chromecast --- something I haven't seen at any other hotels or resorts.  We could watch Netflix or Prime from our phone -- on the wall TV.  

The surrounding area was the main attraction... the shops and restaurants of Old Town Scottsdale and the 'Fashion Mall', both a short walk away.

Overall a great destination that we'll visit again.

reviews.author: drdylankrueger
reviews.title: Complete rip off
reviews.text: The staff did the absolute minimum and didn’t try at all to assist us.  The room was loud.  The restaurant made no accommodations for guests.  The price was ridiculous for the quality and then they added over $90 in random “hotel fees”.  I would never book here again, period.

reviews.author: ryanmm2020
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: We stayed here for a birthday. The suite was very nice and clean. Staff was great as well. I would definitely recommend staying here if you want a great experience. We will be coming back again when we’re in town.

reviews.author: Jean P
reviews.title: Girls trip!
reviews.text: We had such a wonder stay at the Scott. The pools were perfect. The Spa was amazing. It had everything we needed for a few days away. Great location. Friendly service and a very adult atmosphere. We loved the fire bowls and vibe the resort has.

reviews.author: slcgreens
reviews.title: Only the hallways and bathrooms fell short
reviews.text: Gorgeous property with exception of dark claustrophobic hallways, and small bathroom compared to thegenerously sized guest rooms. Also, the patio access rooms do not have keycard entry so in order to enjoy the convenient access to courtyard and pool, the patio door would have to be left unlocked, which we weren’t comfortable doing. So every time coming and going from the pool (all day every day for 6 days) we had to go the long way around, thru the dark small hallway.

reviews.author: TheBridgets
reviews.title: Spa getaway
reviews.text: This place was magnificent!! Peaceful, comfortable, and absolutely beautiful. The tranquil waterfalls, many lounging areas, opulent fireplaces and pits. The only downside was there’s no housekeeping due to covid19. But the upscale is “they are taking extra measures to assure there’s no spread of the virus.”

reviews.author: Veronica B
reviews.title: Big let down
reviews.text:
I booked through a discount site because I was looking for someplace close to a medical appointment I had. I was already stressed about that, and trying to save money but wanted a nice place for a little down time/ relaxation too with my best friend who came to support me. I am assuming because I used a discount site to book my room that instead of trying to impress me they figured I wasn't a worthy guest because I didn't pay full price.
Our room faced a very busy roadway- so no real rest/relaxation time for either of us. I told them upon my check in that I was with my best friend, yet we were still given a room with a king bed. We also got to hear the maintain crews out running their leaf blowers etc. in the mornings.  Upon leaving the property for the day we saw masks, gloves and other things stuck in the bushes and at the base of the walls around the exterior of the building and property line. 
The only pros on this trip where, they are close to Scottsdale Fashion Square, close to my medical appointment and the rooms where clean and comfortable. 
Because of this experience I will not be booking at The Scotts nor recommending it to anyone.

reviews.author: clairest232
reviews.title: Overpriced Hipster Hotel
reviews.text:
If hanging out with a bunch of 20-something year old hipsters s is your thing, this is the place to go. Picture a pool scene like at a Vegas hotel. Other than that, know that location and a boutiquey feel are literally all you are paying for here.

So I'll start with the pros:
- Walking distance to Old Town
- Cute property
- Comfy beds

For us, that was it. This place was easily twice what the luxury north end hotels cost, and service was abysmal. I'm pretty sure that for now, that's not their niche and they don't care...they just want to be the 'cool" place, which may or may not work for them long-term.

Cons included:
- You have to stake out a pool chair by 9am or you are screwed. There are no attendants regularly clearing towels off unattended chairs. When we asked someone about it we were told that we could move chairs around ourselves. Pool area is way too small.
- Service at the pool was awful. I saw multiple people around us complain. No service until 11, which was tossed your way in a greasy box which was never even picked up afterwards. Servers walked around but never even tried to make eye contact...you'd have to flag them down. They'd never check on you, and they "forgot" orders several times for us or those around us.
- Specialty drinks at the bar were literally undrinkable. Food was not good.
- Rooms were kind of dirty (bathroom, walls, patio) and the refrigerators didn't get cold enough
- Even on a slow day, they expect $25 an hour for a late check out.

We were on a girl's trip and for the money, we would much rather stay elsewhere for a luxe experience. It was really small and did not feel like a resort at all, but more like a renovated apartment complex with a courtyard pool.

reviews.author: Caitlin C
reviews.title: Extremely disappointing
reviews.text: What a total disappointment. We booked here because we were part of a wedding party block and heard nothing but good things about the resort. From check in we had billing problems, problems with the cleanliness of the rooms, and maintenance issues. My mom had to clean the bathroom, the fridge is in an unventilated cabinet which makes it lukewarm at best, so we had to get a separate mini fridge to keep my nephews milk cold, the room safe was broken, they could not find my credit card authorization form and put the rooms on the wrong card, there was an extremely sharp piece of metal sticking up on the hallway door that maintenance never even addressed, and the food at The Canal Club was an overpriced mess (don't get the "pizza" the crust is a tortilla), etc. My family came in from MO and specifically asked for adjoining rooms so we could spend maximum time together. When I arrived, the smoke alarm was on the desk and not on the wall. We asked maintenance to come fix it, which they did immediately. Later that evening after my nephew was asleep, we heard the sound of water inside the wall. The alarm started screaming and in an attempt to keep my nephew asleep, my brother tried to disconnect it from the wall. He was immediately covered in water and electrocuted twice. The leak was pouring out of the hole. The hotel said we had to move and they only had one room available in the entire resort. Half of us had to move to an entirely separate building and floor which really ruined the amount of time we had together. When we checked out, they had comped a single night for all our trouble, effectively stating that they didn't care a single bit about how our stay went. And they DEFINITELY tried to cover their asses over my brother getting electrocuted! When you spend the kind of money we did at a place like that, you are expecting incredible service and accommodations. I absolutely will never spend my money there again. It was just very disappointing all around, especially when the wedding block brought them so much business. The only positives I have are the maintenance man (TA won't let me mention his name) getting to the room as soon as he could to help with the alarm and being SUPER apologetic and helpful and one of the front desk managers (again, can't mention her name) when we checked out. She fixed our billing issues and was super patient and accommodating.

reviews.author: MySun0928
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: Our stay was more than expected.  From the moment we entered the lobby, with the amazing scent in the air, we knew we were going to enjoy our stay.  The staff was pleasant, the property was well kept and the ambiance was really nice.  I will say, the patrons were not friendly.  Everyone seemed to keep to themselves.  Possibly due to covid, not sure though.

reviews.author: Mabrading
reviews.title: Hip and Comfortable!
reviews.text:
Resort staff super friendly!
Hip and Comfortable!  Loved the Bohemian Chic/Retro Vibe!
The Canal Club specialty drinks are very creative and yummy!
Outdoor movies next to the firepits = on point!
Great retreat from Covid!

reviews.author: Nissi_Vee
reviews.title: Beautiful Decor
reviews.text:
This hotel is very chic. I absolutely loved all the decor. It has beautiful gold accents and lush greenery everywhere. This place is great for couples who seek entertainment and for bachelorette/bachelor parties. I would not recommend for families with small children. It has more of a party vibe.

Parking: It was free and there was ample parking at all times. 

Check-In: it was quick and easy. At check-in, you will be provided with wrist bands for the pool. The hotel does not have an elevator. Be prepared to carry your own luggage up the stairs if your room is in the second floor. 

Vidorra Spa: My husband and I had a great spa treatment. Although expensive, The Vidorra Experience is worth every dollar. If you can splurge, go get pampered. The spa is beautiful and very clean. I left a separate review specifically for the spa.

Pool: There are two pools right next to each other. One is a regular pool and the other one simulates a beach. Although it is beautiful, the sand hurts to walk on. The pool gets busy very quickly. Usually around lunch time, a few chairs will open up. Then again, it fills up. You will see many bachelor/bachelorette parties at the pool. They seem to prefer the pool and hot tub area versus the simulated beach. On a good note, the pool closes at 10pm so you can always go to the pool after dinner. The grounds are beautiful. However, dirty towels pile up very quickly. Also, there is a tree near the pool so there will be many leaves in the water. 

Bar: The bar was great! They have delicious cocktails. Also, the bar has the same menu as the restaurant. You are able to order food and drinks at the bar and either eat at the bar or at any lounge area available. There are many lounge areas available so you will find seating either inside or outside. The outdoor lounge areas have fire pits and there is a movie playing on the wall with a projector. 

The bar could get very busy as many people will be ordering food as well. There is only one line for drinks and food. If it’s starting to look busy, order a few drinks at a time. It’s a buzz killer to wait in line for 20 minutes to get another drink. 

Food: The food was quite good. We ate dinner one night and had room service for breakfast. 

Room Service: The food was good. Be aware that there is a $5 delivery fee and 23% service charge. 

Fitness Center: It was closed due to COVID.

Views: Unless you pay extra for a pool/lagoon view, do not expect much of a view. Our room faced a parking lot. However, there was a large white wall that will give you some privacy when you step out to the patio area. I did not care for it. 

Restaurant: My husband and I attempted to eat dinner here. However, we were told that we needed reservations and they did not have any available for a couple of hours. I am unsure if it is usually this busy or if it was extra busy because it was restaurant week. It worked out fine since the hostess told us that the bar has the same menu as the restaurant. We enjoyed sitting in the lounge area instead. If you plan on having a special dinner, be sure to call ahead. 

Overall, I loved this hotel. It is so cute! Yet, there is room for improvement in the pool area. Also, it should not charge extra fees for room service, as we are already paying a resort fee.

reviews.author: 902hayleem
reviews.title: The Scott hotel review
reviews.text: I enjoy my stay at The Scott Hotel. I was visiting Scottsdale on a business trip and can only speak for the services provided during the week. The grounds and rooms are beautiful; I can't say enough about the pool/lounge area. As for the room, there was a loud banging sound which occur when the AC unit shut off that sounded like a car hitting the room door, it was LOUD. This was very disturbing for sleep purposes. Also, I did notice a mildew type smell throughout the hallway and room. There is a distinct smell throughout the hotel and property which is lovely and pleasing but this was far different and not pleasing.

reviews.author: v1ct0rylapz
reviews.title: The best Secret staycation getaway.
reviews.text: The moment you walk in through the doors, you're transformed to another place, similar to Old Havana's charming character.  The Canal Club exudes a cheerful vibe and atmosphere.  The rooms are clean.  The only criticism is I wasn't greeted as soon as I entered the Scott but it didn't stop me from enjoying a great time at this wonderful Scottsdale resort.

reviews.author: Heidi S
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: The Scott is a beautiful resort with amazing decor. I want to give this resort a 5 star review, but cannot based on our room. We booked a pool side room with 2 queen beds. Upon check in we requested a king if it was available. They accommodated our request, but failed to mention we would be facing the parking lot for our 3 day stay. We went back to the front desk and requested the pool view room. They were unable to accommodate as no pool rooms were available. They were able to move us to a king courtyard view. Upon entering the room we realized it was an ADA room, this was not mentioned to us. Day 2 we requested to be moved from the ADA room. The hotel said they would accommodate this, and they would let us know when the room would be ready. After 4pm I checked with the front desk, and was given the new room key. Upon entering I found the new room had not been cleaned. It’s hard to understand why this is so difficult. It is 5pm and we are still waiting for our courtyard view room ( no pool view king bed rooms available). The hotel staff is very nice and did offer a daily resort credit, but it shouldn’t be this difficult. I think the Scott can do better considering they have such a delightful resort.

reviews.author: motioneng
reviews.title: Favorite. Hotel. Ever.
reviews.text: This was a last-minute pick as we were eating dinner nearby, that I based on a Scottsdale blogger that I follow. I loved this place! I drove my husband crazy because I could not stop pointing out all the super adorable features and taking pictures! But not just well styled... REALLY well styled, but also super functional in the rooms. The furnishings were all so beautiful but also worked so well for guests. From the plug-in/charging placement, to lighting and furniture placement, bathroom features and beverage station! I just loved everything about it!

reviews.author: Joel_Diaz18
reviews.title: Perfect getaway
reviews.text: From the beginning to the end, our weekend stay was what we needed.  The staff was so friendly and made our stay a memorable one.  The restaurant was well organized and the food was incredible. The front desk was super friendly and welcomed us and thanked us on our departure.  Amazing time here!

reviews.author: Tiffany L
reviews.title: Just stayed at the Scott's Resort and Spa for a girls getaway.
reviews.text: The resort is very cute and the beds are amazing.   What made our stay at the resort wonderful was Brooke.  She provided us with the best service out at the pool.  She was extremely friendly, attentive and went out of her way to make our stay amazing.  I really hope the resort knows what an amazing employee they have.  She really made our stay and trip wonderful.  Thanks again Brooke !!!!

reviews.author: cassiehanson
reviews.title: Amazing girls getaway!!
reviews.text: My friends and I celebrated my 21st birthday here and it was perfect! We had the best time getting brunch at the Canal Club and laying by the gorgeous pool! I was in love with all of the decor and tropical vibes.

reviews.author: bb58434
reviews.title: Very Nice Stay
reviews.text: The place was very nice and staff was helpful and attentive. The rooms were nice ,cool and clean. The beds were comfortable. The location has a variety of things around it that are within walking distance. Only wish that there was liquid hand soap cause there was only bar soap but that's not too big of a deal.

reviews.author: Karin D
reviews.title: Wonderful staycation experience. Beautiful resort.
reviews.text: Excellent weekend & perfect for my husband’s birthday. Beautiful resort with stunning landscaping. Pool was great with a man-made beach, wading pool for kids, hot tub & adult pool. Rooms were quite, clean & comfortable. Great location close to Old Town Scottsdale, restaurants & shopping.

reviews.author: janemwisniewski
reviews.title: Summer staycation extrordinnaire!!!
reviews.text: This was an excellent way to have a small family getaway safely and without having to travel far. By far we are planning on a return trip soon.  The pool and ambience was so special for our 5 year old and 1year old. My husband was so appreciative of the wi fi services too.

reviews.author: 2vhq4wln77
reviews.title: Weekend staycation
reviews.text: nice location and unique period decor. Overall nice place, unique bar and main lobby area, very comfortable. Pools were nice. Room had a musty smell. There were dirty wine glasses left at the door when we checked in which was a little unfortunate from an impression standpoint.

reviews.author: William Brownlee
reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: My wife and I went for a little get away at The Scott. It was a celebration of our anniversary and my birthday. My wife could not have picked a nicer place. We had a couples massage that was very expensive but even with the crazy price it was wonderful and well worth it. All the staff went above and beyond for us. There was this one woman who stood out in a exceptional staff.  She was amazing. She worked the bar area at the pool and her name is Brooke. We were just enjoying our time in the pool and she was beyond attentive constantly trying to make us feel special and taken care of. It is hard to stand out in a group of wonderful staff filled with friendly people but she did. She found out we were celebrating our anniversary and she brought over these delish cinnamon ball thing’s complimentary just to be sweet. The hotel is beautiful but having Brooke remember our names was just special. She went so far above and beyond I truly can’t wait to go back. The Scott was so relaxing and has the best staff around!

reviews.author: Brooke W
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: My husband and I wanted a short getaway and I couldn’t be happier with this place. We had a message here and it was on the pricey side for the couple messages but even given the cost it was wonderful. They were beyond friendly. I have to give massive credit to one of the people named Brooke (I wish I had gotten her last name). She was so attentive. We were just enjoying the pool just enjoying our time and she served us always asking if we needed anything. She found out we were celebrating our anniversary and she brought us these delicious cinnamon doughnuts balls just out of the kindness of her heart. I wish I could her more props. The next time we go back I sure hope she is still working there. I have traveled the world and have met all like of hotels and service but truly she tops the cake. The hotel is beautiful but having someone remember your name and look up our anniversary is just above and beyond. I am not even big one reviewing places. I just had to because of this one employee. Massive props to her and The Scott for hiring the friendliest staff ever. The guy that checked our AC was a delight. Best staff ever!!!!

reviews.author: Kathy S
reviews.title: Excellent Staycation
reviews.text:
Loved everything about our stay at The Scott. From the moment we arrived we knew we'd made the right choice for our summer staycation. Front desk staff was extremely helpful and courteous. Loved getting to use the pool earlier in the day before room check-in. Pool and grounds are beautifully kept... So many amazing and photo-op worthy lounge area. All staff were friendly and eager to help make our stay special. Food was incredible. Room is so well designed and bedding is very comfortable.
Thank you The Scott... We've already made plans to return next month!

reviews.author: Nsurratt
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, not great precautions
reviews.text:
I stayed here last weekend for three nights and it was a beautiful resort. The food was good, not great. Service at bar was nice when they were open before 10. The pool bar was closed when I got there at 3:30 Thursday afternoon, not sure what that’s about.

We are in the middle of a pandemic, and I was arriving from California. There are signs throughout the hotel saying that you need to wear a mask on the property. Apparently that doesn’t apply to housekeeping or maintenance. Not one of the 10 or so people I saw was wearing a mask covering their face. The majority had them around their neck, some hanging off of one ear, and then the one or two I saw wearing a mask not covering their nose. It shouldn’t be that hard. Wear your mask on your mouth & nose. No need to visit again.

reviews.author: briannabeyer54
reviews.title: So cute!
reviews.text: Loved the location and the ease of dining and shopping. The facility is beautiful and really unique. You almost forget you are in Arizona. The lobby, the pool and rooms are perfectly done. Great stay-cation.

reviews.author: hollyfleminginte2020
reviews.title: Birthday Weekend
reviews.text: I met my daughter (who lives in AZ) here for her birthday.  It was a fun getaway and the lobby, restaurant and lounge areas are all very nicely done and have a fun vibe.  Traveling and hotels stays are different during COVID.  The service isn't quite the same but nothing is these days.  The staff was very friendly and helpful.  The location is great.    I'd love to come back again

reviews.author: raymondlombardi25
reviews.title: "Repeat Customer"
reviews.text: Our third time staying at The Scott. Love the property. Easy to navigate around the resort, great location. Can walk to Old Town or Fashion Square, extremely helpful and friendly staff, clean comfy rooms, tasty food, pool, parking, and close to Starbuck's! What's not to like!!

reviews.author: Escape799555
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel!
reviews.text: We absolutely loved this hotel! It was super clean and had a beautiful aesthetic throughout the whole property. The rooms were fun and the pools were incredible! We will absolutely be coming back here for another staycation!

reviews.author: brooke
reviews.title: AH-MAZING
reviews.text: This resort has Caribbean vibes to it and gorgeous décor! We were there on our honeymoon and we loved every second of it! The pools are the perfect size and a 6ft deep end to jump in! The pool loungers and lobby seats are so comfortable! I want to come back every year!

reviews.author: Josh
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
My girlfriend and I found this property on Expedia and decided to give it a shot as the photos and reviews looked promising. Upon arrival, we were checked in to a room already occupied. Someone was in the shower behind the door. The next room we were assigned (409) had a very particular smell (old, musty etc) and was a little off putting. I decided to deal with it as she wasn't bothered as much as I was. The mini fridge hardly worked and there were scuff marks and paint chips in the wall from previous travelers luggage. I believe around 10pm our A/C started to go bad and it became really hot in our room. After lying in bed until about 1 in the morning I went to the front desk to see if we could be relocated. We switched rooms in the middle of the night and had no further issues. Just disappointed because this was supposed to be a one night stay for us to relax and we weren't able to do that. 

With all this said, I do want to thank the staff for being professional and polite. My girlfriend and I were comped a few drinks and resort fee was waved for our troubles. I want to think this was just a fluke visit but I don't think we will be back. -J

reviews.author: Simon Z
reviews.title: Beautiful and clean
reviews.text: First we visited this property on our girls trip last year. We didn't stay overnight and just came for a day at the pool. We loved it so much that we came back next year with our husbands and stayed for 4 days. The property is very pretty and pleasant to the eye and soul. The lobby, the yard and the pool area was very clean and well taken care of. Originally we paid for the cheapest room option but when we came we didn't like the view from our balcony and asked to upgrade us to a different room. They were very good about it and upgraded us to a room of our choice without additional costs. Staff is very nice and polite. Girls at the pool bar were amazing! Working at the 104+ heat serving drinks and food. We really appreciated their work!

reviews.author: juliag0nzales
reviews.title: Absolutely terrible
reviews.text: Couldn’t pay me to stay here again. Had to move rooms because of flooding. Sink in second room was backed up and filled to the top. The people in the room next to us had to be removed by Scottsdale police and were threatening to harm us. Room service took hours for some pancakes. Lobby and pool were overfilled with party goers. Not recommended if you want to relax in any kind of way. Extremely chaotic and stressful.

reviews.author: sotobeatriz892
reviews.title: ok for the price
reviews.text: The Scott is nice and has a decent price point. Located near old town and fashion square,  location is great. I've stayed here before and always had a good experience. My most recent stay was ok, not enough pool staff, towels weren't the best in the room or by the pool, and the wait time at the restaurant was far too long especially since they weren't busy. But overall,  given the price point, not bad.

reviews.author: ebender35
reviews.title: The Scott Resort
reviews.text: The hotel is a bit dated.  The rooms are very average in terms of quality and amenities.  The hotel staff was friendly and helpful, but I just don't think the price of this hotel is a very good value given the alternatives nearby.  The resort fee was excessive and I guess is meant to cover the cost of the pool access.  Not sure why a resort fee should go to something like this.  There were no other amenities to speak of.

reviews.author: CoriS725
reviews.title: Dirty
reviews.text: The newly remodeled pool area was making no attempt at social distancing. The pool was hazy and full of debris. The room was not clean either, clearly no one went in to make sure soap was provided or that all the appliances worked.

reviews.author: Daniel W
reviews.title: All-Star Mangement Team
reviews.text:
We booked a long weekend at the Scott with the hope of watching some spring baseball, enjoying the AZ sunshine, and exploring some new restaurants in Scottsdale.  Unfortunately, none of that came to pass due to the covid-19 interference.   I had booked a prepaid reservation through Hotwire and didn't expect to get any refund.  That's when I received the best service ever from a resort that I hadn't even checked into.  

The general manager Stephen Johnson and the president of the parent company John Grossman (Classic Hotels & Resorts) decided to give refunds simply because it was good service not because they had any obligation to do so.  Thank you.  I look forward to staying at The Scott Resort next year.

reviews.author: JGA40
reviews.title: Favorite spot
reviews.text:
Haven’t returned to the property after it’s renovation until now and let me begin by saying WOW!! 
You fill as if you are in a Miami resort. Clean , fresh , vibrant. Poolside service was amazing.John really made us feel at home and took care of us. Great guy. Benny “loko” at the inside bar offered amazing friendly service and was quite a character. We love this resort and will return in the near future.

reviews.author: Dknight2030
reviews.title: DIRTY ROOMS
reviews.text: DIRTY ROOMS look for urine on tile and base of toilet, toothpaste on sink from previous guest. Boogers on balcony chairs. Super disappointed especially for how much it is to stay. The staff was great (minus maid) and the public areas and lobby were clean and beautiful

reviews.author: Nancy C
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel with Amazing Dining!
reviews.text: From the moment you walk in, you feel the warmth of stepping back in time to beautiful Cuba back in the day. Love every single thing about the decor, welcoming canisters of water, fireplaces, cozy sitting areas, shawls hung on hooks by front desk for chilly evenings out back in the beautiful gardens & fire pits. The food in the restaurant is top notch & bonus to staying there!

reviews.author: KellyR50702
reviews.title: Best last minute trip!
reviews.text: This place is amazing! Beautiful inside and out. Staff members were superb. Food and drinks were delicious. Every single thing about this resort was nothing short of amazing. I can’t wait to come back!!

reviews.author: Navigate625520
reviews.title: Short stay away from snow and cold
reviews.text: This resort is overpriced for what you get.  The pool area is at least 50% covered in shade all day.  We were there during the corona virus, so the hotel wasn't full, however the resort allows day passes and on Sunday of our stay the pool was full and we couldn't find chairs to sit in by the pool and in the sun.  The pool service was poor because of all the people and not enough workers.  It was hard to practice "social distancing" and for $400 per night I would think the overnight guests should be able to expect a positive poolside experience in the smaller boutique hotel.

reviews.author: Getaway481445
reviews.title: Beautiful picturesque property in the heart of Scottsdale
reviews.text: This was a staycation that didn’t feel like AZ (a good thing!). The weather was unseasonably perfect and we enjoyed the thundershowers from the beautiful club house patio our 2nd night there. This was the last weekend before everything started shutting down for COVID-19 and I’m very grateful we had such a good time on such a gorgeous property. Lots of secluded seating areas, good pool (we didn’t use), walking distance to Postinos and other restaurants. Complimentary rides if we wanted...we switched rooms after the first night to get an interior. It’s worth it. Kids napped while we enjoyed drinks and the weather just steps from our room. My husband doesn’t love older properties but it’s been renovated beautifully and is Insta-perfect for all you influencers out there. Would definitely stay there again!

reviews.author: PGHPinot
reviews.title: Weekend escape, not a resort
reviews.text:
The Scot has an awesome Cuban vibe and cozy pool ideal for a weekend escape w the girls or your significant other. Meals are delicious and the drink menu does not disappoint. The entire property is well maintained and offers plenty of quiet areas. Beds are some of the best to sleep in!

Here are a few points to consider - 
Rooms are small like a hotel - not large Liek you typically find in other SCOTTSDALE resorts - especially tight bathroom. 
Pool view room is not worth it - there’s a worker using an electric leaf blower at 5A each day to clean the pool deck - and you will hear it. 
The hotel misses the mark in serving east coast travelers with a breakfast that does not open until 7A - tough when your body is still on EST - even hot coffee and tea in the lobby would have been a nice option (pretty typical at other resorts). 
The gym is VERY small - 3-4 cardio, rack of weights - little space and definitely no room for stretching - disappointing. 
Pool is heavily shaded so don’t count on a soak in the sun unless you’re one of the first 20 to mark a chair in the AM. 

Again - amazing food and kind service - just not appropriate for a family get away when you’re looking to stretch out and indulge.

reviews.author: Sharon T
reviews.title: The Scott
reviews.text:
I was robbed at the pool while sitting in my chair. 
The resort made zero compensation other than to waive the resort fee for one night. $40. I reported to the desk ... and no security person ever followed up with us.

reviews.author: Renee D
reviews.title: Spring Break
reviews.text: This property is nice and in a good location. We used the shuttle several times and this was very convenient but our room was very warm and even after requesting help with this on three different occasions the problem wasnt addressed by the maintenance.  we were there for three nights and had trouble sleeping.

reviews.author: jo37mn
reviews.title: Fabulous Birthday Weekend!
reviews.text: I was celebrating a birthday weekend with my daughter. Our room was lovely, pools quite fabulous and the restaurant food (we ate breakfast there every morning) so delicious! At night we enjoyed talking by the fire or in one of the beautiful sitting areas. The grounds at night are like a fairy land with hanging lights and lanterns. A wonderful weekend!

reviews.author: Sandra D
reviews.title: Love the resort property! Great staff and ambiance.
reviews.text: This is our must stay place when we visit Scottsdale. The property is well designed and makes you want to hang around to enjoy the pool, outdoor couches, fire pits, bar and even the “lobby” which is so much more than that! Guest rooms are nice but deserve some attention to live up to the premium price of a stay.

reviews.author: pattywacky
reviews.title: Quick Overnight Work Trip
reviews.text: The resort is lovely.  I enjoyed my stay.  It was a quick 1 night work trip, so I did not have a chance to explore the resort much - I arrived late afternoon and left by noon the next day.  The bottled water in the rooms is a nice touch, along with the free shuttle which I did not get a chance to utilize.

reviews.author: 738rutho
reviews.title: Great place for some R & R
reviews.text: Great atmosphere/decor, friendly helpful staff, and clean.  Only issue was the speed of service at the Canal club and bar were exceptionally slow.  Also the air vents bang when the come on and turn off which was disruptive.  But we had great time and I would definitely come back.

reviews.author: FreeholdNewJersey
reviews.title: Stepping to the plate big time!
reviews.text: Great resorts are staffed with great people and that is no more true  anywhere than at the Scott! Without getting into specific details they really stepped to the plate today and helped my wife and I out of a tough situation. I've always said we since we've been staying at the Scott the past few years, that the resort is wonderful, and I always acknowledge the people because they are wonderful X 2! Much thanks to Alyssa and her team for really helping us out of a tight spot. Thank you folks, my wife and I will continue to visit you in the future and sing your praises to our friends and family! You guys are the best!

reviews.author: Mfrances229
reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text:
Perfect location. Fantastic amenities.
Used the free shuttle several times. The Bel Aire too! Fun. Lovely staff. Great pool and spa. The most comfortable bed ever. Will definitely go back and recommend.

reviews.author: Kathryn G
reviews.title: Watch out!
reviews.text: Yes it is a beautiful resort and we chose it for all the right reasons only to find on check in our booking had been cancelled 3 days before and they had moved us to there sister resort without communication.  This was a suspicous move as we were advised that someone had booked the whole resort.  Happy to take our money in advance.  After travelling 5000km it was a difficult holiday moment.

reviews.author: Renee D
reviews.title: Unique
reviews.text: Beautiful resort. Great restaurant. Was there on business so didn't have a chance to fully utilize all of the facilities such as the pools, spa etc...but I will definitely return for vacation. Great location, walking distance to Fashion Square and Old Town Scottsdale.

reviews.author: barbgrace1
reviews.title: NOT A CLUE
reviews.text: The hotel is really just a remodeled motel. It is poorly maintained. Dirty carpets, torn sheets and sinks that leak. Management smiles but does not address the issues. It appears they sit in an office but never walk the property. The great location does not make up for the other shortcomings.

reviews.author: Explorer55961
reviews.title: Charming hotel with an incredibly friendly staff
reviews.text: We were delightfully surprised by the airy, charming common spaces of this hotel, from the wide open, stylish entry to the restaurant, fire pits, and sprawling pools and outdoor spaces.   There are many nooks and gathering spots for small groups to visit and the atmosphere is fun, upbeat, cheery.  The rooms was nice - hints of an older hotel that was tired and in need of updating, but with the new finishes and furniture, our room was comfortable and tasteful.  It was nice to have a balcony as well.  I recommend the rooms looking out over the interior courtyard.

reviews.author: LinRenee
reviews.title: Most dreamy stay!
reviews.text: The location was great, and the complimentary bikes or shuttle were such a nice perk! We wanted something close to shopping and restaurants but most importantly it was so beautiful and unique! We wanted a 'non chain hotel feel' and this was even more perfect then we could have imagined with all of the needed amenities but the boutique feel! We really wanted a dreamy pool, room with outdoor balcony and access to great bar, spa, fitness center, etc. and this exceeded our expectations! The staff were all SO friendly and accommodating! I will definitely be recommending & coming back!

reviews.author: Adventure696159
reviews.title: Gorgeous property
reviews.text: Enjoyed staying here for a long weekend. Beautiful property - rooms, lobby, bar, pool area - all really well thought out and lovely. Great food, great drinks, great service all around. Very comfortable and we'll be back!

reviews.author: amma2662_12
reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: I stayed here with friends for a getaway and I am so glad I chose this hotel! The location was unbeatable, being able to walk right into town. Their free shuttle was available for us as well. Staff was courteous. Decor was amazing-- so funky and cool and it felt like a true oasis getaway. Rooms were spacious and had good amenities.  Restaurant was one of our favorite meals.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: TB374
reviews.title: Great place to stay-be sure to book a few days
reviews.text: Wonderful resort and great location.  Staff made the stay outstanding.  The resort was close to all shopping, hikes, dinners, site seeing etc.  Looking forward to going back again and wished we would have booked our stay for more like 5-6 days instead of 3-4.

reviews.author: traciefish
reviews.title: Beautiful getaway
reviews.text: Loved staying at this property, was beautiful and relaxing, walking distance to other restaurants and shopping. Rooms and hotel lobby ambience is beautiful and well decorated with an anthropologie style. We loved our spa treatments! The shuttle was super convenient. I wish we could have stayed longer. Staff was attentive except in the bar lounge area. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: stephp6
reviews.title: May Be the Cutest Hotel
reviews.text: Gorgeous and adorable boutique hotel. Boho/Cuban flair. Bright and airy. Huge lobby with tons of lounging space. The Canal Club bar has great food and drinks. Awesome atmosphere. Loved our room too. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: crystalsmith2
reviews.title: business trip
reviews.text: the food at the hotel was not good, staff was friendly and facility clean. no vending machine or fridge, or microwave. hotel was in walking distance of everything which worked out great. the room were clean

reviews.author: RobertWDeFries
reviews.title: Review
reviews.text:
Overall a good experience.Friendly staff willing to accommodate.. 
Would like to know the definition of and what is included in resort fee

Taxes and resort fee of approximately $100.00 per day excessive

reviews.author: mcmahonj2020
reviews.title: Good for the most part. Your stairways are a liability spend the money and put in ramps.  Someone could get really hurt
reviews.text: Are a liability someone could seriously get hurt. Sped the money and put in a ramp on one side.  Luggage can get heavy it help your guests concrete is cheap and a ramp could be easily installed not sure why such a nice hotel wouldn’t want to do this

reviews.author: ophfvj2677
reviews.title: Great design, Poor Service
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel. Great location.  The staff was very friendly, but overwhelmed and not able to respond in a timely manner. Room had a pungent moldy odor that would come and go. The pool was overcrowded. The overall design and aesthetics excellent. Wish the hotel would focus on the little things and improve service.

reviews.author: Cindy Rae R
reviews.title: Back to another era. Wonderfully done pool area. Spa was intimate and technicians were very well at their craft
reviews.text: The spa was incredible and technicians perfect at their craft. Food very tasty and server Will was a treat. Room overlooked pool and we had a lot of fun with the bean toss game. Would come back anytime

reviews.author: Amy611
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort-Great Location
reviews.text: The Scott Spa and Resort is a lovely hotel for those who want the amenities of an upscale hotel close to everything in Scottsdale and not on a golf course. Beautiful rooms with incredibly comfortable beds, great pool area for relaxing  and lunch and a very friendly staff. The hotel has a great looking lobby and is beautifully landscaped around the pool.  It is well located near shopping, Old Town and many great restaurants with easy access to the highways.

reviews.author: khandibrock
reviews.title: Spectacular Property
reviews.text: If you want a relaxing environment with a beautiful property, this is the place to visit.  We were here for a conference, that' we've been having here for the past 15 years.  Even though the property has changed hands during these years, the transition has now come full circle now with an incredible staff.  The banquet folks such as Ken, Lydia, Norma and team makes sure the group feels welcomed.  It feels like were the only group on property.  The AV team is extremely attentive, making sure everything we need is handled.  It would be nice if they had a wine hour again.  This was a great networking opportunity for our attendees, which we now miss.  The new décor is nice, but the "sofas" in the room are not conducive for any kind of cuddling or comfort. Overall though, an amazing experience.  Thanks so much!

reviews.author: TripAdvice2832
reviews.title: Some Positives, but mostly things that need work
reviews.text: The Hotel is pretty and nicely redone with a beautiful lobby. However, we booked direct and our room was not available upon checking in. There is really no excuse for this, especially when we came to the hotel for that room alone (we would've stayed elsewhere if we knew it wasn't available). The room we ended up with had stained sheets, no soap in the bathroom, and no soap in the shower. It seems they rushed us into a room that wasn't quite ready due to the circumstances at check-in. The staff was generally friendly and accommodating when they could be but this hotel still has a lot of kinks to work out. The pool was crowded and people "claim" the good seats earlier in the day with their belongings which shouldn't be allowed. The WiFi is also pretty weak and disconnects all the time (tried from multiple devices).

reviews.author: ttrujillo73
reviews.title: Weekend Getaway at The Scott
reviews.text: Our weekend getaway at The Scott was everything we expected and more! Easy check in and out, spacious, well appointed room, comfy bed and exceptional service from the staff. Overall the property was gorgeous. We will be back!

reviews.author: Rachel P
reviews.title: Pretty hotel with Lots of Issues
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and is in a great location. However, we encountered a lot of problems during our stay.  First, our room wasn't ready when it was supposed to be and the front desk staff kept giving us later times that it would be ready and it wasn't done then either. Then, when we finally got to the room, we realized they had given us the wrong room type which wasn't what we had reserved. The room was beautiful but it didnt have enough beds for us so we had to request to be moved.  Fortunately, there was another room available that had enough beds, but it wasn't as nice as the previous one.  The heat in the room was not working and we had to call maintenance to fix it, twice!  while we were gone, the housekeeping stopped up the sink and left water sitting in there. There was no way for us to drain the sink so we had to call maintenance again.  When we went to the front desk to inquire about the refund we had been promised due to all the issues upon arrival, we were told that there were room service charges to our room, and we hadn't ordered anything.  There was a lot of conflicting messages from the front desk staff about what our refund would be and when we would get it. In the end, the issues were resolved but it this hotel leaves a lot of room for improvement.

reviews.author: Road755678
reviews.title: Amazing property
reviews.text: Great experience from start to finish! Staff were above and beyond courteous and helpful. Beautiful hotel and decor. The sleeping rooms were very nice as well. Great property, definitely recommend for future stays.

reviews.author: Andrea V
reviews.title: Was it worth the price?
reviews.text: We went for my daughter’s 26th birthday. Not the first time we’ve stayed as we love the property, spa and restaurant. Unfortunately there was some golf thing this weekend and they raised the rates of the rooms. I mean really raised the rates! But it was her birthday and she really wanted to stay so we did but that room bill for 2 nights was outrageous. Room was great, had a fantastic dinner at the Canal Club and she had a wonderful massage at the Spa. Was it worth it? I’m on the fence.

reviews.author: brink29
reviews.title: Mother/Daughter Staycation
reviews.text: We drove down from Prescott. Have stayed here several times. Love the kick back vibe and the lush landscaping and pool area and the food is amazing too! A very relaxing staycation for us. We will be back!

reviews.author: Melissa P
reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text:
Stayed here briefly for a work trip. The hotel is beautiful and feels lush with an abundance of plants and beautiful decor. Great attention to detail in the decorating. The hotel feels very spacious with an abundance of seating inside and out. Nice firepits outside to enjoy the great weather with a drink, as well as a large pool (that I sadly didn’t get to take advantage of). 

Enjoyed that they have a “shuttle” service that can drive you anywhere within 3mi of the hotel. I had them drop me off in old town to walk around (about .5-1mi depending how far you go). They can also pick you up if you give them a call- a convenient way to get around if you are visiting and don’t have a car.

I’d definitely recommend this beautiful hotel

reviews.author: Jessica M
reviews.title: Absolutely IG worthy
reviews.text:
Stayed here for 3 nights with a corporate room block & banquet spend. We did two private events a breakfast and a twilight cocktail party, the service was impeccable and the food delicious. 

Nicole was responsive and communication was great, she was our event manager. Our bartender Ken was a dream! 

The property photos speak for themselves and with a hot tub (stays hot!) and pool area with hours from 6AM-10PM I managed to get a bit of hot tub time between work events, can’t ask for more!

reviews.author: Kathryn W
reviews.title: Waste Management Open
reviews.text: We stayed this weekend to attend the WM Open. Had stayed in the resort when it was Firesky. Adorable boutique hotel with a good vibe. Great location to go to Oldtown and Camelback. Staff is very friendly. Food was delicious. Spa services were good. Only issue we had was room service didn't answer for an hour yesterday morning when we wanted breakfast in bed. Use of the free transport to dinners was a great benefit!

reviews.author: pacnw2018
reviews.title: Great location, but under construction and not ready for guests
reviews.text: The best thing about this hotel is it's location to downtown Scottsdale.   Easy walking distance to everything.  That said the property was having some kind of major construction work being done on the pool.  Net they were grinding concrete, jack hammering, etc. during our stay.   The pool literally had dirt in it!   They did not charge us a resort fee, but we would not have stayed if we knew that construction was going on .   The room, restaurant and bar were all uninspiring, and no were close to the reviews.   We won't stay here again.

reviews.author: imacharmer
reviews.title: Charming hotel near Old Town
reviews.text: Charming hotel with lovely decor, comfortable beds and lots of pillows. Lovely outdoor seating areas with fire pits all.perfect for January days and evenings. Good convention food. Friendly staff especially housekeeping and groundskeepers.

reviews.author: eseaberg
reviews.title: Scott Resort
reviews.text: Excellent place. Beautiful grounds, exceptionally friendly and helpful staff. The bartender at the Canal Club bar was outstanding.  I especially loved the old movies being shown on the outside wall each night.

reviews.author: snall72417
reviews.title: Barrett Jackson Auction
reviews.text: This is a wonderful resort! Fantastic spa, grounds are lovely and the staff are very informed and accommodating! Resort is pet friendly.  Decor of interior and exterior feels like a 5 star resort! Nightly outdoor movies, restaurant with outstanding food & pool with beach area makes it “over the top!” Will definitely be bringing my adult family back for long weekend! Very close to old town Scottsdale- great location!

reviews.author: Jacob C
reviews.title: Mediocre
reviews.text: hospitality.  Niceish room and facility.  Slow service. Weird food. Plumbing issues.  Nice brass features though.  Lots of potential but no hot shower and no addressing the problem is a 2 star killer.  Staff seemed bored.

reviews.author: AdeleRose12
reviews.title: Freezing cold pool!
reviews.text:
The hotel lobby looks nice, but when you walk to your room it feels like an old motel that has been re done. 
There was no odd smell in our room, no bath tub, only showers.
The room was well laid out, plenty of space to open suitcases, comfy beds. Asked for old towels to be replace in the night, no one came. There was broken pipe or something so noisy work going on at the pool and one pool totally closed, and a lot of mud on the path way to our room. The one pool that was open was not heated so impossible to swim in it.

reviews.author: MSH
reviews.title: Could be so good!
reviews.text:
This place could be so good! It’s a beautiful property, but w construction going on and a pool closed this dampened our trip. We had to ask for the resort fee of $42 to be waved as we couldn’t use the pool for construction or the jack hammering. 
Pros- courtesy car to old town, or 3 mile radius. 
Great bar and good. Fire pits w warm blankets. 

Cons- checkin was a disaster. Computers down etc. - construction  all weekend with no guests amenities for the inconvenience. Include free breakfast for a few days, or drink passes. Something. But don’t make me be the bad guy. 
Water was turned off one night of our stay, the day we were leaving the toilets wouldn’t flush in building 4. 
Construction in the hallways. 
Get the construction done and in the mean time, take care of your guests.

reviews.author: Bliss
reviews.title: Havana Chic
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing design and decor. One of the pools was under construction during our stay and for a brief time the running water was out in our room, however the hotel more than made up for the inconvenience. The Scott location is ideal. Close to all things Scottsdale! Excited to come back when the pool and construction are complete. My only suggestion would be to turn the pool heat up during the colder months as the baby pool was far too cold for our daughter.

reviews.author: cjosserand
reviews.title: ASU students loved  the Scott!
reviews.text: Canel club was great and Alyssa was amazing! Wonderful time with ASU buddies! This was such a great time and everyone was top notch!! Thank You everyone. The Front Desk staff to the security teams were so professional yet so friendly  they called me by first name and made us feel welcome there. We felt pampered and spoiled.

reviews.author: tlthavens
reviews.title: The Scott - Super Location
reviews.text: The Scott had a perfect location to walk to the mall and old town. The complimentary shuttle service and bikes are also great to get you where you need to go. The bed was amazing and the room stayed very dark, the towels were pretty thin and the spa left much to be desired, no relaxation room, steam room or shower for pre or post massage. My massage was awesome it was just a very get in get out experience.

reviews.author: mjtxf
reviews.title: Adorable resort, but the pool area was under construction 🚧.
reviews.text: Great location to old town and fashion square. Concierge service had a free suv to take you to close by locations. This was very helpful even with a large party. Hotel has great food and drinks. The staff is awesome and the rooms were adorable.

reviews.author: Passenger564689
reviews.title: Best hotel is Scottsdale
reviews.text: Always a fun and enjoyable time when we stay at the Scott.Close to downtown and the limo is awesome as we park and never have to drive.Walk to the mall across the street as well. Pool is always fun and we always meet some great guest as well

reviews.author: O4284IQjb
reviews.title: Highly Recommend!!
reviews.text: Beautiful resort and excellent staff. Great location and car service to local shopping and restaurants. Especially loved the fun Cuban vibe and garden-like grounds with pockets of intimate fireside seating!

reviews.author: noellep445
reviews.title: Good but could be so much better
reviews.text:
I have stayed at this hotel three times now so I am writing this review knowing that the positives and negatives weren’t just a fluke on a good day or a bad day. I will start with the things that I enjoyed or thought were just overall positives. The lobby of this hotel smells fantastic and is very open and comfortable. The lobby boasts Lots of seating, great fireplace and a wonderful bar with friendly bartenders. The outdoor seating is also unique as there are fire tables going and comfortable chairs surrounding them and two large screens where they show old movies which is pretty cool. The pools at the Scott are also fabulous. There is a larger pool and a smaller pool that has sand around it so you feel like your on a beach walking into the water. I also appreciate that there is food and beverage service by the pool. 
Now for the not so good. It seems every time I stay here there have been similar housekeeping issues. Consistently Every hallway carpet is just gross, hair, strings, crumbs, you name it it’s on that hall carpet. My last stay I was there for 5 days and not once was that hallway vacuumed. Not a huge deal, I know, but just gross. We also saw a long trail of blood along the wall in the hallway which remained until I pointed it out to the housekeeper.
The rooms are a decent size with the exception of the bathroom. You can barely shut the door by the toilet unless you stand to the side of it. The shower also sprays water all over the floor. (Again this has been consistent in all 3 of my stays) This last trip we found a huge hair ball on the wall of our shower and had no toiletries left in the room which leads me to believe the bathroom was not properly cleaned, it took several phone calls before I received some soap! All rooms have kind of a musty humid smell. Not sure what it is exactly but I just deal with it by keeping my suitcase closed. So overall the room cleanliness could be stepped up a notch, as well as the buildings they’re in. 

Food at this hotel has always been delicious! I especially love the breakfast menu. However, portion size tends to change. For example I love the avocado toast but Some days it comes with one egg and others with two. This makes a difference when feeding teenage and twenty something boys. We know now just to ask for two eggs so it’s a bit more filling. 
If this hotel would just work on the cleanliness of the guest rooms and the buildings they’re in I think this would be a fantastic place to stay. I do like the location as well which is why I’ve given it several chances.

reviews.author: jason774
reviews.title: Yes yes and more yes.
reviews.text: One of our favorite places to stay hands down. The place is beautiful, the rooms are stellar, the atmosphere is awesome. 15 minute walk to an amazing downtown experience. Even the freaking mega mall was fun.

reviews.author: suegcollins
reviews.title: A little bit of Hollywood in AZ
reviews.text: With all the (gorgeous) rooms surrounding a courtyard with pools, shady conversation spots and a bar, The Scott is a great place for anyone wanting a quiet break from all the fun of Scottsdale. The decor is casual glam, with thoughtful touches like backgammon sets awaiting players, cold citrus-infused water in the lobby all day and a lobby bar where you'll immediately feel special. Excellent food, plenty of outdoor nooks to post up and read, sip or snooze.

reviews.author: KPMTrav
reviews.title: Great customer service made up for the cold weather in December
reviews.text:
Great customer service - very prompt and polite. Reka was the perfect host and ambassador for the resort.
The lobby is very well appointed.
The resort is very close to the trails.
The bell-man service was excellent and we had great drop-off and pickup service as well as great restaurant recommendations.
I would come back in spring when the weather a little more tolerable.

reviews.author: 5ayde3wqr5
reviews.title: Great resort close to old town with a great cocktail bar and restaurant.
reviews.text: The lounge is perfect for relaxing and play games. The pool was heated and the hot tub was great for the rainy and cold weather during Christmas. Nice food, friendly service and the cocktail bar is amazing.

reviews.author: Venture708837
reviews.title: christmas party
reviews.text: The scott Resort has a nice attmosphere, hugh layout, nice rooms. freindly staff and the food is great.  I would go there again.  We staied there afer our company christmas party and we enjoyed the room and the outside settings.

reviews.author: Lisa H
reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: Very nice boutique hotel!  Front desk was very accommodating!  Lunch at restaurant was very good.  The rooms were clean and the location was great.   We would definitely stay here again  they also had a shuttle that took us to McDowell for hiking

reviews.author: Megan A
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience at the Scott. The decor is really chic and all of the staff were incredibly nice especially Reka, Jorge, Benny the bartender and the Wednesday night concierge.  Room was gigantic and luxurious. Great experience all around— would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Rose
reviews.title: It has a lot of potential, but falls short
reviews.text:
This is an interesting one.  

It has all the right ingredients...instagrammable everywhere, trendy & fun vibe, friendly staff, great minimalist chic interior design, yoga class at 9 everyday (though the 'fitness center' is a really small dingey room), and lots of outdoor areas (pool & hot tub, lounge chairs, hammocks, fire pits seating areas, and lawn games.  That's what you first se as you walk in.   As time passes though, you start seeing all these flaws that could either be because it was just renovated, so things are still being organized, or some things weren't fully though through.  

I arrived Thursday, with an extra day before my friend arrives, and noticed the resort was filled with medical conference guests. Scott Resort was hosting at least 2 separate conferences.  It would have been nice if Scott Resort reached out to guests know, only because the resort is boutique, so it felt like conference guests overtook the hotel lobby lounge areas and outdoor fire pit & eating areas during the day. 

While checking in, I asked the receptionist where yoga will be, and she told me "we're still finding a room, so just check with me again in the morning and I'll have that for you.  The spa is closed, so we don't have a set space right now".  Wait WHAT?  The spa is closed?!   How was there no hint that this was the case on Scott Resort’s site?  On their website & also their profile on Tripadvisor, there’s a lot of talk about their recent beautiful renovation (which talks about the spa too but nothing about it being closed).   My plans for the weekend were supposed to be pool & spa.  I don’t understand why this wasn’t on the website.  

For the most part, the staff was all very friendly and kind.  The restaurant & bar staff were amazing, but the receptionists felt a bit junior.  I had to ask a lot of questions to find out information that’s normally shared without having to ask.   One of them was also pretty rude. I wanted to leave a key, map & key holder for my friend who was arriving later, and she said she couldn’t with an attitude-y tone.  She started to explain it’s because of security reasons, but then just snapped and said they can’t, I told her it’s only because I was given 2 keys, and to that she said “well I’ll just have to throw it out”.   I asked to just leave the key card holder & map, because I didn’t want to waste extra paper.  She mumbled something under her breath & later found out from my friend, she never got a map, (it was that same receptionist that checked her in) and when she asked her for directions to the room, she actually didn’t seem to know, so my friend had to ask someone else. 

The rooms were nice, but there weren’t enough hooks in the bathroom & shower areas.  There were a lot of ‘ugh where am I going to hang this’ moments.  I was also surprised there weren’t any recycling bins and that the cups weren’t compostable & that by the water & iced tea stations, only single-use cups (non-compostable) were available.   The bath products are from Lather, which is a eco-friendly brand, so I’m surprised and disappointed, Scott Resort didn’t have a more sustainable model.

The pool area was nice.  There were always open seats, and the hot tub day & night was extremely relaxing.   One strange (and annoying) thing was that there was never anyone behind the bar by the pool.   Until Sat & Sun, there wasn’t even a water station there.   I think it’s because it’s not peak season & all the conferences had left by then, but still… what about all the other paying customers?  

I really do like the location though.  It’s right by Fashion Square, which is the massive mall that has a ton of stores and restaurants.   It’s also close to Old Town, and a few healthy eateries.  In Scott Resort itself, the restaurant & bar Canal Club is solid.  The food is pretty good & the vibes & interior design are on point.  The staff are also really great. 

Asides from the location & restaurant, I know it sounds like I’m bashing Scott Resort, and I am a bit…, but I did enjoy my time.  It’s just that it has so much potential, but I don’t feel I got my money’s worth.  It’s annoying to think I paid a $42/day resort for what feels like not much at all.

reviews.author: Gail S
reviews.title: Holiday Shopping Getaway
reviews.text: Met up with some girlfriends to celebrate and also wrap up our Christmas shopping. Perfect location to Scottsdale Fashion Plaza.  The complimentary shuttle made it even more convenient.  Door to door service and no hassle with parking nightmares.

reviews.author: Helen W
reviews.title: Lovely resort with a cool vibe
reviews.text: This is my second stay at The Scott and always enjoy it. Staff is friendly, rooms are lovely and just enjoy the cool Casa Blanca vibe. It’s also well located so very close to Old Town Scottsdale, Scottsdale Fashion Square & tons of restaurants.  Recommend.

reviews.author: Connector534302
reviews.title: Dont waste your money
reviews.text:
Horrible horrible place to stay.  The overpriced resort and pool is okay and has a relaxing vibe so points for that.  
Staying at the hotel is however really bad.  The living areas are
Dingy and1950’s vibe. Carpet dirty and dull.  The room ot self leaves alot to be desired.  No bathtub.  Shower small without a door!! Really!!! Who has a shower without a door with water running all over!! When i called reception, they said they were in the process of fixing the doors.  Mind you they had just moved me to a different room because the prt of the hotel Did not have running water.  They could have atleast warned me ahead of time.  

The room is very basic.  Small bed.  Small desk.  Overpriced room service where its 5 dollar delivery fee with 
25% service fee!!!!!!! 
What service? The delivery which am already paying??? Resort fee is 50$ a day!! 
Please do not stay here.  Especially not for a romantic getway.  Go to the Phoenician.

reviews.author: MargieB
reviews.title: Old Arizona
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel with a relaxed “old arizona” resort vibe, hidden away in Old Town Scottsdale.  Super friendly service and great cocktails in The Channel Club. The rooms were comfortable and all of them have a patio or balcony, and many little details that make you smile :-)

reviews.author: Yuliya D
reviews.title: Overall very good stay
reviews.text:
My stay for a conference was very pleasant  and besides minor issues with internet connection I had no problems. Staff is amazing and very helpful!!! Hotel offers free shuttle to the attractions within 3 miles from the hotel. 

If I had to return I'll definitely consider this property!

reviews.author: dayna30
reviews.title: Great hotel, minus the necklace theft and total lack of customer service
reviews.text: I want to say great things about this place. We had a good experience, until we checked out. We left very early in the morning and I forgot to grab the necklace I put out to wear the night before. It was super early and dark and it completely slipped my mind. I called that same day about it. Actually, I've called and left three voicemails and no one has returned my call. I've sent emails, too. I did speak to someone at the front desk who said nothing was in the system at that point (but that the system was down, so someone would return my call when it was back up). So a necklace that has deep sentimental value was, I guess, stolen by the staff. And no one at the Scott has the decency to return my voicemails. Super disappointed with this. Not sure how else to get a response from them besides leaving this review.

reviews.author: azleeann
reviews.title: Quaint Accommodations
reviews.text: I really liked the rooms at The Scott.  Very quaint,  Clean with a great shower and bed.  I liked how the TV was on an easel and the chairs and couch were a nice touch.  The courtyard was very cute and we had a great time.

reviews.author: susanmissions36
reviews.title: Seasoned Traveler Best Stay Yet!
reviews.text: This place was incredible. Simple, uncluttered elegance! All the things that bother you at hotels, this place has those issues covered. From amazing comfortable beds, cleanliness, top notch decor, hooks&Rack in the bathroom, convenient electronic charging, to a NESPRESSO machine in the room!! The Scott is high-end without feeling stuffy, and no rules/regulations to bog you down. The pool is not in lock-down, and you can freely enjoy the lobby with guests and friends. Free beverage refreshments, a 10 star hotel restaurant, and bar/lounge. Fireside relaxing, fire pits outside that actually warm up so you can sit on it and be cozy. Seriously, you have to try this place if you are a seasoned traveler!!

reviews.author: Lisa C
reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.text: Breathtaking. Amazing atmosphere and so relaxing and welcoming. The Canal Club drinks were so tasty and staff was friendly. I highly recommend visiting and checking out the renovations and Zen like environment.

reviews.author: shannonakui
reviews.title: Meh - There are better resorts
reviews.text: While the service from the staff was phenomenal, it didn't make up for the average quality of the food and the rooms.  For a Scottsdale resort, I expected more for my money.  The food was average and frankly the portions were quite small.  The rooms were very small (again, for a resort of the expected caliber) and lacked basic amenities like a microwave and fridge.  There was a fridge but it only had room for a few drinks, as it was dedicated to products from the honor bar.  I probably would stay here again if service were the only factor however my experience in its entirety would not justify another visit.

reviews.author: Silice001
reviews.title: The rude staff ruins the experience
reviews.text: The hotel is nice and very interesting, the food and drinks are good. The staff completely ruin the experience, they are very rude. From the valet staff to the front desk. I get better service at Walmart.

reviews.author: Abbe L
reviews.title: Resort with Personality
reviews.text:
I cannot express enough how much we enjoyed our stay at The Scott. We travel prolifically and I rarely book a hotel outside properties included in my rewards program (I know many people are in the same situation). I am so glad I took the plunge. Our experience was exceptional. The level of customer service certainly raises the bar. The open lobby area is not only beautifully decorated, it immediately makes the guests feel as though they belong and are more than transient visitors.

The rooms are well decorated and extremely clean. It was simple to call and ask for anything we needed. The only negative for me was the hallways felt a little worn, and are in need of new carpeting. However, our terrace area was perfect for a glass of wine in the evening before dinner. Sheets are crisp and the robes (which are not in the room, but can be provided if you call and ask for them) are soft and plush. Unlike some resorts in the area, the rooms are extremely soundproof and you are not aware of the guests next door.

It was rather cold to swim, but we did use the hot tub. I can only imagine how wonderful the oasis is when the weather is warmer. There are firepits with plenty of seating dotted around the resort and on some evenings a movie is projected on a large wall near the bar just outside. I am sure plenty of people have mentioned the wonderful car parked out the front! 

I could write so much more. I will finish with the observation that the caring atmosphere and the welcome feeling seemed to make guests more conducive to mingling and chatting with each other. The location is also fantastic for Old Town where there is so much to see and do. 

I would highly recommend The Scott - thank you for making our stay so excellent!

reviews.author: Lisa A
reviews.title: Definitely want to come back
reviews.text: The Scott was an absolute delight.  My friend and I went to Scottsdale for a girls weekend and stayed at The Scott this past weekend.  We loved the warm and inviting ambience of the front lobby and pool area.  The Canal Club is a great place to hang out in the evening with a cocktail.  The location is fantastic as it was within walking distance to fashion square, 5th avenue shopping, tons of restaurants and the Old Town area.  We walked everywhere! I should also mention that if you need a ride within a short distance, there is a shuttle available to take you places. I am recommending this hotel to everyone.  Lisa A.

reviews.author: tgreene2019
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text: I would highly recommend staying here. The entire resort was amazing. The room was super comfy. The pool and hot tub were the perfect addition to my stay. Staff was extremely friendly. I was there for business, but would definitely come back for personal.

reviews.author: groy765873
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text: Stunning hotel right in the heart of Scottsdale. There’s also a free shuttle that can bring you to Old Town or downtown. Loved the decor and the vibe, especially the Canal Club bar and the fire pits outside. Very cute rooms, comfortable beds.

reviews.author: legaljazz
reviews.title: Great place to stay.
reviews.text: Everything top notch at this hotel, and just a few blocks from Old Town, art district, performing arts center, and modern art museum.  Larger rooms, beautifully designed and landscaped pool area with several fire pits.

reviews.author: 5576miked
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: I love going here because of the location.  The pool area is great.  The rooms aren't the best, but overall it is a great place to stay.  lately it seems like the prices continue to increase.  The service is usually pretty good.

reviews.author: flooringsd
reviews.title: Short Vacation
reviews.text: We'll be back.  It was a great choice.  The location is great.  Thanksgiving dinner at the restaurant was outstanding.  Service by all of the hotel staff is friendly and professional.  Can't wait to visit again.

reviews.author: h0h2dx95wa
reviews.title: Beautiful place. Small rooms Smaller beds
reviews.text:
Absolutely beautiful resort. Only drawbacks are the cramped rooms, and the “queen” beds are fulls if not twins.

They have numerous fire pits and private outside gathering area. There is even a sand bottom pool.

reviews.author: mark
reviews.title: This place rocks !
reviews.text: This Place Rocks ! You want to stay here - updated, trendy cool, staff is 5 star ! Location is walking distance to old town or they give you rides at any time ! Price is better than the big box hotels.

reviews.author: Ben C
reviews.title: Great not Good
reviews.text: We stayed at the Scott Resort & Spa for one night before heading to Sedona. We enjoyed everything about the hotel. The pool is incredible. Room details give the place a fun vibe. Restaurant food was flavorful and cocktails were tasty! Very comfortable robes if you enjoy #robelife in the hotel. Our only complaint about the place is that we couldn't stay longer. If you're looking for a hotel that you don't need to leave for food, beverage, or comfy lounging, this is your spot! They transformed this place in to a destination that you'll want to check out, even if it's simply to have a drink in the spectacular lobby.  Thank you!

reviews.author: liz_unknown
reviews.title: Online reviews and descriptions over sold
reviews.text:
I researched like crazy for a one day quiet retreat for my husband, two boys (24 & 16) and myself before we headed north toward the Grand Canyon.
