Sorely disappointed that The Scott allowed a conference to completely take over the main pool, bar, fire pits and other amenities without notifying or compensating the guests not a part of that event.  

We chose this hotel specifically for the atmosphere and two pool areas. We ended up being surrounded by highly motivated networking realtors who had nonstop buffets and bar service around the main pool (nothing is more fun than swimming with an audience in suits...ugh).  Then we were looking so forward to sitting around one of the fire pits at night, but it was over run with inebriated networking professionals. 

Total waste of money and time for us. We'd never give them another cent.

The rooms were clean and comfortable. Pillows had no support.  Pools and property appeared great, but we only used the sand pool, which is large sand and hard on the feet.

reviews.author: twickski
reviews.title: Lovely Pools and Gardens and Location
reviews.text: Great hotel in old town Scottsdale. Hotel even has a free shuttle service within 3 miles of hotel. The gardens, pool and common areas are beautiful. Lots of fire pits and gathering spots by pool and gardens. Only negative experience was very tiny bathrooms. The kind where you open the bathroom door and it barely clears the toilet. Also, thought the couch in our suite was uncomfortable and very small for the space. Having a nice comfy couch would be better for lounging and meetings.

reviews.author: MARTINIGURL
reviews.title: Disappointed!!!
reviews.text:
Booked this hotel because of good reviews plus was recommended by an aquantiance.  We arrived on a day that was pouring rain at 3:10 pm on a Tuesday afternoon. Was told our room was not ready. Women that waited on me was not very friendly at all.  ; (   So since the weather was too bad to go walking around we decided to just wait in the Lobbby.  Finally got a text at 4:05 saying our room was ready.  They have a very small reception desk with only one employee.  I waited in line for about 15 minutes to get our keys.  We had to walk arross the pool area in the pouring rain to get to our room.  : (  Only later to notice that other hotel guests were given umbrellas.  We were not offered one.  ; (    Room was nice.  Nothing special.  We were on 1st floor and the gutter was gushing rain all night...very loud.  Could hear people walking above us at night.  
Went to lobby (in the rain) in the morning to have a latte.  It was very tasty...but only about 4 sips for $5.00.  Then in the evening ordered a Cosmpoloitan martini at the bar in the lobby....    $19.48   : O    It was not very good and not good quantity.  ; (   
Work Out room is tiny....  Some of the equipment was broke.  
Wi Fi in the room and lobby area was terrible.
Top all that off with a $40 resort fee per night (for what, I do not know)  Makes this hotel a NO GO for me.

reviews.author: 404cthompson
reviews.title: work getaway
reviews.text: Very beautiful facility.  I loved my patio which was surrounded by greenery and a fountain.  Very close to the pool and easy access to the facilities.  The staff was friendly and helpful.  Close proximity to shopping and restaurants

reviews.author: Lg1947538
reviews.title: Lots of noise
reviews.text: Check in was easy. The hotel was clean and they did a great job on the remodel. I was allowed to bring my dog. However there was a lot of noise outside of the room which caused us to leave. We were only there for an hour.

reviews.author: kimberlywZ8672JU
reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.text: The most professional staff and meeting. Food was wonderful. Room was wonderful. Loved the shuttle service to local areas. Each staff member I had interaction with was so professional and friendly.  I do want the name of the pillows that you have as they are AMAZING!

reviews.author: FarAway739765
reviews.title: Pleasant stay
reviews.text: Came here for a conference and this place is beautiful. The pool is heated so I took advantage of that and the jacuzzi after dinner. Room is clean and spacious. I got one with a balcony with the pool view.

reviews.author: ebenjamin2019
reviews.title: Really excited but then very disappointed
reviews.text:
we were celebrating our five year wedding anniversary and were so excited for our trip. unfortunately a week before we arrived we were informed my husbands massage was canceled and he could come back the next week.....we are from out of town. They then told us he could come to the spa to relax but not have his service? 

When we arrived at the resort we were given minimal information when we checked in. On our first night we had to move rooms due to EXCESSIVE screaming and banging on the walls from the people in the room next door. 

on our second day we were out of the room the entire day from 9-5 and our room was not cleaned. They tried to clean at 6 pm but at this point we had to get ready for dinner. We even saw the maids across the hall when we left in the  morning. 

Over all the resort is pretty but seems to be understaffed and needs to work out a lot of issues.

reviews.author: RachelDRieg
reviews.title: Great for girls trip!
reviews.text: This hotel was perfect for our girls trip. So many cute areas to sit and have a drink. Multiple firepits for chilly nights. The pool and hot tub were perfect. To spa was nice too (but a little pricey for my taste).

reviews.author: nicolerodgers
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text: Great hotel and the location was perfect. The pool did have a lot of shade, which can be good or bad depending on your preference. Definitely recommend. The smell in the lobby was amazing!!! The decor is also fabulous.

reviews.author: Emily J
reviews.title: Beautiful Escape
reviews.text: We came to town for a conference and each time we returned to the Scott it felt like a wave of refreshment and relaxation after a busy and chaotic day.  Delicious food, drinks, atmosphere, and BEDS.  We'll be back!

reviews.author: Onemomthreeboys
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Did not have room ready until after 5pm on the day of arrival and did not have a double room available even though it was prepaid months in advance. They did comp an extra room, though not adjoining. Bathrooms in the lobby without toilet paper and not well cleaned. Rooms not cleaned well each day (soap not replenished, ice bag not replaced, etc).  Very friendly staff at the front desk and bell staff. Free shuttle service was nice for rides to Old Town. Easy walk to many restaurants & the mall.

reviews.author: Q4540SXamy
reviews.title: Loved it, cant wait to come
reviews.text: We had a great stay. the first night we were not prepared for there to no food being served after 10:00. The next nights we just made sure to eat ahead of returning to the hotel. The grounds are beautiful. The rooms are really nice and I love the decor. The showers were amazing. Nice water pressure. I am looking forward to coming back to stay.

reviews.author: Flyer31611492754
reviews.title: LAST MINUTE GET AWAY
reviews.text: we stayed at the scott on 2 different nights going to Sedona and coming back for a stay. the rooms were spacious and clean , beds very comfortable .. very close to food and shopping . staff was friendly and helpful .. pool area great and seating by fire pits .. would recommend the scott and will be returning again .

reviews.author: Will F
reviews.title: beautiful, gem of a property
reviews.text: The renovation is tasteful, the property run at a high level, a nice little hotel for grown-ups. The food is excellent, but not inexpensive. All in all, the place has a real charm to it, and I will certainly return when I can.

reviews.author: stacykillion
reviews.title: Horrible service
reviews.text: We had people fly in from Poland and all over the country. The reserved appetizers and drink party was a hot mess! One waitress walked out and quit the same evening therefore the other waitress was way behind and it took over an hour and a half before we even got one drink. This reservation has been booked six months out they should’ve taken care of us first as opposed to the patrons walking in off the street.

reviews.author: janeadams1223
reviews.title: PORTMAN wedding guest
reviews.text: I’ll recommend this facility to others. Quaint boutique style. All aspects of my visit and stay were fantastic. Breakfast was a great value. The wedding reception meal was great. I truly enjoyed every aspect of the facility!

reviews.author: Roxanne F
reviews.title: FiOasis in Scottsdale
reviews.text: We had such a great stay. Property recently underwent a huge ($14M?) renovation, and it shows. Tasteful, elegant, decorated in a Cuban/Caribbean theme which carries through from the furnishings to the inspired menu.  Cool touches like a black and white movie with Spanish subtitles silently projected on the patio wall in the evenings.  Beautiful, soft blankets hanging in the lobby to use by the firepits.  Retro postcards to grab.  We were surprised how quiet this property was, too, being right off of Scottsdale Road.  This is a resort hotel you'll want to take time to enjoy...so much more than just a room.  Truly felt like we were somewhere different.

reviews.author: lisainr0me
reviews.title: Relaxed-style hotel that’s perfect for a girls weekend!
reviews.text: I stayed here with several friends for a long weekend getaway. We loved the vibe of the hotel! The interior decor, food, cocktails, and spa were really enjoyable. The pool area is broken up into 2 pools which feels more private but it can be hard to find a chair. We will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: princesswendi1973
reviews.title: An amazing resort in the desert.
reviews.text: What an oasis in the desert. A great place for any type getaway. From the moment you walk in it’s paradise and a feel of pure relaxation. Everything from the atmosphere, service, food are excellent! I would highly recommend this boutique style resort. Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: ambergillies
reviews.title: Almost Perfect
reviews.text:
Would recommend staying! The location can’t be beat and the property is stunning! 

My only complaint is the perks for booking directly (option of late check out, $10 bar credit or complimentary appetizer at the Canal Club) were not offered upon check in.. nor was the complimentary welcome beverage that is supposedly included in their resort fee.  The rooms are beautiful and the bed was comfy however there is no way to play music in the room and they charge $10/day for the music channel on the tv..... I pay $6/month to stream unlimited on Pandora so that’s way over priced.

I would definitely stay here again though :)

reviews.author: WVolk16
reviews.title: Business and personal time
reviews.text:
I really loved the lobby and the vibe. Very convenient to shopping and great restaurants. 
They also have a great shuttle service :)
The room was nice and comfortable and quiet.   The reason why I give it 3 stars is because of the pool.  One of the main reasons we went to this hotel was to swim and relax. The pool was cold. It was 90 outside and the pool was not enjoyable cold.  They said it was heated. Not ! Also it was dirty. Needed to have the tile cleaned and repaired.  It seems to me that it should be cleaned everyday for such a nice hotel. 
Kinda ruined the stay.  It can’t be that expensive to heat to a comfortable temperature with the rates they charge. 
No one was swimming.  Such a shame. 
Definitely recommend it if you were into swimming.

reviews.author: lisasusko
reviews.title: Not the place to stay
reviews.text: Many issues from rude people to bad service. Stayed here for our wedding weekend, was not impressed with the rooms. It was a beautiful place, so maybe my expectations of the room were too high. For the price and the rude people, I won’t go back.

reviews.author: Travelling-n-Style
reviews.title: Such a Great Experience
reviews.text: I had the wonderful opportunity to stay at the Scott for a conference.  The staff were so attentive and seemed genuinely happy to work there.   All rooms were separate from the main lobby. One has to walk outside to get to them.  My room was was comfortable and faced the pools, which were quite lovely. The bathroom was a bit on the small side, but very clean.  I attended a business luncheon while there and the buffet choices, freshness, and flavors were phenomenal.  I have some dietary restrictions and was able to eat well without special requests.  I also must give kudos to the waitperson who served me breakfast.  I had the almond butter toast which was served with bananas. I asked for the greenest one she could find and she did!  I just can't say enough good things about The Scott and hope I can get back there soon!

reviews.author: Patrick D
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Well located, this hotel is well maintained and the outdoor spaces (pools, fireplaces, lounges...) makes it a relaxing and extremely charming resort. Our room was spacious and have the most comfortable  bed of our trip to Arizona. The resort has the luxurious feel without the bling bling. The delicate aroma in the lobby makes you fell good. We loved it. We will go back in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: twinkl864959
reviews.title: Bug bites
reviews.text: We left this resort with multiple itchy, red, bug bites.  They tried to tell us it was mosquito bites, really?  No action taken to resolve the itchy except to say they checked the room and found nothing...

reviews.author: Anita L
reviews.title: Quaint Boutiquey Vibe
reviews.text: Super cute and full of personality! Definite attention to detail. Very clean. The room I was in was a bit noisy. I had up graded to a queen queen lagoon and could not really see any water. Don’t know that I would upgrade again but definitely would go back!

reviews.author: psledoux
reviews.title: Scott Resort & Spa - awesome place to relax
reviews.text: This place is amazing.   Total renovation on this resort.   Spacious rooms.  First class facility.  You will enjoy staying in this resort.  The pillows were soft.  Bed was extremely comfortable.  Bathrooms are very luxurious.

reviews.author: Michaelrikon
reviews.title: The Scott Resort in Scottsdale
reviews.text: Excellent hotel in very good location. The hotel was beautifully designed, The pool complex was stunning . Excellent and interesting food selection.We were there for a family occasion and all the rooms for the party were terrific

reviews.author: Robin G
reviews.title: Beautifully restored hotel
reviews.text:
Loved this property.  Wide open spaces and beautiful rooms and public areas.  
The staff is very friendly and food and drink was top notch.
My room was very spacious although the bathroom was tiny.  Would have loved a bathrobe.  Other than that I loved this place!

reviews.author: Culture20863039465
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text:
Landscaping and pool along with the inside of the main building are beautiful.
The hotel part is a dated somewhat but has been renovated and is really nice. Beds are comfy~
Lots of places around to eat.

reviews.author: H8724WFmikek
reviews.title: Birthday party trip
reviews.text: This was a trip from California to Arizona for a surprise birthday party unfortunately the experience I had with your receptionist on check-in was one of the worst I’ve ever had you should not take reservations if you don’t have the room set people paid for and upon arrival give them something less than what you paid for I expect a full refund for Friday night

reviews.author: ejcarter1
reviews.title: Business andRelaxtion
reviews.text: The Scott was very relax environment, the amenities was great. The staff was friendly and helpful. The young men that operate the  shuttle was great in recommending places to see and things to do. The pool area was very beautiful.

reviews.author: Duncan S
reviews.title: Destination wow
reviews.text: We were invited to a destination wedding to the Scott.!  From the moment we stepped into the Scott we were treated like royalty.  The staff made every effort to make us feel welcome and went beyond expectations to make us feel that we were at a tropical vacation.  What a fabulous grounds. The pool was fantastic and the staff catered to our every need. The house keeping staff were so pleasant and attentive.  The rooms had everything you could need and excellent coffee which definitely helped after our wild nights.  The food was outstanding and promptly served. The drinks flowed like a fountain.  This is a must stay for us in the future.  Thanks again for making this a memorable trip.  Cheers.

reviews.author: Brianna T
reviews.title: My favorite hotel in Scottsdale
reviews.text: This is my second time staying at The Scott Resort and Spa and its always such a lovely experience. The grounds are so beautiful and meticulous maintained. The pool is so relaxing and the staff is so friendly. Every time I visit Scottsdale this is my go to place.

reviews.author: jimiwright
reviews.title: Business vacation.
reviews.text: Wonderful trip! Came for business and was able to relax and enjoy the experience. This was a nice hotel with vintage charm. I truly enjoyed my stay. The food was wonderful and so was the drinks. Very intimate casual seating areas outside, which we used nightly

reviews.author: Pamz-on-the-road
reviews.title: What a lovely hotel!!
reviews.text: Very nice hotel in Scottsdale - - perfect if you want a quiet place with some local access and oasis pools!  Staff were particularly friendly and helpful, and the food was just GREAT.  I was here on business, but can't wait to come back for pleasure.

reviews.author: Terry H
reviews.title: The perfect retreat
reviews.text: I can't say enough about the professionalism, care and friendliness of the staff, service and facilities at The Scott.  You have to experience it for yourself.  It's the perfect retreat for a business event or just a weekend getaway.

reviews.author: stephaniebutler
reviews.title: SB 1st HSFO Conference
reviews.text: Keep doing what you are doing. The staff was pleasant and polite. Your Resort was beautiful and I enjoyed myself throughout my entire stay. I would recommend this property to anyone who would like to visit Scottsville AZ.

reviews.author: Steve V
reviews.title: Best little get away ever!
reviews.text:
Need to get away for a quick mini vacation this place is the one. Have always loved staying here. Close to Downtown Scottsdale, close to everything! Great place!!
Relaxing by the pool and listening to the flowing water from the ponds are just amazing, relaxing and definitely makes you feel you are not in a big city but a resort out in the hills of Arizona. Love this place!

reviews.author: Saarfari
reviews.title: A little disappointing
reviews.text:
I really wanted to stay at this hotel as I thought it‘s design was really unique and inspiring, which it definitely is. However, while the design lived up to our expectations, some other aspects did not…

First the positive aspects:
- rooms are nice and comfy
- beautiful gardens with lots of cozy places to hang out and fire lit in evening giving the place a lot of atmosphere
- breakfast was really good with a selection of unusual dishes, too and fair prices
- free shuttle around town in an SUV from 6 to 11 pm
- central location - a 20 minute stroll away from the Old Town of Scottsdale with lots and lots of restaurants and shops nearby

Potential for improvement
- the price performance ratio is completely out of place!!! we got a particularly “good“ deal for 750$ for two nights which is still a hell lot of money. on top, you have to pay a 45$ daily resort fee!! no complimentary water in the room (not even upon arrival). no newspapers, shoeshine service or whatsoever. turndown service only upon request. you pay for luxury, but receive pretty much standard.
- while the inside of the hotel is very nice, the outside isn‘t quite so much. You have very busy roads surrounding the hotel which means your rooms facing the outside are quite noisy. It feels rather like a motel and your views are the parking lots surrounding the hotels.
- service was mostly not existing. Reception staff was fine, but breakfast service was a little clumsy. At the lounge, we were not even served our after-dinner drinks and ended up getting them at the bar ourselves although lots of servers were around.

All in all, we were a bit disappointed. The place could be awesome with some more effort taken.

reviews.author: Sherpa761609
reviews.title: Beautiful ambiance
reviews.text: My husband was here for a work trip and I tagged along. I read by the pool, napped in a hammock and are good food and tried some amazing new drinks. The staff were super helpful as I tried to navigate the city. They have complimentary rides within 3 miles of the resort. One driver even waited at the Walgreens as I ran in for allergy medicine and sunglasses. Wow! Great customer service. The room was huge and had ample closet space. I hope to return someday!!!

reviews.author: MeganPat
reviews.title: 40th Birthday Celebration
reviews.text: As soon as you walk in, the aesthetics of The Scott take you to a place of relaxation. There is an abundance of plants, all beautifully maintained and plenty of space to chill. Loved the fireplace in the lobby. The Cabana Club was where our family met every morning for a yummy fruit and granola bowl and great coffee. The decor is lush and stylish. We spent our days poolside enjoying cocktails from cored out pineapples and had massages as well, the Spa staff was very nice and the spa had a beautiful southwest interior, soft sandy color and our Masseuse Brian was fantastic. The rooms themselves had comfy beds and nespresso machines (as a coffee connoisseur, little things like a Nespresso truly make a difference)  Alexis our group coordinator did a great job accomodating us when we had to switch our dates, the staff really went above and beyond to help us. With our big family after our dinners, we would spread across the property, finding little nooks to chill in, near firepits, or in hammocks. Great stay!

reviews.author: Michael Q
reviews.title: Great Resort/ Bad scheduling
reviews.text: Great resort. Bad Scheduling. They did their best to make it right, but it was unacceptable in my eyes to allow such a thing to happen. I would have been very upset had my family been with me. Good people working there did their best to make it right overbooking my room. I would go back happily.

reviews.author: hollz143
reviews.title: Family getaway
reviews.text:
Lovely!! The facility is adorable! Fresh, clean, unique. Best mattress I’ve slept on while traveling! The breakfast at the Canal Club was amazing! The only thing I have a complaint about is the other guests using towels to save chairs so early in the morning around the pool area, and then not using the chairs until
Much later.  We brought our girls to this hotel just for the pools and we barely were able to snag three chairs by the pool. Other than that we loved our stay and plan on coming back!

reviews.author: N4783ADeric
reviews.title: Perfect weekend at the scott
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel with a great pool and lots to do. This was a quick weekend getaway for me and my wife and we had a wonderful stay at the Scott. A must stay and play location. Perfect for a family or a couple trying to enjoy a weekend away.

reviews.author: hongyaony
reviews.title: Great resort for corporate  event
reviews.text: Stayed here because of a conference. Had a great experience. Room is a bit dated, with a hint of smell when first walking in. But the entire  premise  is well maintained and the outdoor space makes it extremely  charming as a resort.

reviews.author: earthymom
reviews.title: Just Beautiful
reviews.text: I recently stayed here for a short conference. The property is breathtaking. The pools and common areas are beautiful, clean and modern. The staff were all very nice and helpful. They  seemed like they genuinely liked their job. The rooms were very clean and nicely decorated. My room had a patio balcony, which was really nice. The bed was really comfy. The location was great. It is about a half mile away from a mall where there are a multitude of shopping and eating options. It was a nice little walk there and back. The food at the resort was great. Very fresh and healthy. I would definitely go again.

reviews.author: kristagoconnor
reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel and Spa
reviews.text: This resort has all you need.  Friendly helpful staff, great ambiance, amazing spa, close to most tour spots.  The concierge were always so friendly and helpful with tips and rides to most places.  The pools were lovely and the Spa was amazing!

reviews.author: x1771ajlue
reviews.title: "Adult-Summer" Getaway
reviews.text: The Scott was the perfect location for my "adult-summer" getaway. The staff was friendly and accommodating, and the grounds were beautiful. Each room has either a balcony or patio, which is perfect for catching an evening breeze. Although, we only ate breakfast on-site, the restaurant had plenty of options. Another great feature is that the resort is walking distance to a variety of other good restaurants, unique shops, and art galleries. I would definitely consider staying here again.

reviews.author: Samantha W
reviews.title: Amazing boutique resort experience!
reviews.text: We came here for a birthday celebration and had such a great time! The decor and ambiance of the resort is just perfect! We will definitely be back for a future stay! Prices and location are great too!

reviews.author: Davina S
reviews.title: 3.5 stars
reviews.text: Overall stay was good, pool service slow for drinks, no welcome drink.  Love the salt water pool, rooms are cute. Love the lobby, food we ordered was good. Service was alright nothing outstanding. I would go back for the pool and the lobby

reviews.author: cruisetraveler56
reviews.title: The Scott, an oasis near Old Town Scottsdale
reviews.text: We recently stayed at The Scott, in Scottsdale.  It was our first trip to the area, and we wanted to be in walking distance of Old Town.  We enjoyed the facilities, the staff was excellent, we would return.

reviews.author: swakef381743
reviews.title: Lovely hotel, all bells and whistles but crowd was way too young for a couple in their 60s
reviews.text: We chose the Scott for its location in Scottsdale. We wanted to stay close to the airport after a 10-day road trip. The hotel is absolutely beautiful with all the bells and whistles however we are in our early 60s and the hotel was filled with tons of young women in their 20s crowd could not have been older than 30 and was not what we expected. Quite pricey with lots of amenities we didn't need. If you fit the demographics then this is the place for you especially if you have the money

reviews.author: J8237OBpaulah
reviews.title: Fantastic stay
reviews.text: This is a boutique hotel with all of the amenities in the heart of Scottsdale. Spa was lovely. Staff and food was fantastic. It is a jewel close to everything. The pool is so calming and the outdoor fire pits were so quaint.

reviews.author: 841courtney
reviews.title: Pretty hotel. Average service
reviews.text: We were always waiting for a server to come to our table, to get us the check, to come by and get us another drink. It was average service. Not bad just average. People were nice and friendly. The resort was pretty and clean. Our room was clean.

reviews.author: bcmommaine
reviews.title: sisters weekend
reviews.text:
Overall great stay.  Staff very welcoming and helpful.  Great little escape areas to lounge in and good ambience. Food was good. 
Pool on Sat was too crowded and I wondered if a lot of people were non overnight guests.
We did rent a cabana on Sunday and liked it but felt a little expensive. 
We did the AZ food tour on Sunday night and enjoyed. 
Paying for internet above resort fee is a little overboard- so do not know if I would choose if I had to do work while I was there also, but luckily this weekend we had time to just relax.

reviews.author: Roadtripper
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: We started our girls weekend at this neat hotel that has a convenient location.  Awesome decor, yummy food and drinks, great staff. Pool was wonderful. Luis at the front desk was so helpful!! I would highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: evelez2019
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort with perfect Havana Vibe!
reviews.text: Large rooms with unique décor. The drinks and food were beyond my expectations!  Great Internet and they even had Chromecast available. The beds were so comfy too and rooms were quite and dark for great sleep. Can't wait to return!

reviews.author: jscherpinski
reviews.title: Perfection Girl's Weekend Destination
reviews.text: Love this venue. The food and drinks were amazing. Staff was so friendly and helpful. Pool was perfection. I highly recommend this spot for a girl's weekend or couple's getaway! I will be back to this spot on my next AZ adventure.

reviews.author: jas2612019
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: Though I was here for a conference, the resort itself was beautiful and accommodating. I'd love to come back for a personal getaway so I can enjoy the pool and spa. The resort staff were very friendly and the food was good. Drinks were a little pricey, however. One interesting surprise was the fire-dancing on Saturday evening. That was super cool! Oh, and free popcorn was a bonus as well! :)

reviews.author: Ringo21
reviews.title: Trendy and worth it
reviews.text:
This hotel is great, we had an amazing stay here! Around every corner is a picture perfect Instagram worthy photo! 
Staff was great and the food on site is great! 
Rooms are huge! 
Will definitely recommend and visit again!

reviews.author: xwvh5jwfti
reviews.title: Amazing hotel grounds, location, and pool
reviews.text: Such a beautifully decorated hotel with no stone left unturned. Totally relaxing environment with a great pool space with plenty of chairs. Food and beverages were delicious and reasonably priced. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: beijosevents
reviews.title: Cutest Hotel
reviews.text: We loved our stay at The Scott Resort!  The Helen & Maude is my new favorite cocktail and the staff was incredibly kind and helpful.  Plus, it's got the cutest style!!  We enjoyed dinners, breakfast, laying at the pool and it was close to all the fun local spots.  Such a great hotel, we will definitely be back!

reviews.author: kristen406364
reviews.title: Gorgeous Hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is GORGEOUS and we had a very relaxing experience. The service was a 4/5, didn't quite match the level of design and amenities provided. Multiple times I felt the staff was annoyed and they weren't responsive. My husband and I called the pool boys Beavis and Butthead :)

reviews.author: esweeney2019
reviews.title: A hotel with personality
reviews.text: The hotel was fantastic. I would travel again just to stay in the hotel. The branding and character of the hotel is super cool. Unlike other hotels that may feel sterile, this hotel you feel homey, comfortable, and relaxed. The staff customer service was beyond my experience. The food and drinks were super good. The decoration is out of this world, they play old movies, have a fun event most nights, overall I can’t recommend it enough. I did not leave the hotel because everything I needed was there.

reviews.author: Jhultzy
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: A fun, hip environment in a nice part of town. The decor was fabulous, the rooms clean and comfy, and the pool area gorgeous. The staff were all friendly and helpful and the local shuttle was also a nice touch.

reviews.author: X9297EYvictoriab
reviews.title: Heroes! With a bar!
reviews.text: We had an unexpected plumbing issue at home and when to The Scott for the night while that got sorted out. We = THE WHOLE FAMILY: mom and dad and baby and dog. The Scott delivered! A pet friendly, baby friendly hotel with great style (The Canal Club was gorgeous!) is what you're getting when you book here. They helped us make the most of a stressful situation, and it ended up being a great time/memory.

reviews.author: Tiana S
reviews.title: SCOTT STAYCATION
reviews.text: I had a wonderful time at the resort. I felt like it was my home away from home and enjoyed the patio we had outside our room. The pool was fantastic and love the sand that led into the pool. Everyone who worked there you could tell really enjoyed their job and made my friend and I feel so welcomed and pampered!!! Will definitely be going back for many more STAYCATIONS!! my friends 30th birthday was a success!!!

reviews.author: Shannon V
reviews.title: Great experience, beautiful place
reviews.text: Beautiful place, great experience, great staff, everyone was friendly, beautiful lobby, interior decor, restaurant, ambiance, beautiful entrance, pools and waterfalls amazing, old movies outdoor at night, fire features

reviews.author: Kelseymorita
reviews.title: Beautiful outdoor space and great location
reviews.text: We loved our stay here, the hotel lobby and outdoor space is stunning. Everything is so well curated. There is a free/gratuity shuttle that will take you within 3 miles which was so helpful! The staff is lovely and the pool is nice. Lackluster gym but I’m used to that at most hotels. Every detail is curated here.

reviews.author: Andrea V
reviews.title: The little oasis
reviews.text: Beautiful boutique hotel. The decor, from the big gold mirrors in the hallway to the scent they have pumping through the vents in the main lobby, begs you to just sit and take it all in!  Customer service was great. Loved the whole experience and will be back in January.

reviews.author: 4kcgyagkbl
reviews.title: Not the best in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
i had high expectations for this fancy resort based on other reviews. But we were very disappointed. Staff was rude and not helpful throughout our stay. Pool area needed more cleaning. 
However, bartenders were great and very friendly.

reviews.author: jchaney560
reviews.title: Recent visit to The Scott
reviews.text:
The staff was great, and they had a great lobby and common area, including lounge and restaurant.  The pool was excellent, and again, the staff and complimentary shuttle was outstanding and all great touches.

The only negative at all is the guest room experience.  They just needed updating and a little better climate control in the rooms.  Everything else was so nice, that we expected a little more out of the guest rooms.

The rooms were still very clean, but it was just the fact that the rooms did not match the rest of the resort.

reviews.author: efile25
reviews.title: Sales Conference Stay
reviews.text: My company set us up at this hotel for a sales conference, and the accommodations were excellent! I will gladly stay at the Scott Resort if I ever get back to Scottsdale.   The only hiccup I had was the wi-fi access right when I got in the room, but that was addressed quickly! Thanks so much for a wonderful stay!

reviews.author: rhansen0
reviews.title: Highly Recommend the Scott
reviews.text: Very clean, contemporary, and friendly. A unique resort stay with little perks and quirks that will exceed your expectations. I enjoyed the " mid 1900's Miami Throwback" vibe and stylings throughout the property.

reviews.author: stuckintraffic
reviews.title: Nice changes.
reviews.text: The Firesky was a favorite for many years for those wanting a resort experience without the high price tag. The Scott has made some nice changes to the look and ambiance that give it an update and add to the charm. The pool area and rooms have some nice new touches. Overall, good job on updating this classic.

reviews.author: Departure764818
reviews.title: NAME TAGS
reviews.text:
Name tags on your employees. Shame on you for not honoring them with the minimum of that especially ones that have been there through 4 different owners!
Thaks for the Adult TV option. A lost amemity these days.

reviews.author: jacquilyn2019
reviews.title: Will be back
reviews.text: The last leg of our road trip was a stop here at the Scott, and now I'm kicking myself that we went anywhere else. Wish we had booked the entire trip just here. The area is incredible, so many amazing restaurants and shops but better than that was the hotel itself. The grounds are picturesque, just absolutely stunning. The pool was incredible, some people say they dont like the coarse sand but I loved it. We never really had interactions with the staff, good or bad. We didn't try to hotel restaurant or spa so I can't speak to those things but the room was lovely. Small hiccup with the wifi but a quick call to tech support cleared it up. Truly, we were so sad to leave. Can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: cou2135314
reviews.title: Labor Day weekend
reviews.text: The pool area where the sand is was full of used towels and empty glasses, food and melting pineapples. The room we stayed in was hot- turned the a/c as low as possible and felt no change in temperature so we were sweating. Overall not worth the amount you pay.

reviews.author: ireyfarmgirl
reviews.title: Wonderful Place
reviews.text:
I have stayed at The Scott two times now, and it has been great both visits.  People are GREAT and accommodating.  Such a clean place, newly renovated.  The Food is very good.  Just a gorgeous place.  2 1/2 miles from Old Town Scottsdale.  The bell service will take you anywhere you want to go within 3 miles of the hotel.
LOVE IT!!!
Will be staying again next year!

reviews.author: Kuukama
reviews.title: Resort lost some of it’s previous  ambience but still a nice place to stay
reviews.text:
Very nice re-do of the previous owner (Kimpton Firesky but I really missed the complementary s’mores at the fire pit and afternoon wine tasting.
Pool and garden areas really attractive and a smaller shallow pool great for the kids

reviews.author: asasasasas2019
reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: We chose this property based on value (gorgeous resort that seemed quite a bit less expensive than a lot of other Scottsdale resorts) and also because they were so dog friendly. We needed to travel with our pup and they were so welcoming to him (also the dog fee for the room was not outrageous like the other resorts we looked at). Thank you to The Scott for

reviews.author: sc0tt57
reviews.title: An oasis in Scottsdale
reviews.text: We went to The Scott for a staycation having driven by it countless times.  The front is nice but no different than other area resorts, so we were so pleasantly surprised by the lobby and bar area.  The resort grounds in the back are amazingly lush, with multiple majestic Ficus trees and other plants that turn the pool and property into a relaxing and luxuriant experience.  The service at The Scott was impeccable — efficient and also very friendly.  The food was all simple but top quality.  (Amazing ceviche!). Our room was clean, spacious and comfortable.   Massages at the spa were among the best we’ve had in a long time.  Great stay!

reviews.author: nikkihoo2019
reviews.title: Beautiful resort.
reviews.text: I stayed at The Scott for a conference. The hotel is beautiful.  The staff was very nice and accommodating. The location was awesome with so many things to do within walking distance.   I have no complaints.

reviews.author: heapsofsmile
reviews.title: $44/day resort fee when anyone from the outside can use the pool....
reviews.text: The hotel is pretty, the lobby, the vibe, the service, everything is very well thought through. The room was clean. However, I have one complaint-why are we, as hotel guests paying a resort fee-$44/day when anyone from the outside can come and use your pool? The wristband system is not enforced. Not only do we pay the fee but then random people enter the pool and take up the best spots/chairs. It's unacceptable and overall affected our stay.

reviews.author: ZenJen
reviews.title: AZ vibes
reviews.text: The Scott Resort is one of my faves. I've stayed here three times so far and will definitely will be back again. An incredible ambiance filled with a very friendly staff. Great food and drinks along with some fun activities. Great pool atmosphere, too! Their spa services are out of this world and worth the indulgence. Woke up every morning to enjoy a gentle yoga class taught by Carolyn Blackmon. She does a beautiful job creating a sacred vibe. You won't be disappointed in this place!!

reviews.author: christinakelley12
reviews.title: Don't trust the pool bar
reviews.text: We left after the pool bartender couldn't find our credit card that we had started a tab with. The hotel shrugged the situation off. See my Google review for full details as I am livid that I am even having to type anything out about this again.

reviews.author: jmrmd
reviews.title: The W syndrome
reviews.text:
I was in Phoenix in the middle of August for a conference. We chose it because they take dogs as opposed to the conference hotel which did not. 
The Scott was done right. It is a beautiful property. The staff is friendly and attentive. Omar in the restaurant  made the start of the day ever pleasant.  The food is great too! ie. Try the brownie and sweet potato hash. The bed is luxurious and ultra cozy. I do think the bathroom towels and the robes are too old such that they are rough on your skin. Maybe the bathroom needs a door or a curtain. It is positioned right across from the door such that when another person opens the door while one is in the bathroom, one can be seen right from the hallway. (See pic) However, it is one of those hotels where the other guests play into the vibe of the hotel. I just thought that there was too much selfie taking, too much “look at me” strutting going on. If one wants to go to a hotel where you want to instagram every moment and see and be seen this is for you. I tend to prefer a more sedate, private and toned down get away.

reviews.author: deana c
reviews.title: The best place to stayt
reviews.text: PERFECT. All around the best place to stay. Everything was great. Couldn't have asked for more.  The staff was super nice and friendly, the food was consistent and delicious.  All of the girls commented how smooth everything went and how we would love to come back and stay here again

reviews.author: zchberg
reviews.title: Perfect Getaway!
reviews.text: The Scott Resort was an incredible desert oasis and we enjoyed every second of being there! We were at the pool all day every day, which is the exact vacation we wanted. The room was beautiful, the lobby was inviting, and the staff was so helpful! Would definitely come back!

reviews.author: 707melanie
reviews.title: Renovated, Cute
reviews.text: Hotel has been renovated. It was cute and clean. Bed was comfy. Gathering places outside were nice and plenty of room to work inside the hotel room. I didn't get the chance to use the pool, but it looked nice and plenty of people were taking advantage of it.

reviews.author: Cara E
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with a few improvements needed
reviews.text: This is the first time staying here and upon arrival I was impressed with how nicely decorated and nice the staff was. The problem was our shower was clogged and they did not have a bathtub in the room. My other issue was the cleaning crew knocked on our door at 8:30 am then when I answered she apologized and left. An hour later, I assume it was the cleaning staff, opened the door this time without even knocking! Luckily we had the latch locked so they were not able to open the door very far but super uncomfortable as a guest to have some one come into our room like that.

reviews.author: kdavis273
reviews.title: Miami  or Havana glamour  beautiful relaxing
reviews.text:
Attended a conference and the resort is beautiful 
It felt like a place i visited when  I was in Miami with glamour touches cuban influence  just beautiful 
Fantastic highly recommend you're in for a treat , escape the desert scenerary for chane of pace and go to The Scott

reviews.author: airbaker
reviews.title: Great Resort, Great Pool, Great Location
reviews.text: I would definitely stay here again.  The newly renovated resort has all of the great amenities, large rooms, and  fabulous decor!  The pool was relaxing and the staff was amazing.  I had a great time during a business trip here.

reviews.author: amanwarren
reviews.title: Hoping to see the experience rise to the photos
reviews.text: eWe wanted to stay at the Scott because of the design company who help transform it.  They did a wonderful job and the property is the most Instagramed in all of AZ (we hear).  The website too does a great job of portraying the Scott as a luxury in the desert.  There is a lot to like about the Scott.  The staff is very good and extremely welcoming.  The main part of the hotel is indeed beautiful, comfortable and a great hangout.  The grounds and pool areas are nicely done.  That said, the rooms are comfortable and spacious yet not the most lux -- as you would expect.  Towels are thin, bathrooms are strangely placed, furniture and walls are already taking a beating.  Internet service is not the best.  You can't get coffee until 7am.   Just some little things that separate this from being that much better. Again, this was good enough...but sometimes that's not good enough.

reviews.author: SweetP_922
reviews.title: Special jewel in the desert.
reviews.text: The Scott is a truly gorgeous and relaxing facility with a little tropical vibe; including a spectacular pool, comfortable and stylish rooms and wonderful, locally sourced, delicious food. Not only does the excellent and friendly staff add to the experience but also the fabulous central location in old town Scottsdale makes this a special jewel in the desert.

reviews.author: B D
reviews.title: Great Summer Stay
reviews.text:
Travelled to Scottsdale from Tucson just to get away for a night and chose The Scott to get a different vibe/experience than usual. We were glad we did. 
The Scott is not your typical Scottsdale Resort/Spa. It is much smaller and a lot lower-key...exactly what we were looking for this particular evening. Located near Scottsdale Fashion Square Mall and close to the bars/restaurant of Scottsdale Old Town this is a great option if you want to be close by those. They even have a Shuttle that runs back and forth during certain hours. 
We upgraded to a Garden View room and glad we did. Would not of wanted to look out onto the parking lot. Our King room was clean and large in size with a small patio as we were on the 1st floor. 
Because we were looking for a “Chill” weekend, we choose to eat on site and chose the Cubano sandwich and an order of Plantains. Both were very delicious.
My only complaint is that the pool closed at 10pm.

reviews.author: jeks792r0i
reviews.title: Good place with good customer service!
reviews.text: Nice place good staff!  Good location for what I had to do. It would not be a bad location if I was going all over the Phoenix area either. The party was easy to get in and out of. Room service and food were Great! Thanks for a great trip.

reviews.author: brink29
reviews.title: Mother/Daughter Weekend Getaway
reviews.text: We are from Prescott and plan to return here again and again. Love the pool, food, drinks and atmosphere. Like the convenience of being in the Scottsdale area for shopping and restaurants. The room was very nice too. A real laid-back and relaxing experience. All the employees were very friendly. A special shout out to Jay for his personal service poolside.

reviews.author: Jennifer K
reviews.title: Lovely & Relaxing Anniversary Stay
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for two nights and had a really great time. At check-in, I was asked for the reason for my stag and I explained that it was for my anniversary, to which the gentleman at the desk provided two free drink vouchers for the bar on premise. The location itself was just beautiful, the room was super comfortable, and the poolside cabana we rented for one of the days was awesome! We will definitely be staying here again the next time we do a weekend trip to Scottsdale!

reviews.author: ERJohnson87
reviews.title: Scottsdale August 2019
reviews.text: We loved our stay at the Scott. The central location close to old town and plenty of dining and shopping options was great. The hotel bar and restaurant were excellent. We basically had the pool to ourselves Monday-Thursday for the week we were there!

reviews.author: AlannaPerk
reviews.title: Beautiful Property
reviews.text: Very gorgeous lobby rooms and pool. But the pool was way too packed and the food / drinks are so expensive. Great customer service and free trolly to DY scottsdale. Had a nice stay, i just wish the pool experience would have been better.

reviews.author: NickRayer
reviews.title: Relaxing and welcoming visit.
reviews.text: I took my girlfriend here for a surprise spa visit and overnight stay. She loved the bath soak and massage. The property was sparkling clean and the staff were very friendly and accommodating. I've tried 5 of the cocktails and they were all great. I've heard it could he busy at the pool on weekends so I booked a Monday-Tuesday and most of the cabanas were empty which was a plus!

reviews.author: eamar10s
reviews.title: Easy Breezy
reviews.text: Fantastic hotel for folks with kiddos. The beach entry pool is just so ideal. Lovely warm shallow water makes it just so ideal for all ages to enjoy the pool. Our nibbles from the Cabana Club were delivered poolside with a friendly smile and were very tasty.

reviews.author: Louis59
reviews.title: Fun, hip choice in Scottsdale!
reviews.text:
Our company selected the Scott Resort for a summer meeting, and meeting at the Scott was a real treat!  

First, the resort has some history – here’s what I found online:  “From the Arizona Memory Project:  The Sunburst Hotel originally opened as the Executive House Arizonian in November 1961, with Jayne Mansfield as the celebrity ribbon-cutter. It became the Sunburst during the 1970s. For many years, the National Indian Arts Exhibition was held there, as well as the Scottsdale Jazz Festival. In the early 2000s, the resort changed its name to Caleo, then to FireSky by Kimpton.  In January 2017, it underwent a renovation and became the Scott Resort. It is located on the southeast corner of Scottsdale and Chaparral Roads.”  At 58 years of age, it looks and feels good.

What did I like about the resort?
•	It had enjoyable amenities, but was not one of Scottsdale’s mega-resorts – it was very manageable
•	It’s not a vanilla or cookie-cutter design – it’s just funky enough to be different from anywhere else I’ve stayed in the area, in the rooms, public areas, and restaurant – throwback style
•	LOTs of stuff for sale in the room, although prices were high ($7 for a bottle of water, and high prices on the liquor, snacks, and even a “Lovers Kit” on top of the minibar
•	The staff are all super friendly, from the bell staff to the front desk, the bar and restaurant staff, and the housekeepers
•	The pool opens early and closes late
•	Food in the restaurant and at our event was very well-prepared and served, and tasty!
•	Meeting room set-up and service was top-notch
•	The Wi-Fi was fast enough
•	Ample hot water and a forceful shower, and great AC in my room

What needed attention?
•	Minor maintenance issues in my room – the clock was missing the battery (and was not an electric clock, so it was stopped); my room door did not close on its own – I had to shove or pull it closed to lock it.
•	No refrigerator in the room, but they did bring one when I asked for it
•	No free bottled water at check-in or in the room

All in all, it’s a unique, fun, and interesting little resort.  Too bad I couldn’t earn points or miles by staying there but that aside, I do look forward to returning!

reviews.author: Lelley2019
reviews.title: Not a fan
reviews.text: Old property, even though rooms had been updated.  No elevator.  Very off-putting smell in the lobby area.  Great location and the staff was very friendly and helpful and we enjoyed the spa, but there are so many higher quality choices in this area we are not likely to do this again.

reviews.author: Passenger564689
reviews.title: Love The Scott
reviews.text: Great atmosphere and environment. Fun pool and great location. Lobby is inviting and lobby bar is a great place if you need a break from the pool and want to escape the heat in the summer .Grab a bike and ride downtown for breakfast or take the car and driver that is provided.

reviews.author: DayTrip28280231968
reviews.title: Family weekend visit
reviews.text: The overall feel of the hotel is nice.  The room renovations were needed and are very nice.  The hotel is older and but it adds to the character.  However, the pool is in need of maintenance and a renovation.

reviews.author: Kyle S
reviews.title: Unique Resort!
reviews.text: Very upscale checkin, lobby, and dining area. Great customer service. Awesome pool area. Rooms are unique as you can get one that has a balcony or porch area looking into the courtyard. You can tell the facility is old, but they have done a good job remodeling and keeping everything feeling new. We will be back!

reviews.author: vlamoree
reviews.title: More charming than ever
reviews.text: This re-imagining of this property to a Havana-themed resort is amazing.  I have never seen this property look to good through its various points in history.  Guest room details are wonderful, but the gem of this property are the lushly landscaped central gardens and pool area and the over-the-top themed lobby and main building and patio.  So many classy details and amazing new light fixtures throughout the property.  Staff was exceptional as well. I have already recommended the property to several people.

reviews.author: Roger L
reviews.title: Great Resort
reviews.text: Great location and price!  The staff and facility more than meet our expectations. The lobby has room for all to either conduct business or have a drink with friends. Two pool areas, one for younger children and one for adults with plenty of seating. Food was prepared well and presented with a Cuban flair. Will stay at the Scott again!

reviews.author: l6wlxtku08
reviews.title: Quick getaway
reviews.text: Everything about this stay was an awesome experience. I would recommend to anyone. The staff, the bar, the pool were all in amazing shape. From the valet to the front desk we were treated like VIP. 5 stars for everyone.

reviews.author: Raymond R
reviews.title: Simply Sensational
reviews.text: I had the pleasure in staying 3 nights at The Scott.  From driving up to leaving, nothing was overlooked, the staff was on top of everything. I've been to 5 star resorts that would not come close to the service I received here.  I highly recommend and will return.

reviews.author: rachelraeliving
reviews.title: Havana ohhh yah yah!
reviews.text: Amazing place! Perfect Havana nights/ Cubano vibe. Amazing music piped through the lobby and pool areas, every inch is Instagram worthy! Little hidden sitting areas and hammocks throughout. Multiple pools and hideaways so you feel like you have the whole place to yourself! Book it! It’s worth it! -Rachel Rae

reviews.author: e6jyyo0pra
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Beautiful, whimsical and the perfect location! Perfect for a couple and a group of friends.Great food, great pool area, great spa and walking distance from the strip. I would definitely go back in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: khatch164825
reviews.title: incredibel
reviews.text: everything about our stay was top of the line, luxurious, and a perfect getaway. Definitely will be coming back. Pool was clean, staff was friendly and incredibly helpful. Shuttle service was top notch taking us to and from our dinner reservations!

reviews.author: Katie M
reviews.title: Beautiful property!
reviews.text: The Scott Resort is a beautiful place to stay. Such a great location for a girls staycation. The decor is stunning. The service was excellent. The drinks and food were beyond. There are places to visit and relax around every corner that are just gorgeous.

reviews.author: ana gloriela g
reviews.title: unique place
reviews.text:
This hotel is a gem, perfect location, beautiful and spacious areas, the rooms are very conceptuals, the projections at night outside the Canal Club are great. 

Comfy and stylish  rooms, the food is good, staff very friendly

reviews.author: hannahabrammer
reviews.title: Bachelorette Party Heaven!
reviews.text: We went for my bach party weekend and were blown away by everything. The hotel is expertly curated and the staff is amazing. The complimentary shuttle was perfect and added a touch of luxury to the whole experience.

reviews.author: Tori K
reviews.title: Teenage dream
reviews.text: Took my teenage daughter and 2 of her friends for her 17th birthday up to Scottsdale. They loved the hotel, lots of Instagram photo opportunities with the cool new retro decor. The pool was very refreshing and a bar located at the pool for beverages.  The rooms were decorated very nicely. We have a small 5 pound dog and this property allows small pets.  The hotel is located within walking distance to shopping and restaurants. Will definitely go back again.

reviews.author: amytilley
reviews.title: Quality and Serenity
reviews.text: Top notch resort that caters to your needs. Helpful staff and great happy hour. The grounds are beautiful and provide a calming feeling throughout the resort. I enjoyed the renovation and new color scheme/theme to the resort.

reviews.author: sandysanteramo45
reviews.title: Great Anniversary stay!
reviews.text: Great staff, food, drinks, rooms, grounds, pools! Celebrated our 33rd Anniversary, very relaxing, fun, memorable stay. Our 3rd time at the resort, love it! The remodeling of the rooms was done very nicely- the grounds are our favorite part, beautiful!!

reviews.author: Mark K
reviews.title: A wonderful overnight getaway
reviews.text: For my birthday this year my wife surprised me with an overnight stay at the Scott. It proved a terrific idea, as we enjoyed both the facilities on site and the proximity to downtown Scottsdale. Highly recommended for the in-town getaway or when you just want to spoil yourself!

reviews.author: Michelle Cali
reviews.title: Was warmly greeted by friendly staff and loved La Vickers, an intimate spa experience
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stylish courtyard room and found Nycolette, a bartender, full of local knowledge and suggestions. We took advantage of spa specials and were especially impressed by Jill at the Spa who suggested ideal services and provided a spot-on restaurant recommendation for a special occasion. Loved the island chic vibe and helpful staff at this conveniently located hotel. Super comfortable beds, too!

reviews.author: Nick W
reviews.title: BS Resort Fee!!
reviews.text: As some others have mentioned, the hotel itself is really nice and beautifully decorated. One thing we especially loved was the smell when we entered our room. You can tell they are targeting social media influencers to help promote the hotel. The hotel centrally located in Scottsdale and offers some cool amenities like the bikes, a shuttle that runs in a 3 mile radius to the hotel, etc. We stayed from Thursday-Sunday 7/11/19-7/14/19, and you could definitely tell when the weekend crowd rolled in. The pool area became excessively crowded and was party central. They have a highly rated restaurant and bar, but we didn't indulge mainly due to our prior plans, so I can't speak to that. I wasn't dissatisfied by anything, however I think the "resort fee" for this type of establishment is a bit ridiculous. They say it covers wifi (I'm sorry but it's 2019 and you can get free wifi at McDonalds), parking (open, unmonitored parking lot I should add), a "welcome beverage" (I understood this to be the tea they have out in the lobby), the Tesla charging stations (to my knowledge, only 1 Tesla owner benefitted from this the entirety of our stay), and water stations around the resort (I won't argue this one for those triple digit hot days in PHX). I'm sure the shuttle and bikes are included in their resort fee as well, but they are limited in number and subject to demand, so you might not even get use out of these amenities. By contrast, we also stayed at Enchantment Resort in Sedona, which is the type of place you expect a "resort fee". This was a pretty but glorified, recently-remodeled hotel, not a resort. Sorry, but your resort fee is BS. And also, as others have stated, it seemed like a weekend hot spot for locals and/or a girl's trip destination, which I imagine would be a good place for either purpose. We were celebrating our 5 year anniversary while making our way through AZ and stayed here longer than we should have planned for. Hopefully this will help someone as they are planning. It's really not a bad stay, but they shouldn't charge a resort fee.

reviews.author: Kari W
reviews.title: Great little boutique
reviews.text: The hotel is nicely decorated, clean and comfortable. The bed was one of the most comfortable beds I have ever slept in. Both my husband and I were able to sleep in because the room was so dark and cool.

reviews.author: Mustlovedoggies
reviews.title: Staycation success
reviews.text: Booked the hotel for a girls weekend. It was perfect. Loved the vibe of the hotel. The pool was great. Provided a perfect little get away with plenty of shade to hang out at the pool for hours and relax. The staff was great. The beds are super comfy. We will return again for sure.

reviews.author: garybecker
reviews.title: Scott Resort
reviews.text:
One of the very best hotels anywhere. Period. I have stayed in the best hotels in the US and abroad.
Four Seasons; Peninsula, Mandarin Oriental. The Scott is as nice as any of these properties-maybe nicer. The rooms are terrific. On a night when the Phoenician was nearly $500 the Scott was only around $120. The larger resorts in Scottsdale are a chore-large hikes from your car to your room; from your room to the lobby or pool. The Scott is much more convenient and far more up to date. It’s bright and friendly and the others are less so. It also has the best location if you are interested in being able to walk around Old Town Scottsdale of the Fashion Square. Last, its location adjacent to Paradise Valley means the terrain is that of a lush valley and not the arid landscape of many of the other properties,

reviews.author: Thomas J
reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations
reviews.text:
The level of service and guest experience was excellent. The front desk and house keepings desire to meet our needs was nothing less than exceptional. During our stay the bellman (Nate) made our stay amazing. From his local knowledge, restaurants recommendations and shuttle service was spot on! He also recommended the salt water tubing adventure that was a blast.

We will be back to enjoy the excellent service and a very cool pool vibe!

reviews.author: Sarah M
reviews.title: Awesome place to stay!
reviews.text: Absolutely love The Scott! The staff is super friendly and helpful. The resort is located in good location and is very welcoming. Resort grounds are clean with a lot of beautiful plants. Rooms are clean and modern. Will definitely be visiting again!

reviews.author: Navigator14324098052
reviews.title: Great property!
reviews.text: Overall, the resort is fabulous. The décor and vibe is so unique and my husband and I had an excellent time. The beds were not very comfortable and the guest room temperature was a little hot for our liking overnight (this also could have been because we visited when the temperature outside was 105 degrees or hotter). Otherwise, the food and drinks that we had were excellent and we are already planning our trip back!

reviews.author: macelim
reviews.title: Breezy, chill vibe, if it's not too busy
reviews.text:
Stayed for a week and it was fantastic! The weekends can get busy from day-passes, but other than that, I really enjoyed the chill, relaxed vibe. 

Upon entering, the lobby impresses, with it's high ceilings that streams in natural light. Makes you just want to lounge and have long chats on a couch with a bunch of friends.The pool area is inviting and cosy, whether you're going for a dip, or just hanging out by the fire pit. Rooms are gorgeous and cosy. 

The food in the hotel was amazing. I did not have a bad bite all our meals there, and the bar serves up really interesting twists on your favorite cocktail. 

I was there for a work event, but I would definitely choose it for a family staycation.

Location is amazing too! Just a block away from the Scottsdale Fashion Mall, and a short drive from Old Town. The hotel provides a shuttle that services a 3 mile radius. 

Oh yes, and the staff were nothing short of fantastic. I had some packages sent there, and they kindly delivered it to my room though I was more than happy to pick them up from front desk (they were heavy too!)

Room tip: All rooms have a balcony/patio. For more privacy, ask for a room that faces the outside, but you may miss out on a pool/courtyard view. Also, the ground floor patios are 'public' access, so you may want to ask for a room upstairs, if you're okay walking the short flight of stairs.

reviews.author: Paradise23694688131
reviews.title: Definitely won't be back
reviews.text: This hotel reminded me of the hotel from the shining. Instead of getting king size bed it was two queens. The staff was rude and uppity. The shower was horrible and no baths in the hotel. You could hear the hallway traffic all night.

reviews.author: Tourist25186863468
reviews.title: Anniversary Trip
reviews.text:
Even though the resort is located in a busy area, you feel like you're secluded while inside the resort. 
 The resort is located near a lot of restaurants and close to Old Town Scottsdale.  The resort staff was extremely helpful and nice.  Jason, one of the waiters by the pool was great!  The food is delicious with reasonable prices.  The resort was very clean, and staff did what they could to keep up with the falling leaves in the area.  I would recommend this resort to others.  The resort played music in the pool area, however there was someone playing music on their bluetooth speaker, competing with the resort's music.  Our spa experience was great and relaxing.  Some of the gym equipment needs some attention.

reviews.author: JulesMon
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: Our family from the east and west coasts met here for a vacation. We enjoyed the location of the property. We ate breakfast, dinner and enjoyed the bar area. The restaurant has a varied menu and we enjoyed our meals. The bar menu has great beverage choices. Providing better pillows and higher quality towels and soaps would elevate this experience! Overall, we had a great time and enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: Meander26526470998
reviews.title: Staycation at the Scott Resort
reviews.text: My daughter and I loved our staycation here!  The atmosphere was so awesome.  The lobby was beautiful and chill.  Loved the layout of the place as was easy to get to the pool, restaurant, lobby, etc.  Our room was so cool and the place was clean and staff was friendly.

reviews.author: Ambassador760485
reviews.title: Not too family friendly
reviews.text: We were staying overnight for a quick transition to PHX airport. Looking for a family friendly stay. This hotel resort seems to cater better to couples who enjoy partying as we noticed several around us.

reviews.author: louiseanne6
reviews.title: Another great vacation
reviews.text: We come here every year for 5 days over the July 4 th period . This year they surpassed themselves and we were very happy with the service and comfort . The food was Excellent and the staff were fantastic .

reviews.author: Bryon W
reviews.title: Best anniversary/ special occasion getaway!
reviews.text: You are treated like a king/ celebrity all the staff knows your name and goes far out of their way to make your stay a magical experience. Have come for the last 4 years on my anniversary with my wife

reviews.author: Voyager00156791325
reviews.title: Great Boutique Hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is a great value and is in a very convenient location.  We have stayed in very clean rooms with very clean bathrooms.  If you rent the suites, the murphy bed offered is actually a very comfortable bed.  The pool area is kept clean and the cabanas are a great value.  I'm impressed with their level of service, which is why we have returned on other occasions.  The food and drinks at the Canal Club in the hotel lobby are flavorful.  Prices are reasonable and the service is great.  Overall, this is a very nice boutique hotel in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: brunie1966
reviews.title: Sehr nett
reviews.text: Denn die Hotels in Amerika sind meist nicht auf diesem Niveau. Geräumige Zimmer, ein toller Pool, eine sehr nette Bar, tolles Frühstück, top freundlicher Service... Und das alles zu einem guten aber dem Preisleistungsverhältnis entsprechenden Preis... Ein Katzensprung zum nächsten Golfplatz und in die Altstadt...

reviews.author: Travel04093394401
reviews.title: Pretty and fun
reviews.text: It was a good place for a couples weekend. Pretty and relaxing. Not too many kids at the pool. The service at the pool was great and the food was excellent. Only down side is they don't serve food after 10 p.m.

reviews.author: Jessica A
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: I've never left a review on Trip Advisor before but this one is so warranted. I came to the Scott for a weekend with my best friend for a spa weekend. We were blown away as soon as we stepped foot in the lobby. Every detail of this place is incredible. The food, drinks, room, decor, service was all amazing. The La Vidorra Experience was the best massage I've ever had. I don't have one negative thing to say about the Scott. I can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Derek B
reviews.title: Beautiful Gem
reviews.text: The Scot is a amazing and beautiful hotel and spa located just outside of Old Town in Scottsdale. I would highly recommend this for a body looking for a short or longer stay in this hidden gem right outside of Old Town

reviews.author: Squinn12345
reviews.title: Relaxing escape!
reviews.text: My husband and I had a great time on our anniversary staycation! Awesome atmosphere that takes you out of the desert and gives a cool, Cuban feel. Rooms were spacious and super clean.  Service was outstanding from the bellman, to the front desk to the pool service. For sure a place we would stay again!

reviews.author: Jillian H
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, great location, delicious food, amazing service!
reviews.text:
We booked a staycation at The Scott to celebrate my birthday and had the most fantastic time.  They were able to accommodate an early check in (which was a pleasant surprise) so we were able to get into our room before heading to the pool and our spa treatments. 
We stayed in a Pool King room and had a large balcony that overlooked both pools. The room decor is beautiful and the bed is very comfortable.  They truly took the time to put thought into the little things (including your room key being in a "passport" looking envelope).
The Canal Club restaurant is delicious for dinner (I highly recommend the vegetable paella - it's enough to split between two people, especially if you get a side, like the black beans), and their poolside menu is great too (the pizzas are delicious and the cocktails are tasty). 
The spa was probably my favorite part of our visit  - the massages were the best I've had in a long time!  They even provided us with macrons and a bottle of wine (for my birthday) that we could enjoy in our robes after.
Already can not wait to come back!

reviews.author: Vacation12268274331
reviews.title: Girls getaway
reviews.text: Cute, trendy, and quiet hotel. The pool was a big disappointment and looked older and dirty. Rooms were clean and staff all very nice except the staff by the pool. Over all a nice spot to getaway for a girls trip.

reviews.author: Wardaful
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Had the most amazing experience here. We hardly left the resort all weekend! The Canal Club is the perfect spot for breakfast, lunch pool side or dinner! We dined here numerous times during our stay and were never disappointed. The service we received during our stay was also some of the best we've ever experienced. If you're fortunate enough to cross paths with Jason, you're SURE to enjoy your time at the resort. He served us at the pool almost every day during our stay and went out of his way to make sure we were taken care of. Everyone at this resort was super kind and hospitable, but Jason was hands down our favorite! I forgot my brand new sunglasses at the pool on our first day and was convinced that they were long gone, but Jason had found them and turned them in!!! Service aside, the decor is stunning (I need their decorator to re do my home), every corner is instagram worthy (if you're into that) and well kept. My only complaint would be that the restaurant and bar closes pretty early (10 or 11pm), so you definitely have to leave the resort for any night life, but you’re not going to want to leave otherwise so perhaps this is a good thing! We will most definitely be coming back and hope this this spot never loses its charm!

reviews.author: Sherpa620178
reviews.title: Great Lobby Scott
reviews.text: Front desk was not welcoming and simple questions seemed a chore.. but location for the hotel is excellent , close to Old town Scottsdale, The grounds are pretty and lobby is light bright and beautiful. .. getting to and from rooms the hotel looks a bit dingy with low ceilings in the hallways; the darker colors and glossy paint reminds me of an inexpensive hotel I stayed at in Mexico in my college days. Reads cheap.  However, once in the room there is a charming retro feeling. and pool area is also charming ... and of course the lobby is great for meeting clients or enjoying with friends.  Tech notes.. No music channels in rooms and other standard options I was told I would need to download an app to my phone.

reviews.author: Explore18611601802
reviews.title: Dirty pools and palm tree cutting
reviews.text: We had to move pools each day we were there because they were chainsawing palm leaves. This made the pools extremely dirty and was just an inconvenience to have to move pools especially with a baby and kids. We came for the pool experience and wasn’t very satisfied.

reviews.author: Kim
reviews.title: Beware of staff
reviews.text: I was approached by a male hotel employee in the parking lot while I was carrying my suitcase, and was asked if I needed a ride. I stated no, I had a ride. He then told me he could drive me as far as Kentucky or Tennessee. Are the employees involved in sex trafficking and transporting women? I was truly offended and scared.

reviews.author: Tour59891409910
reviews.title: Definitely Recommend!
reviews.text: Came  here for a "girl's getaway."  Had such a good time.  The room was beautiful...as well as the entire resort!  Staff was courteous and friendly.  Food was excellent.  So glad we chose this place and we will return.

reviews.author: Breanna L
reviews.title: Best weekend ever!
reviews.text: It was an amazing weekend from start to finish and my favorite resort I’ve EVER stayed at! I definitely recommend..the decor was beautiful and the crowd so fun! Customer service was beyond expectation!

reviews.author: KellyAnne H
reviews.title: Great spot for a girls’ day
reviews.text:
I recently moved back to the valley and my tribe is scattered all over town: we’ve been looking for a central meeting spot and The Scott might just be it. Two of us did a little reconnaissance mission this weekend and had an absolutely lovely time. 
If you’re into such things, the lobby is definitely insta-worthy with its lush Havana inspired decor. 
We started with brunch in The Canal Club—the food was delicious and the cocktail menu extensive. Detail we loved? The cocktail menu gave descriptions and glass icons that really helped identify what you could expect from the drink. 
We followed up with pedicures in the spa; there are only two chairs so this isn’t the place to gather your entire tribe all at once (you’d have to round robin different treatments and then meet by the pool). That said, it was an intimate setting, the technicians were wonderful and, fun fact, the long wearing polishes are created locally. 
We had a great day and plan to come back—especially with local summer specials on the menu!

reviews.author: Susiemcampbell
reviews.title: Good value
reviews.text: Great place to stay!  We celebrated two birthdays with a joint celebration.  Perfect venue, trendy with the right amount of luxurious ness.  Bath robes, nespresso coffee and mini bar......perfect!  Most important of all a normal size hairdryer!

reviews.author: Adis Kadiric
reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.text:
My fiancé and I will come back another 100 times. This resort is absolutely amazing, from the check in staff to the pool side staff. The rooms are cozy and so comfortable. The pool area has such a diverse group of people at all times it’s such a blast. If you get a chance to stay here please introduce yourself to Jason, one of the pool side servers. The guy is an absolute rockstar. Anything and everything we needed he took care of for us. 

We will 1000% be coming back.

Thank you so much for the great stay!

reviews.author: Peter D
reviews.title: Needs more update and trained staff
reviews.text:
Holes in doors that face a cruddy looking building was my room.  The room was pleasantly stocked though and the bed was comfortable.  Find your way to and from the rooms wasn’t easy with half the gates closed.  

Staff was not existent at the desk and when I found staff to ask about a cup of real coffee and not Nescafé they said they couldn’t get me coffee for almost an hour and half later. Yet, almost all staff was drinking coffee being brewed for banquets that morning.  How hard would it be to give me a cup?

Pretty, but I would not stay there again

reviews.author: Voyager771925
reviews.title: Family Reunion / Wedding
reviews.text: Really enjoyed the atmosphere and decor.  Highlights were the sandy beach/pool for our two toddlers and the relaxing breakfasts on your property - great service from the wait-staff!  Also, very much enjoyed the spa, although disappointed to hear that she felt she had been doing massage therapy for a long time and was about "done".

reviews.author: Nattie
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: My stay at The Scott was wonderful. It’s a beautiful hotel with a unique beach resort vibe. Service was 5 stars and the food was lovely and very good. Definitely will be staying again when I’m in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Connector49059501759
reviews.title: The Scott Serves as a Downtown Scottsdale Hub for Activities
reviews.text: Competent and friendly staff that eclipses many other Hotels & Resorts.  Beautifully landscaped property with a plethora of seating areas to meet, greet or simply chill.  Generously sized pool areas adequately stocked with towels, lounge chairs etc.  Convenient & available shuttle to quickly swoop you to & from local venues.  Very clean throughout and clearly managed quite well.  Enjoy!!!

reviews.author: Ashley C
reviews.title: Gorgeous resort
