reviews.text: This resort is amazing! Gorgeous, clean (even the bathrooms!), yummy food, beautiful spa, friendly staff. It’s like a destination resort without having to leave the country! The location is perfect. We rode electric scooters to Scottsdale river walk. The vibe of the hotel is amazing.

reviews.author: Walter M
reviews.title: Weekend Stay
reviews.text:
We stayed at The Scott for a local dance event. The property is excellent. The bed was comfortable and the room was very clean. The two pools were great, the beach pool was more for the kids than the other. I would not recommend the Scott for very small children, as the rooms are definitely more setup for adults (wine and liquor bottles in the room).

Overall a good stay and staycation.

reviews.author: Rpollo9212@rogers.com
reviews.title: You can go home!
reviews.text: The great American author Thomas Wolfe wrote, “You can’t go home. He was not referring to the Fairmont Scottsdale property in Arizona. You can go home. Last year we visited for our 30th wedding anniversary. This year marking the 31st we came home. As Fairmont Gold guests we were fortunate to have OUR suite made available to us. Our old and new family at the lounge who offer us personal concierge service warmly greeted us and to them we are truly grateful and offer many thanks - Taylor, Tom, Jessica, Tammy and Hannah. It is a charming and beautiful resort. We adore the wildlife and cactus etc. The grounds are lovingly cared for and it is apparent that maintenance is at the forefront in the care of this property. Keep our porch light on. We will return soon!

reviews.author: estyjewels
reviews.title: Definitely coming back
reviews.text: We planned a girls trip for a friends birthday. Arrived at the Scott on a Saturday, left on Monday. Short and sweet! We met the nicest people, the staff was amazing. Special shout out to Mike at the pool, Katia at bar and the lovely staff that drove and picked us up all over town. Our room was clean and the housekeeping kept us stocked on extra towels and hygiene products. We are already talking about our next trip back. The only thing I would ask is that the pool music be turned up or bring a speaker if that’s not possible.

reviews.author: 958geraldinel
reviews.title: Fantastic Stay at The Scott Resort & Spa
reviews.text: My husband and I enjoyed an overnight stay at The Scott this past weekend in celebration of his birthday.  Everything was fantastic.  We arrived early and were happy to hear that our room was ready and we had access to all hotel amenities.  We would have loved to have sat by the pool but there was no room to sit, etc.  We made due sitting in the lovely garden area surrounding the lagoon and then enjoyed a snack at The Canal Club.  Our room was comfy and had everything we needed for a lovely stay.  Our view of the lagoon was fantastic and it was great sitting on the balcony taking it all in.  We learned from our arrival day and made sure we got to the pool bright and early the last day of our trip.  We staked out our chairs and enjoyed a lovely day at the pool.  The staff was attentive and catered to anything that you wanted...drinks, snacks, towels, etc.   I would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Trip56507285285
reviews.title: Above my budget but worth it
reviews.text: Loved the pool,service, food,lobby  room was good and comfortable but it didn’t wow us. We were on as pretty tight budget so maybe got a budget room. I knew it was off season but I still had to ask 4 times to finally get the lowest rate. Over all we had a great stay and would stay again because of the things we enjoyed most

reviews.author: Sarah L
reviews.title: A little bit of heaven in the desert
reviews.text: We were privileged to escape mom and dad duties to celebrate 5 years of marriage and come relax for a night at The Scott. It did not disappoint. The ambiance is incredibly relaxing and beautifully thought out. We were impressed with how kind and friendly the staff was. Especially Reka at check in with her smile and property knowledge, Jason at the pool made our day so special with his amazing service and attentiveness. The property has a so many creative spaces making it enjoyable for a romantic weekend away or entertaining for the kiddos. Overall, we felt like we were in Cuba in the az desert. A perfect weekend away! Thank you The Scott for making it so special! Also, have to mention Dave, Amber, Mike (at the pool), and Matt the bellman for being super awesome as well! We can’t wait to go back!

reviews.author: Victoria W
reviews.title: Relaxing stay
reviews.text:
This is perfect if you want a spa and pool break. It’s a lovely relaxing haven in a hot noisy town. 

We stayed two nights on a long road trip so the room and facilities mattered most. Beds and showers were great room was spacious and clean - we had a two queen room and courtyard. This meant that we had a couple of chairs on a little patio overlooking a bush. 
  
There are no elevators so if you have cases to lug then it’s better although the staff are very helpful. 

We had a couple of problems - the fridge did not work and so the milk and fruit salad we had put in it were ruined because of the heat. Also the coffee maker wouldn’t plug in. We asked for help and the maintenance guy explained the fridge switched off when it overheated and we had to keep the outer cupboard door open,  also the plug sockets had been filled with a solution so people didn’t push anything in them! The plug had to be really forced in. It would be helpful if quests knew this. He sorted it all out. 

Otherwise a very pleasant stay

reviews.author: Resort00353022519
reviews.title: Fantastic Stay in Scottsdayle
reviews.text: We stayed over a weekend at the Scott Resort & Spa Hotel and this is a great place to stay. This is an exciting Hotel, the room we were in was very clean, the pool is great and well designed, the service is fabulous. The restaurant was outstanding and we had a great time during our stay.

reviews.author: Dream66324262477
reviews.title: We will stay here again!!
reviews.text: Our stay at the Resort was 2 nights.  Excellent room, pool, experience!  Staff was SO helpful.  Looking forward to next year! We will be back.  Bedding is light, so if you like a heavier cover, ask for more or a blanket.  But that is the only thing lacking.  Everything was splendid.

reviews.author: Meghan S
reviews.title: Amazing Bachelorette Trip! Highly Recommend for a Large Girls Trip
reviews.text: The Scott seemed to be perfectly curated for a large girls' trip.  This spot is perfect if you are looking for a more mature, classy Bachelorette location. There were 7 of us, in our early thirties.  It was so peaceful, tranquil, rejuvenating and gorgeous.  It was the exact R&R we were looking for.  It was quiet overall in a good way---it was not crowded, you could always get a seat at the bar, or lobby, or by the pool, not loud or rowdy at all.  Recently renovated, every single detail was perfect-everything was picture perfect-very Instagram worthy.  The pool was GORGEOUS and warm.  The Bar, the Canal Club made AMAZING mixed drinks, the food was so reasonably priced.  I have never been to such a luxurious hotel where the food was so tasty and well-priced.  To be honest, my regret is that we did not spend more time at the hotel.  You could have spent your whole time in Scottsdale at the hotel and not had to leave.  The breakfast options were so healthy--the Overnight Oats, the Granola Bowl were both to die for.  The lunch salads were amazing.  You could get poolside drinks and lunch brought directly to you.  But the best part of the Scott experience was the staff.  Doug was amazing.  Doug welcomed us so warmly, I have never felt so welcome and so appreciated at a hotel before.  I felt like we belonged there, which you don't always get at fancy places.  Doug went above and beyond to make our Bachelorette Party the best, sending champagne to the room, making sure we had lunch waiting for us when we checked in.

reviews.author: Roving27695934751
reviews.title: The Scott Resort
reviews.text: My husband and I were celebrating our one year anniversary and we were greeted with a bottle of champagne which I thought was so thoughtful of the resort. Our first night we had dinner at The Canal and our food was terrible, I had ordered (medium steak) and I couldn't eat it of how raw it was. I felt bad sending it back because the server was so nice. We then moved on to drinks and same thing they were terrible. The resort is beautiful, you have  friendly staff but the food and beverage were extremally disappointing..  I would recommended recreating the menu I was also surprise of how simple the menu was and the lack of choices for such an outstanding resort.

reviews.author: Heather S
reviews.title: Beautiful gem of a place
reviews.text: Amazing location, fantastic staff, and glorious grounds. The perfect size to have a great staycation or travel from abroad. Gives you the perfect "escape" feel  with flair. I live within 15 minutes of the location and didnt need to stay overnight. So happy I did. Gave me the out of town experience I wouldnt have been given otherwise, this summet.

reviews.author: Souxie q
reviews.title: Havana ooh la la
reviews.text:
The decor, the pool, the fountains on the property. It feels like you are sitting in paradise. A real Cuban feel.
Great evening entertainment. The negative, would be the food and bar service was extremely slow.

reviews.author: A6852SJleahs
reviews.title: Oasis at The Scott
reviews.text: We were only there 2 nights - but had an excellent getaway!  The piped in music was fabulous, loved staying on the lagoon - lots of outdoor seating and water elements.  The food was outstanding at the resort.  We will definitely go back for longer next time!

reviews.author: Anna L
reviews.title: Perfect for a girls weekend
reviews.text: I was blown away by The Scot. After recently undergoing a major renovation the property is absolutely gorgeous and you feel like you've been transported to an amazing oasis. The decor is chic and modern, the food was phenomenal, and the service was top notch. As a smaller property, I loved that there was still a fun atmosphere, without the chaos of some larger hotels in the area. The spa was excellent (ask for Baron!) and the food and drink at the Canal Club blew us away all weekend!

reviews.author: Cruiser52514109789
reviews.title: Not a good babymoon
reviews.text: Don't expect a nice warm bath. No elevators. Only one restaurant. Check in takes a while. Generally an ok place if you don't value sleeping or feeling comfortable. The bed is stiff. The pillows are too fluffy. I couldn't get comfortable and when I did noisy people in the hall and surrounding rooms ruined the sleep. The maid tried to come in even with the do not disturb sign up. I was very tired when we got home even after a "relaxing" couple's trip. Parking was hard

reviews.author: Crystal J
reviews.title: Great Get Away
reviews.text: The Shuttle is fabulous and the staff is great. They are always friendly and willing to give tips on restaurants or things to do. The hotel's renovation was beautifully done, and everything was clean and beautiful.

reviews.author: Adventure68161236578
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing !
reviews.text: This resort is so relaxing and beautifully decorated! We booked the Scott for a bachelorette party and we can’t wait to go back! Couldn’t have asked for A better experience! The staff was amazing and so helpful and friendly!

reviews.author: Explorer35238530523
reviews.title: Couples Trip
reviews.text: Overall great experience and great place to stay. We would definitely stay here again in the future. Within walking distance to old town, plenty of bars / restaurants all within walking distance and a hotel shuttle that will take you anywhere in a 3 mile radius. We never waited more than 15 mins for the shuttle. The staff was also very accommodating and friendly.

reviews.author: NorthStar35621625392
reviews.title: Amazing getaway
reviews.text: While rooms can get pricey at times, this is a highly recommended hotel! Atmosphere is great, the pool experience  is lovely, staff was friendly and helpful. Lots of great dining options nearby as well!

reviews.author: Ralph S
reviews.title: Beautiful Oasis on Scottsdale Road ...
reviews.text:
This is a great boutique resort and spa. Stayed over a weekend recently and found it to be charming, chic and very much a lively spot. The expanded lobby invites guests in groups or even a couple to find a place to sit and enjoy a drink and or an appetizer. As you walk through the main lobby toward the pool area there are open air booths on either side again for relaxing on comfortable chairs and sofa.There is always hot and cold tea available as well as chilled water.

Our room opened on to a lovely patio surrounded by shrubs and the sounds of outdoor music. The two pools were indeed busy all day but you expect that if you're getting away for the weekend in fabulous weather.

The resort is located a couple of blocks from the incredible Fashion Square Mall, Old Town a little further down Scottsdale Road and restaurants, restaurants and great shopping including wonderful art galleries. Go north and you'll find even more to choose from.

The staff was wonderful from checkin to checkout and in between. They've got a good formula working at The Scott as they do with their other property here and on the upper CA coast. Thanks for a wonderful weekend.

reviews.author: jessicasona
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel, tons of plants
reviews.text: Love the decor here! One of the cutest hotels I have ever stayed at. Plants everywhere and they did not miss a detail.  Only complaints would be mosquitoes in the lobby/lounge area. They should get sprayed! I was playing backgammon at one of the tables and had to leave because I got eaten alive. And then I wish they had more loungers by the pool! They get filled up by 9AM and there’s nowhere to sit. People just leave towels on chairs but then aren’t sitting there or spend the whole time in the pool. We had lunch at the pool and the club sandwich was really just a big cold bun with cold deli meat vs a toasted layered sandwich so wouldn’t recommend that but the other stuff on the menu looked good! I would stay again for the decor but would get to the pool super early.

reviews.author: Robin P
reviews.title: Enjoyable staycation
reviews.text: Smaller property so not too busy.  Was great to enjoy either the regular pool or the beach pool ( though that is more family oriented). They have pool side service and a bar, the food is fantastic and the staff is very friendly and helpful.  A perfect staycation for a holiday weekend with our out of town friends.  The location is perfect for many dining options, shopping and overall activities.

reviews.author: NorthStar32048808046
reviews.title: Beautiful property and great location, poor service
reviews.text: We stayed at this resort for a stay-cation girls birthday trip. The decor, detail and location of the resort were amazing. They even offer a shuttle service. Was not at all impressed with the pool or service for drinks or the restaurant. We went to dinner at The Canal Club for restaurant week. The food was ok but the service was terrible. We waited forever to get drinks or our food orders taken. Once we got our food, the server only checked on us once. The staff were running around frazzled and literally running from one table to the next. The pool service and drinks were also awful. We went early on a Sunday to get chairs at the pool and they were all gone. For a resort in Scottsdale with a beautiful property, they didn’t have enough chairs to lay out on.  Both days during our stay, we had to sit on the side of the pool and never got a chair.

reviews.author: Gabriel Gold
reviews.title: Perfect spot of a getaway
reviews.text: The is resort is AWESOME!!! It’s trendy and stylish. The rooms are comfortable. I had no complaints. The canal club was great as well. The pool was nice and the staff was friendly! Michael and Sean took care of us at the pool and their customer set was awesome. I will definitely come back!

reviews.author: StreetwiseSmart
reviews.title: Hotel Party!
reviews.text:
Stayed at The Scott for two nights, mid-week. The hotel is well decorated, with rooms presented to a high standard and with nice styling, and easy car parking. We didn’t eat at the hotel but we did have drinks both nights, finding the bar staff underwhelming in enthusiasm. There are really two distinct pool areas and rooms either overlook ‘the lagoon’ or the car park, so if you’re fussy for a view make sure you check what you’re getting in advance. That said, although we were there midweek, this definitely felt like a ‘party hotel’ with groups of girls and guys roaming here and there, hogging loungers and barstools. I have a feeling that The Scott Party Central may get a little raucous at weekends, so be warned! (and possibly chose a car park view for respite). 
Our only real frustration with The Scott was that our stay happened to fall over my partners birthday and friends had ordered and paid for a card and wine to be delivered to our room. This never happened though, and we had no idea to expect it (it was to be a surprise!). However, when we checked out the girl on reception offered a hearty (and out of nowhere) Happy Birthday wish to my partner! Clearly something flashed on her screen, linking probably to the room gift we never got. Disappointed for our friends who had such a nice thought and frustrated that The Scott team failed to follow through....(house keeping probably drank it - Dutch courage to face the rooms vacated by that weekends boys stag party!)

reviews.author: Companion13891409821
reviews.title: Girls trip!
reviews.text: Our stay here was nothing short of amazing. The food, the rooms, and the decor were all spectacular. Our only complaint would be how crowded the pool gets with day visitors, making it close to impossible for paying guests to find spots by the pools. I'd definitely recommend and stay again.

reviews.author: Andrea Z
reviews.title: Amazing experience, excellent service, great value--will be back again in the future!
reviews.text: We were here for a bachelorette Weekend. The staff was extremely attentive. They went above and beyond to make sure we had a great experience. Great food and beautiful property. Gorgeous pool and firepit. We will be back!

reviews.author: Matt P
reviews.title: Great rates and awesome deals
reviews.text: We were able to book our room for $208 (includes taxes and resort fee) a night PLUS you get two free welcome drinks and a $10 voucher to use the mini bar! Plus, valet parking is complementary.  The location was perfect as well.  A free shuttle takes you into town, so no need to have to find parking. if you plan on going to the mall or out to dinner.  We are totally coming back!

reviews.author: Maps43777294221
reviews.title: Girls weekend
reviews.text: we enjoyed our visit at the scott resort.  the complimentary transportation to camelback and the mall plus restaurants.  we loved the décor and rooms.  the pool was way packed with people and unfortunately no places to lounge.

reviews.author: Heather L
reviews.title: Best. Hotel. Ever.
reviews.text: Amazing staff; friendly and welcoming. Super helpful. The food was to die for. We never left the resort for any reason. We’ll be back. It was the best hotel in Arizona we’ve been too (and we’ve been to a lot).

reviews.author: Tour19676263189
reviews.title: Mini vacation
reviews.text: walkable distant to Fashion Market great place to visit. Also old shopping district great time there.Lots of restaurants in that area. Miss out on the tour Grand Canyon make sure you book the tour when you book your trip. The down Side the shuttle is restricted to a 3 mile radius you need to use your own resources.

reviews.author: Road59975448407
reviews.title: Weekend getaway from Philly
reviews.text: This was a beautiful resort and I will be back with my girlfriends. I do think that water should be provided in the room at least a couple of bottles. The pool would have been nice a tad warmer but overall this was great and I’ll be back!

reviews.author: LStanley1022
reviews.title: Great location, ambiance and price!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Scott Resort for a few days prior to my daughter's wedding in Sedona.  The location was just perfect with the Fashion Square Mall and many wonderful restaurants nearby.  The hotel shuttle was available to take us to Old Town and anywhere else in a 3 mile radius which was very convenient.  We spent multiple days at the pool and enjoyed the hotel restaurants which had a nice selection of well-prepared fresh food.  We look forward to returning.

reviews.author: JJGerk
reviews.title: Babymoon
reviews.text: Highly recommend this hotel for a babymoon. Quiet, clean, romantic, great “mocktails” and an amazing spa with the best prenatal massage (might be the best massage I have had in general). Close to activities!!

reviews.author: Roxanne B
reviews.title: Attention to Details is Greatly Overlooked
reviews.text: Room was nice and clean.    Attention to Detail is over looked.    Bell man broke my wine upon arrival but did give us 2 free drinks.   Our keys had to be recoded daily.   Rented a cabana and while we were away for our massage, after informing the young man working out there, another man decided to use our cabana and was waited on.   I had to approach the staff and remind him that was the one we paid for.   He stated he thought that was my husband.      Had to go get my own drinks once.     The Spa massages were excellent.    Would not return to this resort nor recommend it to friends.

reviews.author: BeepBeep
reviews.title: Beautiful resort!
reviews.text: The Scott is a great resort and we had a wonderful time!  All of the staff were friendly and helpful.  The rooms and property were well maintained and clean.  The location was good also, easy walk to many restaurants and coffee shops.

reviews.author: Gwendolynn J
reviews.title: A great property
reviews.text: We had an amazing long weekend at the Scott. It's a relaxing environment with beautiful rooms and an amazing lobby and bar area. The staff is friendly and accommodating. Will definitely stay again. The pool fills up pretty quickly on the weekends, so get there early. But the weekdays are much more calm and chill. Located close to Old Town restaurants and shops as well as Camelback Mountain.

reviews.author: Holleigh A
reviews.title: Cool vibe, close to everything
reviews.text:
The perfect place for me and my family to spend a weekend. 
The property was super cool with two awesome pools, one with a sandy beach. The service was friendly and attentive. Loved that it was super close to Old Town and Fashion Square.

reviews.author: Jen T
reviews.title: Mom/daughter trip
reviews.text:
Rooms clean, comfy beds, service is a little slow, pool is nice, food excellent, Spa is good! 
Front desk could be a little more attentive. But overall, I would stay again on a trip like this, it was a short stay with my mom for mother's day!

reviews.author: Colorado Couple
reviews.title: Busy Trendy Hotel
reviews.text: This resort is great for bachelorette/bachelor parties and groups of celebrating young adults. I wouldn't necessarily call it a resort. The decoration is very trendy, and the pool is packed with people. I would not recommend this resort to anyone looking for a luxury or relaxing resort stay. The pool chairs are all taken by 9:00 AM. While we were enjoying coffee by the pool, there was a group of women yelling at people from their balcony when they noticed their towels being moved off chairs. There was also group of women who put their belongings on a group of 15 chairs that sat empty until 11:00 AM, while they watched a pregnant women sit on the ground because no lounge chairs were open. We enjoyed our time in the room. The decorations are very nice. The rooms are spacious. The balconies are lovely. I did notice that none of the doors to the outside parking lot lock automatically. I called the front desk twice to let them know that the doors did not automatically lock. The doors were never fixed the entire time we were there. It is a little concerning, as there are no gates or security to the parking lot. Anyone can park in the parking lot and walk into the buildings with the rooms. I don't think the staff is...motivated? We were missing bathrobes in our room and it took an hour and a half to get extra coffee pods when we called the front desk. The best part of the stay was the canal club restaurant and the courtesy car and valet. Both had incredibly friendly and helpful staff. The food was so good!

reviews.author: NJtraveler16
reviews.title: Could have been a 5 star had it not been for the pool situation
reviews.text:
My best friend and I chose The Scott for a Girls Getaway weekend and loved it.  We wanted a boutique hotel with a great vibe and The Scott delivered.  The staff could not be more friendly and welcoming.  The grounds are gorgeous and well-maintained.  The hotel lobby is decorated to the very last detail, and the hotel bar/lobby scene is great.  The hotel offers a free shuttle that will take you anywhere within 3 miles of the hotel and they are so accommodating and willing to take you!  The concierges are among the most friendly and helpful of anywhere that I have been. There are more than enough restaurants in the area to choose from, some within a 15 minute walk or less. 
The rooms are nicely-appointed and a good size with large French doors that go out to a balcony.  
We also took the free morning yoga class and really enjoyed it.
The only thing that kept my review from being a five star (as we really loved the hotel) is the pool situation.  On Saturdays and Sundays, the hotel sells Day Passes which changes the serene pool area to a packed pool party, complete with plenty of drunk bachelor and bachelorette parties.  All the lounge chairs were gone by 9am and as hotel guests, we had to sit on chairs in the scorching hot, fake grass the entire day.  Absolutely inexcusable, and they are ruining the vibe of the hotel by doing this.  Beware if you are there during a weekend---you'll need to get your lounge by the pool by 8am.

reviews.author: hopemac
reviews.title: Beautiful resort in the middle of it all
reviews.text: This resort is stunning inside and out, you have no idea you’re in the middle of a city until you step off the beautiful property which is only minutes away from wonderful shopping and dining in old town scottsdale. The shuttle service is perfect and free for guest within a 3 mile radius.  Highly recommend getting a poolside cabana one as well.  And the spa was amazing! Beautiful and relaxing, had a wonderful massage and facial

reviews.author: Companion48773315083
reviews.title: Dirty and terrible service
reviews.text:
The pool area was always dirty. Pool chairs were always dirty. Dirty dishes, empty cups lined the pool area all weekend. Restaurant service was terrible. After sitting looking at menus on the patio (between the bar and pool) for 25 minutes we were told to order from the bar because they didn’t have enough servers on staff. Food came out 25 minutes after we ordered ONLY after I grabbed a server walking around to ask what was going on. Of course the food showed up cold. The server said she was not helping us so she couldn’t do anything about it. She said she would send over the manager but not one person came over. I had to walk up to the front desk and explain what was going on but I had to wait in line because there was two other guests complaining about the service, or lack there of, in the pool area. The staff seems young, unorganized, rude and lacking a real leader. 
I’ll be sending a detailed letter to management/ownership. We had friends who live in Phoenix join us for a pool day and they couldn’t believe how poor the service was and how dirty the pool was. When a 9 year old complains about how dirty a pool area is you know it’s bad. Save your money and rent a house for the week! Airbnb next time for us!

reviews.author: Karienne S
reviews.title: One night - wish it had been more
reviews.text: Stayed here for a night and can’t say enough about this wonderful hotel. Gorgeous lobby, bar and rooms. Attention to detail. And every single member of staff was wonderful. It’s got a really cool vibe without being precious.

reviews.author: Discover33254063203
reviews.title: Excellent vacation
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed for 3 nights and loved every minute of it. The Canal Club has awesome food and drinks that are reasonably priced. The shuttle is convenient and very quick and took us to every place my wife and I wanted to go. We definitely plan on returning in the future.

reviews.author: Road22993011867
reviews.title: Trip gone bad
reviews.text: After waiting for 4 hours for our upstairs room with a sunset view, we received a first floor room with a view of a bamboo fence. The suite is really just 2 bedrooms with a door open between them. Not enough lounge chairs at pool. If you don't get there early, no relaxing by the pool

reviews.author: Kate_lalaluna
reviews.title: Anniversary Oasis in the Desert
reviews.text: I knew from the pictures on Instagram and Trip Advisor I was going to love this resort. From the minute we stepped onto the property, we felt like we had stepped back in time to a 1950's movie set in Havana. Checking in was easy and even though our room wasn't ready, we enjoyed hand-crafted cocktails out in the cabanas while we waited. The music playing around the hotel was on point and just had the perfect ambient vibe. The decor is ABSOLUTELY STUNNING! Every little detail of this place has been curated and given the utmost attention. The colors, the furniture selections, the gold bathroom fixtures, the restaurant decor...I could go on forever. I couldn't stop telling my husband how much I loved being here. There are so many little sitting areas throughout the property that just invite you to grab a drink and chill. The landscaping is tropical and kept so pristine. Once we settled into our room with a Lagoon View, we knew we had made the right decision to stay here. We have traveled to many other countries and stayed at numerous exclusive hotels, but this property has made a lasting impression. We enjoyed the food for breakfast and took in the weekend movie night and snacks by the fire pits. Everything was SCRUMPTIOUS. We had incredible service from Mike at the pool. He was very attentive and crafted a drink for me that I absolutely loved. He was busy, but made us feel like we were the only ones there. I had an equally wonderful experience at the Spa. I enjoyed a 30 minute soak in the copper tub and an 80 minute deep tissue massage with Baron. I couldn't ask for anything better. Yoga in the morning was nice, but the matts used were a little dingy. This could be improved with custom matts that match the color scheme of the hotel and a water bottle to keep us hydrated in the heat. The location of this hotel is IDEAL, as Old Town is only a quick Bird or Lime ride away. You can also catch a complimentary ride in one of their Escalades. For a romantic dinner we at The Monarch Cafe. It was all candlelit and a perfect setting for our anniversary dinner. The food and cocktails were lovely. On another evening we took in the sites and sounds of the Desert Botanical Garden on our last evening. That was such a unique and interesting place to visit as there was a sound and light show during sunset. There were bars set up around the area so you can stroll and have a glass of wine or beer. Our highlight of the entire trip was our ATV adventure 40 minutes from Scottsdale in the Tonto Forest. We booked with Stellar Adventures because they had the best reviews. That was such a blast! We did the 9am ride with Colton and covered 26 miles in less then 2 hours. This was a great way to experience the desert and try something new. I would highly recommend Scottsdale and the Scott Resort for your next getaway! We are already looking at dates in the fall for our return! Bravo!

reviews.author: SDFamily1918
reviews.title: Charming Cuban Themed Resort
reviews.text: This laid back but beautiful resort has charming grounds set up with intimate vignettes where small groups can mingle and sip cocktails. Even when there are many large groups of women celebrating Bachelorette parties the staff is able to accommodate all. I was pleasantly surprised by the professional catering staff who accommodated my gluten and dairy free dietary restrictions at an outside buffet  and also a sit down formal meal. Every Room is located close to the pool. Lastly, the resort location is prime and within walking distance from great restaurants, the Fashion Square Mall which includes the Harkin’s Movie theater. We also found many great golf courses within a short distance.

reviews.author: Compass40407836499
reviews.title: Perfect getaway!
reviews.text: We stayed in this hotel for only a night, but it was perfect for a nice relaxing Sunday by the pool.  The friendly staff were so accommodating and we were able to check in early to take advantage of the nice weather.  Being on the grounds is so private and makes you feel secluded.  Perfect for a couples getaway.

reviews.author: Danielle M
reviews.title: A beautiful escape
reviews.text: A sweet escape as if you've stepped in to a small corner of Havana. The staff was very friendly,  very clean, well appointed rooms, beautiful, lush grounds and pool areas. Celebrated my birthday here and they made me special. Loved it!

reviews.author: Charlyn C
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Never disappointed with this resort!!! Staff is friendly, lobby is beautiful and comfortable. Pools are nice, great location. Feels like you are in a tropical place miles away but then you are in the heart of downtown Scottsdale. Such a classy place with good summer rates. We don't ever stay anywhere else.

reviews.author: crt2home
reviews.title: We will recommend The Scott!
reviews.text: Our first visit to Scottsdale. We were very impressed with The Scott. Since it was our first visit, I gave all 4’s, because I do not know what else to compare to. My only somewhat not positive comment would be all the ”Influencers” and picture taking interrupting our experience (but I guess it is the sign of the times...).

reviews.author: Ryan A
reviews.title: Overall, really nice place
reviews.text:
Stayed here for a business event over the course of three days and really liked the hotel. I was pleasantly surprised with everything and would definitely return if the opportunity presented itself.

Pros:
-really good location with walkability to downtown Scottsdale if the weather is reasonable. Plus there is a free shuttle and bikes available if you want to go that route. Only 25 minutes from the airport.
-really nice attention to the details throughout the facility. It has a Cuban theme and is done very well; not too over the top but just enough to give you that feel
-besides the pool, the lobby area is nice to hang out in with a small central bar along the back wall. There is also a little area to hang out between the pool and lobby that has fire pits and seating with tables so you can eat out there too

Cons:
-I never understand why hotels have showers that are open and let the water go everywhere. This one is no different
-the pool area is nice but crowded on the weekends Be prepared to fight over chairs. Plus it seems like everyone there just wants to take photos and post them on Instagram and this goes for everywhere at the resort
-half the rooms face the parking lot which is not so nice to look at. Plus you have to walk through the pool area to get to some of the rooms which when crowded could be annoying

Tips:
-ask for an even number room
-the free iced tea they serve by reception is really good

reviews.author: melboban
reviews.title: A lush gem!
reviews.text: This resort is so wonderful - the smell is amazing and I felt immediately relaxed. The food and drinks are top notch. Can't wait to go back! The location is perfect and scooters were always available too in the parking lot to get downtown faster.

reviews.author: Chip R
reviews.title: cant get any better
reviews.text: Location, food, drinks and pool!  Also cool room and great staff!  There for two visits now - I'll be back!  The location to old town is also a plus and I love the size of the place.  Loved the bar and drink menu too!

reviews.author: Lmette
reviews.title: Great design, atmosphere, food and service
reviews.text: I highly recommend staying at this wonderful, boutique hotel in Old Town Scottsdale.  Beautiful design, amenities, food and service.   Walking distance, or scooter access, to everything in Old Town.   A few minor issues in our room reduced the rating but I'm sure they will be corrected as we leave as service is outstanding.  Hope you are able to enjoy The Scott as we certainly have.

reviews.author: Cathy L
reviews.title: The Scott Resort rose to the challenge.
reviews.text:
I have visited this property since the late 1990’s. Two years ago shortly after the ownership change to The Scott, there were many issues with my stay and I worried the resort had been purchased strictly as a financial transaction. I wrote a previous review highlighting the jack hammering at the pool on a crowded spring break. The previous manager reached out and two years later I gave the resort another try over spring break. 
I was pleasantly surprised and thoroughly enjoyed my five day stay. The remodel is tasteful and the artwork refreshing. Although I missed the Italian food, the high quality of food and chefs attention to detail offered many tasteful menu options.  Personally I would prefer more organic and food to table options. 
Unlike my last visit, the staff seemed happy and attentive to guests. A few long time employees remembered my family and this was appreciated! As things got really busy over Easter, they definitely could have used more staff though. In particular it can be difficult to get service in the interior lobby area and where tables are often in need of cleaning. 
Transportation and housekeeping was awesome.
Two suggestions for management : find a solution to the in room shower which spills water all over the floor. Secondly, pay more attention to maintaining the pool and seating areas. Often the chairs had bird poop or old food remaining on seat cushions or tables. A few days went by with damaged chaise lounges tossed aside. In the past, early morning staff would hose down and pay attention to these details. 
The only significant issue I had was not being notified of a gift certificate left by a good friend. 
Overall I feel the management and tenor of customer service to be strong. We had a very relaxing vacation and were able to appreciate the natural beauty of the property as well as the aesthetic ambience. 
I also appreciated that the corporate and bachelorette/bachelor groups did not overtake the hotel which has sometimes happened in the past. All the guests seemed to be very happy despite the super busy time of year. 
Thanks for a great stay! Congratulations to The Scott Resort Management and hardworking employees.

reviews.author: Angela W
reviews.title: Fun Spring Training Trip
reviews.text:
We planned a quick weekend jaunt to Scottsdale for spring training.  Go Cubs!!

The Scott was a perfect choice for our needs.  The atmosphere has a warm, appealing vibe.  The lobby, bar area is bustling with activity and music.

The staff was friendly and helpful.  The hotel offers a free Escalade shuttle within three miles.  We used it to and from dinner.  Fabulous service!

It was too cool to enjoy the pool; but, the outdoor pool are is gorgeous.  I can't wait to go back.

This is a great hotel.  We will definitely go back!!

reviews.author: Happiness21359132998
reviews.title: The Scott
reviews.text: The location, staff, decor, food, drinks and overall experience were above and beyond our expectations.  The shuttle was a great addition and we were able to walk just about anywhere.  We will definitely be back to visit!

reviews.author: Kelly D
reviews.title: Relaxing place
reviews.text:
Our room was updated and very comfortable especially the bed. I loved the outdoor patio with chairs and a table. I like the setup of this hotel with the separate buildings. I recommend they leave space in the fridge for you to use. I couldn’t hardly fit a water in there without removing their stuff they charge for. This annoyed me when I had no interest in the items in the fridge.

Pool was great. Sometimes it was hard to find a spot especially in the sun, but eventually one would open up. I’d recommend spa customers not receive a day pass for the pool during high season as it was too full at times. 

If you are looking to take a girls trip ( any age), this is your place! There are so many cozy spots to sit around the resort ( inside and out). 

We used the bikes, the guys at the front were so helpful offering directions, helmets, locks, or waters.  The bikes were so convenient, there is a trail close to the hotel 

The location is very convenient to eating, old town, shopping

reviews.author: Adventure606664
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Hotel was very nice.  Friendly staff.  Central located by downtown Scottsdale.  10 minutes away from Camelback Mountain.  Had complimentary bikes and locks for guests to use and we rode our bikes to Old Town Scottsdale.

reviews.author: KK M
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: This spot has the best tropical vibes with the trees, flowers, birds and fountain noise. You forget you are in a desert.  Beautiful and chic decor and super friendly and warm staff. Loved it and will be back!!

reviews.author: Kate L
reviews.title: Spring girls getaway
reviews.text:
My friend and I chose the Scott for our girls getaway this year for several reasons.
1) large pool area with drink and food service 2) shuttle service/walkable to Old Town Scottsdale 3) affordable spa. 
Our room had 2 queens and overlooked the parking area. There is no elevator to the 2nd floor and to get to the rooms in Camino from the Lobby you must walk through the pool area. This was challenging for us with our bags, and was a bit annoying when sitting by the pool listening to other guests rolling their bags through. 
The shower and closet were large with ample hangers. The room does not include free water, though you can refill in the lobby. 

Staff members were generally very professional and friendly. 

Book the spa early as I had planned to do a service each day of my trip, but could only do 1 day based on how booked it was. We did Yoga one day which was great. We would've done it everyday had we known about it.

reviews.author: BillGibson1
reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: Stayed one night for a work function, so I didn't choose to stay here, and it was way nicer than I expected.  The grounds are gorgeous.  The room was very nice and comfortable.  Staff was nice.  I really enjoyed it.

reviews.author: Nancy D
reviews.title: Gorgeous property
reviews.text: My husband and 3 kids stayed for a couple of days and loved the Scott.  Beautifully appointed, delicious food, tranquil spot to relax.  Be sure to ask about your booking direct credit when you check-in.  I didn't know that was a thing until after we left :/  Overall, the staff was very helpful - had one or two at the lobby bar that didn't want to be interrupted - but otherwise, lovely.

reviews.author: Quest00583087572
reviews.title: PERFECTION
reviews.text: Everything was amazing! Thoroughly enjoyed every aspect of The Scott. Honestly, this was my favorite hotel I've ever stayed at! The hospitality was incredible, the aesthetics of the whole hotel was unbeatable, and the memories made are unforgettable! :)

reviews.author: Verdu Eats
reviews.title: Luscious hidden gem in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
We loved their retro-eclectic-tropical decor that immerses you in a tropical-like paradise. Conveniently located right in the center of all Scottsdale’s attractions, walking distance to all things shopping and art. 

We absolutely loved their classic black & white movie nights happening daily on their outdoor bar area.  The rooms have awesome and fun vintage features such as properly working turntables featuring lovely vinyl selections, cool MP3 players for the modern ones, and other fun amenity surprises waiting to be discovered by guests. 

Their pool is a tropical garden experience in the middle of the dessert that will allow you to decompress and relax. Food and beverage service also available!

Their bar area is integrated with the huge lobby area which makes it a great place to be since it never gets crowded yet fun to hang around even if you’re not drinking...great happy hour too! 

They also have themed nights featuring different activities such as cigar rolling, backgammon sessions and others. 

Their restaurant is FANTASTIC! I will write another review about this other hidden gem. 

Service was impeccable, decor is fun and chic all over the resort, it is clear that upper management is doing a fantastic job too so congratulations!

Definitely recommend this resort for families, couples or business meetings alike.

reviews.author: Linda L
reviews.title: Conference location
reviews.text:
A beautiful property and hotel. The rooms have been remodeled and are nicely done and very comfortable. We love having a second floor room with the balcony. Sitting out on the balcony listening to the birds while having our morning coffee is a real treat! 
The hotel is clean, friendly and helpful staff and is within walking distance of restaurants and shopping.

reviews.author: Monica H
reviews.title: The Scott Resort, Scottsdale AZ
reviews.text: This hotel has an outstanding bell staff, lovely lobby and enticing pool area that looks ready to provide plenty of R & R.  But looks are deceiving.  I would never recommend this resort especially during spring training.  It was full of drunks from the 7am jacuzzi full of people bringing glass bottles with them to midday people drinking non-stop (overservice is apparently not a problem because the pool bar never refused service to anyone even if they could barely walk) to nighttime craziness and drunken fights at 2am.  I asked the manager to do something about it midday but NOTHING was done.  Drinks continued to be served. People brought their iwn GLASS containers to the pool. It was insane.  This is not an inexpensive hotel. They did take the resort fee off the bill when we checked out. But we left exhausted and angry not relaxed. Never again.

reviews.author: Culture20863039465
reviews.title: Beautifully landscaped
reviews.text: Pool and landscaping were beautiful. Older hotel with comfy beds. Room was rather warm, staff was friendly, prices were high. No microwave and everything in the room cost extra....even the water. Would not book if I were on a budget vacation.

reviews.author: Pioneer42352458415
reviews.title: Great business trip!
reviews.text: I stayed at The Scott for a work conference and everything was great - the room, the pools and outdoor spaces, and the food! I was lucky to have time for a hike at nearby Camelback, and conveniently used their shuttle service to get there. I would recommend The Scott and would definitely come back for personal travel.

reviews.author: Nancy C
reviews.title: Excellent stay, lovely hotel
reviews.text: This hotel was the site of a conference I attended. I was very pleased with the location and the beauty of this resort. Room was fairly large and comfortable. Nice bathroom with large shower. Food at the hotel was good and room service not horribly overpriced like many hotels these days.

reviews.author: Kgraismeyer
reviews.title: Lake County Bar Association
reviews.text: Very comfortable hotel, good set up for conference; very good breakfast served on patio, good service. Guest room size very adequate; enjoyed our stay very much. Kudos to The Scot for having magnifying mirrors in the bathroom!

reviews.author: maulikandpreya
reviews.title: Utilized the pool area with resort day pass
reviews.text: We were staying around the corner and the resort let us utilize the day pass to use their pool services.   It was a weekday and quite relaxing.  The Canel Club bar inside had great food and drinks as well!

reviews.author: Jessica Armentrout
reviews.title: So Chic
reviews.text: My future sister in law and I stayed here the night before my bachelorette (4/2) and arrived around 11am. Let me preface this by noting that I work in hotel sales and know that early check in is never guaranteed ... however, the front desk agent (I forget her name but she is the sweetest blonde) was able to get us right in and was perhaps my most friendly check in experience I’ve ever had. In addition, valet was superb. We lounged by the pool with food and drinks all day and then relaxed in the evening in the room as we had woken up at 3am to get to the airport. The hotel itself is so chic and like nothing I’ve seen before and the little details surely do not go unnoticed (postcards, key packets, etc.). Thank you to the Scott Resort for making the start of an epic bachelorette... I will be back and will be checking out the spa!

reviews.author: Betsy B
reviews.title: Be aware—booking a suite with a view is not guaranteed.
reviews.text: We booked a King 2 room suite with a lagoon view. It ended up being 2 dark adjoining rooms in the back corner of the hotel with a view of a white wall. The room also smelled like sewer. The hotel moved us to 2 king rooms which was fine but unfortunately they weren’t adjoining like the suite we booked and we were charged for 2 king rooms (which of course is more). Less than ideal. The hotel itself is super chic and the spa is wonderful. I just wished they would have taken care of us a little better for the small fortune we payed. My recommendation—-Definitely make sure you are aware the views are not guaranteed when you book the suite. You may end up in the dark corner rooms like we did.

reviews.author: Sightsee19556546154
reviews.title: Work and Fun
reviews.text: Stayed at The Scott for a business conference but felt like I was on vacation. Beautiful grounds, delicious healthy options for food and great accommodations. The rooms were spacious and the pool had enough lounge chairs and shade for everyone. Meeting rooms were very nice and not kept frigid like other venues. A great experience overall.

reviews.author: Cindy S
reviews.title: Great meeting location.
reviews.text: We loved the pools. There was no elevator to 2nd floor rooms. Lobby was really nice. Plenty of spots to visit and or relax. We're able to walk to lots of shopping and restaurants. There was also a shuttle service.

reviews.author: ligeb
reviews.title: Gorgeous resort in the heart of Scottsdale
reviews.text: We stayed a week at this hotel; I had been wanting to go there for some time after reading an article about great little hotels.  We were not disappointed!  The grounds are truly just as lovely as the photos and the rooms are huge.  Even though it's right on Scottsdale Road, you never hear any street noise.  There are multiple fountains on the property, music is playing, and it's just so relaxing and beautiful.  There is kind of a 'beautiful people' vibe and it's a happening place to be.  It is also easy walking distance to the Fashion Square Mall, with a movie theater and restaurants.  Just a great little boutique hotel, we will definitely stay there again!

reviews.author: Nicole Sheppard
reviews.title: Loved It!
reviews.text: I’ve never been to Scottsdale and was excited to stop by for a few days on the way to Los Angeles. I saw photos of The Scott and thought that it looked amazing but kind of doubted it looking anything like that in person. Well I was totally wrong. The lobby and restaurant area were exactly like the photos- maybe even better! Everyone was so nice and accommodating the entire trip. The room was so comfortable and the upgrades were great, so much attention to detail. My sister in law and I went to the spa and although it’s not the kind of place you can hang out in all day the services and techs were wonderful. 10/10 would stay again!!!

reviews.author: Ali L
reviews.title: Beautiful and great staff
reviews.text: We booked a one night stay at The Scott at the tail end of our Grand Canyon and red rock endeavors as a recoup night before flying out of PHX the following day. The grounds are impeccable and the design throughout the entire property is a desert-chic/mid century modern dream. The rooms are spacious and quaint and very comfortable. The pool is great, food offerings delicious. 10/10, great stay!

reviews.author: 751alfredt
reviews.title: Great place to stay with group or on your own.
reviews.text: The staff was well trained, staff culture was all about taking great care of the guest.  Food was good, Cocktails great, the shuttle service to venues made it so you hardly needed a car.  I recommend the Scott for small group or a nice weekend for two.

reviews.author: Happiness52571814991
reviews.title: Wedding!
reviews.text: We were at the Scott for a wedding and didn't leave the property for the entire weekend. The food was great, the pool perfect enjoyed by us all age 4 to 92. perfect for a family get-a-way. We would love to visit again.

reviews.author: tmt
reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: The Scott has an awesome lobby/bar area complimented by their tasty cocktails. The pool area is nice but fills up quickly on the weekend. The rooms are plenty big and the beds are comfortable. We did not use the "shuttle" but I thought it was a nice feature they offered. My wife enjoyed the spa treatment but was disappointed there were not more spa amenities (i.e. steam room, lounge area, hot tub). All together we had a great stay and would recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: jsiudz
reviews.title: Gorgeous design and great customer service
reviews.text: My husband and I loved our stay at The Scott. The whole hotel is designed beautifully! The food was excellent, the three pools are awesome, and parking is free and easy. It's in a great location- so close to everything in the fashion district.

reviews.author: audigirl06
reviews.title: Lovely Resort - Great Location
reviews.text: My family and I loved staying at the Scott for a much needed spring break getaway.  The resort is beautifully designed and decorated.  The staff is very friendly, our room was very comfortable and the spa was relaxing.  We can't wait to go back!  Please note that they do not have elevators at this resort.  Also, we would have liked the option to have a small refrigerator in the room.  The mini bar cooler is not cold enough to properly store items needing refrigeration.

reviews.author: Brownvincent
reviews.title: The Scott, an easy access oasis
reviews.text: Beautiful resort close to Old Town Scottsdale with easy access to Sky Harbor Airport.  Both the food and atmosphere at the Canal Club were surprisingly good. Overall the service was cheerful and very attentive and La Vidorra Spa was exceptional.

reviews.author: Paul C
reviews.title: Beautiful Tropical oasis in Old Town
reviews.text: It had been a few years and my fiance and I wanted to check out the new restaurant and remodel. The hotel has a very laid back tropical, Bahamas, retro vibe. We loved it! The staff was super nice, the property was very relaxing, and the room was perfect. I would absolutely have another staycation here. Also can't beat the location, close to old town but still a real resort.

reviews.author: Makelagood
reviews.title: Fun and relaxing hotel accessible to best of Scottsdale
reviews.text: The Scott is very well kept with fun and elegant décor, wonderful lounging spaces, and well appointed rooms. The Lagoon room was spacious and equipped with a refrigerator, bar, corner sofa and table, and dressing area separate from bathroom. The avocado toast (includes poached eggs) and the yogurt with fruit platters at breakfast were amazing. The pool area and gardens are lovely.

reviews.author: bree2R
reviews.title: It is a Darling and charming hotel and I highly recommend it
reviews.text: It is a Darling and charming hotel and I highly recommend it. The grounds are beautiful and the room are renovated. The whole feel of the place is just relaxing. The nap in the hammock was priceless!! Hi

reviews.author: twinsisters2016
reviews.title: The Scott
reviews.text: This is a great hotel. The staff is very friendly and helpful. The room was spacious , clean, and had a GREAT coffee maker . The pool is gorgeous, and very family friendly. There is a beach area that leads into the pool which is perfect for little children to play, while parents can supervise. I would definitely  recommend this hotel .

reviews.author: philippe v
reviews.title: Disappointing experience
reviews.text:
We were looking forward to our stay at the Scott to close our Arizona Trip, we were disappointed by the overhaul experience. 
1-This is not a good place for families but more for singles and party crowd. (lots of bachelorette parties and wedding type of event happening there).
2-The value for the money is pretty poor in my opinion (as you add all fees tax room  our rate was about $600/night). 
Our room was overlooking the "lagoon" where they had private parties and music every night so we couldn't enjoy the balcony and had a hard time put the kids to bed.
The pool area is cool but not in tip-top shape.
The lobby space and restaurant is pretty nice to grab a bite or a drink.

reviews.author: bridget_10
reviews.title: Expected better customer service for the money
reviews.text:
Upon arrival when I was given the keys for the room the girl behind the desk said "I think your room is over here somewhere as she was pointing it out on the map", and was not given any information of the property..fitness center, restaurant, pool, activities...
After finding our room, there was no soap, shampoo, lotion or towels in the room and only one robe when there were 2 of us. I asked for the toiletries and a second robe and never got the robe. The only place to put clothes were on a couple of shelves, would have thought there would be a dresser for the price, and only one chair to sit on.  Had to ask for creamer, sugar and coffee every day.  The fridge didn't work and was told an engineer would be over to look at it and 2 hours later nobody showed so I had to call again.  The down comforter was old matted and stained. No activities for adults/kids.
The pool ran out of towels and people would save their chairs by 7:00 am every day so we had to sit on the edge of the pool without a towel-paying $45 resort fee! Not happy!  When I asked the bartender at 10:00 am when the water would be filled in the containers she told me "It will be awhile" and told me to go to the bar for water!  Dirty dishes all around the pool. I ordered salsa and chips and was told they ran out of salsa!
There is an additional $14.95 for in room wifi.  
The bikes are old and tired, I thought the chain was going to fall off and when I asked the bellman to air up the tires for me he told me to just take the other bike.
There should also be coffee in the lobby.  No hellos, good morning from any of the staff.  Not worth the money!!

reviews.author: Excursion18183679881
reviews.title: Spring get away!
reviews.text: What a cool hotel!  Truly unique.  The lobby, grounds, pool and restaurant (delicious!!) were fun and eclectic.  Lots of outdoor lounging areas and fire pits.  The room was spacious and tasteful in a fun retro way.  Our room was poolside and had a great view of the grounds and the lagoon as well as a great patio seating area.  The hotel is central to everything.  Rest of relax.... you can't go wrong at The Scott!!

reviews.author: Paradise26851247166
reviews.title: Business Conference
reviews.text: I would highly recommend this resort to business colleagues and family members. The service was exceptional, the rooms were very well maintained from the cleanliness to fresh linen daily. The fridge was stocked with nice refreshments. If I would have forgotten to bring any toiletries I would not have had any issues because the basics had been provided.

reviews.author: Isabel G
reviews.title: Beautiful piece of paradise
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful place to stay, the area around the pool, the restaurant and the rooms were really nice. There were some trees in blossom that gave it a surreal fragrance. The restaurant and bar were really good. I especially recommend the whiskey cocktail (similar to a Manhattan). The personnel were all very kind and friendly. 
The only area where I didn’t give it a 5starts Was in value, as it is pricey.

reviews.author: GrandTour749745
reviews.title: Fabulous!
reviews.text:
My sister and I stayed here for a sisters/birthday long weekend! 
Our stay was absolutely fabulous! The hotel has a cool Cuban/bohemian vibe! The food was fantastic! The pools were great and the  employee’s were so friendly and helpful! The room was nice and quiet! The shuttle service was great too. The spa treatments we received were fantastic and was what we needed! Can not say enough about the Scott, we hope to make it an annual trip!

reviews.author: JEH-BV
reviews.title: What A Jewel
reviews.text:
Wonderful spot to relax & refresh yourselves!  Great location, yet if you have a room on the inside courtyard you have no idea your in downtown Scottsdale!  The staff is positive and accommodating. The food is great. The bartenders are talented. 

The public spaces are immaculate. And, yet have a very laid back vibe. Very comfy, w fire pits and chair groupings throughout. The remodeled rooms are clean and very functional. The beds are great. 

We will return!  You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Dmora1022
reviews.title: Great Service & Ambiance
reviews.text: Loved the ambiance and music throughout the resort. The drinks and food were spectacular. Great service as well! The lobby was gorgeous and fitting for couples and families to relax in and enjoy the atmosphere.

reviews.author: Patricia B
reviews.title: Exceptional Stay
reviews.text: Great location, hotel ambiance was wonderful, beautiful pools and public areas. Rooms were spotless and well appointed. Food was very good and the complementary shuttle was such a nice service. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Sandra D
reviews.title: Pampered!
reviews.text: The lobby and resort grounds are impeccably designed and maintained for a welcoming and relaxing experience.  The staff is friendly and responsive.  We appreciated having a free shuttle to get us to dinner when the walk was just a bit beyond our energy level.  Location is convenient to whatever we needed.

reviews.author: Lindsleo15
reviews.title: LOVE THIS PLACE
reviews.text:
First of all the décor is amazing. Our rooms were CLEAN, the staff was SUPER friendly and the shuttle was awesome.  Eat at the cabana club, I posted pics on the yelp review of the yummy ceviche I had, chicken tortilla soup which was to die for and their cobb salad. benny was an amazing bartender, he's been there for over 30 years.
Very accommodating place. Location is everything, you can literally walk everywhere but  they also have provide bikes to ride. The pool is awesome, its heated year round which I think is great. 
I am super picky about the hotels I stay at and I just absolutely loved this place so much that I am bringing the hubby and the kid back. Thanks to The Scott for our mamas getaway weekend.  We enjoyed it so much. We slept like babies in those comfy beds, you have a great team over there. we were really surprised about how cool and friendly the staff was.
Stay at this place. you will not be disappointed :)

reviews.author: i2smile
reviews.title: Cool retro vibe
reviews.text:
My family & stayed here our first night in Scottsdale. It’s about 15 minutes from the airport and walking distance to many fabulous shops & restaurants in Old Scottsdale. 
Upon entering you immediately forget that you are off a busy street. It’s chic & retro, with Havana flair. Check in was fast and the valet guy was super nice. I appreciated that he explained our options without being pushy to valet the car. Our room was decent, two queen beds, desk & chair. The AC wasn’t working in our room so I reached out via the welcome text I received and had a response in minutes. They sent an engineer right away who was able to fix the problem immediately. He even gave us a fan to help cool off the room faster. Beds were fine, not great but not bad. Our patio faces the street so nothing to look at there. I’d recommend getting a room that faces the courtyard. 

We had breakfast at the hotel restaurant, food & specialty coffee drinks were excellent. 

Took our daughter swimming at the beach section of the pool. There were 2 ducks swimming in the pool which she thought was awesome. Pool is heated to a perfect temp & towels are provided. Area needed to be cleaned from day prior as there were spilled drinks in the sand and used utensils that people didn’t dispose of properly. 

Overall it was an enjoyable stay.

reviews.author: Seaside10786183259
reviews.title: Improvements to be made and great service.
reviews.text: Free coffee no matter where you get it including the bar. Toilets not smashed against the shower glass room 562. Loved the people out front when arriving or leaving or shuttling. They were great! The grounds were beautiful.

reviews.author: TsiporahBlair
reviews.title: Scottsdale Honeymoon
reviews.text: The hotel is just as adorable as it looks online! I would spring for the rooms that face into the pool and courtyard area though, since the outer rooms really just face the parking lots and I wouldn't have been as please with that. Above all, the food was the real surprise of the trip. We expected to enjoy the local restaurants (and of course we did, with some great recommendations from the hotel) but what we weren't expecting was not even wanting to go out to restaurants because of how incredible the hotel food was! Fresh crescents with jam every morning in bed, lunch by the pool, and dinner in the hotel lobby every night would have been just fine. Not to mention, a few stops at the excellent spa! We highly recommend!

reviews.author: Roving68499124819
reviews.title: Exceptional service, clean comfortable and fun soace
reviews.text: We were hugely impressed with the service at The Scott. Staff consistently went out of their way to accommodate our needs. I’m a nursing mom and was away from my baby for the weekend, they stored milk for me in the staff freezer and gave me a place to pump even after we had checked out but before leaving the property.  The room was clean and quiet with well chosen interiors, crisp sheets and comfortable beds. The pool was a nice place to hang out though I can see that they might want to upgrade it in the coming years. The food was very good, I will happily return here with friends and family.

reviews.author: LCDQueen
reviews.title: Amazing stay over Spring Training
reviews.text: I can't recommend this property enough, we will be back next year!  Great staff, service, food, drinks, location and pool!  The food and drinks were unique, really flavorful - Recommend the Cubano, Caribbean Benedict and the Very be careful =).  The firepits were relaxing, the pool area made you feel like you were truly in an oasis - not overly crowded.  All the staff was friendly and very helpful.  It was great to have the shuttle to take you to Old Town or Scottsdale Stadium vs having to Uber.  Be sure to tip the drivers - so friendly and great recommendations!

reviews.author: Flyer32245338201
reviews.title: Lush Grounds But Sparse Rooms
reviews.text: The location of this hotel is perfect for walking to old Scottsdale, which we did.  Also, the grounds are lush, artistic and beautiful.  We loved the lobby, restaurant and outdoor sitting areas with the lovely 30's, tropical/Cuban/out-of-Africa feel.  Our only disappointment was our room, which had no chairs and was very sparse for the price, and it did not match the rest of the superb quality.

reviews.author: Amarah
reviews.title: The Best AZ Staycation
reviews.text: I'm an AZ local and native so have stayed at several of the resorts and spas since I've lived in AZ. I was extremely impressed with The Scott from the staff, to the decor, to the room, pool, and spa. My fiance coordinated a surprise engagement and the staff was incredibly helpful and made every detail special. I highly recommend The Scott if you are looking for a staycation or getaway to AZ.

reviews.author: keturah627
reviews.title: Different feel
reviews.text: My husband and I enjoyed our stay. It has a tropical feel, other than the usual desert feel like the other hotels have to offer. Book directly and you can get a free drink. They also provide free shuttle to and from restaurants. Food and pool is great. Rooms very spacious.

reviews.author: Amanda A
reviews.title: A work trip turned tropical paridise.
reviews.text: Everything with my stay was amazing. The staff, the facilities, the ambiance... truly a great getaway. The bell service went above and beyond with my packages for my work event. The front desk was so accommodating with mail I needed to send out. The bartenders were extremely courteous and the amenities were perfect. Cannot wait to return!!

reviews.author: Candice S
reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: Friendly staff and beautiful property. over priced for experience. Check in was very late 4 pm. Pool was nice, you can tell room has been renovated, not as nice as expected. Bathroom has glass shower that doesn't close all the way so fairly cold when you shower. Bathroom was so small hard to close the door behind you.

reviews.author: travel4girls
reviews.title: Amazing Stay!!!!!
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about the Scott Resort. From the moment we walked in, we were impressed with the decor and the service. We were able to check in early and our room was incredibly clean and smelled amazing. We had a balcony overlooking the lagoon. The rooms are very modern and the design is incredible. We rode bikes to breakfast which they rent out for free. The service is top notch and you feel like you’re in paradise. This is probably on my top 5 list of best hotels I’ve stayed at around the world. Would not hesitate to stay again. Cannot wait to return.

reviews.author: FreeholdNewJersey
reviews.title: Love love LOVE it here
reviews.text: This is the second time my wife and I have stayed here, in 2018 and 2019, essentially for spring training baseball. This is a boutique resort located close to Old Town, with lots of outside bars and restaurants nearby. We asked for the same room we had last year, very private with a lagoon and pool view, and we got it. Staff is great, always very helpful and courteous, 5 star staff, especially Kristen who always had our early morning coffee ready to go with a bright, cheerful smile. Very modern, big rooms with lots of charging ports  and a large private balcony. Very affordable too, compared to other resorts of this level here. Great outside fire pit areas where you can enjoy a nice glass of wine or cocktail before or after dinner. Bathrooms are a little tight tho very modern with a large shower area. This is a great resort, I would highly recommend the Scott.

reviews.author: AGuerin02
reviews.title: Great property, would definitely stay here again
reviews.text: I stayed here while my husband was on a business trip. I decided to escape January in New England ! The hotel was fabulous, cool decor and very clean. The pools were relaxing and the out door spaces were well maintained and fun. The hotel staff were very helpful and friendly and the shuttle service they offered was very convenient!

reviews.author: Relax60251272010
reviews.title: Nice location, friendly staff, needs updating
reviews.text: Several of the staff were very helpful and friendly and should be commended. Their rooms size or adequate, the bathroom/shower room was very hard to maneuver, and the low ceilings made it peel cramped.  I enjoyed the music by the pool during the day, but when the music persisted 24 hours, and there is no one by the pool, it lost his charm and was more of an annoyance that kept us awake as the speakers were just outside of our room.

reviews.author: Kyle K
reviews.title: An escape from surrounding retail!
reviews.text:
Stayed here with my significant other as a staycation. I had not visited here before, but passed it many times, so I wanted to see what it was all about. As soon as you walk through the front doors, you're immediately taken away to a different world. Plenty of greenery and water, safari like theme. Staff was attentive and friendly the entire time we stayed. The room we had was a king, lagoon facing room. We didn't have much to see, but the grounds are tranquil so we kept the door open to listen to the waterfall. 

We had drinks and dined at the Canal Club and nearby bar. It was incredible. The drinks, food, and staff were knowledgable and very friendly. We want to visit again soon, and this time, hit up the spa!

reviews.author: Amanda T
reviews.title: Here on business, but will return for pleasure in the future!
reviews.text: The Scott is a wonderful resort. I've been twice now for work conferences, and each time has been excellent. The service is wonderful, they provide anything you can possibly want, and the resort is gorgeous. The room is comfortable, pool is perfect, and the restaurant/bar, while expensive, is lovely and quite convenient. The location is convenient to lots of stuff in Scottsdale- walking distance to shopping, restaurants, activities, and Camelback Mountain! Plus, the complimentary shuttle service will take you anywhere within a few miles. I have nothing negative to say about either one of my stays. I hope to return, for pleasure, sooner than later!

reviews.author: A2Member
reviews.title: The Scott Feels Intimate
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my time at the Scott.  I spent a week here with my wife and we were very impressed overall with the hotel.  The hotel itself is good size, but not at all overwhelming.  I believe it has about 200 rooms.  The rooms surround a very nice central area that has a pool and lounging areas.  When you are in this area, you really feel like you are away even though you are right on the corner of Scottsdale and Chapparal Roads.  The staff is very friendly and professional.  The rooms are large and have been recently renovated so they are very nice.  I highly recommend a room facing the inner courtyard.  The Scott is also in a great location.  Less thnt a mile walk to downtown Scottsdale. I will certainly return to the Scott the next time I am in the Scottsdale area.

reviews.author: MDG
reviews.title: Nice Grounds; Room Incredibly Disappointing
reviews.text:
I was very excited for our stay at The Scott, as it was our first trip away without our kids in 4 years.  My husband accompanied me to a conference for an extended weekend. Online, it looked like an oasis with bright, beautiful, comfortable rooms,  and I booked a king bed suite for us.
Unfortunately, reality was quite disappointing.  The lobby and grounds are relaxing and inviting, and staff were friendly.  However, our room was not a king bed room - we were told "We can't guarantee room type." Our room was dark, there was no place to sit other than the beds and a small wooden desk chair, bathroom was dark and tiny, and there was a lack of basic amenities such as a luggage rack or any sort of towel rack near the very small sink area.  I suspect these must be the rooms saved for group blocks.  Honestly, if I had been able to see these particular rooms ahead of time, I would not have stayed here, despite the conference being held here.  I wish I could stay somewhere else for the remaining days we have here and have thought about looking for a different hotel, but due to convenience will probably need to stay here and try for a better getaway next time.

reviews.author: Alan Kohler
reviews.title: Staycation in Style for Whole Family
reviews.text:
A thousand thank yous to The Scott for such a wonderful staycation. Our stay was the family weekend we needed, all thanks to the care and kindness of Brandon Howard, Gregory Peck and the rest of the Front Desk team (Reka Szeker and Amber!). Stunning hotel resort with incredible attention to detail and decor. There are 2 wonderful pools (one with a sandy, wade-in beach), a great hot tub, multiple outdoor fire pits, impossibly comfortable beds, and a gorgeous lobby bar and restaurant with great drink and food. Most notably, The Scott manages to be, at once, chic and unassuming, cool and family-friendly. 

Cuddling up last night with cookies and milk and watching some basketball in our incredibly well-appointed room after taking time to relax in the jacuzzi was the perfect Saturday night. I cannot thank everyone here enough, and we are already talking not only about the next chance we will have to come back, but also about who among our friends would love The Scott as much as we do. 

Many, many thanks for helping us get our family-time refresh, and congratulations on all of the work and detailing done across the property that makes the Scott an impressive upgrade from its previous iteration as the Firesky.

reviews.author: PearlieGirl
reviews.title: Nice hotel but service is unpredictable
reviews.text:
The hotel grounds are lovely and the room was very nice.  Comfortable beds.  Our room was facing the parking lot and a busy street but overall it was pretty quiet.  The decor of the hotel and room are very nice.  

There were a few quirks about the hotel that we noted.  The people who work here are really nice but it seems like the hotel is understaffed.  The food is excellent at the restaurant, but when we arrived for breakfast and told the hostess we had booked the breakfast package, and asked her how that worked, she said “I have no idea.”  My husband had to walk to the front desk to ask how the breakfast package we booked worked.  It is a little weird - we paid extra for the breakfast package but then the “package” is just $30 towards breakfast in the hotel restaurant.  We may as well have just booked the lower cost room and paid for breakfast ourselves.  

We spent some time outside at the pools (one is heated, one is not) but the day was cool, so apparently the hotel sent the pool staff home.  We had to keep going back inside to the bar to order food and drinks.  The poor bartender seemed completely overwhelmed having to handle both the bar and everyone from the pool ordering food.  Finally, we went for dinner in the restaurant.  It was booked (understandable for a Saturday night) so we sat in the lobby.  Connor our waiter was fantastic, but again the lobby was really crowded and I don’t think they had enough staff on for the amount of customers.  

This is a lovely hotel but when paying almost $500/night for a room, it seems like they need to focus less on the ambience and more on service. We felt kind of badly for the staff here, who seem to be working very hard but just can’t keep up with the volume of people.

reviews.author: Carina T
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel but no housekeeping
reviews.text:
In the 48 hours of our stay, housekeeping never cleaned our room once. We had the "refresh"sign up every time we left (which was often!). We had a busy trip so coming back to an unmade room with old towels was not ideal.
