Ask for a room in the building behind or to the right of the pool (near the spa). Our room had a lovely view of the parking lot....

reviews.author: Cabogirl11
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.text: I only stayed one night and I wish that it would have been much longer.  The hotel where my conference was being held was booked the night before it started, so I stayed at The Scott.  The hotel is so adorable and the service was fantastic!  The bellman were so helpful.  They brought me to my appointment at a hair salon and also picked me up.  The front desk was very helpful.  My room was very spacious and clean.  I loved all of the hotels amenities.  I highly recommend this hotel!

reviews.author: tim m
reviews.title: Work and play
reviews.text: Great meeting location and clean, elegant rooms. Great service, good food, pools, hot tubs and a shuttle that takes you to and from old town.  I would stay here again away from work. Used to be fire-something.

reviews.author: Sean R
reviews.title: Resort in Scottsdale town
reviews.text: Nice resort in Scottsdale.  Lobby is nice with a cool bar to hang out in the evening.  The rooms were nice and colonial style. Would recommend getting a room facing the pool and not out to the car park.  However, I was a bit disappointed with the customer service.  I feel like the staff needs more formal training.  For instance, I was speaking with guest relations and half way through the conversation the individual turns to pick up a phone call. Not sure if this is just Scottsdale behavior or specific to the hotel, but there needs to be a bit of management attention focused here especially at a venue where you are paying north of 300 usd per day.  Otherwise a pleasant stay in the heart of Scottsdale.

reviews.author: 172davidfs
reviews.title: Business Summit
reviews.text: Been here twice and always a great time. Great time of year to visit Scottsdale too. Great food! Breakfast, lunch and dinner Excellent bar. Excellent hospitality. Awesome patio to sit at night. Very nice rooms, roomy! Bus transportation to sites.

reviews.author: Laura J
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: The Scott is located near downtown Scottsdale on Scottsdale Road, the main drive.  It is one block from Fashion Square Mall, two blocks from 5th Avenue and the beginning of the shopping district.  My husband golfed every day (not at The Scott, it does not have a golf course), and I walked to downtown to shop.  The hotel itself is lovely.  It has a very nice pool area.  The rooms are large.  You definitely want a poolside room, otherwise you're facing a parking lot.  I believe all rooms have a balcony. I don't think there is a better located hotel that is as lovely as The Scott.  We used the spa and it was very nice.  Also, it has a shuttle that will take you anywhere within three miles.  We will stay there again.

reviews.author: JVFH
reviews.title: Cute hotel with great ambience - a few small issues
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at The Scott with a fellow mommy friend for a long weekend. The staff were so friendly all around, check in was a breeze and we even found out they have a hotel shuttle to take you anywhere within 3 miles!!! The driver's were SO friendly and helpful.

Upon heading to our room on the beautiful grounds we admired the pool, the bar area and the lush landscaping. We were, in general quite happy with our room and its spaciousness (and private patio!!) However we had to call to request toilet paper, robes and a hairdryer....none of which were in our room to begin with (head scratch). Once requested, they did deliver VERY quickly and gave us 2 drink vouchers for the mistake which was a good "save" but the next day they didn't replenish toilet paper or towels. To be honest,  if our beds hadn't been made I might have assumed they didn't refresh our room. Just kind of odd for a 4 star resort/spa. Also, though they did give us vouchers there was no stipulation as to what sort of drinks and when we ordered at canal club bar the bartender informed us they didn't qualify but honored them anyway. So again, a fair number of hiccups for 3 nights but all were dealt with properly I think. 
The food in the restaurant was yummy for breakfast and the entire place is totally Instagram worthy.
They have awesome seating indoors and outdoors with fire pits that we took full advantage of while sipping on drinks after dinner.
I'd totally stay at The Scott again but with the knowledge that there will likely be those same sorts of hiccups. It certainly did not dampen our trip but perhaps we were able to swallow those better since we were splitting a room at a rate we got via Priceline rather than the $400+ per night regular price tag. I suspect we would have been a bit more irritated had that been the case.

Still, I'd be hard pressed to not stay here when I return to Scottsdale.

reviews.author: The Z’s
reviews.title: Oasis in the Desert
reviews.text: My wife and I decided to have a “Staycation” recently in Scottsdale and we had a friend recommend The Scott. At check in we were greeted by Raika who was extremely nice , very knowledgeable of her surroundings and helpful during our stay. The entryway is extremely open and beautiful and the Cuban theme throughout the resort is a great touch. Our room was very spacious and again the decor in our room was a great. The bed was comfy and our view from our room was very peaceful, great place for my coffee in the morning. What we love most about this resort was that it felt like you were transported to an island with all of the beautiful trees and greenery. The location is perfectly located with so many amenities close by ,  great entertainment and nearby restaurants although the Canal Club within the resort is fantastic. We loved our stay and will definitely stay again and recommend to others as well.

reviews.author: Lisa H
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text: Loved this boutique hotel!  It has a very inviting vibe.  I loved all of the seating throughout the lobby and patio area.  It was a cool weekend when we were there and they had lots of seating around fire pits!   The food at the restaurant was awesome, especially the salads, although service was quite slow.  Rooms were clean and comfortable

reviews.author: Nathanboh
reviews.title: Clean, polite and good location.
reviews.text: Stayed here during a recent business trip. The staff were very professional and I believe the hotel was just remodeled. The entire place is clean and chic.  We didn’t eat there, but did grab drinks at the lobby bar.  It is close enough to many restaurants and they have a Suburban they will run you around (up to three mile).

reviews.author: Adam Richichi
reviews.title: Chic getaway
reviews.text: The Scott is a chic elegantly curated getaway in Scottsdale, Arizona. The attention to detail in maintaining the esthetic is remarkable. Their staff were professional and friendly. We truly enjoyed our stay. We were intown for a mixture of business and vacation.

reviews.author: Deb K
reviews.title: Great place for business meeting or vacation
reviews.text: I spent three days here for a conference, and hated to leave.  The grounds and buildings are beautiful.  Staff was attentive and friendly.  I loved the delicious cocktails mixed at the Canal Club and the food was definitely a level above the usual stuff you get a conference.  I loved all the outdoor firepits.  I would love to come back here for a vacation and explore the area more.

reviews.author: T4132SYshannonp
reviews.title: Company Convention
reviews.text: Absolutely love this resort!!!  My room overlooked a pond with a fountain and the golf course!  Loved seeing Love Birds flying around also!  The decor and atmosphere was classy, southwestern and polished.

reviews.author: RedBonk
reviews.title: Has potential...needs some polishing.
reviews.text:
The good: location (while on a super busy stripmall/office park weird highway) was good to walk to stuff or get the shuttle to take you. the lobby is crazy nice with high ceilings and updated decor; warm fireplaces but could have offered coffee or tea given it was freezing and unseasonably cold. room was spacious; some of the shuttle drivers were friendly like Shawn who went out of his way to give us some cool tips. 
the bad: need a few more pillows on the bed as it was horribly uncomfortable to watch tv (which we almost never get to do at home so we looked forward to a little netflix night in with take out as I'm pregnant) the towels are painfully scratchy and rough, and the shower contractor must not have tested the shower door width since water pours out onto the floor when you shower, no slippers on a freezing cold floor... silly stuff but were used to lux hotels being all things lux so we took notice. Most notably the staff could be summed up with "indifferent" not saying unfriendly or rude just didnt seem to really care much rather than the service and going out of their way like you expect with lux. We almost felt bad bothering the front desk with our questions at some points. :(

reviews.author: JulieCreech
reviews.title: Won't Regret it!
reviews.text: This Hotel is amazing Staff was great! The shuttle made my stay so much for easier! The Decor of the hotel is amazing as well. Your right in the middle of Scottsdale but once you inside the hotel it does not feel like that at all! It puts you in a tropical paradise! Will definitely be coming back for a longer stay with my Hubby!

reviews.author: Sara Bray McClain
reviews.title: New Years Getaway
reviews.text: We loved the staff and ambience at this remodeled 50’s resort. It’s beautiful and fun! It’s not a run of the mill place in any way. Now, it isn’t a new build, but the renovated decor and amenities present as if it is. Top notch service. Fun bar, lounge like no other, gorgeous for a wedding or event!

reviews.author: NC_Biker750
reviews.title: Could be nice
reviews.text: The facility is nice with lots of pools and fire pits. Nice that they have shuttle for 3 mi area and bicycles to use.  Staff were pleasant. The rooms are not up to par; shower only without door that allows large amounts of water to splash on floor creating a hazard . Room had view of parking lot and dumpster including trash truck noise. Lock on door to balcony was misaligned and would not lock. Room supplies were often incomplete (soap, shampoo, wash cloths or towels. Room initially lacked comforter on bed.

reviews.author: Athienitou
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort & great stay!
reviews.text:
The Scott’s Resort & Spa is a stunning hotel. The rooms are clean & beautifully decorated with simple yet classy decor-rustic western  theme. I loved the eucalyptus leaves in the vase that gave the room such an earthy aroma. 

Great complimentary coffee in the room - Nespresso & fully stocked fridge & alcohol options at a price. 

We had a room with two queen beds & a gorgeous view of the pool area. We did not swim but walked around the pool area & all agreed that it must be super fun in the summer. Close Scottsdale downtown & not too far from other Phoenix attractions such as the MIM & Cactus Botanical Gardens.  Some huge upscale malls nearby too. 

Overall a great stay & we would return if ever visiting Scottsdale again.

reviews.author: Eric V
reviews.title: All we got at the Scott
reviews.text: What a fantastic resort! It had the best pool I’ve seen in a long time, great food and amazing staff! I will definitely be coming here again - it’s a private oasis in the desert. Really close to fashion square, postinos wine bar and all that old town Scottsdale has to offer.

reviews.author: Shanna C
reviews.title: Lovely resort
reviews.text: Really enjoyed my stay at The Scott Resort. I was there for 3 nights for a business trip. The accommodations, food, outdoor space etc was all very nice & relaxing. The food was very good & service was excellent. Love the fountains in the lobby & seating space. I would travel back for personal use anytime!

reviews.author: Nicole D
reviews.title: Amazing Stay at the Scott
reviews.text:
The property was beautiful! We stayed for 4 days 3 nights for business conference. The good was good, the grounds well kept. 
I loved the shuttle service that runs from 6AM-11PM and will drop you off within 3 miles, and pick you back up. 
The meeting rooms and banquet halls were all perfect! I couldn’t get my temperature right in the bedroom,and I wish I had an empty mini fridge and microwave (they did hVe a well stocked fridge with items for purchase)  but other than everything was to satisfaction. I’d return.

reviews.author: Jessica M
reviews.title: Great hotel for a relaxing getaway
reviews.text: Great facilities and friendly staff made for a great weekend stay.  The bar and pool created a central hangout place that was perfect for socializing and enjoying the weekend with a group of friends.  The bar had top notch bartenders with many amazing cocktails on the menu. The pool and hotel grounds were beautiful, making this hotel feel like a resort with a Cuban vibe.  The hotel offered a free shuttle service to places around town that we used often.  Rooms were large and spacious.

reviews.author: Tiffany C
reviews.title: So Trendy!
reviews.text: We had a fabulous stay. The staff was extremely nice & the grounds are gorgeous. This place is “picture perfect.” The beds are comfortable too! We’d definitely stay here again. Can’t wait to come back next time we’re in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Erin
reviews.title: Great rooms
reviews.text: The hotel overall was excellent. The food at the restaurant was good, but the service IN the restaurant was lacking overall. The rooms are comfortable and elegant without being pretentious. I was disappointed there was no bathtub, only a very nice shower.

reviews.author: Marcel C
reviews.title: Great option; very nice remodel
reviews.text:
Had I not known this was previously FireSky, I would never have recognized it. The Havana / Cuban remodel is beautiful and has a great vibe minus the usual pretentiousness you get with other Scottsdale resorts. The service is great, starting with being greeted outside and led to the front desk.  The old black/white films projected on the patio are a nice touch, and who can ever resist a good fire pit and cozy blankets on a cool desert night. 

I wish there were a few more amenities, but the location puts you walkable to everything you might need and the free hotel shuttle within a 2-3 mile radius is very nice.

Staff is friendly and helpful, just remind the front desk to program your room card to match your late check-out so yo don’t get locked out like we did. 

Great food and service at both the Canal Club restaurant and lobby bar.  

Well done!

reviews.author: GoGoIrene
reviews.title: Loved this hotel!
reviews.text: I loved our stay at The Scott.  The hotel rooms were spacious, comfy, and offered pretty views to the garden/pool.The pool, garden, hammock, fire pits, Canal restaurant, and beautiful lobby were all a delight.  Landscaping was gorgeous. Design was urban chic w/ soft touches to make it inviting and funky with the touch of traditional.  Evening themes of "game night" and "movie night" were great for the family/kids.  FIre pits and delicious cocktails were perfect for the adults.  I loved this hotel and will be back!

reviews.author: Kathleen S
reviews.title: Family Reunion Thanksgiving 2018
reviews.text:
We were a group of 25 total adults and children. The Scot was absolute perfection for all of us. The multiple large casual seating areas were perfect for conversations. The pools and hot tub were a real hit with the kids aged 8 to 16.  The vegetation and mature plantings had us feeling we were in the tropics. Rooms were excellent. 
The Scot catered our Thanksgiving Dinner in one of their private banquet rooms - outstanding meal. Most of us enjoyed breakfast daily, a diverse menu with yummy offerings. 
We will return.

reviews.author: Mario
reviews.title: Sunny Scottsdale
reviews.text: Had a fabulous day at the Scott Resort and Spa excellent rooms very nice pool walking distance to shopping and restaurants end very close to several top notch golf courses very friendly staff that go out of their way to make sure your stay is top notch highly recommended can't wait till next year

reviews.author: Food great, not very friendly
reviews.title: Terrible experience!  Please, please, please select another hotel.  You will regret this one!!
reviews.text: The location of this hotel is great but that is where it ends.  The hotel staff at this hotel are indifferent and could really care less about customer service. Our room was noisy (situated along Scottsdale Road), our room was in disrepair; closet doors were terribly difficult to open, outdoor patio chairs were broken and no one appeared to fix them in the course of our 10 day stay.A fight broke out on our floor in the middle of the night.  Police were called; man was yelling that he didn’t have a weapon, woman was crying and screaming.Huge party the last evening of our stay, we couldn’t sleep.  Ordering at the bar and poolside was very difficult.  Young staff were busy visiting with friends and not interested in attending to guests.

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.title: Wedding Weekend
reviews.text:
A beautiful venue to go to a wedding!  We had a room for two nights on the second floor.  All of our needs were met.  The fridge was stocked with beer, soda, candy, etc.  There was a bottle of wine available as well as water and coffee.  The beds were comfortable and room was very clean.

The courtyard and pool area are spectacular, and where we spent the majority of our time.  There is a bar at the poolside and another in the main lobby area.  The staff was extremely friendly and helpful.  Our cleaning lady gave us a few extra towels when we requested.  Will, the bartender, turned on the football game for us, and made sure we were in good hands! :)

If you’re looking for something cheap, move on.  But if you’re willing to pay for what you get, I think you’ll find this place meets the mark.

If I could make ONE change, I would have gotten one of the rooms that faced the courtyard.  The rooms on the outside do not have any good views.  It would have been so pleasant in the morning to drink your coffee from the patio and look over the foliage.  Next time.  :)

reviews.author: shadamai
reviews.title: Beautiful Property!
reviews.text: This was by far the most beautiful place I have ever stayed!  The lighting and atmosphere at night gave it the wow factor from the moment we pulled in.  The gentleman at the front door was welcoming and the lady at the front desk was pleasant and efficient at check in.  It was nice to sit outside at a fire pit and relax with a drink from the bar after a long day.  With the nighttime lighting and landscaping, the ambiance was that of tropical luxury.  I do wish the pool had been open a bit later; we had arrived later than planned and weren't able to enjoy a lot of the amenities.  If in the area again, I would want to come back when we have more free time to enjoy the property.

reviews.author: Annakru
reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text:
My husband and I booked a room at The Scott for a long weekend stay.  Overall we were pleased- here are my takeaways.  

1.  Pool area is half sun, half shade.  The palm trees are beautiful, but if you want a sunny spot by the pools you may be out of luck.  The sunny spots go fast.  

2. The location is great, walkable to many bars and restaurants, plus they have a shuttle service that will take you up to 3 miles from the resort.  This is great if you don’t have a car.  If you have a car, and don’t mind using it, you could save a lot of money by staying a little farther out.  You’re paying in large part for location.  

Overall we had a nice stay- no complaints.  The staff were all friendly and the room was nice.

reviews.author: Melanie M
reviews.title: Beautifully appointed room
reviews.text: We only stayed one night at this resort as we were flying out the next day. We liked its  proximity to shopping and restaurants. The resort and our room was simply beautiful, very tastefully appointed. Unfortunately someone had smoked in the room at some point and the smell was unmistakable along with whatever deodorizer the hotel used to try to get rid of it. There was even a half-smoked cigar on the patio that wasn't cleaned up.Given that we were only staying one night, we didn't bother to try to get a room switch. We did mention it at checkout though. The front desk person was very apologetic and offered to waive the resort fee.Other than that one thing, we had no complaints about our stay.

reviews.author: TravlingAZGirl
reviews.title: Beautifully Done Resort
reviews.text: My sister and I had a sister weekend at this resort. It is very clean, kind of old school, but also very modern in the ways we enjoyed. I would definitely recommend this resort, the restaurant, and the delicious drinks!

reviews.author: Mommadukes123
reviews.title: Wonderful Resoet
reviews.text:
First visit to Scottsdale certainly not what I had expected. I  though the resort would be in the middle of the desert something out of old movie well certainly not the case. Located blocks from a mall for those they may not have brought everything with them. 
Starbucks within 4 minute walk
 The staff has been awesome since check in and throughout our conference. While only one restaurant on site the food has been outstanding. Other restaurants nearby and free shuttle within a 3 mile radius. Hotel has Great variety including gluten free, though gluten  free snacks limited to muffins. 
Would come back on vacation worth the 5 1/2 plane trip from the east.

reviews.author: Sandycor
reviews.title: Luxury Resort
reviews.text: The Palms is a lovely place, with lots of activities in season, and entertainment (extra cost). We were there in Sept (too hot) so activities had not yet started.  The grounds are lovely, many plants and flowers in the public areas, and the lots that have been sold have been landscaped to their owner's taste.  The two pools were wonderful, and very very clean, as was the whole resort.  If we ever get back to Mesa, we will certainly stay there again, if there are any vacancies.  Staff was friendly and helpful. Five stars.

reviews.author: Compass43783560485
reviews.title: Throwback gem in the middle of Scottsdale
reviews.text: Stayed at The Scott for a work conference and it was a wonderful time. Rooms are great (comfortable and clean) and the resort is themed to perfection (see bar in lobby) I highly recommend this place for any occasion.

reviews.author: Plumamazing
reviews.title: Havana Nights
reviews.text: You immediatley feel like you're in Cuba or Miami. This hotel is very retro, modern, and has a cuban like style. I almost forgot I was in Arizona. The resort is so nice. There were 2 pools, a lagoon area, hammocks, hanging swings, fire pits, and more. The rooms have nice sized balconies and rooms. I was at a conference and I tell ya what, it was like a life of luxury. We had so much food with such great hospitality. The hummus and pita chips were AMAZE BALLS. I STILL think about it. I thoroughly enjoyed my short trip. My only negative experience was room service, because they forgot my water. I will say, I wish there were more restaurants in the hotel, but they are ao close to MANY restaurants, within walking distance. I highly recommend this resort. Clean. Comfortable beds. Large rooms. I was not at all disappointed.

reviews.author: Jeffrey B
reviews.title: Great visit and service
reviews.text: From the front desk, to the bar tenders and waitstaff to the events and shipping people this hotel is incredible.  The food was great too.  Comfy beds and a cool outdoor space.  Not enough words to describe

reviews.author: chip356
reviews.title: Nice stop - good location
reviews.text:
Had a quick stopover here, and was pleasantly surprised!  Rooms were pleasant, although the hallways and common areas are a little dated.  But a nice courtyard pool area with a sand beach area!

Restaurant was nice and food was good. Service was excellent, and enjoyed the stay.

reviews.author: chitv00
reviews.title: The Scotts Resort
reviews.text: 名前が変わったみたいです！とても可愛くておしゃれなホテルでした！バスタブはないですが水周りも使いやすかったです。近くのファッションスクエアモールにも徒歩で行けるので、次回もリピートしたいホテルです♪

reviews.author: H G
reviews.title: We had an amazing time
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at the Scott.  Although the place is top tier, the people working at "The Scott" were probably the best I have every met (and I have been traveling for business and pleasure for over 30 years).  Raika at the front desk always had a smile on her face and went out of her way to help us with whatever we needed.  Ron greeted us with a smile when we drove up to the hotel and told us all about the hotel amenities and where to go once we settled in.  Christine, the barista started our day with a great cup of coffee and a smile.  Jordan....there is nothing better than sitting at the pool drinking martinis and eating fruit-->thanks Jordan.  Finally, Sasana immediately facilitated all our needs and requests in our room.  Thanks to all.  You made a much needed vacation great, relaxing and memorable.  We will be back.

reviews.author: David D
reviews.title: Centrally located but too corporate
reviews.text: Stayed for two nights before beginning a tour of Arizona and New Mexico. Located 1 1/2 miles from the Old Town. We had a quiet room at the back of the complex however don't expect fine dining, they have a bar serving food. Apparently restaurant closed 12 months ago Felt like a conference hotel. Helpful front desk.

reviews.author: ratnrol
reviews.title: Could be so much better
reviews.text:
Weekend away with my wife and 3 other couples.

The good:
 - Location to Old Town Scottsdale, shopping and restaurants
 - Resort is nicely decorated and laid out
 - Rooms were spacious and quiet
 - Bellmen, restaurant staff and front desk staff were excellent
 - Restaurant food was good and decently priced

The not so good:
 - Resort fee. Yes, I knew about it ahead of time. Didn’t feel like I received value for money. You get basic wifi but add a premium wifi for another ~$11/night. Surely the resort fee would cover this
 - Service in the lounge area inside or outside is poor to say the least. There are people there but they don’t know how to be efficient. Like they bring one drink out at a time instead of a tray of drinks. We often just went to the bar to self-serve and then walk back to our tables. This was every day of a 3 night stay.
 - $13 for well and mixed drinks. When you are hanging around the resort during the day it adds up.

Overall the resort fees, high drink prices and service in lounge area soured out experience. Unlikely to be back.

reviews.author: Lauren A
reviews.title: Great Scott
reviews.text: Our stay at the Scott was nothing short of amazing. Nate, the bellman, was extremely accommodating and charismatic. He made us feel so comfortable. He made our shuttle ride back so much fun and even sang with us to ridiculous music to make sure we had a great time in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: amv21290
reviews.title: Love this hotel!
reviews.text: Most beautiful hotel I’ve ever been to! Amazing decor, service and food! Nate the bellman was especially amazing and made us feel so welcome! The lobby is one of the most gorgeous places I’ve ever seen. We will definitely the back!!

reviews.author: Elizabeth073
reviews.title: Super cute grounds but lacking in service
reviews.text: We LOVED this hotel when we walked in.  The design is adorable and there is much attention to detail.  But, from check in, the customer service was lacking.  We got a room that had work that wasn’t finished - it smelled strongly of glue and the shower was in pieces.  The front desk was really rude about a package that was delivered, she said it couldn’t have arrived even though Amazon showed it had.  The pool staff was totally overwhelmed during the day with old dishes piled up, no towels, nobody taking orders at the chairs.  We paid way too much for the service we received.  We are still here and are waiting 20 minutes and counting on drinks from the bar.  We will stay at one of the other resorts which are better staffed with trained professionals the next time we are in town.

reviews.author: inesalice
reviews.title: SO SO
reviews.text:
I am not happy with this choice.
The first room we had was available at 2pm. It was a courtyard room at the first floor. when we got there, the room door was open. the room was large but there was a terrible smell and  We asked to be moved to an upper floor. At 415pm the second room was finally available. The new room was large, with a large balcony facing the garden. No major issues with the room but:
No chairs available. If you have to work there is no way to do it because there are no chairs where to sit. Desk but no chairs. No chairs or ottomans. Only the bed. There is a nespresso machine available in the room but if you want a tea there is no way. Bathroom is ok. Poor and super basic vanities. With the hairdryer on the light in the room loose intensity. Ahaha
The room is simple and it reminds an old mission cell.
The hotel offers a shuttle service that can take you anywhere for free within 3 miles range (or at least that's what they say). Last night we requested this shuttle service to go to the royal palms for dinner (there is a very nice restaurant inside the resort) and they said the restaurant was out of range. According to Google maps, the awarded 5 stars restaurant T Cook was not more that 2.7 miles far from here but they refused to take us anyway. 
The front desk personnel was not particularly friendly or nice, except for a Serbian girl. Every time I called them to book the car and for the room they didn't sound happy to assist at all. The guys at the lobby were very nice, helpful and kind, as well as the guy who brought the bags.
I tried to book an appointment at the spa but unfortunately there was no availability so I can't review it. 
The pool looks nice. The garden around is nice but the beds area is kinda small.
I was looking for some leaflets or magazines in the room to discover the area a little but nothing is available,  not even a  pen or a piece of paper. In the closet,the laundry paper is there  but unfortunately, not the bag. 
If I would come back to Scottsdale I would definitely  not stay here again. 
I travel often to Scottsdale and I wanted to give this place a try 
But i must say, it is possible to find nicer resorts at the same price. A positive side Is the hotel location which is close to old town and fashion square

reviews.author: othellomoto
reviews.title: Qualité et raffinement
reviews.text:
Très bel établissement , les chambres sont très spacieuses et très bien agencées autour d’un complexe aquatique simple et raffiné. Literie d’excellente qualité , la restauration est particulièrement soignée et le personnel très avenant .excellente 
adresse

reviews.author: Pittsburghparents
reviews.title: Conference stay, great location
reviews.text: Stayed here for 5 nights for a conference.   Nice location, it is a boutique hotel.  Definitely an adults style hotel.   Keep in mind, there are no elevators, so choose a room wisely.  Many of attendees had problems with their door locks.  I had to call 3 times to get mine fixed, as the door would just unlock on its own!   The facilities and grounds are very nice.   The shuttle service and front door staff are awesome!!  Quality customer service!   Beds are great.  Loud, late-night weekend visitors are easily heard in the enclosed, long hall corridors.  Walking distance to Fashion Square mall and possibly Old Town, if you are up for it.

reviews.author: ksmith592
reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: Very nice resort. The way it's setup and the nicely landscaped grounds make you feel like you're in an exclusive retreat far from the world -- not right on a busy road with lots of activity around you. The rooms are very nice, the décor very current, and the service excellent.

reviews.author: jcaiell0
reviews.title: Double check the honor bar
reviews.text: I stayed for a business conference at the hotel. The hotel was nice and most of the staff was very friendly. However, they still use an honor bar system and of course I was charged for an item that was not used by me. I told the front desk that no bottle of water was used and they assured me that I would not be charged. Of course, I was charged.

reviews.author: Peggy
reviews.title: Perfect Escape
reviews.text: Loved staying here!  The way the hotel is set up (5 buildings surrounding a peaceful interior courtyard with hot tub, lagoon and pool) was beautiful!  We had very good service from hotel personnel throughout our stay (they went above and beyond), although the bartenders were more focused on doing their duties than interacting with patrons.

reviews.author: Paul M
reviews.title: Room with a view
reviews.text: We only had a standard room, but when we opened the doors to the patio we looked onto a brick wall, not great, this should have been a real cheap room, but we upgraded for $10 to a room with a better view. Nice hotel, nice setting, nice people

reviews.author: Beremerino
reviews.title: Nice and chic
reviews.text:
Hermoso hotel boutique, la atención muy buena.
Estuvimos hospedados por un congreso, los salones del hotel muy comodos, la comida buena.
El gimnasio esta muy bien equipado.
Al terminar el congreso tenia ganas de quedarme el fin de semana a descansar en su alberca. 
La ambientación de las áreas publicas es muy agradable, por la noche todo lo iluminan con antorchas y las áreas publicas invitan a relajarte y tomarte unos drinks.
Estas a unos pasos de un gran mall lujoso para ir de shopping y muchos lugares nocturnos para salir por las noches.
Definitivamente volvería!

reviews.author: Expedition106891
reviews.title: Rainy wedding
reviews.text: Quaint, comfortable updated retro. Great lobby, bar and outdoor area for relaxing. Yummy drinks and great chill DJ. Beds are comfy, room was quiet and snacks were good. Everyone was super hospitable and accommodating. Will visit again for a spa stay.

reviews.author: trenat2016
reviews.title: Perfect stay!!
reviews.text: This will be my second time here and each time was excellent! Customer service is the best. I love coming here. They have a escalade  that will take you around & pick you up. The grounds are spectacular. Literally an oasis in the desert.

reviews.author: allym20182018
reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.text: This has been an incredible stay. The rooms are so clean and well decorated, the pool area is beyond amazing, and the food is delightful. Friendly staff, reasonable rates- I really don’t have anything negative to say about this place! I will be back!

reviews.author: Mandy in Miami
reviews.title: La Vidora Spa was incredible!
reviews.text: Unfortunately we did not have the pleasure of staying here BUT we were looking for a Spa and stumbled upon this property.  The decor is absolutely gorgeous, it's a 1950's mid century Havana theme, would have loved to see the rooms also...  Carol I believe was the lady that booked our appointment, her recommendations were great, I had a very relaxing Vichy Shower, my therapist was incredible, we even got Palo Santo as a gift when we left, such great service!  When I go back to Scottsdale I definitely want to stay here.

reviews.author: Marnie S
reviews.title: Mother - Daughter Trip!
reviews.text: We had a fabulous time, relaxing, reading, and dining! This property was such an inspiration for decor! Fabulous! The staff was amazing, and the shuttle was handy to get to the mall and Old Scottsdale. The spa was glorious. Food was terrific! I would have like the room service menu to be a little more expansive. And the pool could have been a little cleaner. All in all, a wonderful property and we'd stay here again!

reviews.author: Raderma
reviews.title: Great spot for a relaxing vacation
reviews.text: Great place to stay. Complementary shuttle within a certain distance allowed us to get to Oldtown for dinner without having to worry about parking.  Great staff! Pool area is nice as is the common area inside where there are plenty of places with seating, games, drinks.

reviews.author: MARTINFROMXCH
reviews.title: Really enjoyed this place.
reviews.text:
The Scott is a compact resort with rooms on 2 stories around the perimeter and a tastefully landscaped middle bit containing 2 pools and a Spa pool. We were a family of 4 who stayed 12 nights. We were allocated a standard patio room with a "car park" view but reception staff were happy to reassign us to one of the inner rooms with a much more pleasing veiw of the garden area. There was some refurbishment of rooms and garden landscaping in progress but this was unobtrusive and didn't detract from our enjoyment. Our top floor room was clean, comfortable and spacious enough for 4. The hotel was wonderfully quiet when we arrived and started to get busier towards the end of our stay (Labor Day weekend). Even when the place was full there was still enough space to enjoy the pools and relax in the well shaded seating areas.
The Scott has a slight Cuban theme (mostly via it's menu & music). We ate several times at the hotel - Food always good and not too expensive - the menu was varried enough for all our tastes (including the vegetarians). All the staff were friendly and efficient; from housekeeping to front-of-house staff. A nice touch was the choice of free bicycle rental or a courtesy shuttle within a 3 mile radius (although it's only a few minutes walk to the Fashion Square Mall, we appreciated the air conditioned ride). The Scott was not a cheap option for a 2 week stay (especially when you factor in the nightly resort fee) but given its prime location, great pools and welcoming vibe, I have to say it was worth the money. Would definitely stay again and recommend to friends.

reviews.author: Resa G
reviews.title: Nice Resort needs Repair
reviews.text: The grounds are beautiful  and the bar was Amazing! When we got to our room we were very pleased with the decor and spaciousness of the room. However the building is very old and in need of a few repairs. The shower drain in our room was clogged which greatly limited our shower time to ~4-5 mins. After a very quick shower we had to wait another hour for it to drain.

reviews.author: dazirap
reviews.title: Great location, decor and service.
reviews.text: We just stayed at The Scott for 5 days, 4 nights. Great location in walking distance to restaurants and Fashion Square mall. The rooms were spacious and comfortable. The free SUV shuttle service is great as us the concierge service. Great front desk service too.

reviews.author: Cameron Frye
reviews.title: Great resort!
reviews.text: We stayed here from 9/15-9/19. Great place to stay. Awesome pools and the staff is so friendly. Prime location in downtown Scottsdale makes it convenient to go to places near by without driving very far.

reviews.author: KB2KB2
reviews.title: All This and a High School Art Exhibit Too
reviews.text:
Had previously stayed at other places in Scottsdale and noticed this when it was the FireSky. 
First thing, check in noticed what appeared to be a starving artist or high school exhibit behind the desk. Clerk said it was the owners wife's portraits and we could "enjoy" them throughout the facility.. Sure enough everytime I stood at the toilet there was a picture of a woman staring back at me. I found it odd but am strangely motivated to go to one of their other facilities to see if she ever moved beyond portraits. I guess it is better to buy a hotel then add a wing on to the mansion to exhibit her art.
The facilities are older but very well maintained. We stayed in a reconditioned wing and could see they were working on others. You want an inside facing room as both Scottsdale and Chapparal  are very noisy but inside  pool facing rooms are not.
Pool area is beautiful but since it is kidney shaped it is mostly a stand around pool.
Ate breakfast there and it was great- original stuff like plantain eggs Benedict. Many restaurants in area so did not have dinner here. 
Would I go back? Yes in off season when prices are down but otherwise would probably book at Embassy Suites across the streeet

reviews.author: Kelly O
reviews.title: Amazing service !
reviews.text: Gerardo was around as a security guard and helped us out with drinks last minute and provided amazing service! would definitely recommend coming here! So nice and attentive! Really enjoyed the environment!

reviews.author: 148carolinemcn
reviews.title: Great spot with Mediterranean feel.
reviews.text:
The rooms were pleasant, quiet and had a reasonably upscale feel. Agoda pricing was excellent so the extra $35.00/day facilities fee was fine. Our room was in D block second floor. The view, although looking over parking area still had a nice feel as you could also see residential area. Don’t recommend 1st floor if you do not have select pool or lagoon view, as you will be looking at a wall. Pool and lagoon area were beautiful and clean. Some nice evening entertainment. Steps away from lots of sites and very safe and upscale area. Mostly young party crowd but fine.
Restaurant food was excellent with very casual service.

reviews.author: Kelly S
reviews.title: Almost great!
reviews.text:
The property is great! The shuttle guys were the best people at the hotel! We had a problem with our room and they made us move... no big deal they compensated us for the incovience. BUT.... bartender inside in evening were rude. Bar closed at 11 in a Saturday night....pool staff was lazy! To many empty glssss left around pool while they just stood at bar. This place has the potential of being awesome.... just needs a few tweaks! But I can't say enough about how great the shuttle guys were with rides and recommendations!
Thanks!

reviews.author: Amanda T
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: We had a great time at The Scott! The staff was very polite and eager to help at all times, the Canal Club staff was great and attentive to all details - down to the signature logo coffee cups, and the Spa services were fantastic even while undergoing a renovation! We look forward to returning!

reviews.author: Barbie S
reviews.title: Luxury Resort with Tropical Cuban Flair -
reviews.text: First stay here for business - was so pleased with the upscale Cuban flair of the property - unbelievable team throughout property from Luxury Car Service to and from OLD TOWN Scottsdale ; bar service, pool service - room service ! Delicious food , craft cocktails - many extra surprises - Highly would recommend this property for relaxation in Scottsdale - YOU will love the lush pool area -

reviews.author: bekkifeil
reviews.title: Relaxing Staycation Anniversary
reviews.text:
My husband and I celebrated our 10 year anniversary at The Scott and it was amazing!  The resort is walking distance to everything in Scottsdale yet when you walk through the doors you feel like you are far away from it all relaxing in a chic Cuban resort. The grounds and pool are fabulous and all of the outdoor seating areas offer many little romantic spots to have a cup of coffee or an amazing cocktail from the bar. The staff was phenomenal and went out of their way to ensure everyone is having a great stay. The rooms are gorgeous and super comfy.  It was truly a home away from home.  The food and coffee was delicious and the unique cocktails at the bar were superb.  I took pictures of all the decor so I can dream of redecorating our house someday. 
And if you are traveling with kiddos I know my boys would have loved the sandy beach entrance pool, jacuzzi and the large lawn to play games. 
Oh... and the spa was marvelous. Gracious and accommodating staff especially when we accidentally showed up a half hour late for our appointment. It was the perfect way to kick off our weekend. 
My husband and I highly recommend The Scott Resort to locals and those visiting our beautiful city and state.

reviews.author: Ben C
reviews.title: Relaxing mid week vacation
reviews.text: I stayed here one night midweek before my friends arrived for the weekend. Super relaxing. Room was clean. Staff was very friendly. Food is great. The massage was exactly what I needed. No complaints at all.

reviews.author: Jennifer T
reviews.title: Relaxing "tropical" staycation
reviews.text:
My husband and I just wanted a one night break from being parents, so we picked this place because it had a fun, tropical vibe and you can't beat the proximity to Old Town Scottsdale (especially with the free car service!).

The lobby/restaurant are beautifully decorated - feels like you're walking into a movie set staged for 1950s Havana. The pool is intimate with a gorgeous landscape so you don't feel like you're in a heavily populated area. We really enjoyed the feel of the room, as well; we also got an upgrade to a lagoon view room. Had it been a little cooler outside, I know we would have enjoyed sitting on the balcony!

The wait staff was awesome at both the bar and the restaurant, and everyone we encountered from the staff was really welcoming. 

We would definitely consider a staycation here again!

reviews.author: Jocelyn J
reviews.title: Girls weekend
reviews.text: We loved this place. The location was amazing, the pool was amazing. Had a great girls trip. Food at pool was great. Everyone was so nice and helpful and really made us feel welcome. We can't wait to go back. Only downside was some remodeling was going on and was a little noisy but it was during the daytime. Very cute decor..

reviews.author: teamthompson358
reviews.title: The Scott Staycation
reviews.text: We are so glad we picked The Scott for our anniversary stay-cation recently.  Really impressed with the new renovations they have competed.  Check in was a breeze and they even gave us two free drink vouchers to use at the bar.  We saved them for later in the night when we enjoyed sipping them by the pool.  We were looking forward to using the free bike rentals but it was just too hot to enjoy so we used the complementary car that took us to and from our dinner location.  Our room was a lagoon view king room.  We had a big monsoon that night so it was fun to watch the storm roll in from our patio.  Before the storm hit we enjoyed relaxing in the pool and jacuzzi.  We are sheet snobs and were impressed with the bedding and room set up.  We'll for sure go back in the future and plan to bring our kids next time as they would love the pool area and the movie at night on the patio.  You can't beat the service, rooms and the great location to do things in the area.

reviews.author: desertfoodE
reviews.title: Incredible resort!
reviews.text: Came here for our 4 year anniversary and had a relaxing time. The first night a haboob rolled through and filled the entire pool and poolside with leaves and dirt. By morning, the entire resort was spotless!  Room was very clean and peaceful. Staff was friendly and efficient. Would love to stay every month!!

reviews.author: 2011glen
reviews.title: Good fun, good hotel
reviews.text: This hotel was good. The rooms were nice. The service was a little less desirable.  The food was ok.  The pool area was pretty nice, was pretty crowded.  There are two pool areas.  The bartenders were very nice and made great drinks.  Overall the experience was good, could have been better, but would probably go back.  Not far from the mall area with shopping, food and drink.

reviews.author: Edidtsa P
reviews.title: Late honeymoon/Vacation getaway
reviews.text: It's very clean and housekeeping is in every day. Everyone is very helpful and kind. Once you enter the resort you can no longer hear the sounds of the city it feels like your on a Caribbean island and so peacefull.

reviews.author: Andrew K
reviews.title: Fun and relaxing
reviews.text: Stayed at the Scott for one night.  First time there.  Beautiful facilities and rooms.  Had a room with a lagoon view and patio.  Wonderful.If you want to have fun and still be able to relax - check out the Scott!

reviews.author: Nicholas B
reviews.title: Atmosphere
reviews.text: The Spa was fantastic, great messages. The Cuban atmosphere from the plants, trees, and furniture down to the art and board games was impressive. Staff were friendly, the pool had a fun beach area, and the rooms were quaint with a ton of complimentary amenities.

reviews.author: melisaswim
reviews.title: Beautiful grounds and friendly people
reviews.text: When you enter the resort you are transported out of the desert to a tropical oasis. The staff is extremely friendly and the vallet car service is convenient and much needed after a day of shopping at the Fashion Square Mall. The rooms are nice and clean but nothing fancy or noteworthy but the grounds make up for it.

reviews.author: Deniseny15
reviews.title: Great Resort; Great Service
reviews.text: We loved this hotel. The room was beautiful and the pool areas are great. We loved the car service provided - a free ride anywhere within 3 miles of the hotel. The driver appreciates tips. Overall a great resort.

reviews.author: shoopnshotgundeville
reviews.title: Staycation
reviews.text: Clean rooms and friendly staff.  This is the second time my friends and I did a staycation at this resort.  Only thing I don't understand.  Why on earth does the resort feel the need to landscape around the pool, with the loud equipment, Sunday morning when people are trying to enjoy things before it gets too hot.  The first time we stayed I thought it was a fluke.  The 2nd time.......

reviews.author: Tasha B
reviews.title: A little slice of heaven even in Hellish AZ summers!
reviews.text:
Ive just booked my 4th trip to this resort and honestly, It is my favorite place to stay that I can actually afford. The staff is wonderful, from the desk clerks, security staff, housekeeping,  to the bartenders and servers, they seem to really care and go above and beyond to offer a truly great experience to their guests.

The rooms are currently being updated, which is great, even though the rooms are fine. They are still in the state they were in as the Firesky, which was also pretty nice, but I look forward to seeing the updates, because I imagine it wont be disappointing, based on the amount of detail and care theyve put into the redo of this sweet spot.

The design, details and care thats gone into things at The Scott are apparent from the moment you walk into the lobby.  I am personally a huge fan of plants/ tropicalia and the 40s era that the design is an obvious nod to. Imagine taking a trip to Puerto Rico in 1945 and you get the idea of what the Scott has  pulled together here. I love every detail, even the cocktaisl are a nod to the era, (try the Helen and Maude, a saucy, less sweet nod to a pina colada). 
The grounds are lovely, both pools are gorgeous ( and flanked by beautiful Jacaranda, Palms and some other gorgeous trees)  even the piped in music is well above par, in fact, Id like to know what playlist they use, because its a great mix of dub/ reggae/ and soul that is both easy to listen and super fun. Its unexpected to hear good music on hotel grounds, and as an audiophile, this went a long way with me.

I could go on, but Ill just add that the restaurant serves really delicious food as well. Ive had breakfast here a couple of times, and have also had salads and some food by the pool and was never disappointed. 

Im so glad to have found this place and I highly recommend it. Living in Tucson, with great staycations available here, it takes a lot to get me up to Phoenix, especially when the temps are 5-10 degrees hotter, but The Scott is worth the heat.. and I cant wait for my next little getaway here!

reviews.author: Heather M
reviews.title: Celebrating Birthdays
reviews.text:
Fun hotel.  The guys and the front make this place the best. They offer car service to drive you around.  Rooms need work and pool area but still functional and super fun!   The lobby is beautiful and the bar area.  On Saturday the bar area was very busy and staff I would say were down right rude... the cocktail waitress bumped into us... never apologized and the female bartender with red hair...never smiled nor said hello, I’ll be right with you... nothing.  
Overall we had a great weekend.

reviews.author: Daniel M
reviews.title: Worst stay in a while
reviews.text: Easily one of the worst days I've ever had at a resort. Was there for a bachelorette party book 7 different rooms. When we arrived at the property it was under remodel which we were never told about before we got there. I was put in a building where they were remodeling some of the rooms and had one of the entryways into the building blocked off. Started construction at 9 in the morning easily could hear the construction throughout the whole building. Then had so many issues with the third party vendor that I booked through the front desk was not very helpful told me that I was all set and taken care of but then continue to charge me. Couldn't connect to the Wi-Fi and was told that that's an ongoing problem for the Resort and I should try to go to espn.com to see if that would trigger the login page. Attempted to spend Saturday at the pool where the bartender was not only rude but very disrespectful to my friend.Went to dinner at the restaurant on property was put in a nice little blocked-off section for The Bachelorette dinner that was 90 something degrees when we asked for a fan the waitress was rude and told us that they didn't have a fan that they could put it there for us but where we were sitting we could see in the kitchen and see what that one was easily accessible and not being used. Was told I would not be charged Resort fees when I checked out I was charged Resort fees called and spoke to accounting department the accounting department said that they were refunding my Resort fees yet I am still being charged. Would not recommend staying here at all I would strongly suggest staying at a different Resort in the Scottsdale area.

reviews.author: Jenni G
reviews.title: Love the Scott but not the Construction
reviews.text:
This is my second time staying at the Scott is 6 months and I live in California, so needless to say I really love this resort. My husband and I just got back from a long weekend there to celebrate our 5 year anniversary kiddo free and while overall it was a great trip there were defiantly some mishaps. 

ROOM: We were in the building behind the pool (300 rooms). They were doing construction in the room right above us and we were woken up to a hammer drill which continued for over 3 hours. We knew there was going to be construction going on at the hotel but we didn’t think that it would be that bad. We could live with the boarded up hallway and not being able to get to our room conveniently. But my husband and I couldn’t even hear each other talk in the room because it was so load. When we were at the pool you could hear the noise but nothing like when it was right above us, annoying but manageable with some drinks and the music. When we spoke to the lady when we checked out we told her that they should have closed that building down or at least the rooms that were so close to the construction. Not being able to sleep in and relax after paying for a lot of money for the room was a disappointment. Not going to lie I was kid free I wanted to take a nap! 

FOOD: After being woken up we decided to just go to the Canal Club for breakfast and it was HORRIBLE! I got the French Toast it was cold when it came to our table and I couldn’t even cut the bread with a knife let alone chew it.  My husband got the Caribbean Benedict and the poached egg was more like hard boiled. He said the flavors where there just not done right. When we told the waiter he just smiled and kept walking like it was no big deal. We waited for the Manager to walk by and never saw him. So I just told my husband at this point just pay so we can get on with our day. The food has been good here in the past but this time was horrible. The service I noticed is hit or miss. 

OVERALL SERVICES: The pool safe was good. Bartenders made good drinks and walked around checking on guest all day. The guys at bell hop and did the shuttle are great! Probably the most personable at the whole hotel. Seriously they need a raise! Lady at check out (should have got her name) was nice enough. She did apologies for our experience and said she would wave our resort fee. We both said that is not enough and she did end up giving us better compensation. 

I will defiantly go back but probably won’t eat at the restaurant again and will wait until the construction is done.

reviews.author: Yves Michel L
reviews.title: La classe sans ostentation
reviews.text: Très belle hôtel à Scottdale, au cœur des quartiers chics et des centres commerciaux de qualités. L’ensemble du lobby a été refait à l’été 2017 avec son nouveau style Caribéens. Le plus gros des chambres a été entièrement rénovées, elles sont immenses et parfaitement équipées. La ligne de décoration oscillant entre Cuba et La Havane a permis au décorateur comme au propriétaire de nous proposer une ambiance thématique et cohérente sur l’ensemble des locaux de ce grand et convivial hôtel. Le personnel est très professionnel. La végétation est luxuriante. La troisième piscine qui sera terminée dernier trimestre 2018 offrira un espace extérieur encore plus grand. En résumé un grand et bel hôtel où il fait bon séjourner quelques nuits ou plus.

reviews.author: Dialla K
reviews.title: Nice reception area, tatty rooms
reviews.text: The reception area is very nice and great to hang out in, the rooms however are quite tired but very comfortable. The ground floor rooms are nice. Its a hotel you drive your car round to your room, so very convenient. The shopping mall is two blocks away. Old scottsdale is a five minute drive, and hotel provides shuttle bus. Staff are lovely and very helpful.

reviews.author: Trina B
reviews.title: Colombian style
reviews.text: A savanna feel, although they are doing construction , it wasn’t nor did it feel  like a nuisance . Liked the lay back feel to this hotel, and noticed a dress trend style associated with the hotel. Saw many types of travelers during our stay. Family with kids stood out the most, and young couples, a few single business people . I liked the location & landscape of this hotel, especially. Across the street from the hotel, is a huge mall, with a movie theater, and walking distance to old town. As in the same location area of the lobby there was a bar and restaurant area that was very inviting.

reviews.author: Barbara171090
reviews.title: un bel hotel a scottsdale
reviews.text: hotel ben arredato e camere grandi e spaziose... un pochino eccessiva la tariffa resort di 40 dollari a camera secondo me, non mi è piaciuto molto che ci abbiano fatto aspettare per la camera ( eravamo arrivati solo 20 minuti prima del check in), si capiva benissimo che era già pronta.

reviews.author: Jodi C
reviews.title: Lovely little oasis
reviews.text: The Scott Hotel is amazingly close to everything Scottsdale and includes a shuttle which will take you anywhere in a three mile radius.  The lobby is gorgeous, and the rooms are well-appointed and comfortable.  Courtyard grounds and pool area is lush and lovely.  Great little spot for a Scottsdale get-away.

reviews.author: Julie M
reviews.title: First glance, 5 stars - look further and needs improvements
reviews.text:
This hotel has a really great website, sales team and beautifully appointed lobby/conference area.  I went here for a family vacation and loved the public space (it appears to have been updated most recently).  I peeked into the conference rooms and would say the same thing.   The guest rooms seem like they had a minor facelift but not a thorough renovation.  It was a little disappointing to go from AMAZING lobby to "eh" guest rooms.  The rooms were still nice but after going through the lobby, they felt less nice.  The other public spaces around the pool were also nicely done, lots of fire pits and little pockets to gather in groups ranging in all sizes.  Seemed like they could have used more lounge chairs but that's always the problem. 

The hotels biggest problem was they seemed to be SEVERELY understaffed - everywhere.  The bellmen/concierges were the staff highlights - they were super friendly, extremely knowledgeable about the area, helped with reservations etc.  It was also nice they have an SUV that takes you within a certain radius (convenient but there's only 1 so...not that convenient).  The front desk staff seemed less helpful in comparison and usually every time I went to the desk, there was more than one person waiting for something and not enough staff to help (or they didn't know the answer).  The indoor bar/morning coffee area were also severely understaffed.  I would have to imagine that having an additional server, or 3 would pay for itself in the additional drinks able to be consumed.  More than once I would go to the bar to order drinks instead of waiting in the outdoor bar area because I only had 45 minutes before a dinner reservation and I knew I wouldn't get the drink in time, this still took forever since the drinks are complicated (yummy but complicated) and there was only 1 bar tender.  There was a lot of self service attempts because people got sick of waiting (ie: I'll get my own lime, straw, menu, etc).  Also for happy hour time, there should really be more than 1 bartender if the hotel is nearly sold out.  This was a very frustrating experience.  In the morning, the only barista kept leaving to fetch croissants or orange juice, leaving people wondering if they would get any coffee....  
Overall, nice property, weird in the midst of office parks.  Nice bellmen/concierges.  Nice lobby space.  Ok rooms.  NEED MORE STAFF!!!  Front desk staff specifically should be better educated on the area.

reviews.author: Aquazoo
reviews.title: Beautiful, peaceful, good service
reviews.text:
This is a favorite location for a business group for our annual conference. The rooms are arranged around the edges with the pools and lawns in the middle. Besides the beautifully landscaped pools, there are a number of casual seating areas for small groups, both inside and out.
The rooms are large and comfortable, in two-story buildings so some will be a walk up. All have balconies or patios. The meeting rooms are well-organized and the technology worked well.
Many of our meals were catered through the resort, including our Monday night dinner which had a lot of choices. Any special dietary needs were accommodated quickly.
The resort is a bit of a walk to old-town Scottsdale, but they offer a free shuttle service. For down time, I would get a ride there and work my way back.
I would definitely recommend this resort for meetings or just for travelers.

reviews.author: nina k
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text:
I stayed at The Scott in July for business.  The location was perfect for my meeting.   It is a beautiful property. I was greeted nicely. My room was nice and comfortable and I got a good rate in July!
The restaurant was great. I will go back!

reviews.author: AlexNZander
reviews.title: Mis-quoted Price not honored
reviews.text:
Shame on the Scott Resort for not honoring the price quoted and booked on their website!
I originally booked a 3-night stay at The Scott Resort for $99 per night. A great deal for an above average resort. I have since received a 'modified' reservation where the price went up to $269.  When I called to inquire I was told it was a 'glitch' in their system and they would not honor the original price quoted.
I'd say Customers Service is terrible.

reviews.author: Janet R
reviews.title: Excellent location and customer service!
reviews.text: From check in to check out, excellent service! Love the refurbished lobby and the free shuttle service to surrounding area. Rooms are clean and fresh and will be redone this summer. Super location near Scottsdale Fashion Square and lots of restaurants.

reviews.author: akitadog1
reviews.title: Cancelled reservation 2 day prior to arrival
reviews.text: So I was suppose to stay at the Scott resort in two days.  Made my reservation 9 weeks ago.  I received a call from my travel agent today, the Scott was overbooked and cancelled my reservation.  Really 2 days before.  It looks like they have a convention, and even though I made my reservation prior they need to follow the money.   Pretty poor customer service.  I called and talked to Allyssa, she said they offered to send me to their sister hotel,  I booked the hotel due to the location.  So if you are not part of a convention, you might think twice about booking here, because they will cancel on a heartbeat.

reviews.author: Traveler20
reviews.title: Very Nice
reviews.text: This is a lovely hotel. Our lake view room in one of the older buildings was nicely decorated and very comfortable. The beds were great. There is nice artwork throughout which I enjoyed. Front staff was excellent. Only word of warning was related to their dinner buffet. We had prepaid for our dinner through our tour, but we are not big meat eaters and the buffet offered no seafood options. We ende up having to eat elsewhere. Breakfast, however, was very good with many choices.

reviews.author: hassen1963
reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: Room outdated, no microwave, frig. overstuffed with hotel items, tempting you to buy water for 7 dollars. Uneven floors, can easily trip. no elevator, How is that legal? everything is extra, even the tiki party.

reviews.author: Nathan C
reviews.title: Tout le confort necessaire
reviews.text:
Nous avons passé une nuit dans ce hotal relativement luxueux.
Piscine très belle, wifi puissant et pièces spacieuses.
Petit bémol pour le déjeuner non compris dans le prix de la chambre et relativement cher.

reviews.author: etaylor09
reviews.title: Amazing stay and incredible value!
reviews.text: We took a girls trip to Scottsdale and stayed at the Scott and it was an amazing trip! The hotel interior was so dreamy, we fell in love with it. They had a signature scent that would hit you as soon as you walked in and I still think about it. I need to try to find out what it is! The value of the hotel made this such a great trip. We didn’t pay an arm and a leg and the service was incredible. They have a shuttle service that will take you anywhere you need to go (and pick you back up) within 3 miles and it’s a black Escalade so you’re always arriving in style. The drivers we had throughout our trip, Kevin, Matt, and Ron were exceptionally helpful and pleasant and just super nice guys. The rooms were fine but they’re phase 2 in the renovations so I’m dying to see how they transform them next. I hope once everything is renovated they maintain the prices of the rooms they have now. Oh and all us gals got spa treatments and they were great! This hotel made our moms getaway exactly what we needed!!

reviews.author: Chris R
reviews.title: Stylish hotel amid lush surroundings
reviews.text:
We booked here for 2 nights rest and relaxation at the end of our 2500 mile road trip from Chicago, so we were hoping for a little luxury. 

We were looked after very ably by the reception staff on our arrival, and without asking we were upgraded to a poolside room free of charge. The entrance lobby and bar area (with friendly barman) is quite spectacular and makes a perfect first impression.

Walking through to the back of the hotel we were equally impressed by the beautiful pool area and gardens with plenty of sun beds and parasols as well as outdoor sofas and stylish semi shaded patio. There's also a poolside bar and service while you relax.

Our room was modern, comfortable and clean with everything we needed for a perfect stay even a little outdoor seating spot to relax in. The beds were large and very very comfortable so a good night's sleep was assured.

The large SUV shuttle which will take you anywhere within 3 miles and also pick you up on request was a great bonus too and made everywhere we wanted to go, more accessible. Downtown and the 'old town' are both within range.

One thing to note is this is a conference centre hotel as well as a tourist one so, as when we were there, the hotel can be quite full of business people but we didn't find it a problem as they are in the specifically suited rooms for most of the time. The business centre off the lobby was handy too, for airline check-ins and printing off boarding cards without any fuss whatsoever.

When we left there was a fairly substantial resort fee to pay, (pool, car parking etc) which we'd half expected and a room tax which we hadn't. But it didn't spoil the overall impression which was of a hotel near the top of the scale - four and a half stars really.

reviews.author: cheriegal001
reviews.title: Perfect Spring Break Spot
reviews.text: I stayed here during the middle of March and had such an amazing time relaxing and enjoying the pools, workout room, and fire pit. My friend and I cane to celebrate another friend’s birthday and took advantage of the free shuttle. They took us to a bakery where we could find gluten free cupcakes. The fact that we were within distance to the best brunch spots, amazing restaurants and spectacular shopping made this hotel a sweet place to stay. Would love to return!

reviews.author: fortjoannez
reviews.title: Spent one night at the Scott
reviews.text: Big beautiful lobby, pools and grounds.  Over-sized King room with nice decor.  Only downfall, could not take a shower or bath as the tub was soo slippery.  Could even sit on the side to freshen up.  The cleaning crew must of used the wrong kind of cleaner.  Very disappointing.

reviews.author: patounetbello
reviews.title: Bon hotel
reviews.text:
Hotel situé sur un grand boulevard permettant d'aller facilement au quartier animé.
Des taxes d'hébergements à payer ...
Sinon les chambres sont parfaites et l'accueil très professionnel. 
Bien mais sans plus

reviews.author: jyoung3095
reviews.title: very dissappointed
reviews.text: A friend of mine came in from out of town so we decided to try a staycation since both of us have hotel backgrounds and this place looked good online. We checked in at 4pm as required, but by that time the pool area was trashed. Not a great first impression. Used towels, cups and plates and garbage everywhere. It looked as though NO ONE ever came out to check the pool area and clean up all day. The next morning we decided to check out the pool area again and fortunately it was cleaned up by then. However, the staff was so cold and unfriendly. I sat in the lobby for over 2 hours with my newspaper and coffee waiting for my friend to get up.I watched the management and staff walk by me multiple times as if I was invisible. Not ONE person made eye contacted or greeted me. For 2 hours!!!! Worst customer service I have seen in years.

reviews.author: louiseanne6
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: We came here last year and we loved it so we came back . Staff are great service is amazing . Only downfall is when there’s no sun beds around the pool it’s because the locals are using the pool as their local ‘country club’ as per a local telling me ! Not impressed as we pay to stay here . If a card on the gate system was in use this wouldn’t happen but today I see groups of people coming through and taking beds and crowding pool with outside alcohol . Very sad as I love this place

reviews.author: Elyse H
reviews.title: Excellent Service, Average Room
reviews.text: The staff here is friendly and attentive. Everyone from the valet, to the front desk, to the restaurant was genuinely helpful. Great poolside beverage service, and two very nice pools. The grounds are lovely; the lobby, bar and restaurant renovations are wonderful. Perfect location. The rooms could definitely use an upgrade.

reviews.author: dsteele526
reviews.title: Enjoyable time at the Scott Resort & Spa
reviews.text: At the last minute we decided to book a nights stay at The Scott Resort & Spa to celebrate our wedding anniversary.  The location is fantastic!  Just down the street from lots of restaurants and shopping.  The Scott even offers a free ride to anywhere within a 3 mile radius!  We took advantage of that service and it was great.  We did not have to worry about having some cocktails and driving.  Everyone we encountered was very friendly and very helpful.  The landscaping was lush and green.  A nice escape from the usual desert landscape.  I only rated it a very good, only because of the rooms.  They are in need of being updated.  But, not to worry!  They are starting room renovations soon and plan to be done by September!  We loved the feeling of the lobby as soon as we walked in.  A nice Cuban feel.  We enjoyed the Canal Bar and had a delicious breakfast in the restaurant.  We cannot wait to return for another visit!

reviews.author: Kim W
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Our 32nd anniversary! We booked a king room, pool view. Our view was of the bushes in front of the patio. The happy hour had been discontinued, which was always an added feature. The pools were nice and staff very pleasant. That king bed though...lumpy, uncomfortable and urine stained mattress. Very disgusting. Liked better when it was Fire Sky. Oh ya, 35 dollar resort fee? For what.

reviews.author: PattiFlorida
reviews.title: Just ok. Disappointing for the $$$ spent- Can't recommend
reviews.text:
PROS: Lots of chairs by the pool, they will bring you drinks and food by the pool, there is shade if you are not a full sun person. Location is great for walking to Old Town.

CONS:  We paid $169 for our room and then when checking out I noticed a note that said walk in rate for AZ Resident $119.  I was asked for my driver's license at check in and would have REALLY liked to be offered the lower rate. I am an AZ Resident.  Room was dated and our shower head could not be moved or it would leak.  So the shower head hit you in the chest not higher. There was chipped tile in bathroom and it was not overly clean.   I was scared to use the coffee maker in the room thinking that I would be charged and exaggerated rate from the HONOR bar menu.   Water $7.50 really? We were only there for one night as a staycation and I can say I was not impressed. I will go to the Wigwams next time where I felt they cared about me as an AZ resident and the room was so much better.  We did drink $100 worth of drinks by the pool. Our bill was $337 so.... the room, resort fee and early check-in $237.. Just too high for what we got.  would have liked to have the resort fee waived as they do in a lot of other resorts for AZ Residents.

reviews.author: Ronald M
reviews.title: The Scott (Take 2)
reviews.text:
First, my apologies for length of this review. So...if you have decided to read on here are my experiences. My wife and I were visiting Scottsdale, Arizona for a quick vacation get-away in mid-June 2018 and decided to give the Scott a second chance after a very disappointing first stay in July 2017. The only reason we even gave the Scott a second chance was the actions of the Front Office Manager Kurt Sanders. Mr. Sanders provided me with a two night stay voucher for a future visit.

JULY 2017 VISIT REVIEW: After the first stay at the Scott in July 2017, Mr. Sanders asked me for a rating of the hotel and my stay. I noted that if I was feeling very generous, I might give the stay a two. He asked me for the reasons for the low rating. I proceeded to note all the issues I had with the initial stay: 1) I did not get the room I requested at check-in and no explanation given for room change; 2) extremely rude front desk staff person who noted the room was not ready for me and would text me when available - a text that came nearly an hour after normal check-in time; 3) dirty room; and 4) every morning of the stay we were awakened super early by the cleaning staff who apparently felt that directly in front of our room door was the best place to gather and laugh very loudly and joke prior to starting their work day.

The above background noted, I must admit I still wanted to like the hotel as it is in an excellent location and has a nice charm to it. So anyway, thanks to Mr. Sanders customer service skills my wife and I decided to use the vouchers (admittedly I had not initially planned to use this voucher) and see if the last stay was just a fluke or not.

JUNE 2018 VISIT REVIEW: My wife and I arrived late at night after a lengthy flight delay and were greeted by a much more welcoming front desk crew. We were checked in quickly and provided the exact room we booked. The room was clean and comfortable. We enjoyed our time at the pool and the staff at the outdoor pool bar was excellent. Based on this re-do we will definitely consider staying at the Scott again on future visits to the Scottsdale, AZ area.

reviews.author: jens1973
reviews.title: A dissapointing Fathers Day Weekend!
reviews.text:
My hubby and I always stay at the Marriott suites in old town which we love. I thought I’d venture out and try something different this Father’s Day weekend. 
Upon arriving, we were walking down the hall to get to our room, and I could tell by the appearance of the hallway, we may be disappointed with our hotel selection this weekend.  I knew when I opened the door to our room this was not going to be comparable to our Marriott experience.  Decore was very cheaply done,  bed was horrible, baseboards very old and ratty looking, bathroom was subpar at best and the marble all around the toilet was stained yellow from urine.  My hubby and I were trying to like it and feel comfortable, but it just wasn’t at all what we’d hoped for. Especially it being a so called 4 star resort.  Ultimatley we ended up not staying the night and left for home.  I didn’t even care to get my money back, I just wanted to leave. I Was not impressed at all!

reviews.author: Mark C
reviews.title: Great service, wonderful charm
reviews.text: This is an older property that has been redone as a cute little boutique property. The staff is wonderful. We loved the service at the Canal Bar, Kirsten is a delight behind the bar! And Mrs. Scott had a great pedicure in the spa!

reviews.author: Javier J
reviews.title: Fathers day
reviews.text:
We have been coming here since it was Firesky resort, we keep defaulting here because we love it, we have been here throughout their construction and always friendly,  kids love it and very relaxing. This time they had fire dancers which was a bonus, the rooms have been updated,

Thank you and see you next time we come to Phoenix

reviews.author: Troy A
reviews.title: Nice courtyard
reviews.text: At first glance from the road it is hard to determine what you are getting. It is an older resort so keep that in mind. The main area of the checkin is nice and decorated beautifully. Our room was large but the decor was dated and the quality of the furniture was “economical”. The walls are thin so you will hear outside noise. The highlight of this property is the courtyard. A lot of seating, green landscape and two separate pools. Overall we enjoyed the property but it is not a five star, a solid four.

reviews.author: jim s
reviews.title: Great place to relax
reviews.text: This is a amazing place to kick back and relax.  The pool area is very cool. The bartenders are a very professional and make sure have a margarita.  My wife had a drink called the rum diary very good.  Later we took the hotel shuttle downtown for s great night. Perfect.

reviews.author: catherinekastner
