reviews.title: Oasis - Hot
reviews.text: Great place, with sizable pools; great wine list, and quaint.  Beds need to be replaced and the pillows and linens.  Need to offer water for free in the rooms, and int the internet is not secured or available 24/7.

reviews.author: nocRN
reviews.title: Possibly my favorite hotel ever
reviews.text: The lobby and grounds of The Scott was gorgeous. So much attention to detail in the decor and every corner of the outside area is welcoming and relaxing. I loved all the water features and beautiful flowers and private areas to enjoy. Located near downtown Scottsdale where all the restaurants and bars are and the hotel offers a shuttle that will drop you off and pick you up. There is a $40/day resort fee which feels deceiving when you’re comparing prices but because I loved the hotel so much I will come again.

reviews.author: jbury5
reviews.title: Top Notch Service
reviews.text: Here for a couple days for business and had to give a couple shout outs.  Huge thanks to the gentleman checking me in.  There was an error on my part and he went above and beyond to find me a room and have it cleaned so I had a place to stay.  While waiting for my room I sat down at the bar, had an amazing dinner and the service from Tommy was one of a kind.  Tommy was helpful with food and drink suggestions, extremely kind and his service was top notch.  After a long day in heels, it was refreshing to be met by such professionals.

reviews.author: Mgaab
reviews.title: Beautiful remodel
reviews.text: My husband and I decided to stay at The Scott to celebrate our anniversary. The remodels are beautiful, so much detail in the lobby/bar/restaurant. The grounds are nicely maintained with very lush landscaping. You can find many little nooks to sit around the resort and it feels very private. We also enjoyed the pool which was extremely busy when it’s 100 degrees outside! Be aware that the pool bar closes at 5:00 even though the pool was pretty busy until 7:00 and you will pay $11 for a basic alcoholic beverage. The food at the restaurant is amazing (we had dinner and breakfast) and our waiter was excellent. As for the rooms, they are not much to be desired. The bathroom was remodeled with marble flooring and cute vintage fixtures. However, the rest of the room was outdated and not impressive. Within an hour of being in the room while we were resting on the bed my husband asked what was all over the ceiling. They were gnats... everywhere. They were very heavy on the patio so someone before us must have left the door open or they were getting through the crack on the bottom of the door. Either way it was gross. I was not hoping for buzzing in my ear all night while I was sleeping, but it was an experience.

reviews.author: betsy1224
reviews.title: Pleasant enough
reviews.text: I stayed here one night for a business meeting. It's hard to square the description of "resort and spa" with a hotel business buildings, apartments and a shopping mall, but the pool area was lush and attractive.  The sleeping rooms are a bit tired as is the woefully small exercise room.  Fortunately the hotel offers bikes, and there is a bike path along the nearby canal. What was impressive about The Scott was the food provided to our group.  I don't think I've ever had better, more varied breakfast and lunch offerings at a business meeting.

reviews.author: dean a
reviews.title: Wedfing
reviews.text: We were at the Scott Resort and Spa the evening of May 26 for our friends wedding ceremony. It was held outside in the lush gardens by the pool with a gentle waterfall in the background. The setting was beautiful, we loved the vibes and decor of the lobby, and to top it off we had great friendly service from Raka at the front desk, Joe the night auditor and even the wait staff at the banquet was sensitive to my wife’s allergy needs. We can’t wait to go back. Oh and I can’t forget to mention Brandon & Erica- great staff all around!

reviews.author: Daniel R
reviews.title: Best Scottsdale hotel!
reviews.text: Stayed at The Scott over graduation weekend this month.  Wow, the service was above and beyond.  Lobby was beautiful and so were the grounds.  They also have loaner bikes and car service around the area.  Very impressed and cant wait to go back!

reviews.author: Cynthia C
reviews.title: Desert Oasis!
reviews.text: From the moment I arrived, the services was excellent, and the staff was incredibly helpful.  At one point I decided to take a last minute field trip and needed some supplies: one of the valet went to a local drugstore for me!  The menu was absolutely delicious.  I loved the Peruvian Hash for breakfast - I ate there my entire stay and always looked forward to the meals.  Several of our group had different eating styles - gluten free or vegetarian - and they were well accommodated.  And the hotel guests themselves were friendly and enjoyable.  Lovely landscaping; stunning in the middle of the dessert.

reviews.author: Salfry
reviews.title: Gorgeous hotel!
reviews.text: Visited in May with my husband for 4 nights. Beautiful resort hotel with lovely reception and chilling out area, bar, restaurant and pool area. Great pool side service. Good amount of natural shade around the pool. Adequate gym. Spacious rooms and comfy beds. Didn’t want to leave. Will return. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jen D
reviews.title: Would love to come back
reviews.text: Found this place randomly from it being listed in an article about amazing places to stay that are affordable. I needed to use miles before they expired and so I booked the trip. I highly recommend the suite experience and the 1st floor for the walkout patio. The rooms got mixed reviews when I was researching and while they’re not crazy plush, I think they’re totally fine. I have no room complaints. The public areas are so incredible that I wasn’t in the room much anyway.

reviews.author: Bert Martinez
reviews.title: The Good, the Bad, the Ugly.
reviews.text:
The ugly.
Getting a good night's sleep was very difficult, the pillows were flat, the bed was extremely hard, and you were either too hot or too cold, it was an ugly night.

The bad.
The Cuban food is not Cuban food, and they even have an item celebrating dictator Castro, which is extremely offensive to me and other Cubans.

The good.
The lobby and grounds of the hotel are lovely, the pools are great and the the rooms are good.

reviews.author: Jacqueline T
reviews.title: Awesome stay
reviews.text: Beautifully decorated hotel. Lobby and bar area is magnificent. Pool was very relaxing. Lots of common areas outside that were beautiful to sit with family and friends and enjoy a drink. They had a lovely band playing at the bar until 10pm. Restaurant was also beautifully decorated and great service. Didn’t have time to explore the area unfortunately.

reviews.author: soccermom1572
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, great location
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful. The theme is nicely done throughout. Great amenities and nice pools. Tommy at the hotel bar was an incredible bartender - best old fashioned I've ever had! The rest of the drinks he made were delicious too. We will be back!

reviews.author: Julie A
reviews.title: Tired Hotel
reviews.text: Lobby and bar area are cool. There was a DJ in the bar area and a movie playing ut by the pool, which was fun. Pool cabana's are basic.  Rooms are underwhelming, pool area needs more chairs an more servers.  Love the free shuttle service within 3 miles.  Valet and front desk are very nice.

reviews.author: Marie561995
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: When we first arrived to our room there were dirty towels from the previous guest on the floor in the bathroom and trash in the trash can. I talked to housekeeping since they were in the hallway and they took care of the bathroom right away.  The internet access is horrible, basically nonexistent.  The refrigerator in the room was not working at all.  All of the drinks in the refrigerator were hot. Not exactly what I was expecting when I paid over $200/night (included taxes and fees).

reviews.author: Charissa W
reviews.title: Mother’s Day trip
reviews.text:
I had an amazing weekend away at the Scott for Mother’s Day. It started with a quick and seamless check in that gave me plenty of time to prepare for my spa appointment. The room was spacious and provided everything that was needed, including a chaise that was comfy to relax in. The spa was amazing and everyone was friendly and inviting.  At night, the atmosphere was alive as a DJ played music by the bar and people enjoyed the seating outdoors. 
Although I looked forward to sitting by one of the pools, I did not have time. 
I ordered room service for breakfast and it was the best decision, breakfast in bed! It was quick and the avocado toast was delicious. 
Everything about my stay was great and I couldn’t say more wonderful things about the Scott.

reviews.author: Maddie E
reviews.title: The best girls getaway!
reviews.text: Thank you thank you thank you to the scott for a wonderful girls trip experience.  The hotel was clean, the pool was perfect, atmosphere was serene, and the service was even better.  Shout out to Nate, ryan, and Charlie for making our stay even better than we could have imagined.

reviews.author: OptimusPrime
reviews.title: Girls trip!
reviews.text:
Benny, Kevin, Ryan & Jordan were top notch customer service at the hotel! Benny was working hard at the bar for breakfast orders each day. The shuttle that takes you within a 3 mile radius was amazing! The guys knew where to go, picked us up and were extremely polite and helpful. We checked in early, had a great stay. Everything was perfect. 
The hotel restaurant is best for breakfast. The other times were hard to get service and the prices were high. 
All in all the staff made our stay. The maintenance workers, housekeeping, bellhops and bartenders were extremely accommodating and polite.

reviews.author: mauramoocow
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text: Had the best girls trip at this beautiful resort! The resort itself was absolutely stunning and aesthetically pleasing (haha). Special thanks to Nate, Chuck, Ryan, and Bird! They were super helpful and made our time here much more relaxing. Will definitely be coming back and staying here again in the future!

reviews.author: Ariana5514
reviews.title: Excellent stay!
reviews.text:
We had a great time visiting! The resort is gorgeous with beautiful grounds that are well maintained; the rooms are clean and beds are comfortable. My kids loved the pools and my husband and I relaxed with the poolside service. 
This was our second visit to The Scott and we know we will be back again.

reviews.author: Neha G
reviews.title: Mixed experience but overall good!
reviews.text:
The Pros:

- beautiful resort
- the onsite restaurant is delicious (we had brunch) 
- the shuttle staff provide an incredible service and are just great guys overall - knowledgeable, polite and really patient 
- our first night was elevated by renovation party the resort was throwing 
- in a prime location, super close to shopping and old town 

The Cons:
- the first night, our friends got in at 9am but we didn’t get our rooms until 4pm (mildly annoying because we asked if they could accommodate early check in)
- initially our interaction with the front desk staff was less than pleasant but all subsequent interactions were great 
- got back from a night out at 2am and realized one of the bedsheets had a blood stain and a few bugs which then required hotel staff to come in and change our sheets 
- service at the onsite restaurant was a tad slow (they only had 2 servers) for a cinco de mayo weekend 

Overall I’d give the experience a 3 but there are definitely elements that I’d like to rate a 5. I would still consider coming back for another vacation!

reviews.author: Kristina L
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Such a great location! We walked in and Nate the bell man greeted us. Told us all the fun things we should be doing. We weren’t able to check into our room because we were waiting for our friends to arrive. They held our bags and showed us around. Such amazing staff. The place is so cute and honestly the service is all around amazing!

reviews.author: ElliotFoz
reviews.title: Wonderful Time
reviews.text: We loved this hotel! I stayed with my wife and four-year-old daughter and we all had a wonderful time. The kids pool was a highlight. It has a lot of sand continuing right into the water and is plenty deep for sand castle building. We found it to be an extremely friendly and beautiful play area with great landscaping and great food and drink service.  My daughter found lots of friends to play with and the kids all seemed to be having a great time. The design of the hotel, being a large courtyard surrounded by the rooms and lobby, gave us the feeling of being at a resort far from the middle of a city. However, upon leaving the lobby old town Scottsdale is just down the street as is the mall. Rental bikes were available and free, and also the hotel offers a free limousine service to nearby locations. The adult pool is also beautiful and we rented a cabana one day that we enjoyed very much. All the staff we encountered were very friendly and helpful. One of the most notable aspects of the hotel is the great design work both in the lobby and also the courtyard. It is really beautiful in the day or night with interesting spots to sit and enjoy everywhere we looked it seemed. The food was excellent at the Cuban themed restaurant and loved being able to sit outdoors. We look forward to staying at The Scott again.

reviews.author: Raman B
reviews.title: What a place!
reviews.text:
Had an amazing few days at The Scott with friends, we were there celebrating my best friends bachelorette party. I truly wish we were there for a few more days just to spend some downtime at the resort and enjoy all it's beauty. I'll try to keep it quick and point form, I know reading long reviews can get irritating!

Pros
-This place is absolutely beautiful, the best way to put it is "pinterest perfect". I honestly can’t say it enough, so glad we didn’t stay at a hotel from a chain.
-Grounds are beautiful and meticulously maintained.
-The staff here are absolutely amazing. I really want to give a special shout out to Kevin!! He was so kind and fun, whether it was something as simple as holding the door open or driving us around in the courtesy shuttle (which by the way is a HUGE bonus, helps save a lot of cab money). Matt was also absolutely wonderful, very kind and helpful. These 2 guys single handedly made us feel like we were warmly welcome- each and every day!
-Did I say the place is beautiful?
-Food at the hotel restaurant was great, only had breakfast there one morning but it was delicious
-Location, The Scott is in the perfect spot very close to all the city action, whether it's the mall, pool parties, or nightclubs.
-Housekeeping staff, you are wonderful. So quick and clean, not a single issue.
-Room service, very quick!

Cons
Flavia. This "lovely" lady was working the front desk on Sunday when we checked out. Every single staff member we met during this trip was very nice, always smiling and greeting anyone they came across. Flavia on the other hand, forget the fact that she couldn't crack a smile, was nothing short of rude. On our first day we arrived at the hotel around 12pm, check in time as we know was 4pm. The front desk staff kept telling us we'd have the room earlier, first in about 1 hr, then 20 minutes, and then 20 minutes, again- we didn't get the room till about 430pm. Which was frustrating- however front desk staff were lovely, apologetic and sorted out the situation. We were promised a few things. Apparently those promises didn't carry over in the notes, which is okay, we understand, miscommunication happens. However, it was this ladies approach that was nothing short of distasteful, she had such an attitude problem it was ridiculous. I work in the customer service industry, and was just shocked that this women was working the front desk. Put her in the back, she shouldn't be the face of Scott. You have many other great employees, one's who don't have an attitude problem. I know this is a bit harsh, but it was just so frustrating to come across someone so rude at the end of the trip. Really left a bad taste, she's the only reason The Scott doesn't get a 5/5- otherwise very honestly this resort is a gem. Ultimately, she comped us what was promised, but she did it begrudgingly and again- no apology, instead she felt the need to educate us on the check in time (which was information that we already had, she clearly didn't listen to a word we said or understand the situation the way it had happened. Only heard what she wanted to hear). I guess there’s always a few bad seeds, glad we didn’t encounter at any other point of our stay.

Overall, I would go back to the Scott in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Genevieve R
reviews.title: Great resort!
reviews.text:
We stayed at The Scott for my bachelorette party and it was perfect!!!

The rooms: very nice, could use some updating (I hear that’s already planned)! They were very clean and the housekeeping service was wonderful. I asked for an extra comforter to be extra cozy but otherwise the rooms were great.

The pool: wonderful! Clean, well attended, and plenty of towels and chairs.

The food: excellent bar staff at the Canal Club, I loved their version of a mojito. One of the nights we just stayed in at the lobby/bar area. It’s great for relaxing and very well decorated.

Bell hops: the shuttle is such a wonderful amenity! We loved Nate, Matt, Charlie, and Ari! They were so helpful, professional, and always greeted us with a warm smile. Honestly they helped make this trip the best. Nate even went and got us sun screen on the first day so we didn’t have to leave the pool!!!!

reviews.author: lcjn12
reviews.title: Wonderful long weekend.  Great location and pool.
reviews.text: Had a wonderful weekend to explore the area and relax.  All the staff were very pleasant and helpful.  I did get to use the resort's shuttle which turned out to be very handy.   Wifi was included and good.  The hotel is located very close to Camelback Mtn which we hiked one morning and is a must do.  The pool is fun and I appreciate that it is shaded on one side.  Very pretty landscaping and the waterfalls are a nice audible escape.  Our room on the 2nd floor was spacious and adequate.  Nice to have double doors open out to the balcony for fresh air. Room 271 did not have a view just parking lot and nearby buildings but close to the pool.  Next time I'd request an interior view.  I liked the sink and counter space separate from the toilet/shower.  Wished the bathtub was a little nicer.

reviews.author: jaylbay
reviews.title: "Beautiful Grounds"
reviews.text: We wish we had more time in Scottsdale to just enjoy the resort for a day or two, but the time we did stay by the pool with a drink or eating a fresh salad was very enjoyable. Service was as good as we have had anywhere and the rooms were very comfortable. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Kelcie V
reviews.title: Girls weekend
reviews.text: The Scott was a very fun, gorgeous resort. They bell hops were amazing Nate and Matt were accommodating and always willing to help, they were such a great team! The shuttle is wonderful and the bikes are super convenient. The pools are great- there was a large group staying at the hotel it would have been nice to know they would be occupying the pool and all the lounge chairs but it was a great time. The rooms are nice and clean, and a good size. The entire staff at the Scott really made our stay. It was fabulous!

reviews.author: Danelle R
reviews.title: Amazing service from Matt
reviews.text: Matt, our bellman, blew us away! Engaging, attentive and so accommodating. He recommended several local places to visit and we couldn’t have been more impressed with his personality and professionalism. Really an asset to this hotel. Nate, our driver, was also top notch! Five stars all around for those two!

reviews.author: princessjazz2000
reviews.title: Girls Weekend
reviews.text: Great resort in an excellent location. We enjoyed the shuttle service and sitting around the firepit in the evenings for cocktails and conversation. Only reserve was the service was super slow at the pool.

reviews.author: JazzMOAZ
reviews.title: Nice hotel, expensive food, underpoured drinks
reviews.text: We live in the area and frequented the bar and restaurant a lot when it was the Fire Sky Resort.  The new ownership has done a nice job at remodeling the facilities.  We had a bad experience at the restaurant a few months back and decided to try it again.  Well, our experience was very much the same as last time.  Still understaffed, service was extremely slow, and the quality of food was just so-so.  Drinks were very expensive – overpriced and underpoured.  Small pizza and four drinks came to $85 with tip.  $14 classes of wine and $13.50 mix drinks, and this was during “Happy Hour”.  Don’t mind paying those prices when the pours are fairly generous, but these were minimal pours at best. The hotel is obviously targeting tourists and business travelers and not locals, but it’s not that great of a hotel/resort to merit those types of prices, especially when the food is overpriced for what you get and the restaurant and bar service is so poor. It makes you feel like you are being gouged.  If you are staying there from out of town there are many great restaurants in the area with far superior food, drinks, and service for a lot less money.  As a local, this was the last time visiting the Scott Resort.

reviews.author: remigi01914
reviews.title: Awesome experience
reviews.text: My wife and I were looking for a place to spend a nice relaxing weekend. We absolutely loved The Scott! The service was immaculate and amenities tremendous! This is a great place for couples. I highly recommend it to anyone! We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: GreyJ008
reviews.title: Great location but understaffed and dated
reviews.text:
This could be a great hotel
Located close to the tourist area of Scottsdale and a short walk from Fashion Square Mall with lovely landscaped gardens
Not cheap....Us400 plus per night!!!
So what about coffee makers that only work some of the time, rooms that have a fleeting whiff of raw sewage, shower that was bordering on scalding and a restaurant trying to serve breakfast for the entire hotel with one server and a manager?
If you are going to pitch the place at this level you need to come up with the goods!
Not to mention tatty decor and tired fittings!
Actually enjoyed the stay because the staff are trying so very hard. Pity they are working with clay. 
Come on owners....invest some money, refurb, DON'T increase the rate and you will have a great business. Carry on the way you are and this place will die on it's feet!

reviews.author: rkherren
reviews.title: Nate The Great rounded off an excellent trip
reviews.text: Have you ever thought to yourself - I’d love to visit Cuba but I’m looking for a vibe that’s a little less socialism and a little more New Age? If so, this is yours and a Turkish towel’s dream landing spot. The hotel bar, The Canal Club, transports you to a Mad Men time if smoking were prohibited indoors. The staff is accommodating on all fronts, especially Nate the bellman with excellent food recommendations and wit as fast as the deadliest gunslinger. Highly encourage The Scott Resort & Spa and it’s Staff Member of the Month 36 months and counting - Nate.

reviews.author: davidalibby
reviews.title: Nate the bellman made my trip supreme
reviews.text: Looking for a great vacation in Scottsdale?! Then look no further than The Scott! Myself, my madam, and her best friend all spent 4 nights in this lovely throwback of a resort to old time Cuba. You'll begin by being greeted by a quaint warmth of nostalgia as you enter the lobby. Don't be fooled, for once this is a hotel lobby you will actually want to spend time in. As you walk past the canal club, the on-site bar with a feel for Havana and a taste for the exquisite, you walk out to the pool area, where you'll find yourself enthralled by the warm sunlight basking down on you as a light breeze glides through palm trees overhead. The poolside service is a social delicacy if ever there was one. While at The Scott, you will have an abundance of amenities on-site, but an even wealthier plethora exists in nearby Oldtown. Don't worry about needing to drive there and look for parking in your rental car (if you have one), the staff at The Scott will be able to more than accommodate you. This is the real meat & potatoes of the review. If you're anything like me, then you're always wanting to make the most of your vacations as a means for slacking off their other 50 weeks of the year. Thanks to Nate, who was leading up a team of extraordinary bellman, we were given an insider track on what restaurants, shops, & watering holes would most suit us. This is because Nate and his team took the time to get to know us and our interests in order to best determine what would guarantee our happiness as we visited Scottsdale. Whether you were traveling on foot, checking out the resort provided bikes, or riding with Nate in The Scott's escalade (3 mile maximum travel distance so please don't try to take advantage and ask for more than is providedby this complimentary service), you'll quickly find yourself having a great time exploring Scottsdale and relaxing. So if you want to make an excellent vacation choice, choose The Scott, but if you want to make a supreme choice then make sure Nate isn't going on vacation that week as well.

reviews.author: mmoon2018
reviews.title: Nate - Best Bellman Ever!!!
reviews.text: Not only is The Scott Resort ridiculously cute & amazing- so was Nate the Bellman! He gave us great recommendations on places to eat, bars, things to do and always offered to drive us if the venue was within distance. He was funny, accommodating & just all around awesome. Thanks for making our trip even more fun. Will definitely be back to the resort and hopefully see Nate again!

reviews.author: macey2951
reviews.title: Girls Night
reviews.text: We chose The Scott for a fun girls night and couldn’t have been more delighted with the experience. The rooms were awesome, the fun Cuban feel of the hotel just does not stop; the restaurant was amazing, the new menu is SO unique and yummy; the pool is always a plus, it takes you out of the desert and into an oasis... we loved every minute of our get away!!! We will be back!

reviews.author: Rachel J
reviews.title: Great staff but not great price for room
reviews.text: Rooms were in need of updating badly. Beds not very comfy. Hotel staff were very courteous and friendly. Avocado toast in canal restaurant was really good. Pools were nice and grounds were very pretty.

reviews.author: Rebelscumchic
reviews.title: Girls weekend trip
reviews.text: I was so looking forward to this stay with my gal pal. I searched and searched before booking this hotel. The front atrium is awesome, the location is fantastic and then we got to our room. Stained bedding, stains on walls, looks like a cheap remodel and this is not a cheap hotel. Very run down. I paid for a pool area view and we have a side view at best. Everything is ala carte and at this point I wish I hadn’t booked. I’d rather be at a Holiday Inn Express with a continental breakfast. I checked out the resort area that we paid a fee for on top of the room cost. There are tree branches and tons of leaves in the pool. Not the best. Had I not already been charged for the hotel, I would not stay another night.  Very disappointing.

reviews.author: Mary M
reviews.title: Amazing hotel, highly recommend!
reviews.text: The Scott Resort and Spa is a wonderful place to stay.  We stayed for three nights and enjoyed every minute of it.  The bed was so comfortable, it was the best I slept the whole vacation.  The staff was all very nice and helpful.  The free shuttle service was very convenient.  Two different pools are available, one for kids and one for adults, along with a bar in the pool area.  The massage was so amazing, definitely worth every penny.  If you are headed to Scottsdale, you have to stay at the Scott!

reviews.author: TeutonicMetal
reviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised
reviews.text: Stayed there for a business trip because the W was full and I was very happy. Rooms were great and the restaurant and bar areas were fantastic. The courtyard is a lush paradise where you feel miles away from downtown Scottsdale, while you are only walking distance away.

reviews.author: Ashley B
reviews.title: Love our visit but could tweak a couple things
reviews.text: Ahhhh upon walking into the lobby of the hotel of The Scott we were impressed. It is absolutely stunning! The grounds are immaculate. You must walk around and see all The Scott has to offer. Designer heaven! We truly enjoyed our stay here but feel The Scott could tighten up on a few things. Upon returning to our room around 4:30. Our room had not been clean. We had been gone since early in the morning. When mentioning something to the front desk; the attendant was quick to respond that the housekeeping has until 5:00 to clean rooms. I have never experienced this at any place I have stayed at until visiting The Scott. I was a bit disappointed in that. The pool area is amazing and relaxing. Get there early as spots fill up first thing in the morning. Around 11:00 people were circling around trying to find spots. The Scott also ran out of towels while we were at the pool as well. Many people had to wait around for quite sometime. Every morning and evening we would grab coffee or tea and sit around the patio near the fire pits. Such a breath of fresh air and a great spot to relax. It would take a while to find someone come take our order. The gym and the equipment is great. Like other reviews said; it is small and was very full during the morning hours; but an evening work out I was the only person in the gym.  The Scott seemed extremely understaffed for the amount of people staying there. Work out the kinks and this will be a top notch resort.

reviews.author: Colin B
reviews.title: Loved our time at The Scott
reviews.text:
Love this place. My wife and I stayed over Easter weekend and were really impressed. Upon arrival, you've got two parking options - valet or self-park. Most hotels of this caliber don't offer self-park and if they do, it's typically a hike from the lot to the hotel. Not so with The Scott. The lot is open and the closest spots are no more than 30 yards from the main building. Valets, whether or not you choose to park with them, are friendly, welcoming and helpful.

Check-in was seamless and friendly. It couldn't have taken more than five minutes from the time we approached the desk to the time we were handed room keys. One other note on parking: Our room was on the opposite side of the property from the main lot. You do have the option to pull your car around the building and closer to your room if you'd like. For us, the main parking lot was still so close that we simply walked our bags to the room, which, was clean with a beautiful view of the grounds, which transport guests from the bustle of one of greater Phoenix's bustling nightlife hubs to a quiet oasis.

The restaurant menu is a fusion of Caribbean-influenced dishes featuring fresh ingredients. One of the standout features is how tight the menu is. I like options as much as anyone, but at some point dishes begin to overlap and become unnecessary. The Scot has done a good job editing the menu. Recommended dishes: Shrimp ceviche; quinoa and arugula salad; doughnut holes. Drinks are extremely solid and, like the food menu, lean island-y; Hemingway Daiquiri, Cubano Viejo, El Floridita, etc. If you like rum, look no further.

Summary: Family friendly, but still quiet; top-notch hospitality; quality food and drink; convenience to everything Scottsdale has to offer. Enjoy!

reviews.author: Stuart B
reviews.title: Resort off the Main Street
reviews.text: I found the Scott Resort & Spa to be an exceptional facility. The rooms were clean, the food was exceptional, and the grounds were very special. You heard no noise from the street and the staff were unbelievably friendly. The location was close to everything.I would highly encourage everyone to come to this resort.

reviews.author: Emmanuelle
reviews.title: Scottsdale with a Cuban accent?
reviews.text: What a welcoming Resort! It is small enough to feel right at home and large enough to handle your next private event!  I really liked the many nooks and corners for guests to sit and relax in privacy.  The resort has a home feel to it, pool size is adequate.  Happy hour menu has a Cuban accent which is a nice addition to Scottsdale venues.

reviews.author: Marianne K
reviews.title: Amazing stay in Scottsdale
reviews.text: Lovely resort! intimate two story hotel surrounds an oasis of beautiful landscaping & pools.  Huge lobby area to hang out, have a drink or some food.  Staff was wonderful, helpful and good spirited. Restaurant and bar were great, breakfast was amazing, dinners and craft cocktail bar was very good as well. We visited with my 14 year old daughter and her friend and we all had a great time hanging out by the pools and playing games in the huge beautiful lobby area. Location was right in the middle of shopping, hiking & golfing. We'll be back!!!

reviews.author: ertoolan
reviews.title: Luxe and  fabulous hotel!
reviews.text:
We booked this hotel at the last minute after a long week of traveling In Sedona, Flagstaff and the Grand Canyon. We are so glad we did— it was the best way to end our spring break trip. We seriously considered moving our flights to stay an extra day! Highly recommend this hotel for families.

From my daughter:
The pool was amazing even with actual sand in it! The hotel overall was stunning. If we had arrived an hour before, we wouldn’t have been able to go in the pool for remodeling, and let me just say That the remodel was gorgeous! If you’re looking for a luxury hotel with the friendliest people you with ever meet, delicious food and a comfortable stay you’re in luck this is the place you to be! — Maeve, age 10

reviews.author: Daydream763604
reviews.title: Starts and Ends on a High Note
reviews.text: A favorite spot for Spring Training! The bellman are on top of everything, a smile to welcome you. great travel advice throughout the trip, and the unbeatably convenient and fun and laugh filled Shuttle rides for use during our stays are all reasons why I keep coming back year after year!

reviews.author: Rene B
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Had an amazing time for my birthday. The bell men were simply fantastic. The location was great for me to go out and celebrate and the weather was great as well. I will definitely be back. Service at the restaurants were great and the bell men really helped me out a lot! Thanks.

reviews.author: bkorg7
reviews.title: Great Service and Excellent Staff
reviews.text: I've been traveling to Scottsdale for many years, and initially chose this Resort as i'm familiar with the location.  Beyond the location, I wasn't certain as to many other details of the resort itself, and wasn't certain what to expect.  Well, those concerns were quickly put to rest, and the tone for great weekend of service was immediately set by the amazing Bellmen staff.  The Bellmen were able to assist with everything from luggage handling to simply offering a bottle of water after a long walk around the area.  It's this service that will bring me back to The Scott the next time I'm requiring a stay in Scottsdale.  Thanks again for the fantastic service.

reviews.author: Keenan V
reviews.title: Great Stay @ The Scott!
reviews.text: The room was very nice, quiet, cozy. Very clean property. Amazing service the entire time, especially from the bellman right from the start! Will definitely be staying here again for Spring Training next year.

reviews.author: Danica S
reviews.title: Amazing Staff!
reviews.text: I had a great solo trip! The food and drinks were great and I had a spa day that was perfect. The best part about my experience was the extremely helpful staff. I was absolutely mind blown how great they were, specifically Kevin who went out of his way to make sure I had everything I needed. I look forward to going back!

reviews.author: j0y76
reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: Everything from the location, to the ambiance of the hotel was fantastic!  There was only one thing that wasn't...and that was the bellmen, because they were beyond fantastic!  From being helpful at check-in, to helping with dinner recommendations, or just being nice guys to chat with, you've got a stellar team on your hands!  10/10 would come back for the staff, tip based shuttle, and that pool!

reviews.author: good2goAustin_TX
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
My rating is 3.5 stars for our stay. While the hotel is very pretty with lovely grounds, we had a few bumps with our stay. When we arrived at 5pm on Sunday the front desk informed us that the main pool would be closed all week for an emergency repair. Not to worry though because they have a second pool. Turns out the second pool is tiny with only a few chairs and not a lot of sun. Since we were traveling from Chicago on spring break, sitting by the pool in the sun was a big priority for us. And from what I could gather, the pool repair was not an emergency but rather they were simply refacing the deck. OK fine, that stuff needs to happen but I feel they should have called us a head of time to let us know so we could make other arrangements. To their credit when we asked to leave ahead of schedule they were very understanding and refunded our last night's stay so we could go to another resort. 

Other than the pool situation our stay was fine. The restaurant has good food, although a very limited menu and was slow and sleepy when we were there. One night for dinner we tried to order wine and they were out of the first three bottles we tried to order, but whatever, we eventually got a bottle that we enjoyed. As other reviewers have mentioned, the rooms are dated and in desperate need of an overhaul. Bathrooms are tiny and only one person can fit. The bathroom door opens right onto the toilet and one would get their knees banged if the door was opened while sitting. Not much to do for kids (and in fact I think this property would make a great adults only hotel). Close to shopping and restaurants but no view to speak of other than the pool area. Overall, it was a disappointing stay and probably wouldn't recommend to families unless close proximity to one of the baseball stadiums is the number one priority.

reviews.author: Margo D
reviews.title: Great Location!
reviews.text: We liked that the resort was very close to major shopping mall -- easy access to highways - close to old town with many stores and restaurants - within walking distance. Only negative would be the resort fee that was applied on a daily basis -- we will rethink staying at this resort next year because of this.

reviews.author: itsbudman
reviews.title: Bell Crew Are Awesome
reviews.text: Our stay was great and we loved The Scott. We have stayed all over Scottsdale but we just had to write a review on how well we were treated by all the staff but especially the Bell Crew. They were the first to start our stay off right, very knowledgeable and just made us feel like we have been here many times, when this was our first stay. These guys deserve cud-dos and we hope that the management knows how much these guys do to make us, the guests, feel welcomed. The advice they gave us for Old Town was the best. Thanks guys. Pat & Brenda ;-)

reviews.author: Budz4you
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text:
We just wanted to say that our stay was wonderful. Started right from our arrival with the Bellman. Nate was super curtious and very  knowledgeable of the entire area. Told us all the cool places to visit. Once inside the place, wow, gorgeous and the food matched the expectations we had. The rooms were nice and clean which is expected when you stay at a resort. We really had a blast in Scottsdale and owe a lot of it to our stay at The Scott. Thanks again! See you next season. 
B&B

reviews.author: Josh F
reviews.title: Perfection right from the start!!
reviews.text: I'm not the type of guy that writes reviews but I had to share my experience.  Not only was the hotel a in a perfect location but the outside bellman took care of everything!! They were so friendly and nice and really went above and beyond!! Do yourself a favor and stay at the Scott, you'll thank me for it.

reviews.author: myslj
reviews.title: Great new feel!
reviews.text: I loved the scott and all the new things they did to the lobby and bar area! The front desk and bell staff was friendly and helpful. Will stay there again!! Ive been there when it was the firesky. Cant wait to return!

reviews.author: Anthony_Matthias
reviews.title: DSM Midwest Group
reviews.text:
From the time you pull  you will be treated probably the best that you’ve ever been. When the staff opened the door and welcomed us to the property, My wife and I looked at each other and just smiled.  It was the friendliest greeting. We travel a lot and there tends to be a routine fever staff gets where they ask the same questions and repeat the same conversation with every guest so It’s a bit mundane once u have had that same greeting of how was the travels, where are you visiting from etc.. but right from the start we were asked what we enjoy doing. We minds well have been locals from that point because we got some insight to the places for the food we we were wanting and shopping spots. Of course the bellman plugged the hotels offerings in his mix and with good reason. We enjoyed the food to the spa and met every expectation he said it would. I think my wife went to the spa everyday but one. I just happen to see the bellman and asked if even for a guy would it be as great as she is claiming and the look on his face as he said absolutely sold me more than the words. Lol. Yup, he was right again. I wanted to be carried back the room so I didn’t have to use any muscles, which I’m sure if I requested it, the staff would have accomadated. Whenever we asked for something whether from the room or by the pool, I swear the staff must go through ninja training because you wouldn’t even hear them coming and then they appeared out of thin air to politely offer u whatever the request. It was fantastic. You can have all the luxurious ammendities piled high as the ceiling but if the service doesn’t match the quality of the surroundings then there is no point. The staff made the stay what it was. We were even greeted by name several times when passing someone who helped us previously. We felt as if they truly wanted us to be there and to come back and not one of them seemed like they were at work. My wife mentioned she didn’t see any staff on their cell phones either which may seem silly but in Paris we waited for almost 15 minutes for the porters attention while he giggled at his phone talking to someone. Since then it’s been something we (or her more or less) pays attention too. It was sad to come down to the last day and make our way back home. This will be our spot any and every time we are back in the AZ sunshine. We truly enjoyed our stay and the beds are fantastic. That’s always one of my major critiques but it passed with amazing comfort. If it fit in my suitcase I maybe would have attempted to take it with me. That was a first time for that comfort too being away from home. 
Thanks again and kudos. We were very impressed.

reviews.author: Pamela T
reviews.title: Production manager
reviews.text:
I was hesitant at first to stay there because I always stayed at.the Firesky on my previous business trips so I was not sure if it would meet my expectations. A business partner told me she had heard good reviews on The Scott so I went ahead and booked my room with them.
  I was pleasantly surprised. They not only met my expectations but far surpassed them. This place is great. Clean, friendly staff and beautiful surroundings. They have done an amazing job with the place.
      The restaurant food was prepared just right. From a business dinner to a simple hamburger out on the patio it left you feeling satisfied. The whole staff was helpful and pleasant at ten o'clock in the morning or eleven at night they always made you feel like they wanted to help you with whatever you were asking not like it was their job. I was blown away by how helpful the bell staff waa....
    They helped with transportation, dinner recommendations, and getting my things to the room. I usually rent a car so as not to worry about getting my clients or being on time for our meetings. They took care of everything. They got a car service to pick up my clients and bring them to the hotel or having the service waiting when it was time to go to a meeting. They are knowledgeable in all recommendations and the best way to get things accomplished so I could be on time and relax with my clients for drinks when the meetings were over. Fantastic job on your staff selection. Not just the bellman but all of them. 
   I will definitely be staying with you in the future. Keep things the way they are. 
Making business pleasurable

reviews.author: Maleficntt
reviews.title: Ring a Bell
reviews.text: The Resort and spa was a nice get away and amazing. What really stood out in my stay was the bellman. They were in point and extremely professional. The bellmen and the staff had great customer service.

reviews.author: Christopher H
reviews.title: Customer Service
reviews.text: I was impressed from the first foot out of my truck. The bellman and front desk crew treated me like a king and made each step feel like it was effortless. I couldn't have been more impressed with the hands on service that others provided as well. The food was good, the bar was ok (It took 9 minutes to get a bartender to notice me and it wasn't even busy.) I think the only staff that didn't do a completely amazing job must have been fairly new in their role and will just need a little more experience to learn how to complete their job with as much gusto as the rest of the team. I am glad I chose  The Scott and I have recommended it to several others already!

reviews.author: 986paolaw
reviews.title: Best Place Ever!!
reviews.text: The staff at The Scott Resort were super friendly and accommodating. The Resort is in a great location. From the moment you walk in the lobby is so inviting and warm. There are lots of areas to congregate with your travel partner or friends. Everything was great, the food the pool and spa.

reviews.author: Nshapi
reviews.title: They have work to do - to be worth the price
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Scott Resort during a Spring Training vacation.,While the hotel is nice enough from the outside and in the lobby, the room was so-so and lacked the amenities one would expect for the room & resort fee price. 

To start on a positive, the rooms were clean and conveniently situated on the property. We were on the second floor, not sure if there was an elevator in the building. It was nice to see that the Resort is dog friendly - they have bags and a nice area for the dogs to do their business. Now, onto the reason For this review: the beds were lumpy and slightly lopsided - maybe in need of turning the mattress? The air conditioning sounded like a helicopter getting ready to take off and we turned on as we were leaving and off when we came back to the room. Fortunately the weather was mild so the AC wasn’t essential. At this price point, details matter - no listing of TV channels or a place other than the toilet seat, to put your clothes when taking a shower. The walls between the rooms seemed pretty soundproof but you could hear everything out in the hall, at all hours of the night. The card key readers didn’t work well and often took half a dozen swipes to garner a green light. The two landline phones in the room were really old and did not work at all. 

Although I looked but didn’t ask, I did not see complimentary coffee service in the lobby. There are small Nespresso machines in the room but ours was not properly stocked and only had 1 regular pod. A true resort would a least have a bowl of apples for guests. The bar has a pay coffee service but they seemed disorganized and surprised a half dozen people showed up in the morning to get coffee. Bottled water in the room was not free and only if one knew to ask would they be given bottles of room temperature water. The Wifi was terrible and when I complained, the gentleman at the desk told me there was a trick to getting it to work. When we checked in, no mention of a trick or even if we needed a password for the WiFi. Due to our flight delay coming in, we were in a hurry to get to a previously booked spa appointment. No offer from check-in to take our bags to our room. 

The gym is dated and completely inadequate. I overheard someone giving a tour and she explained that it was ok that the gym was small because it was never full. Apparently this same gal doesn’t get to the gym much. It was full all 3 days we used it. The 4 pieces of cardio have their own TVs that don’t work and the weight benches are old as is the pull down machine. Again, not a problem if you are a lower end hotel, but not ok at the level this Resort is trying to achieve.

The bar and pool menu are quite nice and the appetizers we ordered were quite good. On the afternoon we arrived I was looking for a small snack or smoothie, they do not have anything for a small snack and the bars don’t have any fresh fruit for a smoothie. We used the spa services and they were good for facials and massages. 

The pools looked quite nice but our schedule did not allow for pool time. The Valet and shuttle service people were quite nice and helpful in terms of recommendations. Important to plan ahead if you are taking the free shuttle because it’s first come, first serve, and you may have to wait awhile for a ride. The shuttle only has 5 seats which seems inefficient for such a large vehicle. The Resort is conveniently located for Spring Training, Old Town, shopping and eating. 

All in all our stay was ok but not adequate for the price. I mentioned a few of my concerns upon checking out and was credited for the resort fee. Since resort fees are just up charges to make room prices look lower, the amenities one assumes the resort fee covers should work well. When expressing my concerns I was told of an upcoming remodel. IMHO the Resort would gain more goodwill and repeat business if they waited until after the remodel to charge such high rates. And at the very least, they should offer a coupon with a “come check us out after the remodel” discount.

reviews.author: Rick L
reviews.title: Nice, but not spectacular
reviews.text: An escape to the desert for a few days brought us to The Scott Resort. The resort is in a wonderful location; fairly close to wherever you might want to go in Scottsdale. They offer a free shuttle to any place within 3-miles of the resort. The lobby area is massive, newly renovated, and lovely. Our room was on the back side of the property, overlooking the parking lot. The rooms are fairly nice, but dated, and lack attention to detail. Our coffee maker didn’t work (we complained and it was replaced).  A huge improvement for 80% of the guests staying here would be the availability of an easy cup of coffee-to-go in the lobby or bar. Instead, there is a bartender required to be a barista and not seeming very happy about it while a line forms early in the morning. The bathroom sink makes a horrible belching noise when it drains. Frankly, we would just laugh as it burped. There’s no fan in the bathroom. Sheets are a bit stiff and starchy. The room is not very sound-proof. You can hear doors slam, people walking and talking in the hallway at all hours. Occasionally, they are drowned out by the loud air conditioning that ‘kicks in’ every 30 minutes or so. The room was just OK. Although it’s certainly an older property, the common areas are very nice and well-maintained. There is a nice pool area (managed very casually) and lots of comfortable outdoor seating in both the sun and shade. We’ve heard they are going to do some major remodeling of the guest rooms later this year. Certainly needed. I would consider returning after the work is done; but not necessarily beforehand.

reviews.author: MrsLive4ever
reviews.title: Wish I could give more stars
reviews.text: The people there are AMAZING! Each and every person I encountered from the front desk to the valet, to the bellhop to the waiters/waitresses to the bar was friendly, helpful and went out of their way to make the stay enjoyable. The same can't be said about the rooms. I attended a seminar at the Scott Resort and not wanting to stay in a "blocked" room since I brought the hubby and wanted him to be able to stay in the room if he so choose to, I upgraded to a "Lagoon View" room. Well, first of all, there are no elevators here so we had to stay in a first floor room. Secondly, we were so far from the lagoon we couldn't even see it let alone hear it (there are little waterfalls/babbling brooks). The room was dark, dreary and old. The room had a little mini bar with goodies and other essentials, but heaven forbid you get a paper cut! There was a mini "first aid kit" that had a bandaid in it....for SEVEN DOLLARS!! The hotel does NOT have a sundry shop! And if you want water!? Forget about it!! Oh they have water in the room for $5.00 (the size of a regular bottle of water) and $7.00 for a little bit larger bottle. Nickel and dime much?? Usually when I travel, I want to lounge in the bed in the morning....hating to get up and go to a conference.....but here I couldn't wait to get out of bed in the morning, as laying in the bed a few extra minutes resulted in a terrible backache. I really looked forward to this trip and although I enjoyed the seminar immensely, I'm afraid if I go back again, it will be to stay at the Embassy Suites across the street from the resort.

reviews.author: Soopergirl88
reviews.title: Stylish, but simple & over populated!
reviews.text:
The Scott is rebranded from what was formerly known as the Firesky Resort. We liked the stylish decor the moment we walked in and the gentleman at the front desk said that The Scott is inspirationally styled after Havana. I especially liked the branding and design of their printed materials ("Travel Log") that looked like a passport folder (see my photos).

Buildings
We stayed in the Estancia building and unfortunately, as soon as we entered, it smelled like feces! Was this a retirement home?! It seems like the circulation in the building is not very good. There is not a fan inside the room (aside from air conditioning) and the building could benefit from some open air. While we were on the first floor, our 'patio' was a a view of bushes and hotel pedestrian traffic behind it, however, we had to keep the patio door open to get some fresh air into the room. Good thing we journey with a travel candle too! Be gone, poo smell!

Rooms
Speaking of rooms, they are pretty old and simple without much style. It seems like much money was spent on outfitting the hotel common areas (lots of decorations and well thought out design). Hard to tell if the aging of the guest rooms was intentional or a sign of deterioration! (see my photos)

Being on the bottom floor, it was LOUD! We had a herd of elephants living above us and one can definitely hear the pipes and plumbing as soon as an elephant shower or toilet is flushed.

It seemed that our air conditioning was also not working/not responsive. When we arrived in our room, the inside temperature was reading 72F! We had it cooled to about 65F, but it sure didn't feel like 65F! We had to adjust the air conditioning often during our stay.

Bed and pillows weren't that comfy. Bed was wobbly and squeaky!

Type of Hotel Guests
The target guests at The Scott seems to be families with young kids and couples with families. Hence, if you're looking for a romantic couples or adult getaway, this is NOT your place! The hot tub and pool areas were very packed! Population density: overload!

Positive Aspects
Great styling and design. We loved sitting by the fire in the evening. The Scott is very conveniently located--within walking distance to Fashion Square shopping and restaurants nearby.

Innovative: I thought it was cool that the hotel had a phone number that you can text with questions and/or requests. The person on the other end was quick to respond, friendly and helpful. Way to get with the times!

I loved the Nespresso machine in the room. You don't see many hotels with this and the coffee is always delicious! 

Speaking of friendly, big kudos to the housekeeping staff. They were always smiling, willing to help and working hard. Thank you!

Overall, we came to The Scott during high season (Spring Training), so no surprise that families and kids were abound. Good thing the pool area was somewhat spacious and we could find lounge chairs--we liked one side of it that had 'fake sand' aka small granular rocks and especially enjoyed the reggae tunes that was always playing on the loudspeakers. Great choice of music and appropriate to the theme of The Scott!

reviews.author: sueellenj0hns0n
reviews.title: Love the Scott
reviews.text: Love everything new about the Scott. Loved it as the Fire Sky, love it the same as the Scott. Many of the same faces I have come to know with my visits there. From the bell men who greet you as you arrive, through the check in process, to having you bags delivered to your room by a handsome young man. A great experience.

reviews.author: Roughrider1
reviews.title: Amazing place in the heart of Scottsdale
reviews.text: Great little resort in the heart of Scottsdale. You are made to feel special with their service. From the front desk, to the restaurant, to the bell men. I loved the idea that there was free shuttle from the resort to spots in old town Scottsdale. The bell men were very attentive with the parking of my car and giving me help with dinning and night life suggestions in Scottsdale. Nice to be greeted with a friendly person when you drive into the resort.

reviews.author: neglegb
reviews.title: Beautiful, relaxing
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about the Scott. From the minute we arrived we were taken care of. The hotel, grounds and room were amazing. The bellmen especially were helpful and attentive. I would highly recommend the Scott for your stay in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: laurendankos
reviews.title: Bellman!
reviews.text: The Bellman at this resort were amazing! Extremely helpful and extremely attractive!! I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a high quality stay. Will be back in about a month! They were really friendly

reviews.author: ilovefood70
reviews.title: Very nice stay
reviews.text: We had a great time here. Really nice property, awesome location and great food. The restaurant closes down on the early side so it was hard to take advantage of the beautiful fire pits and have a night cap. Service at the pool is lacking so you just have to go inside to get what you want. Kids took over the one hot tub both days we were here, which was a bit disappointing. We were in a room that was overlooking the main street out front of the hotel so that, along with early morning deliveries on that side of the building, made for a lot of noise. I would just recommend not staying in building A on the street side.  The rooms on the other side overlooking the lagoon are probably fine. Overall, a very nice stay.

reviews.author: FreeholdNewJersey
reviews.title: A Real Jewel in the Dessert!
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed at The Scott for a few days to catch some Spring Training games. We've been coming to Scottsdale for over 20 years, and have always stayed at the same 2 higher end resorts each time. We took a chance on the Scott, after reading a few reviews, and I must say we could not have been more happy with our choice. The boutiquy Scott is about 1/2 the price of the other 2 higher end resorts we typically stay at, but it sure felt like the same high end resort to us. Check in went smoothly, though there is no elevator, our bags were delivered to our second story room, which was beautiful and overlooked the sparkling lagoon and pools. We also had a private balcony, which was HUGE!  Morning coffee there each day was a dream. The lobby was very new and modern, and bright and cheery too. Happy hour everyday outside on the back patio overlooking the pool, with a couple of fire pits made for a great early Happy Hour! Also, very convienietly located a mile from Old Town, great restaurants and shops too. The service provided was great, everyone was helpful and professional. There were a couple of things that could be better, even improved upon.....1.) the bathroom was very small, with the toilet almost leaning against the shower stall.....which was huge and very modern, though it dripped a bit. There was some unused space for the toilet against the opposite wall; a bit of a design issue. 2.) No elevators as previously mentioned, and 3.) if you didn't have a view room, you overlooked the parking lots. And most importantly, 4.) for us east coast early risers, coffee should be put out before 6:00 am...and sometimes it was after that when it first came out. And it wasn't free....$8 for the first 2 cups at the inside bar, but second cups were free. Just some very small issues.....in general, this was a top notch small resort that we think is really going to give the Phoenician and Gainney Ranch a run for their money! Bravo Scott......well done!!!

reviews.author: Sammileigh88
reviews.title: My go to hotel in Scottsdale!
reviews.text:
I can't say enough amazing words about The Scott Resort and spa. The staff treats me so well and always remembers my name. I came here for a girl's trip for spring training and it always exceeds my expectations.
Nate was especially wonderful. He was very accommodating and friendly. He definitely made our stay super fun and had great suggestions for our girls weekend! Definitely talk to Nate as soon as you arrive!

reviews.author: Alexa M
reviews.title: You don't need to leave, it's that great!
reviews.text:
If you do need to leave, there is car service within a certain mile radius and Nate was absolutely fantastic! The bar, the restaurant, the pool, the rooms everything was an incredible experience.

We couldn't have picked a better place to stay in Scottsdale!

- World is my Menu

reviews.author: Amanda L
reviews.title: Best Scottsdale Hotel & Staff
reviews.text:
I just got back from our annual Girls Trip to Scottsdale for Spring Training and had hands down the best trip yet!  The Scott Resort and Spa never ceases to impress and is easily my favorite hotel, definitely in Scottsdale, but honestly, probably my favorite hotel period! You simply can't get better and I will choose them every time I come into town!  

Nate, one of the bellmen was incredible! Such an asset to their team. He was polite and friendly, such a fun personality and made our stay that much better! Not to mention, their hotel shuttle that takes you anywhere within the 3 mile radius... WOW! Seriously, it can't get better... moral of the story... Stay at the Scott Resort and Spa and have Nate take care of your baggage and shuttling you around the town!

reviews.author: Mathew B
reviews.title: Arbitrary fees and uncomfortable beds
reviews.text:
First off, the property is in a very good location that is very close to old town, as well as Scottsdale stadium, Whiskey Row, nightlife, etc. The pool is really cool, and the property itself is beautiful. The staff was attentive, and the restaurant isn’t bad either. 

That being said, there is definitely some things that I wasn’t very happy with. To start, they charged us a $40 “resort fee” daily. Now, your guess is as good as mine as to what a “resort fee” actually is, or includes. Looks like they are taking after cell phone/cable companies with these arbitrary “fees”. When this property was owned by Kimpton resorts, there was no “resort fee” when we stayed here. 

Also, the beds were in really bad shape. The sheet that covered the mattress didn’t fit the bed, and left about a foot-and-a -half of exposed mattress at the foot of the bed. That’s kinda gross if you ask me. Also, the mattress was extremely uncomfortable and Was not conducive to a good nights sleep. I understand that someone else may think that mattress was wonderful, but for me, it absolutely was not. 

Bottom line, for the price they charge, and the all important “resort fee” that they apparently need, I would not recommend staying here, as you can find a much better deal with a much more comfortable bed in just as good of a location. Sorry, but Kimpton ran the place much better, as they seem to do with most of their places.

reviews.author: Bethany B
reviews.title: I wanted to love The Scott...
reviews.text:
But I don’t. We are here for our annual girls trip. Two of the girls have stayed here under previous management/ownership and raved about it. Unfortunately, it’s quite a bit different than their last experience. I will say the issues are not MAJOR but we like to have four days a year that we can pamper ourselves and stay in an awesome place and this is not it. 

Upon walking in the first impression is great but you quickly realize that the fancy atmosphere is a facade. The water pitcher in the entryway is so inviting, until you realize the fruit in the 
bottom of the pitcher is made of plastic and there are no hints of lemony goodness in your cup. However, there is a large basket of REAL lemons and limes right next to the facade. Alas this could sum up the entire experience of this resort. 

Now onto the real issues. Not enough service staff in the pool area. During I ur one pool day, the staff decided they were going to close the pool bar at 2:30 even though the poor guy (Nate - who was excellent and ran his tail off all day long) was serving most of the resort’s clientele at the time. 

WiFi did not work. I was comped the faster $15 per day WiFi but that only worked for a few hours. When we said something at the front desk, we were given an 800 number to “call and trouble shoot.” I’m sorry, but I believe that should be someone else’s job as we are here on vacation and it is a supposed amenity that’s offered. 

Our first meal here we were billed for a drink we didn’t order. When we asked what it was the waitress said “I don’t know...” and walked away to fix it. 

One of the beds was broken in our room. Maintenance was great and fixed it. 

The bartenders on the inside bar were busy stocking the bar and often ignored waiting customers. Not to mention the bar wasn’t stocked most of the time despite their “efforts”. They could not make a drink that was offered at the pool because they did not have the flavored vodka. Maybe go get it at the closed pool bar? They also said they did not have tonic water. Shocking for a bar. But they didn’t have a blender either. So....

And the issue that inspired this post.....it is our last night. We have been discussing how to spend our last evening here.  We’ve spent a lovely day traveling to Sedona (highly recommend) and we would like to relax for our last evening at The Scott. We decide it’s the perfect night for the hot tub. When we return and head back to our rooms to change, we see that the pool and hot tub are closed for a private event! The other pool is open but there is no hot tub on that side. Frustrating since we are paying customers who would like to use the amenities as well. 

Beautiful grounds, maintenance staff is amazing.  I wish the rest of the staff was as accommodating or even...nice. Overall I’d give it a C-

reviews.author: Debbie I
reviews.title: Grounds are pretty, Staff are friendly, Convenient to Old Town
reviews.text: The Scott is a nice, medium sized resort. The staff are very helpful, especially bellman Kevin. He was always willing to assist with transportation, answers to questions, etc. Expected the rooms to be a bit more updated for the cost (the bathroom had shower/bath combo with older faucets, the headboards were worn); and the card entry system needs some upgrading as we had to have our cards re-done several times. We were told that the rooms are being updated in May. Overall, very pleased with atmosphere and experience and would return.

reviews.author: paulfreeman2017
reviews.title: Professionally run and dial conference location
reviews.text:
The resort provided an intimate atmosphere within in a mid size resort that was ideal for a conference for 160 delegates as it allowed great networking amongst all attendees.
It is located  within easy walking distance to the old town off Scottsdale and a short drive to many quality restaurants. The lighting in the rooms was poor and an improved porter service would be helpful particularly to assist to carrying luggage up steep stairs to the second floor. The restaurant has a very limited lunch menu on Sundays .

reviews.author: KrisKnight
reviews.title: Nice stay - great staff - grounds are lovely
reviews.text: Had a nice visit at the Scott while in Scottsdale for spring training (a little over a mile walk to stadium).  This is the second time I have stayed at The Scott.  When we first arrived we were put  in kind of a run down room - but the hotel was very accommodating and moved us the next day to a much nicer room and view.  Had a wonderful breakfast at the on site restaurant - and there is always places to hang out for a cocktail - great vibe.  They have complimentary transportation that will take you to dinner, or activities within range - when available.  Staff friendly - would stay again.

reviews.author: Marina M
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience
reviews.text: Visited the lobby bar on multiple occasions for food/drink- bartenders Tom and Jackson are very nice and friendly & make GREAT drinks. Food is great as well. Beautiful atmosphere and the pool is nice. Sometimes there is a live band playing by the bar, which is nice entertainment if you're looking to relax. Definitely recommend checking it out.

reviews.author: Paul J
reviews.title: Unique Oasis
reviews.text: Rate 4.5. Wonderful time, beautiful property, great staff! (New mattress would get a 5). All new lobby, restaurant, pool and  common areas done magnificently. I understand that they will be remodeling rooms this Summer. All the more reason to go back!

reviews.author: Shannon M
reviews.title: Escape to Havana - Oh I Wanna!
reviews.text: This is a Cuban getaway right off the strip in the heart of Scottsdale but you feel like your world’s away and thrown back into Hemingway’s hideout!   The pools lit up by the flaming pedestals at night are gorgeous, and dining felt like I was in Casablanca!  Finally, most importantly, the bed was heavenly and the rooms were wonderfully spacious.  Definitely don’t miss!

reviews.author: wgzz
reviews.title: Great service. Good location. Beautiful Pool area.
reviews.text: Just stayed one night but loved this hotel. Staff is so friendly and they really work hard to ensure a good experience. Walking distance to the Fashion mall, many restaurants and the trailhead of Camelback mountain. Would stay here again!

reviews.author: Lauren B
reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text:
I like the place. 
My only reservation is that there is only one Jacuzzi. In winter, everyone, including screaming children and diapered babies love to swim with goggles and fins in the Jacuzzi. I would strongly recommend that a second jacuzzi - adult only be added. I also had a lot of problems with my room key (and was not the only one). 

Nice rooms.

reviews.author: Kyle R
reviews.title: Rindi Rolfing
reviews.text: Having traveled extensively all over the country with my husband for business, I can honestly say that this is one of my favorites!  The Scott has so much character.  At every turn there is something interesting to look at from the decor to the beautiful grounds.  The vibe of the whole place was so inviting, the service was excellent and the location can’t be beat.  This will definitely be our Scottsdale base whenever we are there.

reviews.author: KtBtluh
reviews.title: Exceptional service and great atmosphere
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at The Scott for a girls work trip! The staff was great and the shuttle service was so helpful. We appreciate everyone, especially Nate for going above and beyond! We would recommend this in a heart beat.

reviews.author: ahrensSL
reviews.title: Great grounds and terrific customer service!
reviews.text: Stayed here for a conference. Beautiful grounds! Loved being able to use the shuttle which brought us to hiking areas, Old Town (a must!), etc. Customer service here was absolutely amazing. Nate was the best and went out of his way to help- thanks Nate!!! And thanks to all the great staff who made this place great. I’ll be back for sure!

reviews.author: nicole s
reviews.title: Conference/sister-mother vacation
reviews.text:
Stayed here for a conference and my sisters and mother joined me. Beautiful landscape, sitting areas throughout property. 

Beautiful heated pools, nice hot tub. Many fire pits and sitting areas it was very nice. 

Rooms are smaller, but nice beds and pillows. Housekeeping was excellent. 

The location is perfect! You can walk many places and the hotel will drive you anywhere within a 3 mile radius and this service runs until 11pm. 

Camelback Mountain within a mile.  Hotel has free bicycles which we took to the Safeway Grocery store which was about 1.5 miles away.  Old Town Scottsdale is about 1.5 miles away- very nice area to walk around many great places to eat and get drinks. 

We felt extremely safe at all times of day and night.

reviews.author: jdgff
reviews.title: Worst bed/bedding, better off at Comfort Inn
reviews.text:
Will start with the positive. The lobby and grounds are beautiful. The pool area is serene and tranquil. The staff is very nice and helpful.
The rooms leave a lot to be desired. They are dated which is ok as I think they are trying to achieve a rustic Cuban atmosphere. Our mattress was very aged, you could feel every spring and it was very hard. The pillows have been well used, no shape left. The down comforter was matted and old. The outlet on a bedside lamp was broken so the prong was exposed. No bath mat. Only one coffee cup and one bathrobe. The towels are thin and there are no extras in the room. The tub faucet had far more than just a drip, more of a steady trickle. There is no fan in the bathroom so know and love your roommate. We did ask for some way to fix the bed after the first night, they came and placed a small board under the mattress which did not help at all. For the third night I just asked for a new room and the bed was a little better but certainly not what you would expect for a luxury hotel. The room was otherwise the same. I have stayed at a Comfort Inn with much nicer rooms and far superior bedding at a fraction of the cost. 
I will not stay here again if I come back for this conference next year.

reviews.author: MinnesotaMomma
reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text: Here again for business, this time with a few co-workers.   The staff was excellent and accommodating, especially Nate.  The hotel shuttle was super convenient and Nate was so friendly and helpful!  The pool is beautiful.   Always impressed!

reviews.author: David N
reviews.title: Great atmosphere and happy hour
reviews.text: The transformation of The Scott is underway and it's looking great.  The grounds are beautiful with many different intimate seating areas, some with waterfalls and near the pool.  The lobby area and bar are inviting and comfortable with an island motif.  My wife and I went for happy hour and we were quite happy with our choice.  Good small plates menu and the mixed drinks were excellent.  Very friendly and attentive service!  The pizza, shrimp ceviche and the tres leches in a jar dessert were all delicious.  The menu from the Canal Club restaurant looks tempting also.  We'll be back again!

reviews.author: Sheryl K
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at The Scott. The hotel is very chic with a calming feel. The decor is beautiful with nice touches . The outside has fire pits and hammocks. The staff was very kind too. Kevin always made sure we were comfortable and had what we needed! We loved the shuttle as well. They will give you a ride anywhere within a 3 mile radius .

reviews.author: TravelinGirl8875
reviews.title: Spring Training Doesn’t Get Any Better
reviews.text:
Exceptional location 5 minutes from Scottsdale stadium, Scottsdale Fashion Square and Salt River Talking Stick stadium.

Nate, the bellman took care of us before we even arrived by getting us set up for golf. Once we got there he and the rest of the staff, including Charlie, were exceptional. They took care of our every need, got us to the games, and even when I forgot stuff in our room at the end, Nate went and got it all for us and put it in my bags so that when we got back from the game we could go straight to the airport.

Beautiful Setting and delicious chiliquiles at the restaurant! It’s like staying in a beautiful home in the desert with wonderful people to take care of you.

reviews.author: Paul C
reviews.title: Needs new beds
reviews.text: One of the key reasons to spend a night in a hotel is to get a good sleep. Sorry to say but the Scott fails in this regard. The bed needed replacing. The pillows were exhausted. There was a refrigerator in the room but it was filled with expensive bar food. Access to the lobby was a hike and one had to venture outside. The hotel charged an additional resort fee to include WIFI that was slow and connected sluggishly. The Heating fan ran continuously. Lights were tilted and wattage was poor. The front desk was pleasant but made promises they did not keep. Will not be back.

reviews.author: Hotelieratwork
reviews.title: Can’t wait to return
reviews.text:
Was here for a reception and dinner pool party. Service and food Outstanding. Also had a tour around this Just fully refurbished Boutique Hotel (for US standards, being European it would be middle sized for us - nevertheless still impressive) . Great Spa and room facilities. 
Love the Cuban styling and details. Whenever my Travel takes me back to Phoenix/Scottsdale region I Will book it right away

reviews.author: Allison M
reviews.title: A great resort on the edge of Old Town Scottsdale
reviews.text:
We did a 4 night getaway at the Scott Resort and Spa for my birthday.  

The resort is charming, with a beautiful lobby and grounds.  Fire pits, water falls, lanterns in the trees, and sandy beach at the edge of the pool.  It had a cool, elegant vibe. 

The staff is first rate, friendly and helpful...and they wear charming seersucker jackets and bow ties.  There is a shuttle that will take you anywhere in the vicinity. But the resort is also walking distance to Old Town, so we enjoyed walking to and from restaurants and shops.  

And we felt very safe walking at night. 

The only part that was not ideal.. the mattresses in our room were too soft, bit saggy and need to be updated.  A man at the front desk said new mattresses are coming

reviews.author: skiwe
