reviews.title: Overpriced
reviews.text: Resort fee of $35 per day gets you not much. Wifi is spotty and keeps logging off. Restaurant is mediocre. Room spartan, mattress hard. Only one robe in a room that has 2 people registered to it, and yes, we did ask about this and we were told this was standard. Staff is trying to be helpful, but it's not enough to make up for what seem to be upper level decisions to cut corners. Should have stayed at Hampton or Hilton.

reviews.author: phoenixadvisor
reviews.title: Beautiful boutique hotel in busy Scottsdale area
reviews.text:
This hotel is a perfect getaway in a great location.  When you walk into the lobby it is decorated in a beautiful casual elegance.  There is a lobby bar with games to use while enjoying a bit off the menu or just a cocktail.  The restaurant is just off the main lobby (we didn't get a chance to dine) and there is a pool bar that you can take advantage while enjoying a cabana poolside at one of the two pools on property.  

We had a poolside, second story room that had a balcony overlooking the gorgeous grounds. (They were getting ready to have a wedding in the courtyard the evening we stayed)  The room was modernly decorated, hardwood floors in the entry, a marble shower, dual vanities that made it easy for 2 of us to get ready at the same time.  The bed was comfortable and there was a chaise lounge to sit and read. 

From the bellman, front desk staff, bartenders and the housekeepers, the staff was friendly and helpful.  We felt like they took the time to greet us every time we saw them in passing.  The staff mentioned a room renovation soon, but really the rooms were beautiful, so I can't imagine what they plan to do, but we can't wait to go back to see how they look after they remodel.  Definitely our go to resort when we need to be in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Melissa H
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: We love Nate! He is the best and came back to The Scott just for Nate and his awesome attitude! Nate was great and he never disappoints! Nate was able to get us reservations at Several restaurants and he took us every where we needed to go. Nate is just the best!!

reviews.author: Chris C
reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: We came in 2017 had an amazing experience. Nate was our man and took amazing care of us.  When booking our 2018 girls trip we knew the scott was our first choice. It was booked during the Phx open so we pushed our trip a week just to stay and have Nate take care of us.  He never disappoints—

reviews.author: Lara W
reviews.title: Concierge
reviews.text: Nate at The Scott was amazing. He got us into the most amazing restaurants that were booked. He was so helpful and kind. He drove us around and picked us up. He was very knowledgeable about all the fun things to do in Scottsdale. We came back to the Scott just for Nate. He’s the best. If you stay here please see Nate for all your Scottsdale needs.

reviews.author: debra
reviews.title: Not worth the price. Huge disappointment!
reviews.text: I expected more from this hotel then we received. The room is a bit shabby and the  towels are a dingy white. The room in general could’ve been cleaner, lots of dust & chipped painting, patchwork was obvious. In retrospect I should’ve booked at a Hyatt place as we were only here one night and flying out the next day.

reviews.author: Kathy D
reviews.title: The Scott Resort and Spa is beautiful!
reviews.text: The Scott is a really beautiful hotel, with lots of water displays and pools around the property and restaurant.  We enjoyed lunch outside by the pool and our meals were delicious and the service by Luis, was outstanding!!  Very well-prices as well.  We thoroughly enjoyed our afternoon at The Scott Resort.  The hotel is lovely at night with all the lights and Tiki torches.  Would love to stay here!

reviews.author: houriehc
reviews.title: Sister weekend retreat
reviews.text: We planned a getaway from 3 different states.  We came from nyc, atl, &sfo. The grounds are well kept, beautiful decor - we loved using the bikes! the staff very helpful and superb - especially bell service. Ari, Owen, Garrett, Nate best service, amazing. We had fun playing backgammon in lobby!;)

reviews.author: Roger L
reviews.title: Beautiful room
reviews.text: We truly enjoyed our time at The Scott.  The front desk was genuinely kind, hospitable and had the best customer service we have experienced in a world where customer service is lacking. We were extremely impressed with our room, the proximity to all the amenities and convenient parking.  A little detail that may get over looked was the curtains in the room.  They allowed for sound sleeping because of how dark our room was with them closed.  Very impressed with our stay and look forward to staying agaiun.

reviews.author: Brenda C
reviews.title: Great Location, beautiful grounds
reviews.text: This was our first trip to Scottsdale and first time we didn't rent a car.  The shuttle service provided by the hotel was a life saver.  The grounds are beautiful - little private areas here and there, with several fire pits.  Very relaxing and convenient to shopping and restaurants.

reviews.author: trix71
reviews.title: Nice resort; needs some attention
reviews.text: The overall resort is very nice, especially the pool areas, decor, and the location in Scottsdale is great. Unfortunately, the showers s*ck... no pressure, terrible shower head, pipes literally whine during shower. Service in the bar/lobby lounge was awful. They were terribly understaffed for a busy PGA tournament weekend when the hotel was at capacity. And the bartenders were rude to boot! Stay out of building one as it fronts busy road and traffic is loud. There is no elevator, though buildings are only two floors, something to consider if you get put on the second floor.

reviews.author: Divexcl50
reviews.title: Corporate meeting
reviews.text: Business gathering for 3 days of nonstop discussion.  All resort staff were professional and on point. Smooth check-in and warm welcome set the stay. The property is very clean and has a Caribbean atmosphere. The guest rooms are large, comfortable and quiet.  I hope to return soon.

reviews.author: Julie R
reviews.title: Resort was ok, spa was amazing!!!
reviews.text:
Overall, the place is clean the hallways smell really good, the rooms are average, overall facility is older than we thought it would be. We had good service the first day we sat outside by the pool, but we did go up to the bar to let someone know we were there. The second day we sat out at the pool for approx. 2 hours and not until 5 minutes before we left did anyone come up to us. However, we did book a couples massage and it was super impressive, our massage therapists were fabulous!!! Patrice and Stephanie listened to our needs and executed exactly what we wanted! 
Great location for hotel!

reviews.author: lilj3nj3n
reviews.title: Gorgeous Lobby
reviews.text: Loved our stay at the Scott. The lobby area was my favorite part. The decor was very stylish, had the "outside atmosphere" while being indoors. It was very relaxing. The rooms were very spacious and accommodating. Everything felt very elegant, but cozy. We stayed one night. Had dinner out, but when we returned, had cocktails at the lobby bar. The drinks were delicious. The seating in the lobby was comfortable. Will come back and stay there again.

reviews.author: RTNapa
reviews.title: What a gem!
reviews.text: What a wonderful experience from beginning to end!  The friendliness of the staff throughout and the beauty of the grounds were wonderful.  The unique vibe of the resort and creative culinary delights were pleasant surprises at every turn.  Even the meeting spaces were uniquely appointed and full of natural light and energy.  This is definitely a must-do-again experience!

reviews.author: Businesstraveler3169
reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.text:
We held a large event at this location and basically took over the entire property. The facilities are some of the most beautiful we have experienced. The staff could not have been more helpful. If I could give this place a higher rating I would. Chef Chris Castro is a very talented individual and will surely make their restaurant even more popular than ever. 
Hope to return with my spouse for some R&R.

reviews.author: Laura K
reviews.title: Beautiful Oasis
reviews.text: What a beautiful property! The lobby alone is worth the stay. Gorgeous & so relaxing. The pool is beautiful and unique with a sand entrance in one area. The cocktails were delicious too. The rooms are spacious & very clean. You feel like you've stepped into a cool sheik tropical oasis. I highly recommend this resort!

reviews.author: Elliott M
reviews.title: A moment away
reviews.text: This place can serve as OZ in the old classic. Not to a land ran by little people but of a desert into an island. If this place hand an ocean view and a beach I would be completely fooled. I only got to enjoy the weekend there but everything was worth going. I planned to go out but got so relaxed I grab a bottle of wine and stayed by the fire pit. Good job The Scott. I will see you again

reviews.author: EBN
reviews.title: Weekend trip with the Ladies
reviews.text: This hotel surpassed my expectations. The rooms were clean and the property was easy to get around.  The pool is amazing with all sorts of seating and Cabanas perfect for watching the kids in the middle of the day at the sandy beach entrance or great socializing over drinks with friends.  The Scott is centrally located to the Scottsdale night life but also walking distance to wonderful restaurants that are family appropriate.  The onsite café was a perfect fit for a light breakfast after a wonderful night sleep in the comfy beds.  My girlfriends and I couldn't have asked for a better fit for our stay!  I will definitely be back for another stay with or without the rest of the family;)

reviews.author: beckyhunter038
reviews.title: Weekend with girlfriends
reviews.text: Rooms were perfect. The layout of bathrooms were great. Loved the coffee machine. The had a shuttle to old Scottsdale. That was a plus. The Canal Club was awesome. All the fire pits were fun. We had brunch which was awesome and decided to have breakfast there again nextmorn.   Will diffently return

reviews.author: Marianne A
reviews.title: Great Ambiance!
reviews.text: This was a great place for our long getaway weekend!  The staff could not have been more nice and helpful.  Our room overlooked the garden and was well maintained and big.  The lounge area was stocked with various board games, chairs tables and fireplace.  We enjoyed playing cards in that area every day.  The our door fire pits was another great area to relax and enjoy our friends.

reviews.author: LarryJoeCaraway
reviews.title: Brunch with Mom
reviews.text: My mom and her best friends from high school stayed with you last week and my wife and I joined them for brunch on Sunday morning.It was a great meal! My wife especially loved the Chilaquiles and the Donut Holes. We sat in the patio near the pool and the atmosphere was very relaxed. The service was excellent.  A great experience all around. We will be going back soon.  Maybe next time we can take the time to have a drink in the Canal Club. That looked really cool.

reviews.author: PinkLemonTravel
reviews.title: Nice Pools, Excellent Service, Rooms a Little Small...
reviews.text: A very nice resort, the service of all staff was exemplary. The redesign of the main lobby area is wonderful, really nice attention to detail, and the pools were fantastic. The rooms are a touch on the small side, the bathroom in our king pool view room was the size of a lavatory on a plane. The only other detraction was being slugged for a resort fee when we'd already paid in full for our stay, I know it's becoming common practice in the US but the resort fee charge really is something that puts me off hotels. Especially when the hotel attempted to charge us a resort fee on a day when the main pool and only hot tub were closed for an event. Otherwise a great stay...

reviews.author: kkouklis
reviews.title: Over all a nice place
reviews.text:
A nice place.    Grounds are pretty, and  well maintained... lobby remodel is beautiful.   Makes you feel like your in the tropics lol... The bar has a great staff, very friendly and know there drinks... hotel staff is very friendly also, they always greeted us... as for our room, I had several things to say but after I found out they are going to be remodeled I decided to leave them alone.lol... my only complaint is the restaurant... wow.  I ate 1 breakfast and 1 lunch. In 7 days.. I was not going to try a dinner.  
Very limited menu and what is on it is not ok, at least for me. I don’t want purple potato’s for breakfast.. just not my cup of tea for food choices.  So we ate elsewhere for the week.  
My only suggestion is.  Change the menu in the restaurant...

reviews.author: Cheri K
reviews.title: Family Holiday
reviews.text: Great hotel for parking your car close to your room.  Hotel is in the middle of shopping and great restaurants and Old Scottsdale is walking distance.  Free parking.  Two pools with plenty of play area for families and quiet spots for couples and adults.  Bar service available at pool and plenty of sitting and lounging areas.  Large hot tub.   Restaurant is small but there is plenty of seating on patio with nice fireplace.  Great gathering location and so many places to just sit and visit or work or hang out.  Rooms are very clean and I love their Nespresso Coffee Maker :)

reviews.author: redstackpmc
reviews.title: Resort style in the city
reviews.text: Overall this was just above average.  The room decor and furnishings are dated and a bit worn.  Strange that when I asked for a newspaper I was directed to a convenience store a five minute walk away.  We paid an additional daily resort fee to access the pools one of which closed at 2 pm on a Sunday and use of a courtesy shuttle (only available for destinations within a three mile radius of the hotel). On the plus side the staff is very friendly and helpful, two pools are nicely landscaped.
